````javascript
import { Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { getDefaultRoute } from "../../utils/permissions.js";

/**
 * Dynamic Home Route redirect based on active user permissions.
 */
export default function DynamicHomeRedirect() {
  const { currentUser, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  if (!isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  return <Navigate to={getDefaultRoute(currentUser)} replace />;
}
````

````javascript
import { Truck } from "lucide-react";
import Card from "../ui/Card";

export default function TruckList({ title, trucks, status }) {
  // Determine styles based on whether it's 'available' or 'maintenance'
  const isAvailable = status === "available";
  const containerBg = isAvailable ? "bg-[#E2F4E9]" : "bg-[#E2EAF4]";
  const textColor = isAvailable ? "text-[#1C7351]" : "text-[#1B4B75]";

  return (
    <Card className="flex-1 flex flex-col max-h-[350px]">
      {/* shrink-0 keeps the title from shrinking when the list is long */}
      <h3 className="text-[16px] md:text-[18px] font-semibold text-gray-800 mb-4 shrink-0">
        {title}
      </h3>
      
      {/* overflow-y-auto adds the vertical scrollbar. pr-2 adds padding so the scrollbar doesn't overlap the items */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
        {trucks.map((truck, index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg font-semibold shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 hover:scale-[1.02] ${containerBg} ${textColor}`}
          >
            <Truck size={20} />
            <span>{truck}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/ui/MaintenanceStatus.jsx
export default function MaintenanceStatus({ status }) {
  // Set a fallback style in case the status is missing or unrecognized
  let colors = "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-300"; 
  
  // Normalize input: Convert to uppercase to prevent "Critical" vs "CRITICAL" bugs
  const normalized = status?.toUpperCase() || "";

  // Conditional Logic: Assign different color palettes based on the severity level
  // Logic follows a "Traffic Light" system: Red for Critical, Orange for Major, Yellow for Minor
  if (normalized === "CRITICAL") colors = "bg-[#FFEBEE] text-[#D32F2F] border-[#EF9A9A]";
  if (normalized === "MAJOR") colors = "bg-[#F9C5A0] text-[#B45207] border-[#D37B38]";
  if (normalized === "MINOR") colors = "bg-[#FFED96] text-[#8B6C05] border-[#AA8E30]";

  return (
    // Dynamic Class Name: We combine "static" styles (padding/font) with our "dynamic" color variable
    <span className={`px-3 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full border uppercase shadow-sm ${colors}`}>
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}
````

````javascript
  const variants = {
    "CREATED": "success",
    "UPDATED": "info",
    "DEACTIVATED": "danger", 
  };

    </Badge>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/ui/Avatar.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import { resolveMediaUrl } from "../../utils/media.js";

const SIZE_MAP = {
  xs: {
    container: "w-6 h-6 text-[10px]",
    icon: 12,
  },
  sm: {
    container: "w-8 h-8 text-xs",
    icon: 14,
  },
  md: {
    container: "w-10 h-10 text-sm",
    icon: 18,
  },
  lg: {
    container: "w-12 h-12 text-base",
    icon: 22,
  },
  xl: {
    container: "w-16 h-16 text-lg",
    icon: 28,
  },
  "2xl": {
    container: "w-24 h-24 text-2xl",
    icon: 42,
  },
  "3xl": {
    container: "w-32 h-32 text-3xl",
    icon: 56,
  },
};

/**
 * Reusable Avatar component conforming to MadayawGas UI standards.
 * Supports canonical relative media storage keys, direct URLs, graceful error fallbacks,
 * and standard responsive sizing.
 *
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {string} [props.src] - Direct image URL or base64 data
 * @param {string} [props.storageKey] - Canonical relative storage key
 * @param {string} [props.name] - User name or handle used for initials extraction
 * @param {"xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"|"xl"|"2xl"|"3xl"} [props.size="md"] - Preset sizing
 * @param {"circle"|"rounded"} [props.shape="circle"] - Border radius shape
 * @param {string} [props.className=""] - Additional custom classes
 * @param {string} [props.alt] - Accessible image description
 */
export default function Avatar({
  src,
  storageKey,
  name = "",
  size = "md",
  shape = "circle",
  className = "",
  alt,
}) {
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(false);
  const [imageLoaded, setImageLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Canonical or direct image resolution
  const resolvedUrl = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = src || storageKey;
    if (!raw) return null;
    return resolveMediaUrl(raw);
  }, [src, storageKey]);

  // Reset error state when source changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setImageError(false);
    setImageLoaded(false);
  }, [resolvedUrl]);

  // Extract initials
  const initials = useMemo(() => {
    if (!name || typeof name !== "string") return "";
    const clean = name.trim();
    if (!clean) return "";

    const parts = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      const first = parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      const last = parts[parts.length - 1].charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      return `${first}${last}`;
    }
    return clean.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }, [name]);

  const sizeConfig = SIZE_MAP[size] || SIZE_MAP.md;
  const shapeClass = shape === "circle" ? "rounded-full" : "rounded-2xl";
  const accessibleAlt = alt || (name ? `${name}'s avatar` : "User profile avatar");

  const hasValidImage = Boolean(resolvedUrl && !imageError);

  return (
    <div
      className={`relative inline-flex items-center justify-center select-none overflow-hidden shrink-0 font-bold tracking-wider bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs ${shapeClass} ${sizeConfig.container} ${className}`}
      aria-label={accessibleAlt}
    >
      {/* Background Initials or Icon */}
      {(!hasValidImage || !imageLoaded) && (
        <span className="flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full font-bold select-none">
          {initials || <UserRound size={sizeConfig.icon} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />}
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Actual Avatar Image */}
      {hasValidImage && (
        <img
          src={resolvedUrl}
          alt={accessibleAlt}
          onLoad={() => setImageLoaded(true)}
          onError={() => setImageError(true)}
          className={`absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-200 ${
            imageLoaded ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
          }`}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/ui/AvatarCropModal.jsx
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  Camera,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  RotateCw,
  RefreshCw,
  Check,
  X,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  Move,
} from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "./Modal.jsx";
import Button from "./Button.jsx";
import { compressAndPrepareImage } from "../../utils/imageCompressor.js";

const VIEWPORT_SIZE = 280; // Viewport dimension in px
const OUTPUT_SIZE = 512; // Final output canvas dimension in px

/**
 * Interactive Avatar Editor and Cropper Modal.
 * Provides circular viewport masking, mouse/touch dragging, zoom slider (1x-3x),
 * 90° rotation, and zero-dependency Canvas-based rendering.
 *
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Controls modal visibility
 * @param {File | Blob | string | null} props.imageSource - Image file, blob, or resolved URL
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Modal close handler
 * @param {Function} props.onSave - Callback receiving processed File: (file: File) => Promise<void> | void
 */
export default function AvatarCropModal({
  isOpen,
  imageSource,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}) {
  const [imageLoaded, setImageLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState("");
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  // Transform states
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [rotation, setRotation] = useState(0); // 0, 90, 180, 270
  const [pan, setPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  // Dragging states
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const panStartRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const imageObjRef = useRef(null);
  const [imageMeta, setImageMeta] = useState({ width: 0, height: 0, baseScale: 1 });
  const blobUrlRef = useRef(null);

  // Reset transforms
  const resetTransform = useCallback(() => {
    setZoom(1);
    setRotation(0);
    setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  }, []);

  // Cleanup blob URLs on unmount or source change
  const cleanupBlob = useCallback(() => {
    if (blobUrlRef.current) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrlRef.current);
      blobUrlRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Load image whenever imageSource changes or modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !imageSource) {
      cleanupBlob();
      setImageLoaded(false);
      setImageError("");
      return;
    }

    cleanupBlob();
    setImageLoaded(false);
    setImageError("");
    resetTransform();

    let srcUrl = "";
    if (typeof imageSource === "string") {
      srcUrl = imageSource;
    } else if (imageSource instanceof Blob || imageSource instanceof File) {
      srcUrl = URL.createObjectURL(imageSource);
      blobUrlRef.current = srcUrl;
    }

    if (!srcUrl) {
      setImageError("Invalid image source provided.");
      return;
    }

    const img = new Image();
    // Enable cross-origin loading if it's a remote URL
    if (srcUrl.startsWith("http://") || srcUrl.startsWith("https://")) {
      img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    }

    img.onload = () => {
      imageObjRef.current = img;
      const nw = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
      const nh = img.naturalHeight || img.height;

      // Base scale fits the shortest dimension to the viewport size
      const minDimension = Math.min(nw, nh);
      const baseScale = VIEWPORT_SIZE / (minDimension || VIEWPORT_SIZE);

      setImageMeta({ width: nw, height: nh, baseScale });
      setImageLoaded(true);
    };

    img.onerror = () => {
      setImageError("Unable to load the selected image. Please try another file.");
      setImageLoaded(false);
    };

    img.src = srcUrl;

    return () => {
      cleanupBlob();
    };
  }, [isOpen, imageSource, cleanupBlob, resetTransform]);

  // Pointer drag event handlers for mouse & touch
  const handlePointerDown = (e) => {
    if (!imageLoaded) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    dragStartRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    panStartRef.current = { ...pan };

    // Set pointer capture if available
    try {
      e.target.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // Ignored for environments without setPointerCapture
    }
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;

    // Boundary limits (prevent user from dragging entirely out of view)
    const maxPan = VIEWPORT_SIZE * zoom * 0.8;
    const nextX = Math.max(-maxPan, Math.min(maxPan, panStartRef.current.x + dx));
    const nextY = Math.max(-maxPan, Math.min(maxPan, panStartRef.current.y + dy));

    setPan({ x: nextX, y: nextY });
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e) => {
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    try {
      e.target.releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  };

  // Zoom slider change
  const handleZoomChange = (e) => {
    const val = parseFloat(e.target.value);
    setZoom(val);
  };

  // 90° Clockwise Rotation
  const handleRotate = () => {
    setRotation((prev) => (prev + 90) % 360);
  };

  // Zoom buttons
  const handleZoomIn = () => {
    setZoom((prev) => Math.min(3, +(prev + 0.2).toFixed(2)));
  };

  const handleZoomOut = () => {
    setZoom((prev) => Math.max(1, +(prev - 0.2).toFixed(2)));
  };

  // Render crop to Canvas and Save
  const handleConfirmCrop = async () => {
    if (!imageObjRef.current || !imageLoaded) return;

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const img = imageObjRef.current;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = OUTPUT_SIZE;
      canvas.height = OUTPUT_SIZE;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      if (!ctx) {
        throw new Error("Unable to initialize canvas context.");
      }

      // Smooth rendering
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
      ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";

      // Ratio from viewport dimension to final output canvas
      const outputScaleRatio = OUTPUT_SIZE / VIEWPORT_SIZE;

      // 1. Move origin to center of output canvas
      ctx.translate(OUTPUT_SIZE / 2, OUTPUT_SIZE / 2);

      // 2. Apply Pan adjusted for output canvas scale
      ctx.translate(pan.x * outputScaleRatio, pan.y * outputScaleRatio);

      // 3. Apply Rotation
      ctx.rotate((rotation * Math.PI) / 180);

      // 4. Apply combined scale (base fit scale * user zoom * output scale)
      const effectiveScale = imageMeta.baseScale * zoom * outputScaleRatio;
      ctx.scale(effectiveScale, effectiveScale);

      // 5. Draw image centered
      const drawX = -imageMeta.width / 2;
      const drawY = -imageMeta.height / 2;
      ctx.drawImage(img, drawX, drawY, imageMeta.width, imageMeta.height);

      // 6. Convert canvas to Blob
      const blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob(
          (b) => {
            if (b) resolve(b);
            else reject(new Error("Canvas to Blob export failed."));
          },
          "image/jpeg",
          0.92
        );
      });

      // 7. Create File and compress using shared utility
      const rawFile = new File([blob], "avatar.jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
      const preparedFile = await compressAndPrepareImage(rawFile, {
        maxDimension: 1024,
        maxSizeBytes: 5 * 1024 * 1024,
        quality: 0.88,
      });

      if (onSave) {
        await onSave(preparedFile);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to crop avatar image:", err);
      setImageError(err?.message || "Failed to crop and save avatar photo.");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={isProcessing ? undefined : onClose}
      title="Edit Profile Photo"
      subtitle="Drag to reposition, use the slider to zoom, or rotate your avatar photo"
      icon={Camera}
      maxWidth="max-w-md"
      closeOnBackdrop={!isProcessing}
      showCloseButton={!isProcessing}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center p-2 text-center select-none font-sans">
        {/* Error Alert */}
        {imageError && (
          <div className="w-full mb-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-red-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle size={16} className="shrink-0 text-red-600" />
            <span className="text-left font-medium">{imageError}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Viewport Frame with Circular Mask */}
        <div
          className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-inner cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing touch-none select-none"
          style={{ width: VIEWPORT_SIZE, height: VIEWPORT_SIZE }}
          onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
          onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
        >
          {/* Draggable & Scalable Image Layer */}
          {imageLoaded && (
            <div
              className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none will-change-transform"
              style={{
                transform: `translate(${pan.x}px, ${pan.y}px) rotate(${rotation}deg) scale(${
                  imageMeta.baseScale * zoom
                })`,
                transformOrigin: "center center",
                transition: isDraggingRef.current ? "none" : "transform 0.1s ease-out",
              }}
            >
              <img
                src={imageObjRef.current?.src}
                alt="Crop preview"
                className="max-w-none select-none pointer-events-none"
                style={{
                  width: imageMeta.width,
                  height: imageMeta.height,
                }}
                draggable={false}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Loading Indicator inside Viewport */}
          {!imageLoaded && !imageError && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white/70 gap-2">
              <Loader2 size={32} className="animate-spin text-[#FFDF2C]" />
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold">Loading photo...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Circular Mask Guide Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center">
            {/* Darkened mask around the circular aperture */}
            <div
              className="w-full h-full rounded-full border-2 border-white/80 shadow-[0_0_0_9999px_rgba(10,25,40,0.6)]"
              style={{ width: VIEWPORT_SIZE - 20, height: VIEWPORT_SIZE - 20 }}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Hint Overlay when image is ready */}
          {imageLoaded && (
            <div className="absolute bottom-2 inset-x-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xs text-white/90 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                <Move size={11} /> Drag to position
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ================= CONTROLS ROW ================= */}
        <div className="w-full max-w-[320px] mt-4 space-y-3.5">
          {/* Zoom Slider */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleZoomOut}
              disabled={!imageLoaded || zoom <= 1 || isProcessing}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-[#0A4B6E] disabled:opacity-30 transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Zoom Out"
            >
              <ZoomOut size={16} />
            </button>

            <input
              type="range"
              min="1"
              max="3"
              step="0.05"
              value={zoom}
              onChange={handleZoomChange}
              disabled={!imageLoaded || isProcessing}
              className="w-full accent-[#0A4B6E] h-1.5 bg-slate-200 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Zoom photo"
            />

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleZoomIn}
              disabled={!imageLoaded || zoom >= 3 || isProcessing}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-[#0A4B6E] disabled:opacity-30 transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Zoom In"
            >
              <ZoomIn size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Secondary Action Buttons (Rotate & Reset) */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 pt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRotate}
              disabled={!imageLoaded || isProcessing}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#BCE1F1] transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
            >
              <RotateCw size={13} />
              <span>Rotate 90°</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={resetTransform}
              disabled={!imageLoaded || isProcessing || (zoom === 1 && rotation === 0 && pan.x === 0 && pan.y === 0)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} />
              <span>Reset</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ================= MODAL FOOTER ACTIONS ================= */}
        <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isProcessing}
            className="rounded-full"
          >
            <X size={14} className="mr-1" />
            <span>Cancel</span>
          </Button>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleConfirmCrop}
            disabled={!imageLoaded || isProcessing}
            className="rounded-full bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold"
          >
            {isProcessing ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin mr-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <span>Saving...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Check size={14} className="mr-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <span>Save Avatar</span>
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

export const alertsApi = {
  /**
   * Retrieves all currently active and acknowledged driver emergency alerts.
   * Target endpoint: GET /api/operations/alerts/active
   *
   * @returns {Promise<Array<object>>} List of active alert objects
   */
  async getActiveAlerts() {
    const result = await apiClient("/operations/alerts/active");
    return result.data?.alerts || [];
  },

  /**
   * Retrieves details of a specific emergency alert.
   * Target endpoint: GET /api/operations/alerts/:id
   *
   * @param {string} id - Emergency alert UUID
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Alert detail record
   */
  async getAlertById(id) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/operations/alerts/${id}`);
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Acknowledges an active emergency alert by a supervisor.
   * Target endpoint: PATCH /api/operations/alerts/:id/acknowledge
   *
   * @param {string} id - Emergency alert UUID
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated alert record
   */
  async acknowledgeAlert(id) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/operations/alerts/${id}/acknowledge`, {
      method: "PATCH",
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Resolves an emergency alert with supervisor resolution notes.
   * Target endpoint: PATCH /api/operations/alerts/:id/resolve
   *
   * @param {string} id - Emergency alert UUID
   * @param {string} [resolutionNotes] - Operational notes explaining resolution
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Resolved alert record
   */
  async resolveAlert(id, resolutionNotes = "") {
    const result = await apiClient(`/operations/alerts/${id}/resolve`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: { resolutionNotes },
    });
    return result.data;
  },
};
````

````javascript
// src/api/apprehensions.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

/**
 * Driver Road Apprehensions API Service
 * Handles citation tracking, roadside violations, and settlement statuses.
 * Base Path: /api/operations/apprehensions
 */
export const apprehensionsApi = {
  /**
   * Retrieves roadside apprehensions list with filtering.
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/apprehensions
   *
   * @param {Object} [params] - { vehicleId, driverId, tripId, agency, status, startDate, endDate, search, page, limit }
   * @returns {Promise<{ apprehensions: Array, count: number, meta?: Object }>}
   */
  async getApprehensions(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.vehicleId) query.append("vehicleId", params.vehicleId);
    if (params.driverId) query.append("driverId", params.driverId);
    if (params.tripId) query.append("tripId", params.tripId);
    if (params.agency && params.agency !== "ALL") query.append("agency", params.agency);
    if (params.status && params.status !== "ALL") query.append("status", params.status);
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.search) query.append("search", params.search);
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/apprehensions${qs}`);

    if (Array.isArray(res?.data?.apprehensions)) {
      return {
        apprehensions: res.data.apprehensions,
        count: res.data.count || res.data.apprehensions.length,
        meta: res.meta || null,
      };
    }
    if (Array.isArray(res?.data)) {
      return {
        apprehensions: res.data,
        count: res.data.length,
        meta: res.meta || null,
      };
    }
    return { apprehensions: [], count: 0, meta: null };
  },

  /**
   * Retrieves single apprehension by UUID.
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/apprehensions/:id
   *
   * @param {string} id - Apprehension UUID
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async getApprehensionById(id) {
    if (!id) throw new Error("Apprehension ID is required");
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/apprehensions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    return res?.data || null;
  },

  /**
   * Updates status of an apprehension record (SETTLED, DISPUTED, CANCELLED).
   * Endpoint: PATCH /api/operations/apprehensions/:id/status
   *
   * @param {string} id - Apprehension UUID
   * @param {Object} payload - { status: 'SETTLED'|'DISPUTED'|'CANCELLED'|'RECORDED', notes?: string }
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async updateStatus(id, payload = {}) {
    if (!id) throw new Error("Apprehension ID is required");
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/apprehensions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/status`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res?.data || null;
  },

  /**
   * Records a road citation incident with ticket photo.
   * Endpoint: POST /api/operations/apprehensions
   *
   * @param {Object} payload - { vehicleId, driverId, tripId, citationTicketNo, violationType, apprehendingAgency, incidentTime, location, penaltyAmount, ticketMediaKey, notes }
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async recordApprehension(payload = {}) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/apprehensions`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res?.data || null;
  },
};
````

````javascript
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

/**
 * Fuel API Service
 * Handles vehicle fuel logging, fleet analysis, and summary telemetry.
 * Base Path: /api/operations/fuel
 */
export const fuelApi = {
  /**
   * Fleet-wide Fuel Analysis
   * Retrieves totals, average km/L, cost/km, and individual vehicle breakdowns.
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/fuel/analysis
   *
   * @param {Object} [params]
   * @param {string} [params.period] - 'today'|'yesterday'|'this_week'|'last_week'|'this_month'|'last_month'|'last_30_days'|'last_90_days'|'this_year'|'all_time'|'custom'
   * @param {string} [params.startDate] - ISO or YYYY-MM-DD
   * @param {string} [params.endDate] - ISO or YYYY-MM-DD
   * @param {string} [params.vehicleId] - Filter to specific vehicle asset UUID
   * @param {string} [params.fuelType] - 'DIESEL'|'GASOLINE'
   * @param {string} [params.sortBy] - 'fuelUsedLiters'|'fuelCost'|'distanceTraveledKm'|'kmPerLiter'
   * @param {string} [params.order] - 'DESC'|'ASC'
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} { period, fleetTotals, fuelTypesBreakdown, topEfficientVehicles, leastEfficientVehicles, vehicles }
   */
  async getFleetFuelAnalysis(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.period) query.append("period", params.period);
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.vehicleId) query.append("vehicleId", params.vehicleId);
    if (params.fuelType && params.fuelType !== "ALL") query.append("fuelType", params.fuelType);
    if (params.sortBy) query.append("sortBy", params.sortBy);
    if (params.order) query.append("order", params.order);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/fuel/analysis${qs}`);
    return res?.data || null;
  },

  /**
   * Single Vehicle Detailed Fuel Analysis
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/fuel/analysis/:vehicleId
   *
   * @param {string} vehicleId - Target vehicle UUID
   * @param {Object} [params] - { period, startDate, endDate, fuelType }
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Single vehicle telemetry & breakdown
   */
  async getSingleVehicleFuelAnalysis(vehicleId, params = {}) {
    if (!vehicleId) throw new Error("Vehicle ID is required");
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.period) query.append("period", params.period);
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.fuelType && params.fuelType !== "ALL") query.append("fuelType", params.fuelType);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/fuel/analysis/${encodeURIComponent(vehicleId)}${qs}`);
    return res?.data || null;
  },

  /**
   * Paginated or Filtered Fuel Intake Logs
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/fuel
   *
   * @param {Object} [params] - { vehicleId, driverId, tripId, fuelType, startDate, endDate, search, page, limit }
   * @returns {Promise<{ logs: Array, summary: Object, count: number }>}
   */
  async getFuelLogs(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.vehicleId) query.append("vehicleId", params.vehicleId);
    if (params.driverId) query.append("driverId", params.driverId);
    if (params.tripId) query.append("tripId", params.tripId);
    if (params.fuelType && params.fuelType !== "ALL") query.append("fuelType", params.fuelType);
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.search) query.append("search", params.search);
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/fuel${qs}`);

    if (Array.isArray(res?.data?.logs)) {
      return {
        logs: res.data.logs,
        summary: res.data.summary || null,
        count: res.data.count || res.data.logs.length,
        meta: res.meta || null,
      };
    }
    if (Array.isArray(res?.data)) {
      return { logs: res.data, summary: null, count: res.data.length, meta: res.meta || null };
    }
    return { logs: [], summary: null, count: 0, meta: null };
  },

  /**
   * Summary Fuel Statistics
   * Endpoint: GET /api/operations/fuel/summary
   *
   * @param {Object} [params]
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async getFuelSummary(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.vehicleId) query.append("vehicleId", params.vehicleId);
    if (params.fuelType) query.append("fuelType", params.fuelType);
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/fuel/summary${qs}`);
    return res?.data?.summary || res?.data || null;
  },

  /**
   * Records a vehicle fuel entry.
   * Endpoint: POST /api/operations/fuel
   *
   * @param {Object} payload - { vehicleId, litersPumped, totalCost, pricePerLiter, fuelStation, fuelType, odometerReading, receiptMediaKey, notes }
   * @returns {Promise<Object>}
   */
  async recordFuelEntry(payload = {}) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/operations/fuel`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res?.data || null;
  },
};
````

````javascript
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";

export default function CustomerPasswordStep({
  adminPassword,
  setAdminPassword,
  showPassword,
  setShowPassword,
  passwordError,
  setPasswordError,
  isVerifying,
  currentUser,
  onProceed,
}) {
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (adminPassword && !isVerifying) {
          onProceed();
        }
      }}
      className="px-8 pb-8 overflow-y-auto max-h-[85vh]"
    >
      <p className="text-gray-700 text-[15px] mb-6">
        For security, please enter your password to confirm this action.
      </p>

      <input
        type="text"
        name="username"
        value={currentUser?.username || ""}
        autoComplete="username"
        readOnly
        className="sr-only"
        tabIndex="-1"
      />

      <div className="relative mb-2">
        <input
          type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
          name="admin_confirm_password"
          id="admin_confirm_password"
          value={adminPassword}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setAdminPassword(e.target.value);
            if (passwordError) setPasswordError("");
          }}
          placeholder="****************"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          autoFocus
          className={`w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] text-gray-800 text-sm px-4 py-3.5 rounded-full outline-none focus:ring-2 ${
            passwordError
              ? "border-2 border-red-500 focus:ring-red-200"
              : "focus:ring-[#0B4A6E]/20"
          } pr-12`}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
          className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 cursor-pointer"
        >
          {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {passwordError && (
        <p className="text-red-500 text-xs ml-4 mb-4 font-semibold">
          {passwordError}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!adminPassword || isVerifying}
          className="w-full py-3.5 bg-[#C93B32] hover:bg-[#a8322a] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed border-none !text-white rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[11px] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          {isVerifying ? "VERIFYING..." : "PROCEED"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { formatPhilippineDateTime } from "../../../utils/date.js";
import { resolveMediaUrl } from "../../../utils/media.js";

function formatCurrency(val) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return `₱${num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

export default function ApprehensionDetailModal({
  isOpen = false,
  onClose,
  apprehension = null,
  canManage = false,
  onUpdateStatus,
}) {
  const [showPhotoViewer, setShowPhotoViewer] = useState(false);
  const [isUpdatingStatus, setIsUpdatingStatus] = useState(false);
  const [statusPrompt, setStatusPrompt] = useState(null); // 'SETTLED' | 'DISPUTED' | 'CANCELLED'
  const [resolutionNotes, setResolutionNotes] = useState("");

  if (!isOpen || !apprehension || typeof document === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  const ticketNo = apprehension.citationTicketNo || "N/A";
  const violation = apprehension.violationType || "Road Traffic Violation";
  const agency = apprehension.apprehendingAgency || "Traffic Enforcement";
  const penalty = Number(apprehension.penaltyAmount || 0);
  const status = apprehension.status || "RECORDED";
  const incidentTime = formatPhilippineDateTime(
    apprehension.incidentTime || apprehension.createdAt,
    { fallback: "—" }
  );
  const settledTime = apprehension.settledAt
    ? formatPhilippineDateTime(apprehension.settledAt)
    : null;
  const plate = apprehension.vehicle?.plateNumber || "N/A";
  const model = apprehension.vehicle?.model || "";
  const driverName = apprehension.driver?.fullName || apprehension.driver?.username || "Driver";
  const driverPhone = apprehension.driver?.phone;
  const tripNumber = apprehension.trip?.tripNumber;
  const notes = apprehension.notes;
  const mediaUrl = apprehension.ticketMediaUrl || resolveMediaUrl(apprehension.ticketMediaKey);

  const handleConfirmStatusChange = async () => {
    if (!statusPrompt) return;
    try {
      setIsUpdatingStatus(true);
      await onUpdateStatus(apprehension.id, {
        status: statusPrompt,
        notes: resolutionNotes || undefined,
      });
      setStatusPrompt(null);
      setResolutionNotes("");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to update status:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsUpdatingStatus(false);
    }
  };

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9990] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs p-4 animate-fade-in text-left"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-2xl w-full p-5 space-y-4 border border-slate-200/90 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative animate-scale-in max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 pr-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 border border-amber-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <FileWarning size={18} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-base text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">
                  Ticket #{ticketNo}
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                    status === "SETTLED"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200"
                      : status === "DISPUTED"
                      ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200"
                      : status === "CANCELLED"
                      ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200"
                      : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {status}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium mt-0.5">
                Logged road apprehension incident

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/25 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900/80 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg">
                    <Maximize2 size={13} />
                    <span>Click to enlarge photo</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="py-6 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs italic bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-200">

          {/* NOTES / REMARKS */}

            <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-200/70 text-xs md:text-sm text-slate-700 space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#6D8AA2] block">

              </span>
              <p className="italic leading-relaxed">{notes}</p>

          {/* SUPERVISOR RESOLUTION PROMPT */}
          {statusPrompt && (
            <div className="bg-amber-50/80 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3 animate-scale-in">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle size={16} className="text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-bold text-xs text-amber-900">
                  Confirm Status Change to {statusPrompt}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-900 mb-1">
                  Resolution Remarks (Optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={resolutionNotes}
                  onChange={(e) => setResolutionNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Fine settled at traffic office / ticket disputed..."
                  className="w-full text-xs p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="cancel"
                  onClick={() => setStatusPrompt(null)}
                  disabled={isUpdatingStatus}

                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="blue"
                  onClick={handleConfirmStatusChange}
                  disabled={isUpdatingStatus}
                  className="text-xs py-1"
                >
                  {isUpdatingStatus ? "Updating..." : "CONFIRM UPDATE"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Action Footer */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {canManage && status !== "SETTLED" && !statusPrompt && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStatusPrompt("SETTLED")}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 size={13} />
                <span>Mark Settled</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {canManage && status === "RECORDED" && !statusPrompt && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStatusPrompt("DISPUTED")}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <HelpCircle size={13} />
                <span>Dispute Ticket</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-6 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] shadow-2xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SHARED FULLSCREEN LIGHTBOX FOR CITATION PROOF */}
      {mediaUrl && (
        <DocumentViewerModal
          isOpen={showPhotoViewer}
          onClose={() => setShowPhotoViewer(false)}
          item={mediaUrl}
          title={`Citation Proof - Ticket #${ticketNo}`}
          defaultExpanded={true}
        />
      )}
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import SearchBar from "../../ui/SearchBar";

const STATUS_FILTERS = [

];

const AGENCIES = ["ALL", "LTO", "CTTMO", "PNP-HPG", "DPWH", "MMDA"];

export default function ApprehensionsControls({
  searchQuery = "",

  agencyFilter = "ALL",
  onAgencyChange,
  onRefresh,
  isLoading = false,
}) {

    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">

          >

            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Bottom Row: Status Filter Tabs */}

                }`}

                {s.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { ShieldAlert, AlertTriangle, FileWarning } from "lucide-react";
import ApprehensionsControls from "./ApprehensionsControls.jsx";
import ApprehensionsTable from "./ApprehensionsTable.jsx";
import ApprehensionDetailModal from "./ApprehensionDetailModal.jsx";
import ToastNotification from "../../ui/ToastNotifications.jsx";
import { apprehensionsApi } from "../../../api/apprehensions.js";
import { useRealtimeRefresh } from "../../../hooks/useRealtimeRefresh.js";

function formatCurrency(val) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return `₱${num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

const APPREHENSIONS_CACHE_KEY = "app_apprehensions_cache";

export default function ApprehensionsTab({
  canManage = false,
}) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [agencyFilter, setAgencyFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [selectedApprehension, setSelectedApprehension] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  // Cache Bootstrap
  const [apprehensions, setApprehensions] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(APPREHENSIONS_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(apprehensions.length === 0);

  // Fetch apprehensions list
  const fetchApprehensions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const params = {};
      if (statusFilter !== "ALL") params.status = statusFilter;
      if (agencyFilter !== "ALL") params.agency = agencyFilter;

      const res = await apprehensionsApi.getApprehensions(params);
      const list = res?.apprehensions || [];

      setApprehensions(list);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(APPREHENSIONS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to write apprehensions cache:", e);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch apprehensions:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [statusFilter, agencyFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchApprehensions();
  }, [fetchApprehensions]);

  // Real-time Socket.IO Sync
  useRealtimeRefresh({
    events: ["APPREHENSION_LOGGED", "APPREHENSION_STATUS_UPDATED"],
    onRefresh: fetchApprehensions,
    cacheKeysToInvalidate: [APPREHENSIONS_CACHE_KEY],
  });

  // Client-side search filtering
  const filteredApprehensions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return apprehensions;

    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return apprehensions.filter((item) => {
      const ticket = (item.citationTicketNo || "").toLowerCase();
      const plate = (item.vehicle?.plateNumber || "").toLowerCase();
      const driver = (item.driver?.fullName || item.driver?.username || "").toLowerCase();
      const agency = (item.apprehendingAgency || "").toLowerCase();
      const violation = (item.violationType || "").toLowerCase();
      const location = (item.location || "").toLowerCase();

      return (
        ticket.includes(query) ||
        plate.includes(query) ||
        driver.includes(query) ||
        agency.includes(query) ||
        violation.includes(query) ||
        location.includes(query)
      );
    });
  }, [apprehensions, searchQuery]);

  // Operational metrics
  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    let recorded = 0;
    let settled = 0;
    let totalFines = 0;

    apprehensions.forEach((a) => {
      if (a.status === "RECORDED") recorded++;
      if (a.status === "SETTLED") settled++;
      totalFines += Number(a.penaltyAmount || 0);
    });

    return {
      total: apprehensions.length,
      recorded,
      settled,
      totalFines,
    };
  }, [apprehensions]);

  // Status transition handler
  const handleUpdateStatus = async (id, payload) => {
    const updated = await apprehensionsApi.updateStatus(id, payload);
    setApprehensions((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updated } : item))
    );

    if (selectedApprehension && selectedApprehension.id === id) {
      setSelectedApprehension((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
    }

    setToast({
      type: "success",
      message: `Apprehension #${updated.citationTicketNo || id} marked as ${updated.status}.`,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden min-w-0 space-y-4 pb-2">
      {/* 1. TOP CONTROLS & STATUS FILTERS */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <ApprehensionsControls
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
          statusFilter={statusFilter}
          onStatusChange={setStatusFilter}
          agencyFilter={agencyFilter}
          onAgencyChange={setAgencyFilter}
          onRefresh={fetchApprehensions}
          isLoading={isLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. STAT CARDS SUMMARY (Branded Palette matching RecurringIssuesAnalytics) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 shrink-0">
        {/* Card 1: Total Citations */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-2xl p-4 md:p-5 border border-[#9BCBE3] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase">
              Total Citations
            </span>
            <p className="text-2xl md:text-[26px] font-bold text-[#1B4B75] mt-0.5">
              {metrics.total}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#588094] font-medium mt-0.5">
              Recorded road traffic citations
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 shadow-xs">
            <FileWarning size={24} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Open / Recorded Violations */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-2xl p-4 md:p-5 border border-[#9BCBE3] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase">
              Open Violations
            </span>
            <p className="text-2xl md:text-[26px] font-bold text-[#1B4B75] mt-0.5">
              {metrics.recorded}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#588094] font-medium mt-0.5">
              Pending supervisor settlement
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 shadow-xs">
            <AlertTriangle size={24} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Total Penalties */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-2xl p-4 md:p-5 border border-[#9BCBE3] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="min-w-0 pr-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase">
              Total Penalties
            </span>
            <p className="text-2xl md:text-[26px] font-bold text-[#1B4B75] mt-0.5 truncate">
              {formatCurrency(metrics.totalFines)}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#588094] font-medium mt-0.5">
              Aggregated fine liability
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 shadow-xs">
            <ShieldAlert size={24} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. MASTER APPREHENSIONS TABLE */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 w-full overflow-hidden">
        <ApprehensionsTable
          apprehensions={filteredApprehensions}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          onSelectApprehension={(item) => setSelectedApprehension(item)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 3. DETAIL MODAL & MEDIA VIEWER */}
      {selectedApprehension && (
        <ApprehensionDetailModal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedApprehension)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedApprehension(null)}
          apprehension={selectedApprehension}
          canManage={canManage}
          onUpdateStatus={handleUpdateStatus}
        />
      )}

      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <ToastNotification
          type={toast.type}
          message={toast.message}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/apprehensions/ApprehensionsTable.jsx
import {
  FileWarning,
  ShieldAlert,
  Truck,
  UserRound,
  MapPin,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
} from "lucide-react";
import Badge from "../../ui/Badge";
import { formatPhilippineDate, formatPhilippineTime } from "../../../utils/date.js";

function formatCurrency(val) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return `₱${num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function getStatusBadgeConfig(status) {
  const normalized = (status || "").toUpperCase();
  switch (normalized) {
    case "SETTLED":
      return {
        label: "SETTLED",
        variant: "success",
      };
    case "DISPUTED":
      return {
        label: "DISPUTED",
        variant: "info",
      };
    case "CANCELLED":
      return {
        label: "CANCELLED",
        variant: "neutral",
      };
    case "RECORDED":
    default:
      return {
        label: "OPEN",
        variant: "warning",
      };
  }
}

function getAgencyBadgeColor(agency) {
  const clean = (agency || "").toUpperCase().trim();
  if (clean.includes("LTO")) return "bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200";
  if (clean.includes("CTTMO")) return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-200";
  if (clean.includes("PNP") || clean.includes("HPG")) return "bg-purple-50 text-purple-800 border-purple-200";
  if (clean.includes("DPWH")) return "bg-orange-50 text-orange-800 border-orange-200";
  return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
}

export default function ApprehensionsTable({
````

````javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  RotateCcw,
  FileText,
  BarChart3,
} from "lucide-react";
import SearchBar from "../../ui/SearchBar";

const PERIOD_PRESETS = [
  { key: "today", label: "Today" },
  { key: "this_week", label: "This Week" },
  { key: "this_month", label: "This Month" },
  { key: "last_90_days", label: "3 Months" },
  { key: "6_months", label: "6 Months" },
  { key: "this_year", label: "12 Months" },
  { key: "custom", label: "Custom Range" },
];

export default function FuelControls({
  period = "this_month",
  onPeriodChange,
  startDate = "",
  endDate = "",
  onDateRangeChange,
  selectedVehicleId = "",
  onVehicleChange,
  trucks = [],
  searchQuery = "",
  onSearchChange,
  viewMode = "analytics", // 'analytics' | 'logs'
  onViewModeChange,
  onRefresh,
  isLoading = false,
}) {
  const [showCustomDates, setShowCustomDates] = useState(period === "custom");
  const [customStart, setCustomStart] = useState(startDate);
  const [customEnd, setCustomEnd] = useState(endDate);

  const handlePresetSelect = (presetKey) => {
    if (presetKey === "custom") {
      setShowCustomDates(true);
      onPeriodChange("custom");
      return;
    }
    setShowCustomDates(false);

    if (presetKey === "6_months") {
      const today = new Date();
      const sixMonthsAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      onDateRangeChange(
        sixMonthsAgo.toISOString().split("T")[0],
        today.toISOString().split("T")[0],
        "6_months"
      );
    } else {
      onPeriodChange(presetKey);
    }
  };

  const handleApplyCustomDates = (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (customStart && customEnd) {
      onDateRangeChange(customStart, customEnd, "custom");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {/* 1. Top Row: Search, Vehicle Filter, View Switcher & Refresh */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        {/* Search Bar */}
        <SearchBar
          placeholder="Search by vehicle plate, model, or driver..."
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
          onClear={() => onSearchChange("")}
          className="w-full max-w-md"
        />

        {/* Filter Controls & Actions */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 justify-end shrink-0">
          {/* Vehicle Filter Selector */}
          <select
            value={selectedVehicleId}
            onChange={(e) => onVehicleChange(e.target.value)}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white rounded-full border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold cursor-pointer shadow-2xs max-w-[180px]"
          >
            <option value="">All Vehicles</option>
            {trucks.map((t) => {
              const id = t.id || t.truckId;
              return (
                <option key={id} value={id}>
                  {t.plateNumber} {t.model ? `(${t.model})` : ""}
                </option>
              );
            })}
          </select>

          {/* View Mode Segmented Pill */}
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-full border border-slate-200/80 gap-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("logs")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                viewMode === "logs"
                  ? "bg-[#0B4A6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-xs"
                  : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-transparent"
              }`}
            >
              <FileText size={13} />
              <span>Fuel Log Entries</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("analytics")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                viewMode === "analytics"
                  ? "bg-[#0B4A6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-xs"
                  : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-transparent"
              }`}
            >
              <BarChart3 size={13} />
              <span>Vehicle Breakdown</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Refresh Action Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRefresh}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold text-xs px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95"
            title="Refresh fuel telemetry"
          >
            <RotateCcw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#0A4B6E] ${isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Bottom Row: Time Range Segmented Selector */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/80">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-full border border-slate-200/80 gap-1 overflow-x-auto max-w-full">
          {PERIOD_PRESETS.map((p) => {
            const isActive = period === p.key;
            return (
              <button
                key={p.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePresetSelect(p.key)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#0B4A6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-xs"
                    : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-transparent"
                }`}
              >
                {p.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Custom Date Pickers */}
        {showCustomDates && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleApplyCustomDates}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#E8F3F8] p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-[#9BCBE3] shadow-xs"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
              <input
                type="date"
                required
                value={customStart}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomStart(e.target.value)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
              />
              <span className="text-[#588094] font-bold text-xs">to</span>
              <input
                type="date"
                required
                min={customStart}
                value={customEnd}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomEnd(e.target.value)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#083853] text-[#FFDF2C] uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-2xs"
            >
              Apply
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
                          <Badge variant="neutral" className="px-2 py-0 text-[10px] font-bold">
                            {fuelType}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Volume (L) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">
                        {formatNumber(liters)}
                      </span>{" "}
                      <span className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold">L</span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Total Cost */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      <div className="font-bold text-[#1B4B75] text-sm">
                        {formatCurrency(cost)}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium mt-0.5">
                        ₱{formatNumber(pricePerLiter, 2)} / L
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Odometer */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      {odometer !== null ? (
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs md:text-sm">
                          {odometer.toLocaleString()} KM
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-300 font-medium">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Receipt Media Preview */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-center">
                      {hasReceipt ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (onPreviewReceipt) {
                              onPreviewReceipt({
                                fileUrl: log.receiptMediaUrl,
                                storageKey: log.receiptMediaKey,
                                fileName: `${plate} - ${station} Receipt`,
                                title: `${plate} - Fuel Receipt (${formatCurrency(cost)})`,
                              });
                            }
                          }}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                          title="View fuel purchase receipt"
                        >
                          <Eye size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                          <span>Receipt</span>
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-300 text-xs italic">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
  })}`;
}

function formatNumber(val, decimals = 2) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  });
}

export default function FuelMetricsSummary({
  fleetTotals = null,
  singleVehicleData = null,
  isSingleVehicle = false,
  period = null,
}) {

  if (!totals) {
    return null;
  }

  const fuelCost = totals.totalFuelCost ?? totals.fuelCost ?? 0;

  const distanceKm = totals.totalDistanceTraveledKm ?? totals.distanceTraveledKm ?? 0;

  const activeCount = totals.activeVehiclesCount ?? (isSingleVehicle ? 1 : 0);
  const totalFleetCount = totals.totalFleetVehiclesCount ?? null;

  const efficiencyRating = singleVehicleData?.efficiencyRating;
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/fuel/FuelMonitoringTab.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import FuelControls from "./FuelControls.jsx";
import FuelMetricsSummary from "./FuelMetricsSummary.jsx";
import FuelVehiclesTable from "./FuelVehiclesTable.jsx";
import FuelLogsTable from "./FuelLogsTable.jsx";
import DocumentViewerModal from "../../ui/DocumentViewerModal.jsx";
import { fuelApi } from "../../../api/fuel.js";
import { useRealtimeRefresh } from "../../../hooks/useRealtimeRefresh.js";

const FUEL_CACHE_KEY = "app_fuel_cache";
const FUEL_LOGS_CACHE_KEY = "app_fuel_logs_cache";

export default function FuelMonitoringTab({
  trucks = [],
}) {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState("this_month");
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");
  const [selectedVehicleId, setSelectedVehicleId] = useState("");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState("logs"); // 'logs' (default) | 'analytics'

  // Data States with instant local cache bootstrap
  const [analysisData, setAnalysisData] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(FUEL_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (parsed?.fleetTotals) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return null;
  });

  const [fuelLogs, setFuelLogs] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(FUEL_LOGS_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(!analysisData && fuelLogs.length === 0);
  const [previewReceipt, setPreviewReceipt] = useState(null);

  // Fetch telemetry
  const fetchFuelData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const params = {};

      if (period === "custom" || period === "6_months") {
        if (startDate) params.startDate = startDate;
        if (endDate) params.endDate = endDate;
      } else {
        params.period = period;
      }

      if (selectedVehicleId) {
        params.vehicleId = selectedVehicleId;
      }

      const [analysisRes, logsRes] = await Promise.all([
        fuelApi.getFleetFuelAnalysis(params),
        fuelApi.getFuelLogs(params),
      ]);

      if (analysisRes) {
        setAnalysisData(analysisRes);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(FUEL_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(analysisRes));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Failed to write fuel cache:", e);
        }
      }

      if (logsRes?.logs) {
        setFuelLogs(logsRes.logs);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(FUEL_LOGS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(logsRes.logs));
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Failed to write fuel logs cache:", e);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load fuel telemetry:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [period, startDate, endDate, selectedVehicleId]);

  // Initial & Dependency Fetch
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFuelData();
  }, [fetchFuelData]);

  // Real-time Socket.IO Sync on FUEL_LOGGED
  useRealtimeRefresh({
    events: ["FUEL_LOGGED"],
    onRefresh: fetchFuelData,
    cacheKeysToInvalidate: [FUEL_CACHE_KEY, FUEL_LOGS_CACHE_KEY],
  });

  // Client-side search filtering across vehicles
  const filteredVehicles = useMemo(() => {
    const list = analysisData?.vehicles || [];
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return list;

    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return list.filter((v) => {
      const plate = (v.plateNumber || "").toLowerCase();
      const model = (v.model || "").toLowerCase();
      const driver = (v.driver?.fullName || v.driver?.username || "").toLowerCase();
      return plate.includes(query) || model.includes(query) || driver.includes(query);
    });
  }, [analysisData?.vehicles, searchQuery]);

  // Client-side search filtering across individual logs
  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return fuelLogs;

    const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return fuelLogs.filter((log) => {
      const plate = (log.vehicle?.plateNumber || "").toLowerCase();
      const model = (log.vehicle?.model || "").toLowerCase();
      const driver = (log.driver?.fullName || log.driver?.username || "").toLowerCase();
      const station = (log.fuelStation || "").toLowerCase();
      return (
        plate.includes(query) ||
        model.includes(query) ||
        driver.includes(query) ||
        station.includes(query)
      );
    });
  }, [fuelLogs, searchQuery]);

  const handlePeriodChange = (newPeriod) => {
    setPeriod(newPeriod);
    if (newPeriod !== "custom" && newPeriod !== "6_months") {
      setStartDate("");
      setEndDate("");
    }
  };

  const handleDateRangeChange = (start, end, presetLabel) => {
    setStartDate(start);
    setEndDate(end);
    setPeriod(presetLabel || "custom");
  };

  const handleViewLogsForVehicle = (vehicleId) => {
    setSelectedVehicleId(vehicleId);
    setViewMode("logs");
  };

  // Find active single vehicle data if filtered
  const singleVehicleData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedVehicleId || !analysisData?.vehicles) return null;
    return (
      analysisData.vehicles.find(
        (v) => v.vehicleId === selectedVehicleId || v.id === selectedVehicleId
      ) || null
    );
  }, [selectedVehicleId, analysisData?.vehicles]);

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden min-w-0 space-y-4 pb-2">
      {/* 1. TOP CONTROLS & RANGE SELECTOR */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <FuelControls
          period={period}
          onPeriodChange={handlePeriodChange}
          startDate={startDate}
          endDate={endDate}
          onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
          selectedVehicleId={selectedVehicleId}
          onVehicleChange={setSelectedVehicleId}
          trucks={trucks}
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
          viewMode={viewMode}
          onViewModeChange={setViewMode}
          onRefresh={fetchFuelData}
          isLoading={isLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. SUMMARY METRICS CARDS */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <FuelMetricsSummary
          fleetTotals={analysisData?.fleetTotals}
          singleVehicleData={singleVehicleData}
          isSingleVehicle={Boolean(selectedVehicleId)}
          period={analysisData?.period}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 3. MAIN CONTENT: VEHICLE BREAKDOWN OR INTAKE LOGS */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 w-full overflow-hidden">
        {viewMode === "analytics" ? (
          <FuelVehiclesTable
            vehicles={filteredVehicles}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            onSelectVehicle={setSelectedVehicleId}
            onViewLogsForVehicle={handleViewLogsForVehicle}
          />
        ) : (
          <FuelLogsTable
            logs={filteredLogs}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            onPreviewReceipt={(item) => setPreviewReceipt(item)}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 4. SHARED DOCUMENT VIEWER FOR FUEL PURCHASE RECEIPTS */}
      <DocumentViewerModal
        isOpen={Boolean(previewReceipt)}
        onClose={() => setPreviewReceipt(null)}
        item={previewReceipt}
        title={previewReceipt?.title || "Fuel Purchase Receipt"}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
    if (valB === null || valB === undefined) valB = sortOrder === "asc" ? Infinity : -Infinity;

    return sortOrder === "asc" ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
````
