````javascript
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-md leading-relaxed">
                      No fuel consumption records were found for the selected period. Try adjusting your date range filter or vehicle scope.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              sortedVehicles.map((v) => {
                const vehicleId = v.vehicleId || v.id;
                const plate = v.plateNumber || "N/A";
                const model = v.model || "";
                const driverName = v.driver?.fullName || v.driver?.username || "Unassigned";
                const liters = Number(v.fuelUsedLiters || 0);
                const cost = Number(v.fuelCost || 0);
                const distance = Number(v.distanceTraveledKm || 0);
                const kmPerLiter = v.kmPerLiter !== null && v.kmPerLiter !== undefined ? Number(v.kmPerLiter) : null;
                const count = v.fuelEntriesCount || 0;
                const rating = v.efficiencyRating;
                const variance = v.varianceFromFleetAvgPercent;

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={vehicleId}
                    className="hover:bg-[#F4F9FC] transition-colors duration-150 group"
                  >
                    {/* Vehicle Asset */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs font-bold text-xs">
                          <Truck size={15} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] group-hover:underline text-xs md:text-sm truncate">
                              {plate}
                            </span>
                            {v.vehicleType && (
                              <span className="px-1.5 py-0 text-[9px] font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] rounded-md border border-[#BCE1F1]">
                                {v.vehicleType.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium block truncate max-w-[150px]">
                            {model || "Vehicle Asset"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Driver */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 font-bold text-[10px]">
                          <User size={12} />
                        </div>
                        <span className="truncate text-xs md:text-[13px] font-medium text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          {driverName}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Fuel Volume */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">{formatNumber(liters)}</span>{" "}
                      <span className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold">L</span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Total Cost */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right font-bold text-[#1B4B75] text-sm">
                      {formatCurrency(cost)}
                    </td>

                    {/* Distance */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs md:text-sm">{formatNumber(distance, 0)}</span>{" "}
                      <span className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold">KM</span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Efficiency (km/L) */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-center">
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                            {kmPerLiter !== null ? formatNumber(kmPerLiter, 2) : "—"}
                          </span>
                          {kmPerLiter !== null && (
                            <span className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold">km/L</span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {rating && kmPerLiter !== null && (
                          <span
                            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold mt-1 border ${
                              rating === "ABOVE_AVERAGE"
                                ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200"
                                : rating === "BELOW_AVERAGE"
                                ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-200"
                                : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {rating === "ABOVE_AVERAGE"
                              ? `+${variance}% vs Fleet`
                              : rating === "BELOW_AVERAGE"
                              ? `${variance}% vs Fleet`
                              : "Fleet Avg"}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Fill-ups */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-center">
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs border border-[#9BCBE3]">
                        {count}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Action */}
                    <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onViewLogsForVehicle && onViewLogsForVehicle(vehicleId)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#D2EAF7] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#9BCBE3] shadow-2xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                        title="View intake logs for this vehicle"
                      >
                        <span>Logs</span>
                        <ChevronRight size={13} />
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/AssignDriverModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { UserRoundX, Truck, Phone, Check } from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal";
import Button from "../ui/Button";

export default function AssignDriverModal({
  isOpen,
  truck,
  availableDrivers = [],
  allDrivers = [],
  onClose,
  onAssign,
}) {
  const [selectedDriverId, setSelectedDriverId] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");

  const currentDriverId = truck?.driverId || truck?.driver?.id || "";
  const currentDriverName = truck?.driver
    ? `${truck.driver.firstName || ""} ${truck.driver.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
      truck.driver.username
    : truck?.driverName && truck?.driverName !== "Unassigned" && truck?.driverName !== "No Assigned"
    ? truck.driverName
    : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && truck) {
      setSelectedDriverId(currentDriverId || "");
      setErrorMsg("");
    }
  }, [isOpen, truck, currentDriverId]);

  if (!isOpen || !truck) return null;

  const isDeactivated =
    (truck.status || "").toUpperCase() === "INACTIVE" ||
    (truck.status || "").toUpperCase() === "RETIRED";

  // Compile list of selectable drivers
  const selectableDrivers = [];

  if (currentDriverId && currentDriverName) {
    const matchedCurrent = allDrivers.find((d) => (d.id || d.value) === currentDriverId);
    selectableDrivers.push({
      id: currentDriverId,
      name: currentDriverName,
      phone: matchedCurrent?.phone || truck.driver?.phone || "",
      isCurrent: true,
    });
  }

  availableDrivers.forEach((d) => {
    const dId = d.id || d.value;
    if (dId !== currentDriverId) {
      const name = `${d.firstName || ""} ${d.lastName || ""}`.trim() || d.username || d.label;
      selectableDrivers.push({
        id: dId,
        name,
        phone: d.phone || "",
        isCurrent: false,
      });
    }
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (isDeactivated) {
      setErrorMsg("Cannot assign driver to a deactivated vehicle.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMsg("");
      await onAssign({
        truckId: truck.id,
        driverId: selectedDriverId || null,
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to assign driver:", err);
      setErrorMsg(err.message || "Failed to update driver assignment.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const footerContent = (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center">
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="w-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border border-red-200 mb-3 text-left">
          {errorMsg}
        </div>
      )}
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="yellow"
        disabled={isSubmitting}
        onClick={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider mb-2"
      >
        {isSubmitting
          ? "SAVING..."
          : selectedDriverId === ""
          ? "UNASSIGN DRIVER"
          : "CONFIRM ASSIGNMENT"}
      </Button>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="cancel"
        disabled={isSubmitting}
        onClick={onClose}
        className="text-xs"
      >
        CANCEL
      </Button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Assign Driver"
      maxWidth="max-w-lg"
      footer={footerContent}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4 text-left py-2">
        {/* VEHICLE CONTEXT BANNER */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border border-[#BCE1F1]/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Truck size={20} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-base leading-tight">
                {truck.plateNumber || "Truck"}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#588094]">
                {truck.model || "Isuzu Elf"} {truck.yearModel ? `(${truck.yearModel})` : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#588094] block">Current Driver</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {currentDriverName || "Unassigned"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* DRIVER SELECTION SECTION */}
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider">
              Select Driver <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">
              {selectableDrivers.length} {selectableDrivers.length === 1 ? "driver" : "drivers"} available
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[240px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
            {/* Option: Unassign Driver */}
            <label
              className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                selectedDriverId === ""
                  ? "bg-[#FEF6D1] border-[#F6C445] ring-1 ring-[#F6C445] shadow-2xs"
                  : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-[#BCE1F1] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8]/40"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="driverSelection"
                  value=""
                  checked={selectedDriverId === ""}
                  onChange={() => setSelectedDriverId("")}
                  className="sr-only"
                />
                <div
                  className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                    selectedDriverId === ""
                      ? "border-[#0A4B6E] bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white"
                      : "border-slate-300 bg-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  {selectedDriverId === "" && <Check size={10} className="stroke-[3]" />}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <UserRoundX size={15} className="text-slate-500" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    No Assigned Driver (Unassign)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </label>

            {/* Drivers list */}
            {selectableDrivers.map((driver) => {
              const isSelected = selectedDriverId === driver.id;
              return (
                <label
                  key={driver.id}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-[#FEF6D1] border-[#F6C445] ring-1 ring-[#F6C445] shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-[#BCE1F1] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8]/40"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="driverSelection"
                      value={driver.id}
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onChange={() => setSelectedDriverId(driver.id)}
                      className="sr-only"
                    />
                    <div
                      className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "border-[#0A4B6E] bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white"
                          : "border-slate-300 bg-white"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isSelected && <Check size={10} className="stroke-[3]" />}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">
                          {driver.name}
                        </span>
                        {driver.isCurrent && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold bg-[#BAE6FD] text-[#0A4B6E] px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full shrink-0">
                            Currently Assigned
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {driver.phone && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                          <Phone size={11} className="shrink-0" />
                          <span>{driver.phone}</span>
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </label>
              );
            })}

            {selectableDrivers.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-6 text-slate-400 text-xs">
                No active drivers available in directory.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/FilterPlantStock.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Funnel, Flame, Package } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * FilterPlantStock — Standardized popover filter dropdown for Plant Warehouse inventory.
 * Follows FilterItem and FilterCustomer design specifications.
 */
export default function FilterPlantStock({
  label = "Filter Stock",
  onApply,
  activeFilters,
  className = "",
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedContainerType, setSelectedContainerType] = useState(
    activeFilters?.containerType || "ALL"
  );
  const [selectedStockLevel, setSelectedStockLevel] = useState(
    activeFilters?.stockLevel || "ALL"
  );

  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const containerTypes = [
    { key: "ALL", label: "All Items" },
    { key: "CYLINDER", label: "Cylinders", icon: Flame },
    { key: "CANISTER", label: "Canisters", icon: Package },
  ];

  const stockLevels = [
    { key: "ALL", label: "All Stock Levels" },
    { key: "IN_STOCK", label: "In Stock (> 0 units)" },
    { key: "LOW_STOCK", label: "Low Stock (< 100 units)" },
    { key: "HAS_DEFECTIVE", label: "Has Defective Units" },
    { key: "HAS_EMPTY", label: "Has Empty Returns" },
  ];

  const handleToggle = () => {
    setIsOpen((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (next && activeFilters) {
        setSelectedContainerType(activeFilters.containerType || "ALL");
        setSelectedStockLevel(activeFilters.stockLevel || "ALL");
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setSelectedContainerType("ALL");
    setSelectedStockLevel("ALL");
    if (onApply) {
      onApply({
        containerType: "ALL",
        stockLevel: "ALL",
      });
    }
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleApply = () => {
    if (onApply) {
      onApply({
        containerType: selectedContainerType,
        stockLevel: selectedStockLevel,
      });
    }
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative inline-block text-left">
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleToggle}
        className={`bg-[#FCFEFE] hover:bg-[#F3F8FB] text-[#0A4B6E] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 h-[30px] min-w-[110px] justify-between cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${className}`}
      >
        <span>{label}</span>
        <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
      </button>

      {/* Popover Card Dropdown */}
      <div
        className={`absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-[290px] bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/20 rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-30 p-3.5 origin-top-right transition-all duration-150 ease-out ${
          isOpen
            ? "opacity-100 scale-100 translate-y-0 pointer-events-auto"
            : "opacity-0 scale-95 -translate-y-1 pointer-events-none"
        }`}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100 mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs">
            <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            <span>Filter Plant Stock</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Section 1: Container Type */}
        <div className="mb-3.5">
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
            Container Type
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {containerTypes.map((type) => {
              const Icon = type.icon;
              const isSelected = selectedContainerType === type.key;
              return (
                <button
                  key={type.key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedContainerType(type.key)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-[#F3F5F5] text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  {Icon && <Icon size={12} />}
                  <span>{type.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Section 2: Stock Level / Availability */}
        <div className="mb-4">
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
            Stock Availability
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            {stockLevels.map((lvl) => {
              const isSelected = selectedStockLevel === lvl.key;
              return (
                <button
                  key={lvl.key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedStockLevel(lvl.key)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-left transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold border border-[#BCE1F1]"
                      : "text-gray-700 hover:bg-slate-50 border border-transparent"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{lvl.label}</span>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#0A4B6E]" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2.5 border-t border-gray-100">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleClearAll}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Clear All
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleApply}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs font-bold rounded-full shadow-2xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          >
            Apply
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantActiveFilters.jsx
import { Funnel, X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * PlantActiveFilters — Removable active filter chips for Plant Warehouse page.
 * Follows ActiveItemFilters and CustomerActiveFilters specifications.
 */
export default function PlantActiveFilters({
  selectedContainerType = "ALL",
  selectedStockLevel = "ALL",
  onClearContainerType,
  onClearStockLevel,
}) {
  const stockLabels = {
    IN_STOCK: "In Stock (> 0)",
    LOW_STOCK: "Low Stock (< 100)",
    HAS_DEFECTIVE: "Has Defective",
    HAS_EMPTY: "Has Empty Returns",
  };

  const hasContainerFilter = selectedContainerType && selectedContainerType !== "ALL";
  const hasStockLevelFilter = selectedStockLevel && selectedStockLevel !== "ALL";

  if (!hasContainerFilter && !hasStockLevelFilter) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Active Container Type Filter Chip */}
      {hasContainerFilter && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Container:{" "}
            <strong className="font-semibold">
              {selectedContainerType === "CANISTER" ? "Canisters" : "Cylinders"}
            </strong>
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearContainerType}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove container filter"
            aria-label="Remove container filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active Stock Level Filter Chip */}
      {hasStockLevelFilter && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Stock:{" "}
            <strong className="font-semibold">
              {stockLabels[selectedStockLevel] || selectedStockLevel}
            </strong>
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearStockLevel}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove stock level filter"
            aria-label="Remove stock level filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantStockAdjustmentModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Package,
  Flame,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Warehouse,
  RotateCcw,
  AlertOctagon,
} from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "../../ui/Modal.jsx";
import Button from "../../ui/Button.jsx";
import { inventoryApi } from "../../../api/inventory.js";

/**
 * PlantStockAdjustmentModal — Standardized 3-Step Stock Adjustment Wizard for Bunawan Yard.
 * Conforms to AGENTS.md Section 4: [Step 1: Input] -> [Step 2: Confirm] -> [Step 3: Success View].
 * Streamlined specifically for supervisors to adjust Filled, Empty, or Defective balances.
 */
export default function PlantStockAdjustmentModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  plantStock = [],
  defaultProductId = null,
  initialCondition = "FILLED", // 'FILLED' | 'EMPTY_GOOD' | 'DEFECTIVE'
  onAdjustmentSuccess,
}) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1); // 1 = Form, 2 = Confirm, 3 = Success
  const [selectedProductId, setSelectedProductId] = useState("");
  const [targetCondition, setTargetCondition] = useState("FILLED");
  const [adjustMode, setAdjustMode] = useState("AUDIT"); // 'AUDIT' (Set Count) | 'ADD' (+ units) | 'DEDUCT' (- units)

  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState("");
  const [reasonPreset, setReasonPreset] = useState("Physical Count Verification");
  const [customNotes, setCustomNotes] = useState("");

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [successReceipt, setSuccessReceipt] = useState(null);

  // Initialize or reset state when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setStep(1);
      setError(null);
      setSuccessReceipt(null);
      setAdjustMode("AUDIT");
      setInputValue("");
      setReasonPreset("Physical Count Verification");
      setCustomNotes("");
      setTargetCondition(initialCondition || "FILLED");

      if (defaultProductId) {
        setSelectedProductId(defaultProductId);
      } else if (plantStock.length > 0) {
        const first = plantStock[0];
        setSelectedProductId(first.productId || first.product_id || first.id);
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, defaultProductId, initialCondition, plantStock]);

  const selectedProduct = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      plantStock.find(
        (p) => (p.productId || p.product_id || p.id) === selectedProductId
      ) || plantStock[0] || null
    );
  }, [plantStock, selectedProductId]);

  const isCanister = (selectedProduct?.containerType || selectedProduct?.container_type) === "CANISTER";
  const weight = selectedProduct?.netWeightKg !== undefined ? selectedProduct?.netWeightKg : selectedProduct?.net_weight_kg;

  const currentFilled = Number(selectedProduct?.quantityFilled ?? selectedProduct?.quantity_filled ?? 0);
  const currentEmpty = Number(selectedProduct?.quantityEmptyGood ?? selectedProduct?.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
  const currentDefective = Number(selectedProduct?.quantityDefective ?? selectedProduct?.quantity_defective ?? 0);

  let currentCountForTarget = currentFilled;
  if (targetCondition === "EMPTY_GOOD") currentCountForTarget = currentEmpty;
  if (targetCondition === "DEFECTIVE") currentCountForTarget = currentDefective;

  // Format loose vs crates helper
  const formatCratesText = (units) => {
    const u = Math.abs(Number(units) || 0);
    const crates = Math.floor(u / 24);
    const loose = u % 24;
    if (crates === 0) return `${loose} loose cans`;
    if (loose === 0) return `${crates} ${crates === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}`;
    return `${crates} ${crates === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"} + ${loose} loose`;
  };

  // Calculation of delta and resulting count
  const calculation = useMemo(() => {
    const rawVal = parseInt(inputValue, 10);
    const validNum = isNaN(rawVal) ? 0 : rawVal;

    let delta = 0;
    let resultingCount = currentCountForTarget;

    if (adjustMode === "AUDIT") {
      if (inputValue === "") {
        delta = 0;
        resultingCount = currentCountForTarget;
      } else {
        resultingCount = Math.max(0, validNum);
        delta = resultingCount - currentCountForTarget;
      }
    } else if (adjustMode === "ADD") {
      delta = Math.max(0, validNum);
      resultingCount = currentCountForTarget + delta;
    } else if (adjustMode === "DEDUCT") {
      delta = -Math.max(0, validNum);
      resultingCount = Math.max(0, currentCountForTarget - Math.max(0, validNum));
    }

    return {
      delta,
      resultingCount,
      currentCount: currentCountForTarget,
    };
  }, [inputValue, adjustMode, currentCountForTarget]);

  // Validation before proceeding to step 2
  const handleProceedToConfirm = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const val = parseInt(inputValue, 10);
    if (inputValue === "" || isNaN(val) || val < 0) {
      setError("Please enter a valid non-negative number of units.");
      return;
    }

    if (adjustMode === "AUDIT" && calculation.delta === 0) {
      setError("The verified count entered is identical to the current balance. No adjustment needed.");
      return;
    }

    if (adjustMode === "ADD" && val <= 0) {
      setError("Please enter a positive number of units to add.");
      return;
    }

    if (adjustMode === "DEDUCT") {
      if (val <= 0) {
        setError("Please enter a positive number of units to deduct.");
        return;
      }
      if (val > currentCountForTarget) {
        setError(
          `Cannot deduct ${val} units. Only ${currentCountForTarget} units are currently in ${targetCondition.replace("_", " ")}.`
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    setStep(2);
  };

  // Final submission to API
  const handleFinalSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const resolvedReason = customNotes.trim()
        ? `${reasonPreset}: ${customNotes.trim()}`
        : reasonPreset;

      const pId = selectedProduct.productId || selectedProduct.product_id || selectedProduct.id;

      const payload = {
        productId: pId,
        adjustmentType: adjustMode === "ADD" ? "SUPPLIER_PURCHASE" : "PHYSICAL_COUNT",
        targetCondition,
        newQuantity: adjustMode === "AUDIT" ? calculation.resultingCount : undefined,
        deltaQuantity: calculation.delta,
        reason: resolvedReason,
      };

      const result = await inventoryApi.adjustPlantStock(payload);

      // Invalidate caches
      localStorage.removeItem("app_plant_stock_cache");
      localStorage.removeItem("app_items_cache");

      setSuccessReceipt({
        productName: selectedProduct.productName || selectedProduct.product_name,
        targetCondition,
        previousCount: calculation.currentCount,
        delta: calculation.delta,
        resultingCount: calculation.resultingCount,
        reason: resolvedReason,
      });

      if (onAdjustmentSuccess) {
        onAdjustmentSuccess(result?.stock || result);
      }

      setStep(3); // Step 3: Success View
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Adjustment failed:", err);
      setError(err.message || "Failed to record plant stock adjustment.");
      setStep(1);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const conditionLabels = {
    FILLED: "Sale-Ready (Filled)",
    EMPTY_GOOD: "Empty Good (Returns)",
    DEFECTIVE: "Defective Units",
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Title and subtitle per step
  let modalTitle = "Adjust Plant Stock";
  let modalSubtitle = "Step 1 of 3: Enter physical count details";
  if (step === 2) {
    modalTitle = "Confirm Adjustment";
    modalSubtitle = "Step 2 of 3: Review balance changes";
  } else if (step === 3) {
    modalTitle = "Stock Adjusted";
    modalSubtitle = "Step 3 of 3: Inventory balance updated";
  }

  // Footer per step
  const renderFooter = () => {
    if (step === 1) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="cancel"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleProceedToConfirm}
          >
            <span>Review Adjustment</span>
            <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </Button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (step === 2) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="cancel"
            onClick={() => setStep(1)}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={13} />
            <span>Back to Edit</span>
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleFinalSubmit}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            <span>{isSubmitting ? "Recording..." : "Confirm Adjustment"}</span>
            <CheckCircle2 size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </Button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="primary"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6"
        >
          Done
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={modalTitle}
      subtitle={modalSubtitle}
      icon={SlidersHorizontal}
      onBack={step === 2 ? () => setStep(1) : null}
      maxWidth="max-w-lg"
      footer={renderFooter()}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4 text-xs text-left">
        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-[#C93B32] text-xs flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-[#C93B32]" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================= STEP 1: FORM ================= */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleProceedToConfirm} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Product Selector / Indicator */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Select Product
              </label>
              {plantStock.length > 1 && !defaultProductId ? (
                <select
                  value={selectedProductId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedProductId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/30 bg-white"
                >
                  {plantStock.map((prod) => {
                    const id = prod.productId || prod.product_id || prod.id;
                    return (
                      <option key={id} value={id}>
                        {prod.productName || prod.product_name} ({prod.containerType || prod.container_type})
                      </option>
                    );
                  })}
                </select>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-3 bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div
                      className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                        isCanister ? "bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E]" : "bg-[#FFF9D6] text-amber-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isCanister ? <Package size={16} /> : <Flame size={16} />}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                        {selectedProduct?.productName || selectedProduct?.product_name || "LPG Product"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                        {isCanister ? "Canister" : "Cylinder"} · {weight} kg
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 text-slate-700">
                    Selected
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Target Condition Selector Tabs */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Target Stock Condition
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTargetCondition("FILLED")}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    targetCondition === "FILLED"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-400 text-emerald-900 font-bold shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  <Warehouse size={14} className="mx-auto mb-1 text-emerald-700" />
                  <span className="block text-[11px]">Sale-Ready</span>

                </button>

                <button

                  onClick={() => setTargetCondition("EMPTY_GOOD")}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${

                      ? "bg-blue-50 border-blue-400 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  <RotateCcw size={14} className="mx-auto mb-1 text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                  <span className="block text-[11px]">Empty Good</span>
                  <span className="block text-[10px] text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold mt-0.5">
                    {currentEmpty.toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTargetCondition("DEFECTIVE")}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    targetCondition === "DEFECTIVE"
                      ? "bg-rose-50 border-rose-400 text-rose-900 font-bold shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  <AlertOctagon size={14} className="mx-auto mb-1 text-[#C93B32]" />
                  <span className="block text-[11px]">Defective</span>

                    {currentDefective.toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Adjustment Mode Selector */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">

              </label>

                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="block text-xs">Count Audit</span>
                  <span className="block text-[9px] opacity-80 mt-0.5">Set exact count</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAdjustMode("ADD");
                    setInputValue("");
                  }}
                  className={`p-2 rounded-xl text-center border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    adjustMode === "ADD"
                      ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E] font-bold shadow-2xs"
                      : "bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="block text-xs">Add Stock (+)</span>
                  <span className="block text-[9px] opacity-80 mt-0.5">Intake / receive</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAdjustMode("DEDUCT");
                    setInputValue("");
                  }}
                  className={`p-2 rounded-xl text-center border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    adjustMode === "DEDUCT"
                      ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E] font-bold shadow-2xs"

                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="block text-xs">Deduct (-)</span>

                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Value Input & Live Preview */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700">
                  {adjustMode === "AUDIT" && "Verified Physical Count (Units)"}
                  {adjustMode === "ADD" && "Units to Add (+)"}
                  {adjustMode === "DEDUCT" && "Units to Deduct (-)"}
                </label>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                  Current: <strong>{currentCountForTarget.toLocaleString()}</strong> units
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"

                      }`}
                    >
                      {calculation.delta > 0 ? `+${calculation.delta}` : calculation.delta}

            {/* Reason Presets & Optional Notes */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider">

              </label>
              <select

              >

                <option value="Dented Collar Defect">Dented Collar Defect (Quarantine)</option>
                <option value="Post-Dispatch Variance Adjustment">Post-Dispatch Variance Adjustment</option>
                <option value="Scrap Disposal Write-off">Scrap Disposal Write-off</option>
                <option value="Other / Special Reconciliation">Other / Special Reconciliation</option>

                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 text-xs text-slate-700 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/30 bg-white"

        {/* ================= STEP 2: CONFIRMATION ================= */}

                      : calculation.delta < 0

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 italic mt-0.5">

            <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-amber-900 leading-relaxed">
              <strong>Notice:</strong> This adjustment will immediately update Bunawan plant
              inventory and be visible across dispatching and route operations.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================= STEP 3: SUCCESS ================= */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="py-4 text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
              <CheckCircle2 size={32} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                Stock Adjustment Recorded
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Plant inventory balance has been updated successfully.
              </p>
            </div>

            {successReceipt && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl text-left space-y-2 text-xs max-w-sm mx-auto">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Product:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">{successReceipt.productName}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Condition:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                    {conditionLabels[successReceipt.targetCondition]}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Updated Balance:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800">
                    {successReceipt.resultingCount.toLocaleString()} units
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Reason:</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 italic truncate max-w-[200px]">
                    {successReceipt.reason}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantStockDetailPanel.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  RotateCcw,
  AlertOctagon,
  Warehouse,
  History,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  ArrowDownRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import { inventoryApi } from "../../../api/inventory.js";
import { formatPhilippineDateTime } from "../../../utils/date.js";

/**
 * PlantStockDetailPanel — Content body rendered inside SideDrawer for Bunawan Yard bulk inventory.
 * Follows CustomerDetailPanel pattern: clean section cards, visual gauge, and live adjustment history.
 */
export default function PlantStockDetailPanel({
  product = null,
  onOpenAdjustment,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const [adjustments, setAdjustments] = useState([]);
  const [isLoadingHistory, setIsLoadingHistory] = useState(false);

  const productId = product?.productId || product?.product_id || product?.id;
  const cType = product?.containerType || product?.container_type || "CYLINDER";
  const isCanister = cType === "CANISTER";

  const qFilled = Number(product?.quantityFilled ?? product?.quantity_filled ?? 0);
  const qEmpty = Number(product?.quantityEmptyGood ?? product?.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
  const qDefect = Number(product?.quantityDefective ?? product?.quantity_defective ?? 0);
  const totalUnits = qFilled + qEmpty + qDefect;

  const crFilled = isCanister ? Math.floor(qFilled / 24) : null;
  const crEmpty = isCanister ? Math.floor(qEmpty / 24) : null;
  const crDefect = isCanister ? Math.floor(qDefect / 24) : null;

  // Proportional percentages for visual progress bar
  const pctFilled = totalUnits > 0 ? Math.round((qFilled / totalUnits) * 100) : 0;
  const pctEmpty = totalUnits > 0 ? Math.round((qEmpty / totalUnits) * 100) : 0;
  const pctDefect = totalUnits > 0 ? Math.round((qDefect / totalUnits) * 100) : 0;

  // Fetch recent stock adjustments for this product
  const fetchAdjustments = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!productId) return;
    try {
      setIsLoadingHistory(true);
      const list = await inventoryApi.getPlantAdjustments({ productId, limit: 10 });
      setAdjustments(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to fetch SKU adjustment history:", err);
      setAdjustments([]);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingHistory(false);
    }
  }, [productId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAdjustments();
  }, [fetchAdjustments]);

  if (!product) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 text-left font-sans">
      {/* 1. TOTAL INVENTORY & PROGRESS GAUGE */}
      <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2.5 shadow-2xs">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider">
            Total Yard Stock
          </span>
          <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">
            {totalUnits.toLocaleString()} units
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Condition Distribution Bar */}
        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-slate-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden flex">
          <div
            style={{ width: `${pctFilled}%` }}
            title={`Filled: ${pctFilled}%`}
            className="bg-emerald-600 transition-all duration-300"
          />
          <div
            style={{ width: `${pctEmpty}%` }}
            title={`Empty: ${pctEmpty}%`}
            className="bg-[#0A4B6E] transition-all duration-300"
          />
          <div
            style={{ width: `${pctDefect}%` }}
            title={`Defective: ${pctDefect}%`}
            className="bg-[#C93B32] transition-all duration-300"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-[#475569] pt-1">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
            <span>Filled: {pctFilled}%</span>
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#0A4B6E]" />
            <span>Empty: {pctEmpty}%</span>
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#C93B32]" />
            <span>Defect: {pctDefect}%</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. THREE PHYSICAL CONDITION CARDS */}
      <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
        {/* Sale-Ready Filled */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Warehouse size={16} className="text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 block">Sale-Ready (Filled)</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569]">Ready for truck dispatch staging</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right shrink-0">
            <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 text-sm block">
              {qFilled.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            {crFilled !== null && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                {crFilled} {crFilled === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Empty Good Returns */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <RotateCcw size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 block">Empty Good (Returns)</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569]">Customer returns ready for refill dock</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right shrink-0">
            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm block">
              {qEmpty.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            {crEmpty !== null && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]/70">
                {crEmpty} {crEmpty === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Defective Units */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <AlertOctagon size={16} className="text-[#C93B32] shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 block">Defective Units</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569]">Damaged valves or leaking bodies</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right shrink-0">
            <span
              className={`font-bold text-sm block ${
                qDefect > 0 ? "text-[#C93B32]" : "text-slate-600"
              }`}
            >
              {qDefect.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            {crDefect !== null && qDefect > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#C93B32]">
                {crDefect} {crDefect === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. QUICK ACTION BUTTON */}
      {canManage && (
        <div className="pt-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenAdjustment && onOpenAdjustment(product)}
            className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#0E384E] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider active:scale-95"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span>Adjust Stock for This Product</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. RECENT STOCK ADJUSTMENT AUDIT LOG */}
      <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <History size={13} />
            <span>Recent Stock Adjustments</span>
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569] font-medium">
            {adjustments.length} logged
          </span>
        </div>

        {isLoadingHistory ? (
          <div className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-[#475569]">
            Loading adjustment history...
          </div>
        ) : adjustments.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3">
            No recent manual adjustments logged for this item.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-0.5">
            {adjustments.map((adj) => {
              const delta = Number(adj.delta_quantity ?? adj.deltaQuantity ?? 0);
              const isPositive = delta > 0;
              const targetCond = adj.target_condition || adj.targetCondition || "FILLED";

              return (
                <div
                  key={adj.id}
                  className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl space-y-1 text-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-[#0A4B6E]">
                      {targetCond.replace("_", " ")}
                    </span>

                    <span
                      className={`font-mono font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-0.5 ${
                        isPositive ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-rose-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isPositive ? <ArrowUpRight size={12} /> : <ArrowDownRight size={12} />}
                      <span>{isPositive ? `+${delta}` : delta}</span>

                  </div>

                  {adj.reason && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 italic truncate">

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 pt-0.5 border-t border-slate-200/60">
                    <span>
                      {adj.recorded_by_first_name

                  </div>

          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantWarehouseCards.jsx
import { Package, Flame, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * PlantWarehouseCards — Tactile cards grid view for Bunawan Plant Warehouse bulk inventory.
 * Clean, modern product cards with condition breakdown, crate counts, and quick adjust actions.
 */
export default function PlantWarehouseCards({
  items = [],
  selectedProductId = null,
  onSelectProduct,
  onAdjustProduct,
  canManage = true,
}) {

    return (

        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">No Plant Stock Logged</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#475569] mt-1">
          No inventory entries matching current search or filters.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      {items.map((item) => {
        const pId = item.productId || item.product_id || item.id;
        const isSelected = pId === selectedProductId;
        const pName = item.productName || item.product_name || "LPG Product";
        const cType = item.containerType || item.container_type || "CYLINDER";
        const isCanister = cType === "CANISTER";
        const weight = item.netWeightKg !== undefined ? item.netWeightKg : item.net_weight_kg;

        const qFilled = Number(item.quantityFilled ?? item.quantity_filled ?? 0);
        const qEmpty = Number(item.quantityEmptyGood ?? item.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
        const qDefect = Number(item.quantityDefective ?? item.quantity_defective ?? 0);
        const totalUnits = qFilled + qEmpty + qDefect;

        const crFilled = isCanister ? Math.floor(qFilled / 24) : null;
        const crEmpty = isCanister ? Math.floor(qEmpty / 24) : null;
        const crDefect = isCanister ? Math.floor(qDefect / 24) : null;

        return (
          <div
            key={pId}
            onClick={() => onSelectProduct && onSelectProduct(item)}
            className={`bg-white rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-150 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer select-none shadow-2xs ${
              isSelected
                ? "border-2 border-[#0A4B6E] bg-[#E8F3F8]/30 shadow-sm"
                : "border-[#CBD5E1] hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/50 hover:shadow-sm"
            }`}
          >
            <div>
              {/* Product Card Top Header */}
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">{pName}</h3>

                  }`}
                >
                  {isCanister ? <Package size={17} /> : <Flame size={17} />}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 3 Physical Condition Breakdown Strips */}
              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                {/* Sale-Ready Filled */}
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-emerald-50/70 border border-emerald-200/80 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-emerald-950 block">Sale-Ready Filled</span>

                      className={`text-sm font-bold block ${

            <div className="pt-3 mt-3.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569] uppercase font-semibold block">
                  Total Yard Stock
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{totalUnits.toLocaleString()} units</span>

                  >
                    <SlidersHorizontal size={12} />
                    <span>Adjust Stock</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantWarehouseControls.jsx
import { LayoutGrid, List } from "lucide-react";
import SearchBar from "../../ui/SearchBar";
import FilterPlantStock from "./FilterPlantStock";
import PlantActiveFilters from "./PlantActiveFilters";

/**
 * PlantWarehouseControls — Pinned controls bar for Bunawan Plant Warehouse.
 * Adheres to CustomerControls and ItemControls design specifications:
 * - Search bar on left
 * - Active filter chips, popover filter dropdown, and view switcher on right
 */
export default function PlantWarehouseControls({
  searchTerm = "",
  onSearchChange,
  onClearSearch,
  filters = {
    containerType: "ALL",
    stockLevel: "ALL",
  },
  onApplyFilters,
  onClearContainerType,
  onClearStockLevel,
  viewMode = "cards", // 'cards' | 'table'
  onViewModeChange,
}) {
  const handleSearch = (e) => {
    const val = e && e.target ? e.target.value : typeof e === "string" ? e : "";
    if (onSearchChange) onSearchChange(val);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    if (onClearSearch) onClearSearch();
    else if (onSearchChange) onSearchChange("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 sm:px-6 mb-3">
      {/* Left: Standard Search Bar */}
      <SearchBar
        placeholder="Search products by name or category..."
        value={typeof searchTerm === "string" ? searchTerm : ""}
        onChange={handleSearch}
        onClear={handleClear}
        className="w-full sm:w-64 md:w-72"
      />

      {/* Right: Active Filter Chips, Filter Dropdown, and View Switcher */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-end flex-wrap">
        {/* Active Filter Chips */}
        <PlantActiveFilters
          selectedContainerType={filters.containerType}
          selectedStockLevel={filters.stockLevel}
          onClearContainerType={onClearContainerType}
          onClearStockLevel={onClearStockLevel}
        />

        {/* Popover Filter Dropdown */}
        <FilterPlantStock
          label="Filter Stock"
          activeFilters={filters}
          onApply={onApplyFilters}
        />

        {/* Dual View Mode Switcher (Cards vs Table) */}
        {onViewModeChange && (
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-0.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#CBD5E1] h-[30px]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("cards")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer h-[26px] ${
                viewMode === "cards"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#475569] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/60"
              }`}
              title="Cards View"
              aria-label="Cards View"
            >
              <LayoutGrid size={12} />
              <span>Cards</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("table")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer h-[26px] ${
                viewMode === "table"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#475569] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/60"
              }`}
              title="Table View"
              aria-label="Table View"
            >
              <List size={12} />
              <span>Table</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border font-bold text-xs shadow-2xs h-[30px] ${

              ? "bg-rose-50 text-[#C93B32] border-rose-200"
              : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-slate-200"
          }`}
        >
          <AlertOctagon
            size={13}
            className={(metrics.totalDefective || 0) > 0 ? "text-[#C93B32]" : "text-slate-400"}
          />
          <span>{(metrics.totalDefective || 0).toLocaleString()} Defective</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Right: Action Controls (Adjust Stock + Refresh) */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0">
        {canManage && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenAdjustmentModal}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer h-[30px]"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            <span>Adjust Stock</span>
          </button>
        )}

        {onRefresh && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRefresh}
            disabled={isLoading}
            title="Refresh warehouse stock"
            aria-label="Refresh warehouse stock"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full text-slate-500 hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-slate-200 h-[30px] w-[30px] flex items-center justify-center"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/plant/PlantWarehouseTable.jsx
import { Package, Flame, SlidersHorizontal, ChevronRight, AlertOctagon } from "lucide-react";
import { formatPhilippineDateShort, formatPhilippineTime } from "../../../utils/date.js";

/**
 * PlantWarehouseTable — Master high-density table for Bunawan Plant Warehouse bulk inventory.
 * Conforms to AGENTS.md Section 3.D: sticky header, independent scroll container, row hover/select states.
 */
export default function PlantWarehouseTable({
  items = [],
  selectedProductId = null,
  onSelectProduct,
  onAdjustProduct,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#CBD5E1] shadow-2xs overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        <table className="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse min-w-[750px]">
          {/* STICKY TABLE HEADER */}
          <thead className="sticky top-0 z-10 select-none">
            <tr className="bg-[#0D4B6E] text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold shadow-xs">
              <th className="py-3 px-4">Product & Specification</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">Sale-Ready (Filled)</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">Empty Good (Returns)</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">Defective Units</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">Total Yard Stock</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">Last Updated</th>
              <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          {/* TABLE BODY */}
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 bg-white">
            {items.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={7} className="py-14 text-center text-slate-500">
                  <Package size={30} className="mx-auto text-slate-400 mb-2" />
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 text-sm">No plant stock items found</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                    Try adjusting your search query or filter criteria.
                  </p>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              items.map((item) => {
                const pId = item.productId || item.product_id || item.id;
                const isSelected = pId === selectedProductId;
                const cType = item.containerType || item.container_type || "CYLINDER";
                const isCanister = cType === "CANISTER";
                const weight = item.netWeightKg !== undefined ? item.netWeightKg : item.net_weight_kg;

                const qFilled = Number(item.quantityFilled ?? item.quantity_filled ?? 0);
                const qEmpty = Number(item.quantityEmptyGood ?? item.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
                const qDefect = Number(item.quantityDefective ?? item.quantity_defective ?? 0);
                const totalUnits = qFilled + qEmpty + qDefect;

                const crFilled = isCanister ? Math.floor(qFilled / 24) : null;
                const crEmpty = isCanister ? Math.floor(qEmpty / 24) : null;
                const crDefect = isCanister ? Math.floor(qDefect / 24) : null;

                const lastUpdatedDate = item.lastCountedAt || item.updatedAt || item.updated_at;

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={pId}
                    onClick={() => onSelectProduct && onSelectProduct(item)}
                    className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold"
                        : "hover:bg-[#F4F9FC]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Product & Specification */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                            isCanister ? "bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E]" : "bg-[#FFF9D6] text-amber-700"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isCanister ? <Package size={16} /> : <Flame size={16} />}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs">
                            {item.productName || item.product_name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[#475569] flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                              {isCanister ? "Canister" : "Cylinder"}
                            </span>
                            <span>·</span>
                            <span>{weight} kg</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Sale-Ready Filled */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 text-xs block">
                        {qFilled.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      {crFilled !== null && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 block">
                          {crFilled} {crFilled === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Empty Good Returns */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs block">
                        {qEmpty.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      {crEmpty !== null && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]/70 block">
                          {crEmpty} {crEmpty === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Defective Units */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <span
                        className={`font-bold text-xs block ${
                          qDefect > 0 ? "text-[#C93B32]" : "text-slate-500"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {qDefect.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      {crDefect !== null && qDefect > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#C93B32]/80 block">
                          {crDefect} {crDefect === 1 ? "crate" : "crates"}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Total Yard Units */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-xs block">
                        {totalUnits.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block font-normal">
                        units
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Last Updated */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                      {lastUpdatedDate ? (
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                            {formatPhilippineDateShort(lastUpdatedDate)}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            {formatPhilippineTime(lastUpdatedDate)}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-400">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        {canManage && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onAdjustProduct && onAdjustProduct(item)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:text-[#FFDF2C] transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs"

                            <SlidersHorizontal size={11} />
                            <span>Adjust</span>

                        )}

                        >
                          <ChevronRight size={15} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
