````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/ActiveRouteFilters.jsx
import { Funnel, X, Calendar } from "lucide-react";

export default function ActiveRouteFilters({
  dateScope,
  selectedStatus,
  selectedZone,
  dateFrom,
  dateTo,
  onClearDateScope,
  onClearStatus,
  onClearZone,
  onClearDates,
}) {
  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    const norm = (status || "").toUpperCase();
    switch (norm) {
      case "IN_PROGRESS":
        return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200";
      case "AWAITING_SYNC":
        return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200";
      case "SETTLED":
        return "bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border-[#BCE1F1]";
      case "FLAGGED_VARIANCE":
        return "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-200";
      default:
        return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
    }
  };

  const formatStatusDisplay = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "IN_PROGRESS":
        return "Out on Route";
      case "AWAITING_SYNC":
        return "Pending Reconciliation";
      case "SETTLED":
        return "Settled";
      case "FLAGGED_VARIANCE":
        return "Flagged Variance";
      default:
        return status;
    }
  };

  const hasAnyFilter =
    (dateScope && dateScope !== "all") ||
    Boolean(selectedStatus) ||
    (selectedZone && selectedZone !== "All Zones") ||
    Boolean(dateFrom) ||
    Boolean(dateTo);

  if (!hasAnyFilter) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Date Scope Filter Chip (e.g. Today) */}
      {dateScope && dateScope !== "all" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Calendar size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Date: <strong className="font-semibold">{dateScope === "today" ? "Today's Trips" : dateScope}</strong></span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearDateScope}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Clear date scope filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Custom Date Range Chip */}
      {(dateFrom || dateTo) && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Calendar size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Range: <strong className="font-semibold">{dateFrom || "Start"}</strong> to{" "}
            <strong className="font-semibold">{dateTo || "End"}</strong>
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearDates}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Clear date range filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Zone Filter Chip */}
      {selectedZone && selectedZone !== "All Zones" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Zone: <strong className="font-semibold">{selectedZone}</strong></span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearZone}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Clear zone filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Status Filter Chip */}
      {selectedStatus && selectedStatus !== "All" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Status:</span>
          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border ${getStatusBadgeClass(selectedStatus)}`}>
            {formatStatusDisplay(selectedStatus)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearStatus}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Clear status filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { RefreshCw, X, Calendar, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { getPhilippineTodayString, addPhilippineDays } from "../../utils/date.js";

export default function BatchGenerateModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onGenerate,
}) {
  const today = getPhilippineTodayString();
  const nextWeek = addPhilippineDays(today, 6);

  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(today);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(nextWeek);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [successResult, setSuccessResult] = useState(null);
  const [skippedList, setSkippedList] = useState([]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccessResult(null);
    setSkippedList([]);

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const res = await onGenerate({ startDate, endDate });
      const genCount = res?.data?.generatedCount ?? res?.generatedCount ?? 0;
      const skipCount = res?.data?.skippedCount ?? res?.skippedCount ?? 0;
      const skipped = res?.data?.skippedDetails || res?.skippedDetails || [];

      if (skipCount > 0) {
        setSkippedList(skipped);
        setSuccessResult(`Generated ${genCount} schedules (${skipCount} skipped due to schedule rules).`);
      } else {
        setSuccessResult(res?.message || `Successfully generated ${genCount} daily schedules from master templates.`);
        setTimeout(() => {
          onClose();
        }, 1500);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to generate schedules");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const modalNode = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scale-in max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#FFDF2C]/20 text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <RefreshCw size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Batch Generate Daily Schedules</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">Populates truck schedules from weekly master templates</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {successResult && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} className="shrink-0" />
            <span>{successResult}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {skippedList.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-1.5 text-left">
            <p className="font-bold text-amber-900">Skipped Templates Notice:</p>
            <div className="max-h-32 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 custom-scrollbar pr-1">
              {skippedList.map((sk, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 bg-white/70 p-1.5 rounded border border-amber-100">
                  <span className="font-semibold">{sk.plateNumber || sk.truckId} ({sk.date}):</span> {sk.reason}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-xl border border-[#BCE1F1] text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">
            <p className="font-semibold mb-1">Create Daily Truck Schedules</p>
            <p className="text-[#486581]">
              Daily truck runs will be scheduled matching each active vehicle's weekly route plan. Existing schedules on selected dates are skipped safely.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Start Date *</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={startDate}
                onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">End Date *</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={endDate}
                onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {skippedList.length > 0 ? "Close" : "Cancel"}
            </button>
            {skippedList.length === 0 && (
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#0E384E] cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? "Generating..." : "Generate Schedules ➔"}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(modalNode, document.body);
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/FilterRoute.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Funnel, Calendar, MapPin, Check } from "lucide-react";

export default function FilterRoute({
  label = "Filter Trips",
  activeFilters = {},
  onApply,
  zonesList = [],
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedDateScope, setSelectedDateScope] = useState(activeFilters.dateScope || "all");
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState(activeFilters.status || "");
  const [selectedZone, setSelectedZone] = useState(activeFilters.zone || "All Zones");
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState(activeFilters.dateFrom || "");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState(activeFilters.dateTo || "");

  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const statuses = [
    { key: "IN_PROGRESS", label: "Out on Route", activeBg: "bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600", inactiveBg: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200" },
    { key: "AWAITING_SYNC", label: "Pending Reconciliation", activeBg: "bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600", inactiveBg: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200" },
    { key: "SETTLED", label: "Settled", activeBg: "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E]", inactiveBg: "bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border-blue-200" },
    { key: "FLAGGED_VARIANCE", label: "Flagged Variance", activeBg: "bg-rose-600 text-white border-rose-600", inactiveBg: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200" },
  ];

  const dateScopes = [
    { key: "all", label: "All Trips" },
    { key: "today", label: "Today Only" },
    { key: "yesterday", label: "Yesterday" },
  ];

  const handleToggle = () => {
    setIsOpen((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (next) {
        setSelectedDateScope(activeFilters.dateScope || "all");
        setSelectedStatus(activeFilters.status || "");
        setSelectedZone(activeFilters.zone || "All Zones");
        setDateFrom(activeFilters.dateFrom || "");
        setDateTo(activeFilters.dateTo || "");
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setSelectedDateScope("all");
    setSelectedStatus("");
    setSelectedZone("All Zones");
    setDateFrom("");

        )}
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown Menu Modal */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80 sm:w-96 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-[#D5E3EC] p-4 z-50 animate-scale-in text-left">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 mb-3">
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/ReconciliationModal.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Scale, X, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, FileText } from "lucide-react";

export default function ReconciliationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trip,
  onSettle,
}) {
  const recon = trip?.reconciliation || {};
  const isAlreadySettled = recon.status === "SETTLED" || recon.isSettled;

  const [loadedFull, setLoadedFull] = useState(recon.totalLoadedFull ?? 120);
  const [soldFull, setSoldFull] = useState(recon.totalSoldFull ?? 95);
  const [returnedFull, setReturnedFull] = useState(recon.totalReturnedFull ?? 20);
  const [returnedEmptyGood, setReturnedEmptyGood] = useState(recon.totalReturnedEmptyGood ?? 95);
  const [returnedDefective, setReturnedDefective] = useState(recon.totalReturnedDefective ?? 5);
  const [customerDebt, setCustomerDebt] = useState(recon.netCustomerDebtCreated ?? 0);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(recon.supervisorNotes || "Physical counts verified against driver manifest slip.");

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen || !trip) return null;

  // Real-time calculation based on formulas in API contract
  const fullDiscrepancy = Number(loadedFull) - Number(soldFull) - Number(returnedFull) - Number(returnedDefective);
  const emptyDiscrepancy = Number(soldFull) - (Number(returnedEmptyGood) + Number(customerDebt));
  const isBalanced = fullDiscrepancy === 0 && emptyDiscrepancy === 0;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await onSettle(trip.id, {
        supervisorNotes: notes,
        syncCompleted: true,
        salesData: [
          {
            soldFull: Number(soldFull),
            netCustomerDebtCreated: Number(customerDebt),
          },
        ],
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to settle reconciliation");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
              isBalanced ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800" : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
            }`}>
              <Scale size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                Post-Trip Stock Reconciliation Engine
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                Vehicle: <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">{trip.truckPlate}</strong> · Zone: {trip.zoneCode || trip.zoneName}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Formulas Explainer Banner */}
          <div className="bg-[#EDF3F7] p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#D5E3EC] space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                Full Discrepancy = Loaded ({loadedFull}) − Sold ({soldFull}) − Ret Full ({returnedFull}) − Defective ({returnedDefective})
              </span>
              <span className={`font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] ${
                fullDiscrepancy === 0 ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800" : "bg-rose-100 text-[#D93025]"
              }`}>
                {fullDiscrepancy === 0 ? "0 (Balanced)" : `${fullDiscrepancy > 0 ? `+${fullDiscrepancy}` : fullDiscrepancy} Units`}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 border-t border-[#D5E3EC]">
              <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                Empty Discrepancy = Sold ({soldFull}) − [Ret Empty ({returnedEmptyGood}) + Canister Debt ({customerDebt})]
              </span>
              <span className={`font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] ${
                emptyDiscrepancy === 0 ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800" : "bg-rose-100 text-[#D93025]"
              }`}>
                {emptyDiscrepancy === 0 ? "0 (Balanced)" : `${emptyDiscrepancy > 0 ? `+${emptyDiscrepancy}` : emptyDiscrepancy} Units`}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Breakdown Form Inputs */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 bg-[#F8FAFC] p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold block mb-1">Loaded Full</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={loadedFull}
                onChange={(e) => setLoadedFull(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold block mb-1">Sold Full (App Sync)</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={soldFull}
                onChange={(e) => setSoldFull(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-800"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold block mb-1">Returned Full Unsold</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={returnedFull}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnedFull(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold block mb-1">Returned Empty Good</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={returnedEmptyGood}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnedEmptyGood(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-800"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-rose-700 font-semibold block mb-1">Returned Defective</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={returnedDefective}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnedDefective(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-rose-700"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold block mb-1">Customer Canister Debt</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                disabled={isAlreadySettled}
                value={customerDebt}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomerDebt(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Supervisor Notes */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Supervisor Audit Settlement Notes</label>
            <textarea
              rows={2}
              disabled={isAlreadySettled}
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Bottom Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <div>
              {isBalanced ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} /> Balanced · Ready to SETTLE
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#D93025] bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">
                  <AlertTriangle size={13} /> Unbalanced · Will Flag Variance
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isAlreadySettled ? "Close" : "Cancel"}
              </button>
              {!isAlreadySettled && (
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
                    isBalanced
                      ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700"
                      : "bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E]"
                  }`}
                >
                  {isSubmitting ? "Settling..." : isBalanced ? "Settle Trip (SETTLED) ➔" : "Flag Variance & Save"}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/ReturnCheckInModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Gauge, X, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

export default function ReturnCheckInModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trip,
  products = [],
  onCompleteReturn,
}) {
  const departureOdo = trip?.departureOdometer || 45000;
  const [returnOdometer, setReturnOdometer] = useState(departureOdo + 120);

  // Return unloads count & selected product
  const [selectedProductId, setSelectedProductId] = useState(products[0]?.id || "");
  const [returnTime, setReturnTime] = useState("");
  const [filledUnits, setFilledUnits] = useState(20);
  const [emptyGoodUnits, setEmptyGoodUnits] = useState(95);
  const [defectiveUnits, setDefectiveUnits] = useState(5);
  const [supervisorNotes, setSupervisorNotes] = useState("Evening physical return verified at yard gate");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (products.length > 0 && (!selectedProductId || selectedProductId === "e9b21f37-142c-4f76-96f3-a3d8b02e7b91")) {
      setSelectedProductId(products[0].id);
    }
  }, [products, selectedProductId]);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen || !trip) return null;

  const distanceDriven = Number(returnOdometer) - departureOdo;
  const isOdometerValid = distanceDriven >= 0;

  // 5,000-km PM check calculation
  const remainingUntilPm = 5000 - ((Number(returnOdometer) || 0) % 5000);
  const isPmDueSoon = remainingUntilPm <= 200;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!isOdometerValid) {
      setError(`Return odometer must be greater than or equal to departure odometer (${departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km)`);
      return;
    }

    const activeProdId = selectedProductId || products[0]?.id;
    if (!activeProdId) {
      setError("Please select a product for return unload");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const payload = {
        returnOdometerKm: Number(returnOdometer),
        supervisorNotes,
        returnLoads: [
          { productId: activeProdId, condition: "FILLED", quantityUnits: Number(filledUnits) },
          { productId: activeProdId, condition: "EMPTY_GOOD", quantityUnits: Number(emptyGoodUnits) },
          { productId: activeProdId, condition: "DEFECTIVE", quantityUnits: Number(defectiveUnits) },
        ],
      };
      if (returnTime.trim()) {
        payload.returnTime = returnTime.trim();
      }

      await onCompleteReturn(trip.id, payload);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to complete return check-in");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Gauge size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Plant Return Yard Check-In</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                Vehicle: <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">{trip.truckPlate}</strong> · {trip.truckModel || "Delivery Truck"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Telemetry Odometer */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-xl border border-[#BCE1F1] flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">Departure Odometer:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">{departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km</span>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Return Odometer Reading (km) *</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={returnOdometer}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnOdometer(e.target.value)}
                className={`w-full bg-white border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E] ${
                  !isOdometerValid ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50" : "border-[#CBD5E1]"
                }`}
              />

              {isOdometerValid ? (
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> Distance driven: +{distanceDriven} km
                  </span>
                  <span className={isPmDueSoon ? "text-amber-600 font-bold" : "text-[#6D8AA2]"}>
                    PM Due in: {remainingUntilPm.toLocaleString()} km
                  </span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#D93025] font-semibold mt-1">
                  Return odometer must be at least {departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Product Selection */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Returned Product *</label>
              <select
                value={selectedProductId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedProductId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                required
              >
                {products.length === 0 && <option value="">No products available</option>}
                {products.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.name} ({p.containerType || "LPG"})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                Return Clock-In (Optional)
              </label>
              <input
                type="datetime-local"
                value={returnTime}
                onChange={(e) => setReturnTime(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Physical Return Counts */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
              Physical Return Unload Counts (to Bunawan Yard)
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2E8F0]">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Filled Unsold</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  value={filledUnits}
                  onChange={(e) => setFilledUnits(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-[#0A4B6E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2E8F0]">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">Empty Good</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  value={emptyGoodUnits}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmptyGoodUnits(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-emerald-800"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="bg-rose-50/50 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-800 block mb-1">Defective Leakers</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  value={defectiveUnits}
                  onChange={(e) => setDefectiveUnits(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-center text-rose-700"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Supervisor Notes */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Yard Gate Check-In Notes</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={supervisorNotes}
              onChange={(e) => setSupervisorNotes(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !isOdometerValid}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white hover:bg-[#0E384E] cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? "Completing..." : "Complete Return Check-In ➔"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/RouteCalendarView.jsx
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Calendar as CalendarIcon,
  Truck,
  Clock,
  MapPin,
  User,
  Plus,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  PlayCircle,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowRight,
  X,
  FileSpreadsheet,
} from "lucide-react";

const DAYS_OF_WEEK = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];

function formatDateKey(date) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

function getTripDate(trip) {
  if (trip.scheduledDate) return trip.scheduledDate.slice(0, 10);
  if (trip.departureTime) {
    const d = new Date(trip.departureTime);
    return formatDateKey(d);
  }
  return null;
}

function getScheduleDate(schedule) {
  if (schedule.scheduledDate) return schedule.scheduledDate.slice(0, 10);
  return null;
}

export default function RouteCalendarView({
  trips = [],
  schedules = [],
  selectedTrip = null,
  onSelectTrip,
  onDispatchSchedule,
  onMiddayReload,
  onReturnCheckIn,
  onReconciliation,
  onOpenDispatchModal,
  onOpenAddScheduleModal,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  // Current calendar view month/year
  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState(() => new Date());

  // Selected date for day agenda view (defaults to today)
  const todayKey = useMemo(() => formatDateKey(new Date()), []);
  const [selectedDateKey, setSelectedDateKey] = useState(todayKey);

  // Filter type: 'all' | 'trips' | 'schedules'
  const [activityFilter, setActivityFilter] = useState("all");

  const year = currentDate.getFullYear();
  const month = currentDate.getMonth();

  const monthName = useMemo(() => {
    return currentDate.toLocaleString("default", { month: "long" });
  }, [currentDate]);

  // Navigate months
  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    setCurrentDate(new Date(year, month - 1, 1));
  };

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    setCurrentDate(new Date(year, month + 1, 1));
  };

  const handleToday = () => {
    const now = new Date();
    setCurrentDate(now);
    setSelectedDateKey(formatDateKey(now));
  };

  // Group Trips by Date
  const tripsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    trips.forEach((t) => {
      const key = getTripDate(t);
      if (key) {
        if (!map[key]) map[key] = [];
        map[key].push(t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [trips]);

  // Group Schedules by Date
  const schedulesByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    schedules.forEach((s) => {
      const key = getScheduleDate(s);
      if (key) {
        if (!map[key]) map[key] = [];
        map[key].push(s);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [schedules]);

  // Month Statistics
  const monthStats = useMemo(() => {
    const prefix = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    const monthTrips = trips.filter((t) => {
      const k = getTripDate(t);
      return k && k.startsWith(prefix);
    });
    const monthSchedules = schedules.filter((s) => {
      const k = getScheduleDate(s);
      return k && k.startsWith(prefix);
    });

    return {
      totalTrips: monthTrips.length,
      inProgress: monthTrips.filter((t) => t.status === "IN_PROGRESS").length,
      awaitingSync: monthTrips.filter((t) => t.status === "AWAITING_SYNC").length,
      settled: monthTrips.filter((t) => t.status === "SETTLED").length,
      totalSchedules: monthSchedules.length,
    };
  }, [trips, schedules, year, month]);

  // Generate calendar grid days
  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const firstDayIndex = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const daysInPrevMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();

    const days = [];

    // 1. Previous month trailing days
    for (let i = firstDayIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const dayNum = daysInPrevMonth - i;
      const d = new Date(year, month - 1, dayNum);
      const key = formatDateKey(d);
      days.push({
        date: d,
        dateKey: key,
        dayNumber: dayNum,
        isCurrentMonth: false,
        isToday: key === todayKey,
      });
    }

    // 2. Current month days
    for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
      const d = new Date(year, month, i);
      const key = formatDateKey(d);
      days.push({
        date: d,
        dateKey: key,
        dayNumber: i,
        isCurrentMonth: true,
        isToday: key === todayKey,
      });
    }

    // 3. Next month leading days (to complete 35 or 42 grid cells)
    const totalSlots = days.length <= 35 ? 35 : 42;
    const remainingSlots = totalSlots - days.length;
    for (let i = 1; i <= remainingSlots; i++) {
      const d = new Date(year, month + 1, i);
      const key = formatDateKey(d);
      days.push({
        date: d,
        dateKey: key,
        dayNumber: i,
        isCurrentMonth: false,
        isToday: key === todayKey,
      });
    }

    return days;
  }, [year, month, todayKey]);

  // Selected Day Items
  const selectedDayTrips = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedDateKey) return [];
    return tripsByDate[selectedDateKey] || [];
  }, [tripsByDate, selectedDateKey]);

  const selectedDaySchedules = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedDateKey) return [];
    return schedulesByDate[selectedDateKey] || [];
  }, [schedulesByDate, selectedDateKey]);

  const selectedDateFormatted = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedDateKey) return "";
    const [y, m, d] = selectedDateKey.split("-").map(Number);
    const dateObj = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    return dateObj.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
      weekday: "long",
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  }, [selectedDateKey]);

  const getTripStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "IN_PROGRESS":
        return {
          bg: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200",
          label: "In Progress",
          dot: "bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse",
        };
      case "AWAITING_SYNC":
        return {
          bg: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200",
          label: "Awaiting Sync",
          dot: "bg-amber-500",
        };
      case "SETTLED":
        return {
          bg: "bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border-[#BCE1F1]",
          label: "Settled",
          dot: "bg-[#0A4B6E]",
        };
      case "FLAGGED_VARIANCE":
        return {
          bg: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-200",
          label: "Flagged",
          dot: "bg-rose-500",
        };
      default:
        return {
          bg: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200",
          label: status || "Unknown",
          dot: "bg-slate-400",
        };
    }
  };

  const getScheduleStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "SCHEDULED":
        return {
          bg: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-200",
          label: "Scheduled",
        };
      case "DISPATCHED":
        return {
          bg: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200",
          label: "Dispatched",
        };
      case "CANCELLED":
        return {
          bg: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-200",
          label: "Cancelled",
        };
      default:
        return {
          bg: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200",
          label: status,
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-xs text-left">
      {/* 1. CALENDAR CONTROLS & HEADER */}
      <div className="shrink-0 p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-[#F8FAFC]">
        {/* Month Navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-white border border-[#D5E3EC] rounded-full p-1 shadow-2xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrevMonth}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full text-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              title="Previous Month"
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            </button>
            <span className="px-3 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] min-w-[130px] text-center">
              {monthName} {year}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleNextMonth}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full text-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              title="Next Month"
            >
              <ChevronRight size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleToday}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-[#D5E3EC] hover:bg-[#EDF3F7] text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs font-bold rounded-full cursor-pointer shadow-2xs transition-colors"
          >
            Today
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Switcher: All | Trips Only | Schedules Only */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-0.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-2xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActivityFilter("all")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                activityFilter === "all"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold shadow-2xs"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
            >
              All Runs
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActivityFilter("trips")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                activityFilter === "trips"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold shadow-2xs"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
            >
              Trips Only
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActivityFilter("schedules")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                activityFilter === "schedules"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold shadow-2xs"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
            >
              Schedules Only
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Monthly Tally Badges */}
          <div className="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-bold">
              <Truck size={12} />
              <span>{monthStats.totalTrips} Trips</span>
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-bold">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
              <span>{monthStats.inProgress} Active</span>
            </span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border border-sky-200 text-[11px] font-bold">
              <CalendarIcon size={12} />
              <span>{monthStats.totalSchedules} Scheduled</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. SPLIT LAYOUT: MONTH GRID (LEFT/TOP) + AGENDA DRAWER (RIGHT/BOTTOM) */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col lg:flex-row overflow-hidden">
        {/* LEFT/CENTER: 7-COLUMN MONTH GRID */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-r border-[#E2E8F0]">
          {/* Day of week header row */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] bg-[#F1F5F9] text-center font-bold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] py-2 shrink-0">
            {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((day, idx) => (
              <div
                key={day}
                className={`py-1 ${idx === 0 || idx === 6 ? "text-slate-400" : ""}`}
              >
                {day}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Days Grid */}
          <div className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-7 auto-rows-fr bg-[#E2E8F0] gap-[1px]">
            {calendarDays.map((cell) => {
              const dayTrips = tripsByDate[cell.dateKey] || [];
              const daySchedules = schedulesByDate[cell.dateKey] || [];

              const visibleTrips =
                activityFilter === "schedules" ? [] : dayTrips;
              const visibleSchedules =
                activityFilter === "trips" ? [] : daySchedules;

              const totalItems = visibleTrips.length + visibleSchedules.length;
              const isSelected = selectedDateKey === cell.dateKey;

              return (
                <div
                  key={cell.dateKey}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDateKey(cell.dateKey)}
                  className={`min-h-[92px] sm:min-h-[105px] p-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between transition-colors cursor-pointer group ${
                    cell.isCurrentMonth
                      ? isSelected
                        ? "bg-[#EBF5FB]"
                        : "bg-white hover:bg-slate-50"
                      : isSelected
                      ? "bg-[#F0F4F8]"
                      : "bg-[#F8FAFC] text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Cell Header: Day Number + Item Count */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                    <span
                      className={`text-xs font-bold w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all ${
                        cell.isToday
                          ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-extrabold"
                          : isSelected
                          ? "bg-[#D5E3EC] text-[#0A4B6E]"
                          : cell.isCurrentMonth
                          ? "text-[#0A4B6E]"

                    >
                      {cell.dayNumber}

                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1]">
                        {totalItems}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Event Pills Container */}
                  <div className="flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-hidden">
                    {/* Trips Pills */}
                    {visibleTrips.slice(0, 2).map((t) => {
                      const badge = getTripStatusBadge(t.status);
                      const isTripSelected =
                        selectedTrip && selectedTrip.id === t.id;

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={t.id}
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setSelectedDateKey(cell.dateKey);
                            if (onSelectTrip) onSelectTrip(t);
                          }}
                          className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-between gap-1 border truncate transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${badge.bg} ${
                            isTripSelected
                              ? "ring-2 ring-[#0A4B6E] shadow-sm scale-[1.02]"
                              : "hover:scale-[1.01]"
                          }`}
                          title={`${t.truckPlate} - ${t.zoneName || t.zoneCode} (${badge.label})`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                            <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full shrink-0 ${badge.dot}`} />
                            <span className="truncate">{t.truckPlate}</span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] shrink-0 opacity-80 uppercase">
                            {t.zoneCode || "TRIP"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}

                    {/* Schedules Pills */}
                    {visibleSchedules.slice(0, 2).map((s) => {
                      const badge = getScheduleStatusBadge(s.status);

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={s.id}
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setSelectedDateKey(cell.dateKey);
                          }}
                          className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-between gap-1 border truncate transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${badge.bg} hover:scale-[1.01]`}
                          title={`Scheduled: ${s.truckPlate} - ${s.zoneName || s.zoneCode} (${badge.label})`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                            <CalendarIcon size={10} className="shrink-0 text-sky-700" />
                            <span className="truncate">{s.truckPlate}</span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] shrink-0 opacity-80 uppercase">
                            {s.zoneCode || "SCHED"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}

                    {/* Overflow pill */}
                    {totalItems > 4 && (
                      <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] text-center pt-0.5">
                        +{totalItems - 4} more runs
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT/BOTTOM: SELECTED DATE AGENDA PANEL */}
        <div className="w-full lg:w-[380px] xl:w-[420px] shrink-0 flex flex-col bg-white overflow-hidden border-t lg:border-t-0">
          {/* Agenda Header */}
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-[#E2E8F0] bg-[#F8FAFC] flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarIcon size={15} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                  Day Agenda
                </h3>
                {selectedDateKey === todayKey && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C]">
                    Today
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5">
                {selectedDateFormatted}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Add Schedule Shortcut */}
            {canManage && onOpenAddScheduleModal && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenAddScheduleModal}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold text-[11px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full cursor-pointer shadow-2xs transition-transform active:scale-95"
                title="Schedule a truck run for this date"
              >
                <Plus size={13} />
                <span>+ Schedule</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Agenda Body: List of Trips & Schedules */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-4 space-y-4">
            {/* Section A: Operational Trips on this Date */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Truck size={13} />
                  <span>Delivery Trips ({selectedDayTrips.length})</span>
                </h4>
                {selectedDayTrips.length === 0 && canManage && onOpenDispatchModal && (
                  <button

                )}
              </div>

              {selectedDayTrips.length === 0 ? (

                  <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2]">No trips recorded for this date.</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {selectedDayTrips.map((trip) => {
                    const badge = getTripStatusBadge(trip.status);
                    const isSelected =
                      selectedTrip && selectedTrip.id === trip.id;
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/RouteDispatchControls.jsx
import { LayoutGrid, List, CalendarDays } from "lucide-react";
import SearchBar from "../ui/SearchBar";
import FilterRoute from "./FilterRoute";
import ActiveRouteFilters from "./ActiveRouteFilters";

export default function RouteDispatchControls({
  searchTerm = "",
  onSearchChange,
  onClearSearch,
  activeFilters = {},
  onApplyFilters,
  onClearDateScope,
  onClearStatus,
  onClearZone,
  onClearDates,
  zonesList = [],
  viewMode = "grid",
  onViewModeChange,
}) {
  const handleSearchChange = (e) => {
    const val = e && e.target ? e.target.value : typeof e === "string" ? e : "";
    if (onSearchChange) {
      onSearchChange(val);
    }
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    if (onClearSearch) {
      onClearSearch();
    } else if (onSearchChange) {
      onSearchChange("");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-3.5">
      {/* Left: Search Bar */}
      <SearchBar
        placeholder="Search vehicle plate, driver, sales rep, or zone..."
        value={typeof searchTerm === "string" ? searchTerm : ""}
        onChange={handleSearchChange}
        onClear={handleClear}
        className="w-full sm:w-64 md:w-80"
      />

      {/* Right: Active Filters, Filter Dropdown, and Tri-View Switcher */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 justify-end flex-wrap">
        {/* Active Filter Chips */}
        <ActiveRouteFilters
          dateScope={activeFilters.dateScope}
          selectedStatus={activeFilters.status}
          selectedZone={activeFilters.zone}
          dateFrom={activeFilters.dateFrom}
          dateTo={activeFilters.dateTo}
          onClearDateScope={onClearDateScope}
          onClearStatus={onClearStatus}
          onClearZone={onClearZone}
          onClearDates={onClearDates}
        />

        {/* Filter Route Dropdown */}
        <FilterRoute
          label="Filter Trips"
          activeFilters={activeFilters}
          onApply={onApplyFilters}
          zonesList={zonesList}
        />

        {/* View Mode Switcher (Cards vs Table vs Calendar) */}
        {onViewModeChange && (
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-0.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-2xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("grid")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "grid"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/60"
              }`}
              title="Cards Grid View"
            >
              <LayoutGrid size={13} />
              <span>Cards</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("table")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "table"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/60"
              }`}
              title="Table View"
            >
              <List size={13} />
              <span>Table</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onViewModeChange("calendar")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "calendar"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/60"
              }`}
              title="Calendar View"
            >
              <CalendarDays size={13} />
              <span>Calendar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Calendar, X } from "lucide-react";
import { getPhilippineTodayString, addPhilippineDays } from "../../utils/date.js";

export default function ScheduleModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  vehicles = [],
  salesUsers = [],
  zones = [],
  onCreateSchedule,
}) {
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState(() => getPhilippineTodayString());
  const [truckId, setTruckId] = useState(vehicles[0]?.id || "");
  const [salesUserId, setSalesUserId] = useState(salesUsers[0]?.id || "");
  const [zoneId, setZoneId] = useState(zones[0]?.id || "");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const selTruck = vehicles.find((v) => v.id === truckId);
      const selSales = salesUsers.find((u) => u.id === salesUserId);
      const selZone = zones.find((z) => z.id === zoneId);

      await onCreateSchedule({
        scheduledDate,
        truckId,
        salesUserId,
        zoneId,
        notes,
        truckPlate: selTruck?.plateNumber,
        truckModel: selTruck?.model,
        salesName: selSales ? `${selSales.firstName} ${selSales.lastName}` : "Sales Person",
        zoneCode: selZone?.code,
        zoneName: selZone?.name,
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to create schedule");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const modalNode = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scale-in">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Calendar size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Create Ad-Hoc Schedule</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">Single-day operational truck deployment</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Deployment Date *</label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setScheduledDate(getPhilippineTodayString())}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#D5EAF4] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Today
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setScheduledDate(addPhilippineDays(getPhilippineTodayString(), 1))}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#D5EAF4] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Tomorrow
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={scheduledDate}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduledDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Vehicle *</label>
            <select
              value={truckId}
              onChange={(e) => setTruckId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              required
            >
              <option value="">Select vehicle...</option>
              {vehicles.map((v) => (
                <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                  {v.plateNumber} ({v.model})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Service Zone *</label>
            <select
              value={zoneId}
              onChange={(e) => setZoneId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              required
            >
              <option value="">Select zone...</option>
              {zones.map((z) => (
                <option key={z.id} value={z.id}>
                  {z.code} — {z.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Assigned Sales Person</label>
            <select
              value={salesUserId}
              onChange={(e) => setSalesUserId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            >
              <option value="">Select sales person...</option>
              {salesUsers.map((u) => (
                <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>
                  {u.firstName} {u.lastName} ({u.username})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">Notes / Instructions</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Ad-hoc hospital supply relief"
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white hover:bg-[#0E384E] cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? "Creating..." : "Create Schedule ➔"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(modalNode, document.body);
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/SchedulesTable.jsx
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Calendar,
  Truck,
  User,
  MapPin,
  XCircle,
  Plus,
  Search,
  Filter,
  List,
  CalendarDays,
} from "lucide-react";
import RouteCalendarView from "./RouteCalendarView";

export default function SchedulesTable({
  schedules = [],
  trips = [],
  onCancelSchedule,
  onOpenAddSchedule,
  onDispatchSchedule,
  onSelectTrip,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState("table");
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");

  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "SCHEDULED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
            SCHEDULED
          </span>
        );
      case "DISPATCHED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
            DISPATCHED
          </span>
        );
      case "CANCELLED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
            CANCELLED
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="text-slate-600 font-bold text-xs">{status}</span>
        );
    }
  };

  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      // 1. Status Filter
      if (statusFilter !== "ALL") {
        if ((s.status || "").toUpperCase() !== statusFilter) return false;
      }

      // 2. Search query
      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
        const plate = (s.truckPlate || "").toLowerCase();
        const model = (s.truckModel || "").toLowerCase();
        const sales = (s.salesName || "").toLowerCase();
        const zoneCode = (s.zoneCode || "").toLowerCase();
        const zoneName = (s.zoneName || "").toLowerCase();
        const notes = (s.notes || "").toLowerCase();
        const date = (s.scheduledDate || "").toLowerCase();

        const matches =
          plate.includes(q) ||
          model.includes(q) ||
          sales.includes(q) ||
          zoneCode.includes(q) ||
          zoneName.includes(q) ||
          notes.includes(q) ||
          date.includes(q);

        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [schedules, searchTerm, statusFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs text-left space-y-4">
      {/* 1. Header & Quick Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar size={15} />
              <span>Date-Stamped Operational Daily Schedules</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1]">
              {schedules.length} Total Runs
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5">
            Operational single-day truck dispatches, route zones, and sales personnel
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* View Switcher & Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start md:self-auto flex-wrap">
          {/* Table vs Calendar Toggle */}
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-0.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-2xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("table")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "table"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
              title="Table View"
            >
              <List size={13} />
              <span>Table</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("calendar")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "calendar"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
              title="Calendar View"
            >
              <CalendarDays size={13} />
              <span>Calendar</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {canManage && onOpenAddSchedule && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenAddSchedule}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95 h-[30px]"
            >
              <Plus size={14} />
              <span>+ Add Daily Schedule</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Content based on View Mode */}
      {viewMode === "calendar" ? (
        <div className="pt-2">
          <RouteCalendarView
            schedules={schedules}
            trips={trips}
            onDispatchSchedule={onDispatchSchedule}
            onSelectTrip={onSelectTrip}
            onOpenAddScheduleModal={onOpenAddSchedule}
            canManage={canManage}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Controls: Inline Search Bar & Status Filters */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]/70">
            <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
              <Search size={13} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search vehicle, sales rep, zone, date..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Status Filter Pills */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
              {["ALL", "SCHEDULED", "DISPATCHED", "CANCELLED"].map((st) => (
                <button
                  key={st}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                    statusFilter === st
                      ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white shadow-2xs font-bold"
                      : "bg-[#F1F5F9] text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {st}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

      {/* 3. Table */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse min-w-[700px]">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-[#EDF3F7] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold border-b border-[#D5E3EC]">
              <th className="p-3 rounded-l-xl">Scheduled Date</th>
              <th className="p-3">Vehicle</th>
              <th className="p-3">Service Zone</th>
              <th className="p-3">Assigned Sales</th>
              <th className="p-3">Status</th>
              <th className="p-3">Notes</th>
              <th className="p-3 rounded-r-xl text-right">Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E2E8F0]">
            {filteredSchedules.length > 0 ? (
              filteredSchedules.map((s) => (
                <tr key={s.id} className="hover:bg-[#F8FAFC]">
                  <td className="p-3 font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Calendar size={13} className="text-[#6D8AA2]" />
                      <span>{s.scheduledDate}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                    <div>{s.truckPlate}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-normal">{s.truckModel}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3">
                    <span className="bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold text-[11px]">
                      {s.zoneCode || s.zoneName}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                    {s.salesName || "Sales Person"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3">{getStatusBadge(s.status)}</td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-slate-500 max-w-xs truncate">
                    {s.notes || "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right">
                    {canManage && s.status === "SCHEDULED" && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onCancelSchedule(s.id)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-800 font-bold text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                      >
                        <XCircle size={12} />

                  </td>

    </div>
  );
````
