// src/components/route-dispatch/TripCard.jsx
import { Truck, User, MapPin, Gauge, Layers, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Clock } from "lucide-react";

export default function TripCard({
  trip,
  isSelected = false,
  onClick,
  onMiddayReload,
  onReturnCheckIn,
  onReconciliation,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "IN_PROGRESS":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
            OUT ON ROUTE
          </span>
        );
      case "AWAITING_SYNC":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <Clock size={11} className="text-amber-600" />
            PENDING RECONCILIATION
          </span>
        );
      case "SETTLED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <CheckCircle2 size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            SETTLED & CLOSED
          </span>
        );
      case "FLAGGED_VARIANCE":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-50 text-[#D93025] border border-rose-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <AlertTriangle size={11} className="text-[#D93025]" />
            FLAGGED VARIANCE
          </span>
        );
      case "CANCELLED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            CANCELLED
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            {status || "PENDING"}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  const formattedDeparture = trip.departureTime
    ? new Date(trip.departureTime).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })
    : "—";

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => onClick && onClick(trip)}
      className={`rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer select-none text-left ${
        isSelected
          ? "bg-[#E8F3F8]/40 border-2 border-[#0A4B6E] ring-2 ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 shadow-md"
          : "bg-white border border-[#D5E3EC] hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/40 hover:shadow-sm shadow-xs"
      }`}
    >
      <div>
        {/* Top: Vehicle Plate Number & Status */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3 gap-2">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
              <span className="font-bold text-base text-[#0A4B6E] tracking-tight">
                {trip.truckPlate || "No Plate"}
              </span>
              {getStatusBadge(trip.status)}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] truncate">
              <MapPin size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">
                Zone: <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">{trip.zoneCode || trip.zoneName}</strong>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors ${
            isSelected ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C]" : "bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E]"
          }`}>
            <Truck size={16} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Middle Details Grid */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5 bg-[#F8FAFC] rounded-xl p-3 border border-[#E2E8F0] text-xs mb-3">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Truck size={12} /> Model:
            </span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate max-w-[170px] text-right">
              {trip.truckModel || "Delivery Vehicle"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
              <User size={12} /> Crew:
            </span>
            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 truncate max-w-[170px] text-right">
              {trip.driverName} <span className="text-[#6D8AA2]">· {trip.salesName}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Gauge size={12} /> Departure Odo:
            </span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
              {trip.departureOdometer ? `${trip.departureOdometer.toLocaleString()} km` : "—"}
              <span className="font-normal text-slate-500 text-[11px] ml-1">({formattedDeparture})</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          {trip.returnOdometer && (
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-1 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
              <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
                <Gauge size={12} /> Return Odo:
              </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">
                {trip.returnOdometer.toLocaleString()} km
                {trip.distanceDrivenKm ? (
                  <span className="text-emerald-700 font-semibold text-[11px] ml-1">
                    (+{trip.distanceDrivenKm} km)
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {trip.loads?.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-1 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
              <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
                <Layers size={12} /> Transfer Slips:
              </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                {trip.loads.length} Slips Recorded
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Action Buttons based on Lifecycle */}
      {canManage && (
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#E2E8F0] space-y-1.5">
          {trip.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  onMiddayReload(trip);
                }}
                className="w-full text-center py-2 px-2.5 bg-white border border-[#BCE1F1] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Send extra LPG stock to truck mid-route"
              >
                + Midday Reload
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  onReturnCheckIn(trip);
                }}
                className="w-full text-center py-2 px-2.5 bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                title="Truck back at yard: log mileage and unload items"
              >
                Return Check-In ➔
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {trip.status === "AWAITING_SYNC" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onReconciliation(trip);
              }}
              className="w-full text-center py-2 px-3 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1"
              title="Audit returned physical stock against mobile sales receipts"
            >
              <span>Reconcile & Settle Trip ➔</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {(trip.status === "SETTLED" || trip.status === "FLAGGED_VARIANCE") && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onReconciliation(trip);
              }}
              className="w-full text-center py-2 px-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#D5E3EC] text-[#0A4B6E] rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              View Reconciliation Audit Report
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

      const stored = localStorage.getItem("app_route_guide_open");
      return stored !== null ? JSON.parse(stored) : true;

      return true;

      const next = !prev;

      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      return next;
    });

// src/components/route-dispatch/TripTable.jsx
import {
  Truck,
  User,
  MapPin,
  Gauge,
  Layers,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function TripTable({
  trips = [],
  selectedTrip,
  onSelectTrip,
  sortConfig = { key: "truckPlate", direction: "asc" },
  onSort,
  onMiddayReload,
  onReturnCheckIn,
  onReconciliation,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
      case "IN_PROGRESS":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 animate-pulse" />
            OUT ON ROUTE
          </span>
        );
      case "AWAITING_SYNC":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <Clock size={10} className="text-amber-600" />
            PENDING RECON
          </span>
        );
      case "SETTLED":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <CheckCircle2 size={10} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            SETTLED
          </span>
        );
      case "FLAGGED_VARIANCE":
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-50 text-[#D93025] border border-rose-200 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            <AlertTriangle size={10} className="text-[#D93025]" />
            VARIANCE
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
            {status || "PENDING"}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  const renderSortArrow = (key) => {
    if (sortConfig.key !== key) return null;
    return <span className="ml-1 text-[10px]">{sortConfig.direction === "asc" ? "▲" : "▼"}</span>;
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[840px]">
          {/* Table Header */}
          <thead className="bg-[#0D4B6E] text-white text-xs sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-xs select-none">
            <tr>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3.5 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[17%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("truckPlate")}
              >
                Vehicle Plate {renderSortArrow("truckPlate")}
              </th>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[13%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("zoneCode")}
              >
                Service Zone {renderSortArrow("zoneCode")}
              </th>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[16%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("truckModel")}
              >
                Vehicle Model {renderSortArrow("truckModel")}
              </th>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[16%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("driverName")}
              >
                Assigned Crew {renderSortArrow("driverName")}
              </th>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[15%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("departureOdometer")}
              >
                Odometer & Km {renderSortArrow("departureOdometer")}
              </th>
              <th
                className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] text-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#0b3e5b] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap w-[11%]"
                onClick={() => onSort && onSort("status")}
              >
                Status {renderSortArrow("status")}
              </th>
              <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] text-right whitespace-nowrap w-[11%]">
                Action
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>

          {/* Table Body */}
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-xs">
            {trips.length > 0 ? (
              trips.map((trip) => {
                const isSelected = selectedTrip?.id === trip.id;
                const formattedDate = trip.departureTime
                  ? new Date(trip.departureTime).toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric" })
                  : "—";
                const formattedTime = trip.departureTime
                  ? new Date(trip.departureTime).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })
                  : "";

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={trip.id}
                    onClick={() => onSelectTrip && onSelectTrip(trip)}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-[#E8F3F8]/70 hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] ring-1 ring-inset ring-[#0A4B6E]/30"
                        : "hover:bg-[#F8FAFC]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Vehicle Plate & Departure Date */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Truck size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
                        <span>{trip.truckPlate}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                        {formattedDate} {formattedTime ? `· ${formattedTime}` : ""}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Zone */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-800 font-semibold">
                        <MapPin size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
                        <span>{trip.zoneCode || trip.zoneName}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[120px]">
                        {trip.zoneName || "District Route"}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Vehicle Model */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{trip.truckModel || "Delivery Truck"}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[130px]">
                        {trip.onBoardSummary?.totalUnits ? `${trip.onBoardSummary.totalUnits} units onboard` : "Standard Cargo"}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Crew */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-slate-800">
                        <User size={11} className="text-[#6D8AA2] shrink-0" />
                        <span>{trip.driverName || "Unassigned"}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[#6D8AA2] truncate max-w-[130px]">
                        {trip.salesName ? `Sales: ${trip.salesName}` : "No sales rep"}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Odometer */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                        <Gauge size={11} className="text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{trip.departureOdometer?.toLocaleString() || "—"} km</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                        {trip.returnOdometer ? (
                          <span>
                            Ret: {trip.returnOdometer.toLocaleString()} km{" "}
                            {trip.distanceDrivenKm ? (
                              <strong className="text-emerald-700">(+{trip.distanceDrivenKm} km)</strong>
                            ) : null}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400">In transit</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Status */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                      {getStatusBadge(trip.status)}
                    </td>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                      {canManage && (
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          {trip.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  onMiddayReload && onMiddayReload(trip);
                                }}
                                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-white border border-[#BCE1F1] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] transition cursor-pointer"
                                title="Midday reload"
                              >
                                + Reload
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  onReturnCheckIn && onReturnCheckIn(trip);
                                }}
                                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                title="Return check-in"
                              >
                                Check-In
                              </button>

                          )}

                          {trip.status === "AWAITING_SYNC" && (
                            <button
                              type="button"

                              }}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white transition cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title="Reconcile and settle"

                              Settle ➔

// src/components/route-dispatch/ZonesModal.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { MapPin, X, Plus, Edit2 } from "lucide-react";

export default function ZonesModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  zones = [],
  onCreateZone,
  onUpdateZone,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedZone, setSelectedZone] = useState(null);

  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(true);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleStartCreate = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
    setSelectedZone(null);
    setCode("");
    setName("");
    setDescription("");
    setIsActive(true);
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (zone) => {
    setIsEditing(true);
    setSelectedZone(zone);
    setCode(zone.code);
    setName(zone.name);
    setDescription(zone.description || "");
    setIsActive(zone.isActive !== false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      if (isEditing && selectedZone) {
        await onUpdateZone(selectedZone.id, {
          name,
          description,
          isActive,
        });
      } else {
        await onCreateZone({
          code: code.toUpperCase().trim(),
          name: name.trim(),
          description: description.trim(),
          isActive,
        });
      }
      handleStartCreate();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save service zone");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <MapPin size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Service Delivery Zones</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">Configure delivery route clusters and districts</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Existing Zones List */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs">Registered Service Zones</label>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-1">
            {zones.map((z) => (
              <div
                key={z.id}
                className="p-2.5 bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/30"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

// src/components/route-dispatch/CancelScheduleModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { CalendarX, X, Truck, Info, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { formatPhilippineDate } from "../../utils/date.js";

const COMMON_SCHEDULE_REASONS = [
  "Driver Unavailable / On Leave",
  "Preventive Maintenance Scheduled",
  "Severe Weather Alert / Flood",
  "Route Reallocation",
  "Inventory Restock Delay",
];

export default function CancelScheduleModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  schedule,
  onCancelSchedule,
}) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (schedule && isOpen) {
      setReason("");
      setError(null);
    }
  }, [schedule, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen || !schedule) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!reason.trim()) {
      setError("Please provide a reason for cancelling today's scheduled run.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await onCancelSchedule(schedule, { reason: reason.trim() });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to cancel scheduled dispatch");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const formattedDate = schedule.scheduledDate
    ? formatPhilippineDate(schedule.scheduledDate)
    : "Today";

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 max-w-lg w-full p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scale-in text-left">

              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer transition"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-medium p-3 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 text-rose-600" />

          </div>
        )}

        {/* Informational Callout */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-[#BCE1F1] rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <Info size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="leading-relaxed">

          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Schedule Summary Card */}
        <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1]/60 rounded-xl p-3.5 text-xs space-y-2">

        </form>
      </div>
    </div>,

// src/components/route-dispatch/EndTripModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Gauge,
  Clock,
  Truck,
  User,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ArrowRight,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal.jsx";
import Button from "../ui/Button.jsx";
import { formatPhilippineTime, getPhilippineTodayString } from "../../utils/date.js";

const MAX_ODOMETER = 999999;
const PM_INTERVAL_KM = 5000;

/**
 * EndTripModal — Yard gate return & return odometer check-in modal.
 * 
 * Conforms to API contract `POST /api/trips/:id/end`.
 * Captures mandatory return odometer, validates monotonic increase,
 * evaluates fleet PM baseline, and transitions trip to RETURNED.
 */
export default function EndTripModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trip,
  onEndTrip,
}) {
  const [odometerReading, setOdometerReading] = useState("");
  const [returnNotes, setReturnNotes] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");

  const departureOdo = Number(
    trip?.departureOdometer ?? trip?.truck_current_odometer ?? trip?.odometer ?? 0
  );
  const lastPmOdo = Number(trip?.truckLastPmOdometer ?? trip?.lastPmOdometer ?? 0);

  // Initialize inputs when modal opens or trip changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && trip) {
      setOdometerReading("");
      setReturnNotes("");
      setErrorMsg("");
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, trip]);

  // Real-time calculation of trip delta and PM threshold
  const {
    newOdoNum,
    distanceDriven,
    isMonotonicValid,
    isCeilingValid,
    isPmDueSoon,
    isPmOverdue,
    remainingUntilPm,
  } = useMemo(() => {
    if (odometerReading === "" || odometerReading === undefined) {
      return {
        newOdoNum: null,
        distanceDriven: 0,
        isMonotonicValid: false,
        isCeilingValid: true,
        isPmDueSoon: false,
        isPmOverdue: false,
        remainingUntilPm: null,
      };
    }

    const val = Number(odometerReading);
    if (isNaN(val) || val < 0) {
      return {
        newOdoNum: val,
        distanceDriven: 0,
        isMonotonicValid: false,
        isCeilingValid: true,
        isPmDueSoon: false,
        isPmOverdue: false,
        remainingUntilPm: null,
      };
    }

    const monotonic = val >= departureOdo;
    const ceiling = val <= MAX_ODOMETER;
    const diff = monotonic ? val - departureOdo : 0;
    const sincePm = Math.max(0, val - lastPmOdo);
    const pmOverdue = sincePm >= PM_INTERVAL_KM;
    const pmDueSoon = !pmOverdue && PM_INTERVAL_KM - sincePm <= 200;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, PM_INTERVAL_KM - sincePm);

    return {
      newOdoNum: val,
      distanceDriven: diff,
      isMonotonicValid: monotonic,
      isCeilingValid: ceiling,
      isPmDueSoon: pmDueSoon,
      isPmOverdue: pmOverdue,
      remainingUntilPm: remaining,
    };
  }, [odometerReading, departureOdo, lastPmOdo]);

  if (!isOpen || !trip) return null;

  const departureFormatted = trip.departureTime
    ? formatPhilippineTime(trip.departureTime)
    : "—";

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!isMonotonicValid || !isCeilingValid || newOdoNum === null) {
      setErrorMsg(`Return odometer must be greater than or equal to departure reading (${departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km).`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMsg("");

      const payload = {
        currentOdometer: Math.floor(newOdoNum),
        notes: returnNotes.trim() || undefined,
        returnTime: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      await onEndTrip(trip.id, payload);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to end trip:", err);
      setErrorMsg(err.message || "Failed to record return odometer and end trip.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="End Trip & Yard Return Check-In"
      subtitle={`${trip.truckPlate} · ${trip.tripNumber || "Delivery Run"}`}
      icon={Gauge}
      maxWidth="max-w-lg"
      footer={
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            disabled={isSubmitting || !isMonotonicValid || !isCeilingValid}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <span>{isSubmitting ? "Recording..." : "Confirm Gate Return"}</span>
            <ArrowRight size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs font-sans">
        {/* Error Alert */}
        {errorMsg && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#C93B32] flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold animate-scale-in">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 text-[#C93B32]" />
            <span>{errorMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Departure Meta Card */}
        <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Truck size={14} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
              <span>{trip.truckPlate}</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-500">
                ({trip.truckModel || "Delivery Vehicle"})
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#3E5C76] bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              #{trip.tripNumber || "ACTIVE"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
            <div>
              <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Assigned Driver</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                <User size={12} className="text-[#3E5C76]" />
                {trip.driverName || "Assigned Driver"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[11px]">Departure Time</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                <Clock size={12} className="text-[#3E5C76]" />
                {departureFormatted}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium">Departure Odometer:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">
              {departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Return Odometer Input */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
            Return Odometer Reading (km) <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="number"
              min={departureOdo}
              max={MAX_ODOMETER}
              step="1"
              required
              autoFocus
              value={odometerReading}
              onChange={(e) => setOdometerReading(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={`e.g. ${departureOdo + 45}`}
              className={`w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 focus:outline-none transition-all ${
                odometerReading !== "" && !isMonotonicValid
                  ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-200"
                  : "border-slate-300 bg-white focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
              }`}
            />
            <span className="absolute right-3.5 top-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">
              KM
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Real-time distance indicator */}
          {odometerReading !== "" && isMonotonicValid && (
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 font-semibold">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-600" />
                <span>Distance Driven This Trip:</span>
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-900">
                +{distanceDriven.toLocaleString()} km
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {odometerReading !== "" && !isMonotonicValid && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-[#C93B32] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <AlertTriangle size={12} className="shrink-0" />
              Reading cannot be lower than departure odometer ({departureOdo.toLocaleString()} km).
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Preventive Maintenance (PM) Status Alert */}
        {isPmOverdue && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 text-amber-700 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
              <strong>5,000-km PM Threshold Exceeded:</strong> This vehicle has reached its preventive maintenance interval. Ending this trip will flag the asset for PM inspection in Fleet Management.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {isPmDueSoon && (
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-900 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
            <Info size={14} className="shrink-0 text-blue-600" />
            <span>Preventive Maintenance due soon ({remainingUntilPm} km remaining).</span>
          </div>

        {/* Optional Gate Notes */}

          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">

          <textarea

// src/components/route-dispatch/SettleTripModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import {
  Scale,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  FileCheck2,
  ArrowRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import { tripsApi } from "../../api/trips.js";

/**
 * SettleTripModal — Post-trip financial reconciliation settlement.
 * 
 * Purpose:
 * Once physical returns have been checked in (via StockCheckInModal) and mobile cabin
 * sales have synced, the supervisor audits the variance and locks the trip reconciliation.
 */
export default function SettleTripModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trip,
  onSettleSuccess,
}) {
  const recon = trip?.reconciliation || {};
  const [soldFull, setSoldFull] = useState(recon.totalSoldFull ?? 0);
  const [customerDebt, setCustomerDebt] = useState(recon.netCustomerDebtCreated ?? 0);
  const [notes, setSupervisorNotes] = useState(
    recon.supervisorNotes || "Reconciliation audited and confirmed against sales receipts."
  );
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Escape key listener
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && onClose && !isSubmitting) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose, isSubmitting]);

  if (!isOpen || !trip) return null;

  const loadedFull = Number(recon.totalLoadedFull ?? trip?.onBoardSummary?.totalUnits ?? 0);
  const retFull = Number(recon.totalReturnedFull ?? 0);
  const retEmpty = Number(recon.totalReturnedEmptyGood ?? 0);
  const retDefect = Number(recon.totalReturnedDefective ?? 0);

  // Math: Full Discrepancy = Loaded - Sold - Returned Full - Returned Defective
  const fullDiscrepancy = loadedFull - Number(soldFull) - retFull - retDefect;
  // Empty Discrepancy = Sold - (Returned Empty + Customer Debt)
  const emptyDiscrepancy = Number(soldFull) - (retEmpty + Number(customerDebt));
  const isBalanced = fullDiscrepancy === 0 && emptyDiscrepancy === 0;

  const handleSettle = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const payload = {
        totalSoldFull: Number(soldFull),
        netCustomerDebtCreated: Number(customerDebt),
        supervisorNotes: notes.trim(),
      };

      const result = await tripsApi.settleReconciliation(trip.id, payload);

        {/* HEADER */}

            <div className="space-y-3">

              </span>

                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="settle-sold-full"
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    value={soldFull}
                    onChange={(e) => setSoldFull(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                    required

                    Customer Canister Debt

                  <input
                    id="settle-customer-debt"
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    value={customerDebt}
                    onChange={(e) => setCustomerDebt(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0))}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[#475569] block mt-0.5">Empties owed by clients</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* VARIANCE RESULT BANNER */}
            <div className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs flex items-center justify-between ${
              isBalanced
                ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900"
                : "bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-900"
            }`}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {isBalanced ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={18} className="text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                ) : (
                  <AlertTriangle size={18} className="text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                )}
                <div>
                  <strong className="block font-bold">
                    {isBalanced ? "Stock Fully Balanced" : "Discrepancy Detected"}
                  </strong>
                  <span className="text-[11px]">
                    Full diff: {fullDiscrepancy} · Empty diff: {emptyDiscrepancy}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                isBalanced
                  ? "bg-emerald-200/70 text-emerald-900"
                  : "bg-amber-200/70 text-amber-900"
              }`}>
                {isBalanced ? "READY TO SETTLE" : "FLAGGED VARIANCE"}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* SUPERVISOR AUDIT NOTES */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label htmlFor="settle-notes" className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 block">
                Audit Settlement Remarks
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="settle-notes"
                rows={2}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setSupervisorNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Discrepancy explanation or receipt verification note..."
                className="w-full p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* MODAL FOOTER */}
          <div className="pt-3.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition cursor-pointer uppercase tracking-wider"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#0E384E] disabled:opacity-50 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider active:scale-95"
            >
              <span>{isSubmitting ? "Locking..." : "Finalize & Settle"}</span>
              <FileCheck2 size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(modalNode, document.body)
    : modalNode;
}

````javascript
// src/components/ui/CameraCaptureModal.jsx
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import {
  Camera,
  X,
  RefreshCw,
  Check,
  AlertCircle,
  Zap,
  ZapOff,
  RotateCcw,
} from "lucide-react";
import Button from "./Button";

/**
 * CameraCaptureModal
 * Production-ready in-browser camera viewfinder utilizing WebRTC getUserMedia.
 * Eliminates mobile OS Low Memory Killer (LMK) process eviction by keeping
 * the browser in the active foreground without delegating to native camera apps.
 *
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Controls modal visibility
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Callback to close modal without capturing
 * @param {Function} props.onCapture - Callback (file: File) => void with JPEG File object
 */
export default function CameraCaptureModal({ isOpen, onClose, onCapture }) {
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);

  const [facingMode, setFacingMode] = useState("environment"); // "environment" (rear) or "user" (front)
  const [capturedBlobUrl, setCapturedBlobUrl] = useState(null);
  const [capturedFile, setCapturedFile] = useState(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");
  const [isLoadingCamera, setIsLoadingCamera] = useState(false);
  const [hasTorch, setHasTorch] = useState(false);
  const [isTorchOn, setIsTorchOn] = useState(false);

  // Stop active video track stream cleanly
  const stopStream = useCallback(() => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => {
        try {
          track.stop();
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Error stopping track:", e);
        }
      });
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Cleanup blob preview
  const cleanupCaptured = useCallback(() => {
    if (capturedBlobUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(capturedBlobUrl);
    }
    setCapturedBlobUrl(null);
    setCapturedFile(null);
  }, [capturedBlobUrl]);

  // Start or restart camera stream
  const startCamera = useCallback(async (desiredFacing) => {
    stopStream();
    setIsLoadingCamera(true);
    setErrorMessage("");
    setHasTorch(false);
    setIsTorchOn(false);

    if (!navigator?.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setIsLoadingCamera(false);
      setErrorMessage(
        "Camera stream is not supported in this browser environment. Ensure the page is served over a secure connection (HTTPS) or use the Browse File option."
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      const constraints = {
        video: {
          facingMode: { ideal: desiredFacing || facingMode },
          width: { ideal: 1920 },
          height: { ideal: 1080 },
        },
        audio: false,
      };

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
      streamRef.current = stream;

      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.play().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Video play interrupted:", err);
        });
      }

      // Check if torch/flashlight is supported
      const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
      if (track && typeof track.getCapabilities === "function") {
        const capabilities = track.getCapabilities();
        if (capabilities?.torch) {
          setHasTorch(true);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to access camera:", err);
      if (err.name === "NotAllowedError" || err.name === "PermissionDeniedError") {
        setErrorMessage(
          "Camera access permission was denied. Please allow camera permissions in your browser settings to take photos directly."
        );
      } else if (err.name === "NotFoundError" || err.name === "DevicesNotFoundError") {
        setErrorMessage("No camera hardware found on this device.");
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(
          `Unable to access camera (${err.message || "Unknown error"}). Try the Browse File option instead.`
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingCamera(false);
    }
  }, [facingMode, stopStream]);

  // Manage camera lifecycle based on modal open state
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      cleanupCaptured();
      startCamera(facingMode);
    } else {
      stopStream();
      cleanupCaptured();
      setErrorMessage("");
    }

    return () => {
      stopStream();
    };
  }, [isOpen, facingMode]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // Flip rear / front camera
  const handleToggleFacingMode = () => {
    const nextMode = facingMode === "environment" ? "user" : "environment";
    setFacingMode(nextMode);
    startCamera(nextMode);
  };

  // Toggle flashlight / torch
  const handleToggleTorch = async () => {
    const track = streamRef.current?.getVideoTracks()?.[0];
    if (track) {
      try {
        const nextTorch = !isTorchOn;
        await track.applyConstraints({
          advanced: [{ torch: nextTorch }],
        });
        setIsTorchOn(nextTorch);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Failed to toggle torch:", err);
      }
    }
  };

  // Capture current video frame to canvas
  const handleSnapPhoto = () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight) {
      setErrorMessage("Camera feed is not ready yet. Please wait a second.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      if (!ctx) {
        setErrorMessage("Could not initialize image processing canvas.");
        return;
      }

      // Draw active frame
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // Export as high-quality JPEG
      canvas.toBlob(
        (blob) => {
          if (!blob) {
            setErrorMessage("Failed to encode captured photo.");
            return;
          }

          const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const fileName = `receipt-photo-${Date.now()}.jpg`;
          const file = new File([blob], fileName, {
            type: "image/jpeg",
            lastModified: Date.now(),
          });

          setCapturedBlobUrl(previewUrl);
          setCapturedFile(file);
          // Pause camera stream while previewing
          stopStream();
        },
        "image/jpeg",
        0.92
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Snap photo error:", err);
      setErrorMessage("Error capturing photo frame.");
    }
  };

  // User accepts the snapped photo
  const handleConfirmPhoto = () => {
    if (capturedFile && onCapture) {
      onCapture(capturedFile);
    }
    handleCloseModal();
  };

  // Retake photo: discard captured preview and restart camera
  const handleRetake = () => {
    cleanupCaptured();
    startCamera(facingMode);
  };

  // Dismiss modal
  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    stopStream();
    cleanupCaptured();
    setErrorMessage("");
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const modalContent = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-3 sm:p-5 select-none animate-fade-in text-white">
      {/* Top Controls Toolbar */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-xl flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-1 shrink-0 z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-[#FFDF2C]">
            <Camera size={17} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
              {capturedBlobUrl ? "Confirm Receipt Photo" : "Take Receipt Photo"}
            </span>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-300">
              {capturedBlobUrl
                ? "Review photo clarity before saving"
                : "Frame the official receipt in clear lighting"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {/* Torch toggle button (if supported on active hardware track) */}
          {!capturedBlobUrl && hasTorch && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleTorch}
              className={`p-2 rounded-full transition cursor-pointer ${
                isTorchOn
                  ? "bg-[#FFDF2C] text-[#0A4B6E]"
                  : "bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/20"
              }`}
              title="Toggle Flash / Torch"
            >
              {isTorchOn ? <Zap size={17} /> : <ZapOff size={17} />}
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Camera flip toggle button */}
          {!capturedBlobUrl && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleFacingMode}
              className="p-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/20 transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Flip Camera (Front/Rear)"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={17} />
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Close button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCloseModal}
            className="p-2 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-red-500/40 transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Close camera"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Viewfinder / Preview Body */}
      <div className="flex-1 w-full max-w-xl min-h-0 flex items-center justify-center p-2 relative my-2">
        <div className="w-full h-full max-h-[70vh] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black/60 border border-white/15 relative flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl">
          {/* Error Message Notice */}
          {errorMessage ? (
            <div className="p-6 text-center max-w-sm space-y-3">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                <AlertCircle size={26} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-red-200 font-medium leading-relaxed">
                {errorMessage}
              </p>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="yellow"
                onClick={handleCloseModal}
                className="text-xs mt-2"
              >
                CLOSE CAMERA
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : capturedBlobUrl ? (
            /* FROZEN PREVIEW */
            <div className="w-full h-full relative flex items-center justify-center bg-black">
              <img
                src={capturedBlobUrl}
                alt="Captured Receipt"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              />
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] text-emerald-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 border border-emerald-500/30">
                <Check size={12} />
                <span>Photo Captured</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* LIVE WEBRTC VIDEO FEED */
            <div className="w-full h-full relative flex items-center justify-center">
              <video
                ref={videoRef}
                autoPlay
                playsInline
                muted
                className={`w-full h-full object-contain ${
                  facingMode === "user" ? "scale-x-[-1]" : ""
                }`}
              />

              {/* Viewfinder Target Framing Guides */}
              <div className="absolute inset-6 pointer-events-none border border-white/25 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between p-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <div className="w-5 h-5 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-[#FFDF2C]" />
                  <div className="w-5 h-5 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-[#FFDF2C]" />
                </div>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-white/70 bg-black/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full backdrop-blur-xs font-mono">
                    Align Receipt Inside Box
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <div className="w-5 h-5 border-b-2 border-l-2 border-[#FFDF2C]" />
                  <div className="w-5 h-5 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-[#FFDF2C]" />
                </div>
              </div>

              {isLoadingCamera && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/75 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                    <RefreshCw size={24} className="text-[#FFDF2C] animate-spin" />
                    <span className="text-xs text-white font-medium">
                      Initializing camera...
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Shutter & Action Bar */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-xl flex items-center justify-center px-4 pb-2 pt-1 shrink-0 z-10">
        {capturedBlobUrl ? (
          /* Confirmation Actions */
          <div className="w-full flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRetake}
              className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCcw size={15} />

            </button>
            <button

              onClick={handleConfirmPhoto}
              className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-yellow-400 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
            >
              <Check size={16} />
              <span>USE THIS PHOTO</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Live Shutter Button */
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSnapPhoto}
              disabled={isLoadingCamera || Boolean(errorMessage)}
              className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-white/20 border-4 border-white flex items-center justify-center transition active:scale-95 hover:bg-white/30 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed group shadow-xl"
              title="Snap photo"
            >
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-[#FFDF2C] group-hover:scale-95 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center text-[#0A4B6E]">
                <Camera size={20} />
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}

// src/components/zones/FilterZone.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Funnel } from "lucide-react";
import Button from "../ui/Button.jsx";
import DateFilterGroup from "../users/DateFilterGroup.jsx";

export default function FilterZone({
  label = "Filter Zones",
  initialFilters = { status: "ALL", dateFrom: "", dateTo: "" },
  onApply,
  className = "",
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialFilters.status || "ALL");
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState(initialFilters.dateFrom || "");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState(initialFilters.dateTo || "");

  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  // Sync state if initialFilters changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    setStatus(initialFilters.status || "ALL");
    setDateFrom(initialFilters.dateFrom || "");
    setDateTo(initialFilters.dateTo || "");
  }, [initialFilters.status, initialFilters.dateFrom, initialFilters.dateTo]);

  // Click outside listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setStatus("ALL");
    setDateFrom("");
    setDateTo("");
  };

  const handleApply = () => {
    if (onApply) {
      onApply({
        status,
        dateFrom,
        dateTo,
      });
    }
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const statuses = [
    { key: "ALL", label: "ALL STATUSES" },
    { key: "ACTIVE", label: "ACTIVE", activeBg: "bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600", inactiveBg: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200" },
    { key: "INACTIVE", label: "INACTIVE", activeBg: "bg-gray-600 text-white border-gray-600", inactiveBg: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-200" },
  ];

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative inline-block text-left">
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        className={`bg-[#FCFEFE] hover:bg-[#F3F8FB] text-[#0A4B6E] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 h-[30px] min-w-[110px] justify-between cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${className}`}
      >
        <span>{label}</span>
        <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
      </button>

      {/* Filter Card Dropdown */}
      <div
        className={`absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-[290px] bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/20 rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-30 p-3.5 origin-top-right transition-all duration-150 ease-out ${
          isOpen
            ? "opacity-100 scale-100 translate-y-0 pointer-events-auto"
            : "opacity-0 scale-95 -translate-y-1 pointer-events-none"
        }`}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100 mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs">
            <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            <span>Filter Service Zones</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Filter Section */}
        <div className="mb-3 text-left">
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5 uppercase tracking-wide">
            Operational Status:
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {statuses.map(({ key, label, activeBg, inactiveBg }) => {
              const isSelected = status === key;
              return (
                <button
                  key={key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setStatus(key)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
                    isSelected
                      ? activeBg || "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E]"
                      : inactiveBg || "bg-[#F8FAFC] text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Date Filter Section */}
        <DateFilterGroup
          dateFrom={dateFrom}
          dateTo={dateTo}
          onFromChange={(e) => setDateFrom(e.target.value)}
          onToChange={(e) => setDateTo(e.target.value)}
        />

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={handleClearAll}
            className="!px-2.5 !py-1 !text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 uppercase tracking-wider !rounded-full !h-[26px]"
          >
            CLEAR ALL
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleApply}
            className="!px-3 !py-1 !text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider !rounded-full !h-[26px]"
          >
            APPLY RESULT
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/zones/ZoneModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useId } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { MapPin, X, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import Button from "../ui/Button.jsx";

export default function ZoneModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  zone = null,
}) {
  const codeId = useId();
  const nameId = useId();
  const descId = useId();
  const activeId = useId();

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    code: "",
    name: "",
    description: "",
    isActive: true,
  });
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Initialize or reset form data when modal opens or zone prop changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (zone) {
        setFormData({
          code: zone.code || "",
          name: zone.name || "",
          description: zone.description || "",
          isActive: zone.isActive !== false,
        });
      } else {
        setFormData({
          code: "",
          name: "",
          description: "",
          isActive: true,
        });
      }
      setFormError("");
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, zone]);

  // Handle ESC key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && !isSubmitting) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, isSubmitting, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen || typeof document === "undefined") return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setFormError("Zone name is required.");
      return;
    }
    if (!zone && !formData.code.trim()) {
      setFormError("Zone code is required.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setFormError("");

      await onSave({
        code: formData.code.toUpperCase().trim(),
        name: formData.name.trim(),
        description: formData.description?.trim() || null,

              </p>

          <button
            type="button"

            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={16} />

        </div>

        {/* Error Alert */}
        {formError && (
          <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-[#C93B32] flex items-center gap-2">

              required
            />
            {zone && (

                Zone code cannot be modified once registered to preserve routing integrity.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor={nameId}
              className="block font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1"
            >
              Zone Name <span className="text-[#C93B32]">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              id={nameId}
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Toril District Commercial"
              value={formData.name}
              onChange={(e) =>

              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-hidden focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:bg-white transition-colors"

              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-hidden focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:bg-white transition-colors"
            />

            />
            <label

              className="text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium cursor-pointer select-none"
            >
              Zone is active for trip dispatch and weekly route planning
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Footer Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-4 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >

            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              {isSubmitting
                ? "Saving..."
                : zone
                ? "Save Changes"
                : "Create Zone"}
            </Button>

        </form>

    </div>,
    document.body

// src/context/SocketContext.jsx
/* eslint-disable react-refresh/only-export-components */
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
} from "react";
import { useAuth } from "./AuthContext.jsx";
import {
  connectSocket,
  disconnectSocket,
  getSocket,
  subscribeToReconnect,
} from "../services/socket.js";
import { alertsApi } from "../api/alerts.js";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "../utils/permissions.js";
import { startEmergencyChime, stopEmergencyChime } from "../utils/audioAlert.js";

const SocketContext = createContext(null);

export const SocketProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, can } = useAuth();
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
  const [activeAlerts, setActiveAlerts] = useState([]);
  const [isLoadingAlerts, setIsLoadingAlerts] = useState(false);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);

  const canViewAlerts = can
    ? can(PERMISSIONS.ALERTS_VIEW) || can(PERMISSIONS.ALERTS_MANAGE)
    : false;

  const canViewAlertsRef = useRef(canViewAlerts);
  canViewAlertsRef.current = canViewAlerts;

  // Authoritative REST fetch for active alerts
  const refreshAlerts = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!canViewAlertsRef.current) return [];
    try {
      setIsLoadingAlerts(true);
      const alerts = await alertsApi.getActiveAlerts();
      const list = Array.isArray(alerts) ? alerts : [];
      setActiveAlerts(list);

      // Check if any ongoing alerts are in unacknowledged ACTIVE state
      const hasUnacknowledged = list.some(
        (a) => (a.status || "").toUpperCase() === "ACTIVE"
      );
      if (hasUnacknowledged) {
        startEmergencyChime();
      } else {
        stopEmergencyChime();
      }

      return list;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[SocketContext] Failed to fetch active alerts:", err);
      return [];
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingAlerts(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Supervisor Acknowledge action
  const acknowledgeAlert = async (alertId) => {
    const updated = await alertsApi.acknowledgeAlert(alertId);
    stopEmergencyChime();
    setActiveAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === alertId ? { ...a, status: "ACKNOWLEDGED", ...updated } : a))
    );
    return updated;
  };

  // Supervisor Resolve action
  const resolveAlert = async (alertId, resolutionNotes = "") => {
    const updated = await alertsApi.resolveAlert(alertId, resolutionNotes);
    stopEmergencyChime();
    setActiveAlerts((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== alertId));
    return updated;
  };

  // Toggle Mute Audio
  const toggleMute = () => {
    setIsMuted((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (next) {
        stopEmergencyChime();
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Connection Lifecycle bound to Authentication
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      disconnectSocket();
      stopEmergencyChime();
      setActiveAlerts([]);
      setIsConnected(false);
      return;
    }

    const socket = connectSocket();

    const handleConnect = () => setIsConnected(true);
    const handleDisconnect = () => setIsConnected(false);

    // Incoming Emergency SOS Event
    const handleAlertTriggered = (envelope) => {
      const alertData = envelope?.data || envelope;
      if (!alertData || !alertData.id) return;

      setActiveAlerts((prev) => [
        alertData,
        ...prev.filter((a) => a.id !== alertData.id),
      ]);

      if (!isMuted) {
        startEmergencyChime();
      }
    };

    // Incoming Alert Status Update (Acknowledged / Resolved)
    const handleAlertStatusUpdated = (envelope) => {
      const alertData = envelope?.data || envelope;
      if (!alertData || !alertData.id) return;

      const newStatus = (alertData.status || "").toUpperCase();

      if (newStatus === "RESOLVED" || newStatus === "FALSE_ALARM") {
        setActiveAlerts((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== alertData.id));
      } else {
        setActiveAlerts((prev) =>
          prev.map((a) => (a.id === alertData.id ? { ...a, ...alertData } : a))
        );
      }

      // If no more unacknowledged ACTIVE alerts remain, stop chime
      setActiveAlerts((current) => {
        const stillActive = current.some(
          (a) => a.id !== alertData.id && (a.status || "").toUpperCase() === "ACTIVE"
        );
        if (!stillActive) {
          stopEmergencyChime();
        }
        return current;
      });
    };

    socket.on("connect", handleConnect);
    socket.on("disconnect", handleDisconnect);
    socket.on("EMERGENCY_ALERT_TRIGGERED", handleAlertTriggered);
    socket.on("EMERGENCY_ALERT_STATUS_UPDATED", handleAlertStatusUpdated);

    // Reconnection Recovery
    const unsubReconnect = subscribeToReconnect(() => {
      refreshAlerts();
    });

    // Initial fetch of active alerts on mount
    refreshAlerts();

    return () => {
      socket.off("connect", handleConnect);
      socket.off("disconnect", handleDisconnect);
      socket.off("EMERGENCY_ALERT_TRIGGERED", handleAlertTriggered);
      socket.off("EMERGENCY_ALERT_STATUS_UPDATED", handleAlertStatusUpdated);
      unsubReconnect();
      stopEmergencyChime();
    };
  }, [isAuthenticated, isMuted, refreshAlerts]);

  const value = {
    socket: getSocket(),
    isConnected,
    activeAlerts,
    isLoadingAlerts,
    isMuted,
    toggleMute,
    acknowledgeAlert,
    resolveAlert,
    refreshAlerts,
  };

  return <SocketContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SocketContext.Provider>;
};

export const useSocket = () => {
  const context = useContext(SocketContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSocket must be used within a SocketProvider");
  }
  return context;
};
````

// src/services/socket.js
import { io } from "socket.io-client";
import { API_BASE_URL } from "../api/client.js";

let socket = null;
let wasDisconnected = false;
const reconnectSubscribers = new Set();

/**
 * Resolves the Socket.IO base URL by stripping the '/api' prefix from the configured API URL.
 *
 * @param {string} [apiUrl] - Optional override API URL for testing
 * @returns {string} Backend root URL (e.g. 'http://localhost:5000' or 'https://madayawgas-backend.onrender.com')
 */
export function getSocketUrl(apiUrl = null) {
  const base = (apiUrl || API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5000/api").replace(/\/+$/, "");
  return base.replace(/\/api\/?$/, "");
}

/**
 * Initializes and connects the singleton Socket.IO client instance.
 * Supports cookie credentials ('mg_sid') and session token authentication payload.
 *
 * @param {string|null} [explicitToken] - Optional explicit session token
 * @returns {import('socket.io-client').Socket} Active Socket.IO instance
 */
export function connectSocket(explicitToken = null) {
  if (socket && socket.connected) {
    return socket;
  }

  if (socket) {
    socket.connect();
    return socket;
  }

  const socketUrl = getSocketUrl();
  const token = explicitToken || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("mg_token") : null);

  socket = io(socketUrl, {
    withCredentials: true,
    transports: ["websocket", "polling"],
    auth: (cb) => {
      const activeToken = explicitToken || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("mg_token") : null);
      cb(activeToken ? { token: activeToken } : {});
    },
    ...(token ? { extraHeaders: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } } : {}),
    reconnection: true,
    reconnectionAttempts: 15,
    reconnectionDelay: 1000,
    reconnectionDelayMax: 5000,
    randomizationFactor: 0.5,
    autoConnect: true,
  });

  socket.on("connect", () => {
    if (wasDisconnected) {
      // Reconnected after temporary outage: trigger authoritative REST recovery
      reconnectSubscribers.forEach((cb) => {
        try {
          cb();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("[Socket.IO] Reconnect subscriber failed:", err);
        }
      });
    }
    wasDisconnected = false;
  });

  socket.on("disconnect", (reason) => {
    wasDisconnected = true;
    if (reason === "io server disconnect") {
      // Server explicitly disconnected the socket (e.g. session invalidated)
      socket = null;
    }
  });

  socket.on("connect_error", (err) => {
    // Graceful error logging - do not crash application
    if (err.message && err.message.includes("Unauthorized")) {
      console.warn("[Socket.IO] Authentication handshake rejected:", err.message);
    }
  });

  return socket;
}

/**
 * Retrieves the current active Socket.IO client instance.
 *
 * @returns {import('socket.io-client').Socket|null}
 */
export function getSocket() {
  return socket;
}

/**
 * Explicitly terminates the Socket.IO connection and clears active references.
 * Called on user logout or session expiration.
 */
export function disconnectSocket() {
  if (socket) {
    try {
      socket.disconnect();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    socket = null;
  }
  wasDisconnected = false;
}

/**
 * Subscribes a callback to be executed whenever the socket recovers from a disconnect.
 *
 * @param {() => void} callback
 * @returns {() => void} Unsubscribe function
 */
export function subscribeToReconnect(callback) {
  if (typeof callback !== "function") return () => {};
  reconnectSubscribers.add(callback);
  return () => {
    reconnectSubscribers.delete(callback);
  };
}

/**
 * Subscribes to a specific Socket.IO domain event name.
 *
 * @param {string} eventName - e.g. 'FLEET_VEHICLE_GROUNDED'
 * @param {(envelope: object) => void} handler - Standardized envelope receiver
 * @returns {() => void} Unsubscribe function
 */
export function subscribeToEvent(eventName, handler) {
  if (!eventName || typeof handler !== "function") return () => {};
  const currentSocket = getSocket() || connectSocket();
  currentSocket.on(eventName, handler);
  return () => {
    currentSocket.off(eventName, handler);
  };
}
