// src/components/route-dispatch/StockCheckInModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  PackageCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Warehouse,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldAlert,
  Check,
  Info,
  Sparkles,
  Layers,
} from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal.jsx";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge.jsx";
import Button from "../ui/Button.jsx";
import { tripsApi } from "../../api/trips.js";

/**
 * StockCheckInModal — Fast, physical yard gate return check-in.
 * 
 * Optimized for multi-product dispatches:
 * - High-density tabular layout (Product | Loaded | Unsold | Good Empties | Damaged | Total | Action)
 * - 1-click "Mark All as Sold" bulk action for the standard 100% sellout scenario
 * - Inline defect note row that only expands when Damaged > 0
 * - Real-time variance & balance computation
 * - Conforms to project standards via reusable <Modal>, <Badge>, and <Button>
 */
export default function StockCheckInModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trip,
  products = [],
  onCompleteSuccess,
}) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1); // 1 = Table Form, 2 = Review & Confirm
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Group loaded products from dispatch loads
  const loadedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!trip) return [];
    const loads = trip.loads || [];
    const allItems = loads.flatMap((l) => l.items || []);
    const filledItems = allItems.filter((i) => (i.condition || "FILLED") === "FILLED");

    // Aggregate by productId
    const map = new Map();
    filledItems.forEach((it) => {
      const pId = it.productId;
      if (!pId) return;
      const current = map.get(pId) || {
        productId: pId,
        productName: it.productName || "LPG Product",
        containerType: it.containerType || "CANISTER",
        netWeightKg: it.netWeightKg || 0,
        loadedUnits: 0,
      };
      current.loadedUnits += parseInt(it.quantityUnits, 10) || 0;
      map.set(pId, current);
    });

    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [trip]);

  // Physical counts state map: { [productId]: { returnedFull, returnedEmptyGood, returnedDefective, defectNotes } }
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState({});
  const [supervisorNotes, setSupervisorNotes] = useState("");

  // Initialize or reset counts whenever trip opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && trip) {
      setStep(1);
      setError(null);
      setSupervisorNotes(
        trip.notes ? `Gate return verified. ${trip.notes}` : "Physical return counts verified at Bunawan yard gate."
      );

      const initial = {};
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        // Defaults: 0 unsold full, 0 defective, empties default to loaded units (standard sellout case)
        initial[p.productId] = {
          returnedFull: 0,
          returnedEmptyGood: p.loadedUnits || 0,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      setCounts(initial);
    }
  }, [isOpen, trip, loadedProducts]);

  if (!isOpen || !trip) return null;

  const handleCountChange = (productId, field, rawValue) => {
    const val = rawValue === "" ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseInt(rawValue, 10) || 0);
    setCounts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]: {
        ...(prev[productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0, defectNotes: "" }),
        [field]: val,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleNotesChange = (productId, notesValue) => {
    setCounts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]: {
        ...(prev[productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0, defectNotes: "" }),
        defectNotes: notesValue,
      },
    }));
  };

  // Quick preset shortcuts for physical counts
  const applyRowAllSold = (productId, loadedUnits) => {
    setCounts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]: {
        returnedFull: 0,
        returnedEmptyGood: loadedUnits,
        returnedDefective: 0,
        defectNotes: "",
      },
    }));
  };

  // Global bulk action: Mark all loaded products as completely sold out with empty returns
  const handleMarkAllSoldOut = () => {
    setCounts((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        next[p.productId] = {
          returnedFull: 0,
          returnedEmptyGood: p.loadedUnits,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Global bulk action: Reset all return counts to 0
  const handleResetAllToZero = () => {
    setCounts((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        next[p.productId] = {
          returnedFull: 0,
          returnedEmptyGood: 0,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Helper: Format crate + loose text
  const formatCrates = (units) => {
    const u = Number(units) || 0;
    const crates = Math.floor(u / 24);
    const loose = u % 24;
    if (crates === 0) return `${loose} cans`;
    if (loose === 0) return `${crates} crt`;
    return `${crates} crt + ${loose}`;
  };

  // Aggregate totals across all products
  const totals = loadedProducts.reduce(
    (acc, p) => {
      const pCounts = counts[p.productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0 };
      const full = Number(pCounts.returnedFull) || 0;
      const empty = Number(pCounts.returnedEmptyGood) || 0;
      const defect = Number(pCounts.returnedDefective) || 0;
      acc.totalLoaded += p.loadedUnits;
      acc.totalFull += full;
      acc.totalEmpty += empty;
      acc.totalDefect += defect;
      acc.totalReturned += full + empty + defect;
      return acc;
    },
    { totalLoaded: 0, totalFull: 0, totalEmpty: 0, totalDefect: 0, totalReturned: 0 }
  );

  const varianceFromLoaded = totals.totalReturned - totals.totalLoaded;

  const handleProceedToConfirm = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setStep(2);
  };

  const handleFinalSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Build returnLoads array conforming to API contract
      const returnLoads = [];
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        const pCounts = counts[p.productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0 };
        const full = Number(pCounts.returnedFull) || 0;
        const empty = Number(pCounts.returnedEmptyGood) || 0;
        const defect = Number(pCounts.returnedDefective) || 0;

        if (full > 0) {
          returnLoads.push({
            productId: p.productId,
            condition: "FILLED",
            quantityUnits: full,
          });
        }
        if (empty > 0) {
          returnLoads.push({
            productId: p.productId,
            condition: "EMPTY_GOOD",
            quantityUnits: empty,
          });
        }
        if (defect > 0) {
          returnLoads.push({
            productId: p.productId,
            condition: "DEFECTIVE",
            quantityUnits: defect,
          });
        }
      });

      // Construct payload
      const payload = {
        returnOdometerKm: Number(trip.departureOdometer || trip.truck_current_odometer || 0),
        supervisorNotes: supervisorNotes.trim() || "Physical yard return intake verified.",
        returnLoads,
      };

      const result = await tripsApi.completeTripReturn(trip.id, payload);

      // Invalidate caches
      localStorage.removeItem("app_trips_cache");
      localStorage.removeItem("app_items_cache");

      if (onCompleteSuccess) {
        onCompleteSuccess(result?.trip || trip);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to complete return check-in. Please try again.");
      setStep(1);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Render Footer for Step 1 vs Step 2
  const renderFooter = () => {
    if (step === 1) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="cancel"
            onClick={onClose}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>

          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleProceedToConfirm}
            disabled={loadedProducts.length === 0}
          >
            <span>Review Unloads</span>
            <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </Button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="cancel"
          onClick={() => setStep(1)}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={13} />
          <span>Back to Edit</span>
        </Button>

        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="primary"
          onClick={handleFinalSubmit}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
        >
          <span>{isSubmitting ? "Unloading..." : "Confirm Unload & Complete Trip"}</span>
          <CheckCircle2 size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Return Stock Check-In"
      subtitle={`Trip ${trip.tripNumber} · ${trip.truckPlate} · ${trip.driverName || "Driver"} (${trip.zoneCode || trip.zoneName || "Main Zone"})`}
      icon={PackageCheck}
      badge={<Badge variant="info">{trip.truckPlate}</Badge>}
      onBack={step === 2 ? () => setStep(1) : null}
      maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
      footer={renderFooter()}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4 text-xs text-left">
        {error && (
          <div
            role="alert"
            className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#C93B32] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 animate-scale-in"
          >
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 text-[#C93B32]" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================= STEP 1: TABULAR DATA ENTRY ================= */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            {/* Top Toolbar: Context & 1-Click Fast Actions */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Layers size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                  Dispatched: {totals.totalLoaded} units ({formatCrates(totals.totalLoaded)})
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">·</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  {loadedProducts.length} {loadedProducts.length === 1 ? "product type" : "product types"}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Fast Action Shortcuts */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleMarkAllSoldOut}
                  className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#d8ecf6] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs"
                  title="Sets all unsold to 0 and empties to loaded count"
                >
                  <Sparkles size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                  <span>Mark All Sold Out</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResetAllToZero}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200/70 transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
                  title="Reset counts to 0"
                >
                  <RotateCcw size={11} />
                  <span>Reset</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* High-Density Multi-Product Entry Table */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                <thead className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border-b border-slate-200 text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider select-none">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 min-w-[170px]">Product</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[80px]">Loaded</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[105px]">
                      <span className="text-slate-700">Unsold (Full)</span>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[105px]">
                      <span className="text-[#0A4B6E]">Good Empties</span>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[105px]">
                      <span className="text-rose-700">Damaged</span>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[100px]">Total Count</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center w-[75px]">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {loadedProducts.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          <PackageCheck size={28} className="text-slate-400" />
                          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                            No Dispatched Cargo Found
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-sm">
                            Trip #{trip.tripNumber} has no recorded dispatch loads.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    loadedProducts.map((p) => {
                    const pCounts = counts[p.productId] || {
                      returnedFull: 0,
                      returnedEmptyGood: 0,
                      returnedDefective: 0,
                      defectNotes: "",
                    };
                    const rowFull = Number(pCounts.returnedFull) || 0;
                    const rowEmpty = Number(pCounts.returnedEmptyGood) || 0;
                    const rowDefect = Number(pCounts.returnedDefective) || 0;
                    const rowTotal = rowFull + rowEmpty + rowDefect;
                    const isBalanced = rowTotal === p.loadedUnits;
                    const hasDefects = rowDefect > 0;

                    return (
                      <React.Fragment key={p.productId}>
                        <tr className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                          {/* Product Info */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                            <p className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs leading-tight">
                              {p.productName}
                            </p>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                              {p.containerType === "CANISTER" ? "Butane Canister" : "LPG Cylinder"} · {p.netWeightKg}kg
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          {/* Loaded Quantity */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                            <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200">
                              {p.loadedUnits}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          {/* Unsold (Full) */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedFull}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedFull", e.target.value)}
                              className="w-18 text-center py-1.5 px-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* Good Empties */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedEmptyGood}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedEmptyGood", e.target.value)}
                              className="w-18 text-center py-1.5 px-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* Damaged / Defective */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedDefective}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedDefective", e.target.value)}
                              className={`w-18 text-center py-1.5 px-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 ${
                                hasDefects
                                  ? "bg-rose-50 border-rose-400 text-rose-700 focus:ring-rose-500"
                                  : "bg-white border-slate-300 text-slate-700 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                              }`}
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* Total Counted & Row Status */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 font-bold">
                              <span
                                className={`text-xs ${
                                  isBalanced
                                    ? "text-emerald-700 font-bold"
                                    : rowTotal > p.loadedUnits
                                    ? "text-blue-700"
                                    : "text-amber-700"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {rowTotal}
                              </span>
                              {isBalanced ? (
                                <Check size={13} className="text-emerald-600 stroke-[2.5]" />
                              ) : rowTotal < p.loadedUnits ? (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 font-semibold">
                                  ({rowTotal - p.loadedUnits})
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 font-semibold">
                                  (+{rowTotal - p.loadedUnits})
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>

                          {/* Row Action: Quick Autofill */}
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => applyRowAllSold(p.productId, p.loadedUnits)}
                              className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-slate-200 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/40 transition cursor-pointer"
                              title="Set unsold to 0 and empties to loaded count"
                            >
                              All Sold
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>

                        {/* Expandable Defect Note row if damaged > 0 */}
                        {hasDefects && (
                          <tr className="bg-rose-50/50">
                            <td colSpan={7} className="py-2 px-3">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-800 uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0">
                                  Defect Note:
                                </span>
                                <input
                                  type="text"
                                  placeholder="e.g. 2 leaking valves, 1 dented body..."
                                  value={pCounts.defectNotes}
                                  onChange={(e) => handleNotesChange(p.productId, e.target.value)}
                                  className="w-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500"
                                />
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    );
                  }))}
                </tbody>

                {/* Table Footer with Totals */}
                <tfoot className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border-t border-slate-200 font-bold text-xs text-slate-700">
                  <tr>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-[#0A4B6E]">Total Units</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-800">{totals.totalLoaded}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-800">{totals.totalFull}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-[#0A4B6E]">{totals.totalEmpty}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-rose-700">{totals.totalDefect}</td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      <span
                        className={`text-xs ${
                          varianceFromLoaded === 0
                            ? "text-emerald-700 font-bold"
                            : varianceFromLoaded < 0
                            ? "text-amber-700 font-bold"
                            : "text-blue-700 font-bold"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {totals.totalReturned}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      {varianceFromLoaded === 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-bold uppercase">Balanced</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Live Count Balance Feedback Banner */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs">
              <span className="text-slate-600 font-medium">Reconciliation Status:</span>
              {varianceFromLoaded === 0 ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} />
                  <span>All {totals.totalLoaded} dispatched units accounted for</span>
                </span>
              ) : varianceFromLoaded < 0 ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-amber-900 bg-amber-100 border border-amber-300">
                  <Info size={13} />
                  <span>{Math.abs(varianceFromLoaded)} units pending customer swap / credit</span>
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-100 border border-blue-300">
                  +{varianceFromLoaded} extra units returned
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Optional Supervisor Gate Notes */}
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="supervisor-gate-notes" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
                Gate Notes (Optional)
              </label>
              <input
                id="supervisor-gate-notes"
                type="text"
                value={supervisorNotes}
                onChange={(e) => setSupervisorNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Vehicle physical condition, seal integrity, or gate notes..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/30"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================= STEP 2: REVIEW & CONFIRM ================= */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="text-center py-1">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center font-bold mb-2 shadow-2xs">
                <CheckCircle2 size={24} />
              </div>
              <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Review Yard Inventory Credit</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                Physical counts below will be credited directly to Bunawan Yard balances upon confirmation.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Yard Credit Summary Cards */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {/* Sale-Ready Warehouse */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl space-y-1 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-700 font-bold text-xs">
                  <Warehouse size={15} />
                  <span>Warehouse (Full)</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mt-1">
                  +{totals.totalFull.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">units</span>
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                  Sealed unsold stock
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Plant Refill Queue */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl space-y-1 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs">
                  <RotateCcw size={15} />
                  <span>Refill Dock (Empties)</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mt-1">
                  +{totals.totalEmpty.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">units</span>
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                  Customer return swaps
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Quarantine Defective */}
              <div className="p-3.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl space-y-1 shadow-2xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-700 font-bold text-xs">
                  <ShieldAlert size={15} />
                  <span>Quarantine Buffer</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-rose-700 mt-1">
                  +{totals.totalDefect.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">units</span>
                </p>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                  Damaged or leaking units
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Breakdown Table Recap */}
            <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                <thead className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border-b border-slate-200 text-[#6D8AA2] text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3">Product</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center">Unsold</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center">Empties</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center">Damaged</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-center">Total Return</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {loadedProducts.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          <PackageCheck size={28} className="text-slate-400" />
                          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                            No Dispatched Cargo Found
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-sm">
                            Trip #{trip.tripNumber} has no recorded dispatch loads.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    loadedProducts.map((p) => {
                    const c = counts[p.productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0 };
                    const tot = (Number(c.returnedFull) || 0) + (Number(c.returnedEmptyGood) || 0) + (Number(c.returnedDefective) || 0);
                    return (
                      <tr key={p.productId}>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">{p.productName}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center font-medium">{c.returnedFull}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center font-medium text-[#0A4B6E]">{c.returnedEmptyGood}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center font-medium text-rose-700">{c.returnedDefective}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-center font-bold text-slate-800">{tot}</td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  }))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Reassurance Notice */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-[#BCE1F1] rounded-xl text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
              <span>
                Completing return check-in updates Bunawan yard inventory immediately.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/VehicleSearchDropdown.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { Truck, Search, ChevronDown, Check, X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * VehicleSearchDropdown — Compact, high-contrast searchable dropdown for vehicle plate numbers.
 * Conforms to MadayawGas UI standards (Dark Navy #0A4B6E, crisp borders, immediate search filter).
 */
export default function VehicleSearchDropdown({
  trips = [],
  selectedTripId = "",
  onSelectTrip,
  placeholder = "Select vehicle plate number...",
  disabled = false,
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);
  const searchInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Close on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (e) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleOutsideClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleOutsideClick);
  }, []);

  // Autofocus search input when dropdown opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && searchInputRef.current) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        searchInputRef.current?.focus();
      }, 50);
    } else {
      setSearchQuery("");
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const selectedTrip = useMemo(() => {
    return trips.find((t) => t.id === selectedTripId) || null;
  }, [trips, selectedTripId]);

  // Filter trips by plate number, trip number, or driver
  const filteredTrips = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return trips;
    return trips.filter((t) => {
      const plate = (t.truckPlate || "").toLowerCase();
      const tripNum = String(t.tripNumber || "").toLowerCase();
      const driver = (t.driverName || "").toLowerCase();
      return plate.includes(q) || tripNum.includes(q) || driver.includes(q);
    });
  }, [trips, searchQuery]);

  const handleSelect = (trip) => {
    onSelectTrip(trip.id);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative inline-block text-left w-full sm:w-[280px]">
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled || trips.length === 0}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        className={`w-full h-10 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white border rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs select-none ${
          isOpen
            ? "border-[#0A4B6E] ring-2 ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
            : "border-[#0A4B6E]/30 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 hover:bg-[#F8FBFC]"
        } ${disabled || trips.length === 0 ? "opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-50" : ""}`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <Truck size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
          {selectedTrip ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
              <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">
                {selectedTrip.truckPlate}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0 border border-[#BCE1F1]">
                #{selectedTrip.tripNumber}
              </span>
              {(selectedTrip.rawStatus || selectedTrip.status || "").toUpperCase() === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
                  En Route
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 truncate">
              {trips.length === 0 ? "No returning vehicles" : placeholder}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <ChevronDown
          size={14}
          className={`text-[#6D8AA2] shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180 text-[#0A4B6E]" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown Popover */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 top-full mt-1.5 w-full sm:w-[320px] bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 py-2 z-50 animate-scale-in text-left">
          {/* Search Input Header */}
          <div className="px-2.5 pb-2 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div className="relative flex items-center">
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 text-[#6D8AA2] pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                ref={searchInputRef}
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search plate number..."
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-800 bg-[#F4F8FA] border border-slate-200 rounded-lg placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:bg-white"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                  className="absolute right-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 p-0.5"
                >
                  <X size={13} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* List of Vehicles */}
          <div className="max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar divide-y divide-slate-50 pt-1">
            {filteredTrips.length > 0 ? (
              filteredTrips.map((trip) => {
                const isSelected = selectedTrip?.id === trip.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={trip.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelect(trip)}
                    className={`w-full px-3 py-2 text-left flex items-center justify-between gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] text-[#0A4B6E]"
                        : "hover:bg-[#F4F9FC] text-slate-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          {trip.truckPlate}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200">
                          #{trip.tripNumber}
                        </span>
                        {(trip.rawStatus || trip.status || "").toUpperCase() === "IN_PROGRESS" ? (
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
                            En Route
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
                            Returned
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate mt-0.5">
                        {trip.driverName || "Driver"} {trip.zoneCode ? `· ${trip.zoneCode}` : ""}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {isSelected && (
                      <Check size={14} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0 font-bold" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            ) : (
              <div className="py-4 px-3 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                No matching plate numbers found
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/sales/TransactionRecordsTab.jsx
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Search,
  Filter,
  Receipt,
  Calendar,
  Banknote,
  CreditCard,
  ChevronRight,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { formatPhilippineDateTime, formatPhilippineDate } from "../../utils/date.js";
import Pagination from "../ui/Pagination";
import TransactionDetailDrawer from "./TransactionDetailDrawer";

export default function TransactionRecordsTab({
  transactions = [],
  isLoading = false,
  searchTerm = "",
  onSearchChange,
  statusFilter = "",
  onStatusChange,
  paymentMethodFilter = "",
  onPaymentMethodChange,
}) {
  const [selectedTx, setSelectedTx] = useState(null);
  const [isClosingDrawer, setIsClosingDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const limit = 20;

  // Filter transactions
  const filteredTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    return transactions.filter((tx) => {
      const matchSearch =
        !searchTerm ||
        (tx.transaction_no || tx.transactionNo || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (tx.invoice_number || tx.invoiceNumber || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (tx.customer_name || tx.customerName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (tx.customer_business_name || tx.customerBusinessName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      const matchStatus =
        !statusFilter ||
        (tx.status || "").toUpperCase() === statusFilter.toUpperCase();

      const matchPayment =
        !paymentMethodFilter ||
        (tx.payment_method || tx.paymentMethod || "").toUpperCase() === paymentMethodFilter.toUpperCase();

      return matchSearch && matchStatus && matchPayment;
    });
  }, [transactions, searchTerm, statusFilter, paymentMethodFilter]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredTransactions.length / limit) || 1;
  const paginatedTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (page - 1) * limit;
    return filteredTransactions.slice(start, start + limit);
  }, [filteredTransactions, page, limit]);

  const handleOpenDrawer = (tx) => {
    setSelectedTx(tx);
    setIsClosingDrawer(false);
  };

  const handleCloseDrawer = () => {
    setIsClosingDrawer(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSelectedTx(null);
      setIsClosingDrawer(false);
    }, 250);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden relative">
      {/* Controls Bar */}
      <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-3">
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
          <Search size={14} className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by transaction #, invoice #, customer name..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => {
              onSearchChange(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-full focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E] transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Filter Dropdowns */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Status Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#6D8AA2]">Status:</span>
            <select
              value={statusFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                onStatusChange(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="">All Statuses</option>
              <option value="COMPLETED">Completed</option>
              <option value="CANCELLED">Cancelled</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Method Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#6D8AA2]">Payment:</span>
            <select
              value={paymentMethodFilter}
              onChange={(e) => {
                onPaymentMethodChange(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="">All Methods</option>
              <option value="CASH">Cash on Delivery</option>
              <option value="GCASH">GCash Transfer</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content: Table on Left + Optional Detail Drawer on Right */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-row overflow-hidden border border-[#0A4B6E]/15 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-xs">
        {/* Master Table Container */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse min-w-[780px]">
              <thead className="bg-[#E8F3F8]/70 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-[#0A4B6E]/15 backdrop-blur-xs select-none">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">Transaction No</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Transacted Date</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Customer</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Total Amount</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Payment Settlement</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">Order Status</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
                {isLoading ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                      Loading sales transactions...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : paginatedTransactions.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                      No sales transactions found matching criteria
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  paginatedTransactions.map((tx) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedTx?.id === tx.id;
                    const isCancelled = (tx.status || "").toUpperCase() === "CANCELLED";
                    const paymentMethod = (tx.payment_method || tx.paymentMethod || "CASH").toUpperCase();
                    const paymentStatus = (tx.payment_status || tx.paymentStatus || "").toUpperCase();
                    const totalAmount = Number(tx.total_amount || tx.totalAmount || 0);

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={tx.id}
                        onClick={() => handleOpenDrawer(tx)}
                        className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] font-semibold"
                            : "hover:bg-slate-50/80"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Transaction Reference */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3.5 font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          {tx.transaction_no || tx.transactionNo}
                        </td>

                        {/* Transacted Date */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-slate-600">
                          {formatPhilippineDateTime(tx.transacted_at || tx.transactedAt)}
                        </td>

                        {/* Customer */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            {tx.customer_name || tx.customerName || "Customer"}
                          </div>
                          {tx.customer_business_name && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                              {tx.customer_business_name}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Total Amount */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          ₱{totalAmount.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Payment Settlement */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {paymentMethod === "CASH" ? (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 text-[10px] font-bold border border-emerald-200">
                                <Banknote size={11} />
                                <span>CASH</span>
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 text-[10px] font-bold border border-sky-200">
                                <CreditCard size={11} />
                                <span>GCASH</span>
                              </span>
                            )}

                            {paymentStatus && (
                              <span
                                className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-bold uppercase ${
                                  paymentStatus === "VERIFIED"
                                    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                                    : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {paymentStatus}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Order Status */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                              isCancelled
                                ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200"
                                : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {tx.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Action */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3.5 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>

import Pagination from "../ui/Pagination";
import TripShiftSummaryDrawer from "./TripShiftSummaryDrawer";

export default function TripDeliveriesTab({
  trips = [],
  isLoading = false,
  searchTerm = "",
  onSearchChange,
  statusFilter = "",
  onStatusChange,
}) {
  const [selectedTrip, setSelectedTrip] = useState(null);
  const [isClosingDrawer, setIsClosingDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const limit = 15;

  // Filter trips locally
  const filteredTrips = useMemo(() => {
    return trips.filter((t) => {
      const matchSearch =
        !searchTerm ||
        (t.trip_number || t.tripNumber || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (t.truck_plate_number || t.truckPlate || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (t.zone_name || t.zoneName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (t.driver_name || t.driverName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (t.sales_name || t.salesName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      const matchStatus =
        !statusFilter ||
        (t.status || "").toUpperCase() === statusFilter.toUpperCase();

      return matchSearch && matchStatus;
    });
  }, [trips, searchTerm, statusFilter]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredTrips.length / limit) || 1;
  const paginatedTrips = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (page - 1) * limit;
    return filteredTrips.slice(start, start + limit);
  }, [filteredTrips, page, limit]);

  const handleOpenDrawer = (trip) => {
    setSelectedTrip(trip);
    setIsClosingDrawer(false);
  };

  const handleCloseDrawer = () => {
    setIsClosingDrawer(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSelectedTrip(null);
      setIsClosingDrawer(false);
    }, 250);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden relative">
      {/* Controls Bar */}
      <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-3">
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
          <Search size={14} className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by trip #, plate, zone, driver or sales agent..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => {
              onSearchChange(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-full focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E] transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Status Filter */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1">
            <Filter size={12} />
            <span>Status:</span>
          </span>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              onStatusChange(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="">All Statuses</option>
            <option value="COMPLETED">Completed</option>
            <option value="IN_PROGRESS">In Progress</option>
            <option value="CANCELLED">Cancelled</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area: Table on Left + Optional Slide Drawer on Right */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-row overflow-hidden border border-[#0A4B6E]/15 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-xs">
        {/* Master Trips Table Container */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse min-w-[860px]">
              <thead className="bg-[#E8F3F8]/70 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-[#0A4B6E]/15 backdrop-blur-xs select-none">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">Trip Number</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Vehicle & Crew</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">Zone</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Orders</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Gross Sales</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">Units / Returns</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center whitespace-nowrap">Status</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-700">
                {isLoading ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                      Loading delivery performance records...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : paginatedTrips.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                      No delivery trips found matching criteria
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  paginatedTrips.map((trip) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedTrip?.id === trip.id;
                    const status = (trip.status || "").toUpperCase();
                    const totalRevenue = Number(trip.total_sales_amount || trip.totalRevenue || 0);

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={trip.id}
                        onClick={() => handleOpenDrawer(trip)}
                        className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] font-semibold"
                            : "hover:bg-slate-50/80"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Trip Number & Date */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                            {trip.trip_number || trip.tripNumber}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[#6D8AA2] flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                            <Calendar size={10} />
                            <span>
                              {formatPhilippineDate(trip.departure_time || trip.departureTime)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Vehicle & Crew */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Truck size={12} className="text-[#0F7AB2]" />
                            <span>{trip.truck_plate_number || trip.truckPlate}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                            Driver: {trip.driver_name || trip.driverName || "N/A"} • Rep: {trip.sales_name || trip.salesName || "N/A"}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Zone */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] text-[10px] font-bold border border-[#BCE1F1]/60">
                            <MapPin size={10} />
                            <span>{trip.zone_name || trip.zoneName || "Zone"}</span>
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Completed Orders */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-slate-800">
                          {trip.completed_transactions ?? trip.total_transactions ?? 0}
                        </td>

                        {/* Total Revenue */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          ₱{totalRevenue.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Units / Empties */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">
                            {trip.total_units_sold ?? 0}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">
                            {trip.total_empties_returned ?? 0} returned
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Status */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${
                              status === "COMPLETED"
                                ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
                                : status === "IN_PROGRESS"
                                ? "bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border border-sky-200"
                                : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {trip.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Action */}
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3.5 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenDrawer(trip)}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] hover:bg-[#d5e8f3] text-[#0A4B6E] text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <span>Summary</span>
                            <ChevronRight size={12} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Pagination */}
          <Pagination
            page={page}
            totalPages={totalPages}
            totalItems={filteredTrips.length}
            limit={limit}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            isLoading={isLoading}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Slide-in Detail Drawer */}
        {selectedTrip && (
          <TripShiftSummaryDrawer
            trip={selectedTrip}
            onClose={handleCloseDrawer}
            isClosing={isClosingDrawer}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/ui/Button.jsx
import React from "react";

/**
 * Standardized enterprise Button component for MadayawGas.
 * Supports semantic variants with 8dp rhythm, brand colors, and accessible focus states.
 */
export default function Button({
  children,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  disabled = false,
  ...props
}) {
  const baseStyles =
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center font-semibold transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none cursor-pointer select-none";

  const sizeStyles = {
    sm: "px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg gap-1.5",
    md: "px-4 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg gap-2",
    lg: "px-5 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-lg gap-2",
    pill: "px-4 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-full gap-1.5",
  };

  const variants = {
    // Primary Action (Yellow brand CTA)
    primary:
      "bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-2xs",
    // Secondary Action (Clean white with subtle border)
    secondary:
      "bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-2xs",
    // Destructive / Danger
    destructive:
      "bg-[#C93B32] hover:bg-[#a82e26] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-2xs",
    danger:
      "bg-[#C93B32] hover:bg-[#a82e26] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-2xs",
    // Navy Action
    navy:
      "bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold shadow-2xs",
    // Outline
    outline:
      "bg-transparent border border-[#0A4B6E] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8]/60",
    // Ghost

    red:
      "bg-[#C93B32] hover:bg-[#a82e26] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-2xs",
    cancel:
      "bg-transparent text-[#6D8AA2] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-slate-100 font-semibold",
  };

  const currentSize = sizeStyles[size] || sizeStyles.md;
  const currentVariant = variants[variant] || variants.primary;

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`${baseStyles} ${currentSize} ${currentVariant} ${className}`}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, AlertCircle, Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "./Modal.jsx";
import Button from "./Button.jsx";

export default function ConfirmationModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  title = "Are you sure?",
  message,
  confirmText = "Confirm",
  cancelText = "Cancel",
  variant = "danger", // "danger" | "warning" | "primary"
  isLoading = false,
  icon: Icon = AlertTriangle,
  requiresPassword = false,
  passwordLabel = "Enter password to authorize this action:",
  passwordPlaceholder = "••••••••••••",
}) {
  const isDanger = variant === "danger";
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      setPassword("");
      setShowPassword(false);
      setError("");
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();

    if (requiresPassword && !password.trim()) {
      setError("Password is required to proceed.");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      if (requiresPassword) {
        await onConfirm(password);
      } else {
        await onConfirm();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Authentication failed. Please verify your password.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const isBusy = isLoading || isSubmitting;
  const isSubmitDisabled = isBusy || (requiresPassword && !password.trim());

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={isBusy ? undefined : onClose}
      title={title}
      icon={Icon}
      maxWidth="max-w-md"
      footer={
        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-end gap-2.5 w-full">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isBusy}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto"
          >
            {cancelText}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant={isDanger ? "destructive" : "primary"}
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            isLoading={isBusy}
            disabled={isSubmitDisabled}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs"
          >
            {confirmText}
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 py-1">
        {/* Warning Message Box */}
        <div
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-3 text-xs leading-relaxed ${
            isDanger
              ? "bg-rose-50/70 border-rose-100 text-rose-950"
              : "bg-amber-50/70 border-amber-100 text-amber-950"
          }`}
        >
          <AlertCircle
            size={18}
            className={`shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${
              isDanger ? "text-[#C93B32]" : "text-amber-600"
            }`}
          />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {typeof message === "string" ? <p>{message}</p> : message}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Inline Password Authorization Field */}
        {requiresPassword && (
          <div className="pt-1 space-y-1.5 text-left">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {passwordLabel}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPassword(e.target.value);
                  if (error) setError("");
                }}
                placeholder={passwordPlaceholder}
                disabled={isBusy}
                autoFocus
                className="w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] text-slate-800 text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 outline-none pr-10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 focus:border-[#0A4B6E] disabled:opacity-60 transition"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                disabled={isBusy}
                aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#6D8AA2] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer"
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={15} /> : <Eye size={15} />}
              </button>
            </div>
            {error && (
              <p className="text-rose-600 text-[11px] font-medium flex items-center gap-1 mt-1">
                <AlertTriangle size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                <span>{error}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

/**
 * DocumentViewerModal
 *
 * Standardized global image and document preview modal supporting:
 * 1. Centered dialog preview with file info, external tab opener, and expand trigger.
 * 2. Fullscreen immersive lightbox (isExpanded) with backdrop blur and ESC key navigation.
 * 3. Works seamlessly with string URLs, storageKeys, or document objects.
 *
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Visibility flag
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Close callback
 * @param {string | Object | null} [props.item] - Target media (URL, storageKey, or object)
 * @param {string | null} [props.storageKey] - Direct relative or absolute storage key
 * @param {string | null} [props.fileUrl] - Direct media file URL
 * @param {string | null} [props.url] - Direct URL
 * @param {string} [props.title] - Optional display title override
 * @param {string} [props.fallbackName="Document Preview"] - Default title if none detected
 * @param {boolean} [props.defaultExpanded=false] - Start directly in fullscreen lightbox mode
 */
export default function DocumentViewerModal({
  isOpen = false,
  onClose,
  item = null,
  storageKey = null,
  fileUrl: propFileUrl = null,
  url = null,
  title,
  fallbackName = "Document Preview",
  defaultExpanded = false,
}) {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);
  const [hasImageError, setHasImageError] = useState(false);

  const targetItem = item || storageKey || propFileUrl || url;

  // Sync expanded state and reset error state when opening or targetItem changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setIsExpanded(defaultExpanded);
      setHasImageError(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, defaultExpanded, targetItem]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    setIsExpanded(false);
    setHasImageError(false);
    if (typeof onClose === "function") {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  // Keyboard navigation: Escape key exits fullscreen first, or closes modal if not expanded
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        if (isExpanded) {
          setIsExpanded(false);
        } else {
          handleClose();
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, isExpanded]);

  if (!isOpen || !targetItem || typeof document === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }

  // Resolve media file URL
  const fileUrl = typeof targetItem === "string"
    ? resolveMediaUrl(targetItem)
    : getReceiptFileUrl(targetItem) || resolveMediaUrl(targetItem.fileUrl || targetItem.storageKey || targetItem.url);

  const isPdf = isPdfFile(targetItem) || (typeof targetItem === "string" && isPdfFile(targetItem));

  const displayName =
    title ||

                title="Open original file in new tab"
              >
                <ExternalLink size={16} />
                <span className="hidden md:inline">Open New Tab</span>
              </a>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsExpanded(false)}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              title="Exit Full View (Esc)"
            >

              <X size={18} />

        >

    ) : (

      <div

        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 pr-2">
              <FileText size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
              <span className="font-bold text-sm md:text-base text-[#0A4B6E] font-mono truncate">
                {displayName}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
              <button

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Funnel } from "lucide-react";

const getOptionLabel = (opt) => {
  if (!opt) return "";
  if (typeof opt === "object" && opt !== null) {
    return opt.label ?? opt.name ?? opt.value ?? "";
  }
  return typeof opt === "string" ? opt.replace(/_/g, " ") : String(opt);
};

const getOptionValue = (opt) => {
  if (!opt) return "";
  if (typeof opt === "object" && opt !== null) {
    return opt.value !== undefined ? opt.value : opt.id !== undefined ? opt.id : opt.label;
  }
  return opt;
};

export default function FilterDropdown({
  label = "Filter",
  options = [],
  value,
  onChange,
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const handleSelect = (option) => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    if (onChange) onChange(option);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  // Determine trigger button label
  const selectedOption = options.find((opt) => getOptionValue(opt) === value);
  const displayLabel = selectedOption
    ? getOptionLabel(selectedOption)
    : typeof value === "string" && value
    ? value.replace(/_/g, " ")
    : label;

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        className="
          bg-[#FCFEFE]
          hover:bg-[#F3F8FB]
          text-[#0A4B6E]
          px-3
          py-1.5
          rounded-full
          text-xs
          font-semibold
          border
          border-[#0A4B6E]/30
          hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60
          flex
          items-center
          gap-1.5
          transition-all
          duration-150
          h-[30px]
          min-w-[110px]
          justify-between
          cursor-pointer
          shadow-2xs
        "
      >
        <span className="truncate max-w-[140px]">
          {displayLabel}
        </span>

        <Funnel
          size={12}
          className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" 
        />
      </button>

      <div
        className={`
          absolute
          right-0
          mt-1.5
          w-52
          max-h-60
          overflow-y-auto
          custom-scrollbar
          bg-white
          border
          border-[#0A4B6E]/20
          rounded-xl
          shadow-lg
          z-20
          py-1
          origin-top-right
          transition-all
          duration-150
          ease-out
          ${
            isOpen
              ? "opacity-100 scale-100 translate-y-0"
              : "opacity-0 scale-95 -translate-y-1 pointer-events-none"
          }
        `}
      >
        {options.map((option, index) => {
          const optValue = getOptionValue(option);
          const optLabel = getOptionLabel(option);
          const isSelected = value === optValue;

          return (
            <button
              key={optValue || index}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSelect(option)}
              className={`
                w-full
                text-left
                px-3
                py-1.5
                text-xs
                transition-colors
                duration-150
                hover:bg-gray-50
                cursor-pointer
                truncate
                ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "text-[#0F7AB2] font-semibold bg-[#F8FBFC]"
                    : "text-gray-700"
                }
              `}
              title={optLabel}
            >
              {optLabel}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
