````javascript
  className = "",
}) {
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState("");
  const [isDragOver, setIsDragOver] = useState(false);
  const [isCameraModalOpen, setIsCameraModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const cameraInputRef = useRef(null);

  const resolvedUrl = resolveMediaUrl(value);
  const isPdf =
    Boolean(value && typeof value === "string") &&
    (/\.pdf(\?.*)?$/i.test(value) || value.includes("application/pdf"));

  const handleFileProcess = async (file) => {
    if (!file || disabled) return;
    setErrorMessage("");
    setIsUploading(true);

    try {
      const result = await uploadMediaFile(file, domain);
      if (onChange) {
        onChange(result.storageKey, result);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Media upload error:", err);
      setErrorMessage(
        err?.message || "Failed to process and upload media. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileProcess(file);
    }
    e.target.value = "";
  };

  const handleDrop = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(false);
    if (disabled || isUploading) return;
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileProcess(file);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!disabled && !isUploading) {
      setIsDragOver(true);
    }
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(false);
  };

  const handleRemove = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (disabled || isUploading) return;
    setErrorMessage("");
    if (onRemove) {
      onRemove();
    } else if (onChange) {
      onChange("", null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`w-full flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-left ${className}`}>
      {label && (
        <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#0A4B6E]">
          {label}
        </label>
      )}

      {/* Hidden native file inputs */}
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        id="media_upload_file_input"
        name="media_file"
        type="file"
        accept={accept}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        disabled={disabled || isUploading}
        className="hidden"
      />
      <input
        ref={cameraInputRef}
        id="media_upload_camera_input"
        name="camera_file"
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        capture="environment"
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        disabled={disabled || isUploading}
        className="hidden"
      />

      {/* ERROR NOTICE */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <AlertCircle size={14} className="shrink-0 text-red-500" />
            <span className="truncate">{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setErrorMessage("")}
            className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 p-0.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            title="Dismiss error"
          >
            <X size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ACTIVE VALUE PREVIEW */}
      {value ? (
        <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            {isPdf ? (
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <FileText size={20} />
                <span className="font-bold text-[9px] mt-0.5">PDF</span>
              </div>
            ) : resolvedUrl ? (
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 shrink-0">
                <img
                  src={resolvedUrl}
                  alt="Uploaded media preview"
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <FileText size={20} />
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 truncate font-mono">
                {typeof value === "string" ? value.split("/").pop() : "Attached Document"}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 font-semibold bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-100">
                  Uploaded & Saved
                </span>
                {resolvedUrl && (
                  <a
                    href={resolvedUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-[10px] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 font-medium"
                  >
                    <span>View</span>
                    <ExternalLink size={10} />
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              disabled={disabled || isUploading}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Replace
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRemove}
              disabled={disabled || isUploading}
              className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Remove file"
            >
              <X size={15} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* UPLOAD DROPZONE */
        <div
          onDrop={handleDrop}
          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
          className={`relative border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl p-4 text-center transition-all duration-200 ${
            isDragOver
              ? "border-[#0A4B6E] bg-[#E8F3F8]/50"
              : "border-[#BCE1F1] hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 bg-[#F4F8FA]"
          } ${disabled ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : ""}`}
        >
          {isUploading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-3 space-y-2">
              <Loader2 size={24} className="text-[#0A4B6E] animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                Compressing & Uploading Media...
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                Enforcing 5 MB ceiling & converting image format
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center">
                <Upload size={18} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                  Choose a file or drag & drop here
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5">
                  {helperText || "JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF (Max 5 MB payload ceiling)"}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  disabled={disabled || isUploading}
                  className="py-1.5 px-3.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#083b57] text-[#FFDF2C] flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Upload size={13} />
                  <span>Browse File</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (disabled || isUploading) return;
                    if (
                      typeof navigator !== "undefined" &&
                      navigator?.mediaDevices &&
                      typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia === "function"
                    ) {
                      setIsCameraModalOpen(true);
                    } else {
                      cameraInputRef.current?.click();
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={disabled || isUploading}
                  className="py-1.5 px-3.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-white text-[#0A4B6E] border border-gray-300 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Camera size={13} />
                  <span>Take Photo</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Production In-Browser WebRTC Camera Viewfinder */}
      <CameraCaptureModal
        isOpen={isCameraModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCameraModalOpen(false)}
        onCapture={(capturedFile) => {
          handleFileProcess(capturedFile);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/ui/Pagination.jsx
import React from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Standardized Pagination component for MadayawGas application.
 * Pinned at the bottom of data tables with entry counter, page size selector,
 * boundary controls, and windowed page numbers matching the Navy/Yellow brand identity.
 */
export default function Pagination({
  page = 1,
  totalPages = 1,
  totalItems = 0,
  limit = 20,
  limitOptions = [10, 20, 50, 100],
  onPageChange,
  onLimitChange,
  isLoading = false,
  itemLabel = "entries",
  className = "",
}) {
  if (totalItems === 0 && totalPages <= 1) {
    return null;
  }

  const start = totalItems === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * limit + 1;
  const end = Math.min(page * limit, totalItems);

  // Generate page numbers with dynamic ellipses
  const getPageNumbers = () => {
    if (totalPages <= 7) {
      return Array.from({ length: totalPages }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    }
    if (page <= 4) {
      return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, "...", totalPages];
    }
    if (page >= totalPages - 3) {
      return [
        1,
        "...",
        totalPages - 4,
        totalPages - 3,
        totalPages - 2,
        totalPages - 1,
        totalPages,
      ];
    }
    return [1, "...", page - 1, page, page + 1, "...", totalPages];
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`shrink-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 rounded-b-2xl select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Left: Entry counter & Page Size Selector */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-[#6D8AA2]">
        <div>
          Showing <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">{start}</span> to{" "}
          <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">{end}</span> of{" "}
          <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">{totalItems}</span> {itemLabel}
        </div>

        {onLimitChange && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-2 border-l border-slate-200">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">Per page:</span>
            <select
              value={limit}
              onChange={(e) => onLimitChange(Number(e.target.value))}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] cursor-pointer"
            >
              {limitOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right: Navigation controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(page - 1)}
          disabled={page <= 1 || isLoading}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] disabled:text-slate-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={15} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Prev</span>
        </button>

        {getPageNumbers().map((p, idx) =>
          p === "..." ? (
            <span key={`dots-${idx}`} className="px-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
              ...
            </span>
          ) : (
            <button
              key={`page-${p}`}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(p)}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center ${
                page === p
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs"
                  : "text-[#1B4B75] hover:bg-slate-100"
              }`}
            >
              {p}
            </button>
          )
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(page + 1)}
          disabled={page >= totalPages || isLoading}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] disabled:text-slate-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Next</span>
          <ChevronRight size={15} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/ui/SearchBar.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Standardized SearchBar component for MadayawGas.
 * Supports:
 * - Strategy A (in-memory reactive): Pass `value` and `onChange`.
 * - Strategy B (Search on Enter / Click): Pass `onSearch` (and optionally `onClear`, `defaultValue` or initial `value`).
 */
export default function SearchBar({
  placeholder = "Search...",
  value = "",
  onChange,
  onSearch,
  onClear,
  className = "",
}) {
  const isExplicitSearch = typeof onSearch === "function";
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value || "");
  const [prevValue, setPrevValue] = useState(value || "");

  // Synchronize internal draft during render if parent resets or updates value externally
  if (value !== prevValue) {
    setPrevValue(value || "");
    setLocalValue(value || "");
  }

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setLocalValue(val);
    if (!isExplicitSearch && onChange) {
      onChange(e);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isExplicitSearch) {
        onSearch(localValue.trim());
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSearchClick = () => {
    if (isExplicitSearch) {
      onSearch(localValue.trim());
    }
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setLocalValue("");
    if (isExplicitSearch) {
      onSearch("");
      if (onClear) onClear();
    } else {
      if (onChange) {
        onChange({ target: { value: "" } });
      }
      if (onClear) onClear();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative flex items-center ${className}`}>
      {/* Search Icon / Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleSearchClick}
        title={isExplicitSearch ? "Click or press Enter to search" : "Search"}
        className={`absolute left-2.5 text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
          isExplicitSearch
            ? "cursor-pointer hover:text-[#0F7AB2] active:scale-95"
            : "pointer-events-none"
        }`}
      >
        <Search size={14} />
      </button>

      <input
        type="text"
        value={localValue}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className="w-full h-[30px] bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 rounded-full pl-8 pr-7 text-xs text-[#1B4B75] placeholder-[#6D8AA2]/70 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F7AB2]/20 focus:border-[#0F7AB2] transition-all shadow-2xs"
      />

      {localValue && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleClear}
          title="Clear search"
          className="absolute right-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
        >
          <X size={12} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import React from "react";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";

export default function Select({
  label,
  id,
  options = [],
  className = "",
  error,
  placeholder,
  required = false,
  disabled = false,
  helperText,
  ...props
}) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-1 text-left">
      {label && (
        <label
          htmlFor={id}
          className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1 select-none"
        >
          <span>{label}</span>
          {required && <span className="text-red-500 font-bold">*</span>}
        </label>
      )}
      <div className="relative w-full">
        <select
          id={id}
          disabled={disabled}
          className={`w-full h-10 pl-3 pr-8 py-2 text-xs text-slate-800 bg-white border rounded-lg transition-all shadow-2xs outline-hidden appearance-none cursor-pointer
            ${
              error
                ? "border-red-400 focus:border-red-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400/20"
                : "border-[#CBD5E1] hover:border-slate-400 focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
            }
            ${disabled ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200" : ""}
            ${className}`}
          {...props}
        >
          {placeholder && (
            <option value="" disabled hidden>
              {placeholder}
            </option>
          )}
          {options.map((opt) => {
            const val = typeof opt === "object" ? opt.value : opt;
            const lbl = typeof opt === "object" ? opt.label : opt;
            return (
              <option key={val} value={val}>
                {lbl}
              </option>
            );
          })}
        </select>
        <ChevronDown
          size={14}
          className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#6D8AA2] pointer-events-none"
        />
      </div>
      {error && <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-red-600 mt-0.5">{error}</span>}
      {!error && helperText && (
        <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5">{helperText}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { Funnel, X } from "lucide-react";

export default function ActiveFilters({
  selectedRole,
  selectedStatus,
  onClearRole,
  onClearStatus,
}) {
  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "ACTIVE":
        return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200";
      case "SUSPENDED":
        return "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200";
      case "DEACTIVATED":
        return "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-200";
      default:
        return "bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Active Role Filter Chip */}
      {selectedRole && selectedRole !== "All Roles" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Role: <strong className="font-semibold">{selectedRole}</strong></span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearRole}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active Status Filter Chip */}
      {selectedStatus && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Status:</span>
          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border ${getStatusBadgeClass(selectedStatus)}`}>
            {selectedStatus}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearStatus}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
        {statuses.map(({ key, label, activeBg, inactiveBg }) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChange(key)}
            className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 ${
              selectedStatus === key ? activeBg : `${inactiveBg} opacity-80 hover:opacity-100`
            }`}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/hooks/useRealtimeRefresh.js
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { getSocket, connectSocket, subscribeToReconnect } from "../services/socket.js";

/**
 * Custom React hook connecting real-time Socket.IO events to existing component fetch/refresh logic.
 *
 * Automatically:
 * 1. Subscribes to documented uppercase event names (e.g. 'FLEET_VEHICLE_GROUNDED').
 * 2. Invalidates target localStorage cache keys (e.g. 'app_fleet_cache').
 * 3. Debounces rapid burst events (e.g. bulk sales transactions or multi-vehicle dispatches).
 * 4. Reconciles authoritative state on socket reconnection.
 * 5. Cleans up all listeners on component unmount to prevent duplicate calls and leaks.
 *
 * @param {object} options
 * @param {string[]} options.events - Array of event names to listen for
 * @param {Function} options.onRefresh - Component's authoritative REST fetch callback
 * @param {string[]} [options.cacheKeysToInvalidate=[]] - localStorage cache keys to clear
 * @param {number} [options.debounceMs=250] - Debounce grace window in milliseconds
 */
export function useRealtimeRefresh({
  events = [],
  onRefresh,
  cacheKeysToInvalidate = [],
  debounceMs = 250,
}) {
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const onRefreshRef = useRef(onRefresh);

  useEffect(() => {
    onRefreshRef.current = onRefresh;
  }, [onRefresh]);

  const eventsKey = Array.isArray(events) ? events.join(",") : "";
  const cacheKeysKey = Array.isArray(cacheKeysToInvalidate) ? cacheKeysToInvalidate.join(",") : "";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!eventsKey) return;
    const socket = getSocket() || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? connectSocket() : null);
    if (!socket) return;

    const eventList = eventsKey.split(",").filter(Boolean);
    const cacheList = cacheKeysKey.split(",").filter(Boolean);

    const triggerRefresh = (envelope) => {
      // 1. Invalidate specified localStorage caches immediately
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && cacheList.length > 0) {
        cacheList.forEach((key) => {
          try {
            localStorage.removeItem(key);
          } catch {
            // ignore localStorage quota/access exceptions
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. Debounce invocation to prevent UI thrashing from event bursts
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      }
      timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (typeof onRefreshRef.current === "function") {
          onRefreshRef.current(envelope);
        }
      }, debounceMs);
    };

    // 3. Register listeners on the shared socket instance
    eventList.forEach((eventName) => {
      socket.on(eventName, triggerRefresh);
    });

    // 4. Subscribe to reconnection recovery
    const unsubReconnect = subscribeToReconnect(() => {
      triggerRefresh({ type: "RECONNECT" });
    });

    // 5. Cleanup on unmount or dependency change
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
      eventList.forEach((eventName) => {
        socket.off(eventName, triggerRefresh);
      });
      unsubReconnect();
    };
  }, [eventsKey, cacheKeysKey, debounceMs]);
}
````

````javascript
const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "all", label: "All Topics" },
  { id: "dispatch", label: "Route Dispatch" },
  { id: "fleet", label: "Fleet Board" },
  { id: "inventory", label: "Inventory & Yard" },
  { id: "sales", label: "Sales & Customers" },
  { id: "security", label: "Security & RBAC" },
];

export default function FAQs() {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("all");
  const [expandedIds, setExpandedIds] = useState(() => new Set(["trip-lifecycle-stages"]));

  const toggleAccordion = (id) => {
    setExpandedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const expandAll = () => {
    setExpandedIds(new Set(FAQ_DATA.map((item) => item.id)));
  };

  const collapseAll = () => {
    setExpandedIds(new Set());
  };

  const filteredFaqs = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
    return FAQ_DATA.filter((item) => {
      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === "all" || item.category === selectedCategory;
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        item.question.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.categoryLabel.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [searchTerm, selectedCategory]);

  return (
````

````javascript
// src/pages/RouteDispatch/StockCheckInPage.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";

} from "lucide-react";
import { tripsApi } from "../../api/trips.js";
import { inventoryApi } from "../../api/inventory.js";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "../../utils/permissions.js";

import { useRealtimeRefresh } from "../../hooks/useRealtimeRefresh.js";

const TRIPS_CACHE_KEY = "app_trips_cache";
const ITEMS_CACHE_KEY = "app_items_cache";

/**
 * StockCheckInPage — Minimal, High-Contrast Return Stock Check-In Workspace.
 * Conforms strictly to MadayawGas UI/UX table standards (#0D4B6E thead, border-[#0A4B6E]/30 container).
 */
export default function StockCheckInPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const canManage = can ? can(PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_MANAGE || "route.manage") : false;

  const currentTripIdFromUrl = searchParams.get("tripId") || "";

  // 1. Core Data States (Initialized from cache)
  const [trips, setTrips] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(TRIPS_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [products, setProducts] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(ITEMS_CACHE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmModal, setShowConfirmModal] = useState(false);
  const [showEndTripModal, setShowEndTripModal] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  // 2. Fetch Trips and Items
  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const [tripsRes, itemsRes] = await Promise.all([
        tripsApi.getTrips().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Failed to fetch trips:", err);
          return [];
        }),
        inventoryApi.getInventoryItems().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Failed to fetch items:", err);
          return [];
        }),
      ]);

      const tripsList = Array.isArray(tripsRes) ? tripsRes : tripsRes?.data?.trips || [];
      const itemsList = Array.isArray(itemsRes) ? itemsRes : itemsRes?.data?.products || [];

      if (Array.isArray(tripsList)) {
        setTrips(tripsList);
        localStorage.setItem(TRIPS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(tripsList));
      }
      if (Array.isArray(itemsList)) {
        setProducts(itemsList);
        localStorage.setItem(ITEMS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(itemsList));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Error loading check-in data:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  // Real-Time WebSocket Hook: Auto-refreshes trips and inventory when trips are ended or reconciled
  useRealtimeRefresh({
    events: ["TRIP_ENDED", "TRIP_RECONCILIATION_UPDATED", "TRIP_COMPLETED"],
    cacheKeysToInvalidate: [TRIPS_CACHE_KEY, "app_trips_cache"],
    onRefresh: loadData,
  });

  // 3. Trips Partitioning:
  // 3a. Ended Trips strictly eligible for Post-Trip Stock Reconciliation: status === "RETURNED"
  const endedTrips = useMemo(() => {
    return trips.filter((t) => {
      const s = (t.rawStatus || t.status || "").toUpperCase();
      return s === "RETURNED";
    });
  }, [trips]);

  // 3b. Active In-Progress Trips (out on the road)
  const inProgressTrips = useMemo(() => {
    return trips.filter((t) => {
      const s = (t.rawStatus || t.status || "").toUpperCase();
      return s === "IN_PROGRESS";
    });
  }, [trips]);

  // Combined list for dropdown search (Returned first, then In-Progress)
  const dropdownTrips = useMemo(() => {
    return [...endedTrips, ...inProgressTrips];
  }, [endedTrips, inProgressTrips]);

  // Target trip selected by URL ID or defaulted to first eligible
  const targetTrip = useMemo(() => {
    if (currentTripIdFromUrl) {
      const found = trips.find((t) => t.id === currentTripIdFromUrl);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return endedTrips[0] || inProgressTrips[0] || null;
  }, [trips, endedTrips, inProgressTrips, currentTripIdFromUrl]);

  // Evaluate whether target trip is still out on route (IN_PROGRESS)
  const isTargetTripInProgress = useMemo(() => {
    if (!targetTrip) return false;
    const s = (targetTrip.rawStatus || targetTrip.status || "").toUpperCase();
    return s === "IN_PROGRESS";
  }, [targetTrip]);

  // Active Selected Trip (strictly from ended trips awaiting reconciliation)
  const selectedTrip = useMemo(() => {
    if (!targetTrip) return null;
    const s = (targetTrip.rawStatus || targetTrip.status || "").toUpperCase();
    return s === "RETURNED" ? targetTrip : null;
  }, [targetTrip]);

  // Sync selected trip with URL: update when valid targetTrip exists, or clear invalid tripId if no trips
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetTrip?.id) {
      if (currentTripIdFromUrl !== targetTrip.id) {
        setSearchParams({ tripId: targetTrip.id }, { replace: true });
      }
    } else if (currentTripIdFromUrl && trips.length > 0 && !targetTrip) {
      setSearchParams({}, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [currentTripIdFromUrl, targetTrip, trips.length, setSearchParams]);

  // 4. Authoritative Full Trip Detail for Check-In
  const [selectedTripDetail, setSelectedTripDetail] = useState(null);
  const [isLoadingDetail, setIsLoadingDetail] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isCurrent = true;
    if (selectedTrip?.id) {
      setIsLoadingDetail(true);
      tripsApi

          if (isCurrent && detail) {
            setSelectedTripDetail(detail);
          }
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Failed to fetch authoritative trip detail for check-in:", err);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (isCurrent) setIsLoadingDetail(false);
        });
    } else {
      setSelectedTripDetail(null);
    }
    return () => {
      isCurrent = false;
    };
  }, [selectedTrip?.id]);

  // 5. Products Loaded on the Selected Trip (Resolved from authoritative detail or trip loads)
  const loadedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const activeTrip = selectedTripDetail || selectedTrip;
    if (!activeTrip) return [];
    const loads = activeTrip.loads || [];
    const allItems = loads.flatMap((l) => l.items || []);
    const filledItems = allItems.filter((i) => (i.condition || "FILLED") === "FILLED");

    const map = new Map();
    filledItems.forEach((it) => {
      const pId = it.productId;
      if (!pId) return;
      const current = map.get(pId) || {
        productId: pId,
        productName: it.productName || "LPG Product",
        containerType: it.containerType || "CANISTER",
        netWeightKg: it.netWeightKg || 0,
        loadedUnits: 0,
      };
      current.loadedUnits += parseInt(it.quantityUnits, 10) || 0;
      map.set(pId, current);
    });

    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [selectedTripDetail, selectedTrip]);

  // 6. Counts State Map: { [productId]: { returnedFull, returnedEmptyGood, returnedDefective, defectNotes } }
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState({});
  const [supervisorNotes, setSupervisorNotes] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedTrip) {
      setError(null);
      setSupervisorNotes(
        selectedTrip.notes
          ? `Gate return verified. ${selectedTrip.notes}`
          : "Physical return counts verified at Bunawan yard gate."
      );

      const initial = {};
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        initial[p.productId] = {
          returnedFull: 0,
          returnedEmptyGood: p.loadedUnits || 0,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      setCounts(initial);
    }
  }, [selectedTrip?.id, loadedProducts]);

  const handleSelectTrip = (tripId) => {
    setSearchParams({ tripId }, { replace: true });
    setError(null);
  };

  const handleCountChange = (productId, field, rawValue) => {
    const val = rawValue === "" ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseInt(rawValue, 10) || 0);
    setCounts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]: {
        ...(prev[productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0, defectNotes: "" }),
        [field]: val,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleNotesChange = (productId, notesValue) => {
    setCounts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [productId]: {
        ...(prev[productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0, defectNotes: "" }),
        defectNotes: notesValue,
      },
    }));
  };

  // Row-level fast shortcut: All units sold with empty returns

        defectNotes: "",

      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        next[p.productId] = {

          returnedEmptyGood: p.loadedUnits,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Bulk action: Reset all inputs to 0
  const handleResetAllToZero = () => {
    setCounts((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      loadedProducts.forEach((p) => {
        next[p.productId] = {
          returnedFull: 0,
          returnedEmptyGood: 0,
          returnedDefective: 0,
          defectNotes: "",
        };
      });
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Aggregate totals
  const totals = loadedProducts.reduce(
    (acc, p) => {
      const pCounts = counts[p.productId] || { returnedFull: 0, returnedEmptyGood: 0, returnedDefective: 0 };
      const full = Number(pCounts.returnedFull) || 0;
      const empty = Number(pCounts.returnedEmptyGood) || 0;
      const defect = Number(pCounts.returnedDefective) || 0;
      acc.totalLoaded += p.loadedUnits;
      acc.totalFull += full;
      acc.totalEmpty += empty;
      acc.totalDefect += defect;
      acc.totalReturned += full + empty + defect;
      return acc;

    { totalLoaded: 0, totalFull: 0, totalEmpty: 0, totalDefect: 0, totalReturned: 0 }

              onClick={handleMarkAllSoldOut}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer h-[32px]"
              title="Automatically count all dispatched units as good empty returns"
            >
              <Sparkles size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
              <span>Mark All Sold Out</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleResetAllToZero}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-full transition cursor-pointer h-[32px]"
              title="Reset all inputs to 0"
            >
              Reset
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ERROR BANNER */}
      {error && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#C93B32] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 animate-scale-in">
          <AlertTriangle size={15} className="shrink-0 text-[#C93B32]" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. MASTER TABLE (Strict Project Design Standard: #0D4B6E header, #0A4B6E/30 container) */}
      {selectedTrip ? (
        <div className="w-full flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[760px]">
              {/* Project Standard Dark-Navy Header */}
              <thead className="bg-[#0D4B6E] text-white text-xs sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-xs select-none">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                    Product Name
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[110px]">
                    Dispatched
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[130px]">
                    Unsold (Full)
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[130px]">
                    Good Empties
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[130px]">
                    Damaged
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[120px]">
                    Total Counted
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap w-[100px]">
                    Action
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-xs">
                {isLoadingDetail ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-[#0A4B6E] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                          Loading authoritative dispatched cargo manifest...
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : loadedProducts.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <PackageCheck size={32} className="text-[#6D8AA2]/50" />
                        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 text-sm">
                          No Dispatched Cargo Found
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] max-w-md">
                          Trip #{selectedTrip.tripNumber} ({selectedTrip.truckPlate}) has no recorded dispatch loads. If cargo was loaded, please verify the departure transfer slip.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  loadedProducts.map((p) => {
                    const pCounts = counts[p.productId] || {
                      returnedFull: 0,
                      returnedEmptyGood: 0,
                      returnedDefective: 0,
                      defectNotes: "",
                    };
                    const rowFull = Number(pCounts.returnedFull) || 0;
                    const rowEmpty = Number(pCounts.returnedEmptyGood) || 0;
                    const rowDefect = Number(pCounts.returnedDefective) || 0;
                    const rowTotal = rowFull + rowEmpty + rowDefect;
                    const isBalanced = rowTotal === p.loadedUnits;
                    const hasDefects = rowDefect > 0;

                    return (
                      <React.Fragment key={p.productId}>
                        <tr className="hover:bg-[#F4F9FC] transition-colors">
                          {/* 1. Product Name */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-4">
                            <p className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs leading-tight">
                              {p.productName}
                            </p>
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium mt-0.5 inline-block">
                              {p.containerType === "CANISTER" ? "Butane Canister" : "LPG Cylinder"} · {p.netWeightKg}kg
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          {/* 2. Dispatched */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1]">
                              {p.loadedUnits}
                            </span>
                          </td>

                          {/* 3. Unsold Full */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedFull}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedFull", e.target.value)}
                              className="w-22 text-center py-1.5 px-2 bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* 4. Good Empties */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedEmptyGood}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedEmptyGood", e.target.value)}
                              className="w-22 text-center py-1.5 px-2 bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* 5. Damaged */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <input
                              type="number"
                              min="0"
                              value={pCounts.returnedDefective}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCountChange(p.productId, "returnedDefective", e.target.value)}
                              className={`w-22 text-center py-1.5 px-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all focus:outline-none ${
                                hasDefects
                                  ? "bg-rose-50 border-rose-400 text-rose-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-400/20"
                                  : "bg-white border-[#CBD5E1] text-[#0A4B6E] focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20"
                              }`}
                            />
                          </td>

                          {/* 6. Total Counted */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 font-bold">
                              <span
                                className={`text-xs ${
                                  isBalanced
                                    ? "text-emerald-700 font-bold"
                                    : rowTotal > p.loadedUnits
                                    ? "text-blue-700"
                                    : "text-amber-700"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {rowTotal}
                              </span>
                              {isBalanced ? (
                                <Check size={14} className="text-emerald-600 stroke-[2.5]" />
                              ) : rowTotal < p.loadedUnits ? (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 font-semibold">
                                  ({rowTotal - p.loadedUnits})
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 font-semibold">
                                  (+{rowTotal - p.loadedUnits})
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>

                          {/* 7. Action */}
                          <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => applyRowAllSold(p.productId, p.loadedUnits)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-slate-200 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/40 transition cursor-pointer"
                              title="Set unsold to 0 and empties to loaded count"
                            >
                              All Sold
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>

                        {/* Expandable Defect Note row if damaged > 0 */}
                        {hasDefects && (
                          <tr className="bg-rose-50/60 border-b border-rose-100">
                            <td colSpan={7} className="py-2.5 px-4">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-800 shrink-0">
                                  Defect details ({p.productName}):
                                </span>
                                <input
                                  type="text"
                                  placeholder="e.g. 2 leaking valves, 1 dented collar..."
                                  value={pCounts.defectNotes}
                                  onChange={(e) => handleNotesChange(p.productId, e.target.value)}
                                  className="w-full px-3 py-1 text-xs bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500"
                                />
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : isTargetTripInProgress && targetTrip ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-6 bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 rounded-2xl shadow-2xs">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold mb-3 shadow-inner">
            <Gauge size={28} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5 flex-wrap justify-center">
            <span className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {targetTrip.truckPlate} · Trip #{targetTrip.tripNumber}
            </span>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
              OUT ON ROUTE
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 mb-1">
            Vehicle Has Not Ended Trip Yet
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-md mt-1 mb-5 leading-relaxed">
            This delivery truck is currently active on its route. Before stock reconciliation can be conducted and cylinders returned to Bunawan plant inventory, the vehicle must be checked in at the gate with its mandatory return odometer reading.
          </p>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3">
            {canManage && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowEndTripModal(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Gauge size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                <span>Log Return Odometer & End Trip</span>
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => navigate("/route-dispatch")}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>View Today's Dispatches</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-6 bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 rounded-2xl shadow-2xs">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold mb-3 shadow-inner">
            <CheckCircle2 size={30} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">No Ended Trips Awaiting Reconciliation</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm mt-1 mb-4">
            All returned delivery trucks have completed stock reconciliation, or active runs are still out on the road and have not yet been ended by drivers.
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => navigate("/route-dispatch")}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-4 py-2 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>View Today's Dispatches</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. PINNED BOTTOM ACTION & SUMMARY BAR */}
      {selectedTrip && (
        <div className="shrink-0 pt-3 pb-1 border-t border-[#0A4B6E]/20 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* High-Contrast Tally Indicators */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Dispatched: <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">{totals.totalLoaded}</strong>
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Counted: <strong className="text-slate-900">{totals.totalReturned}</strong>
              <span className="text-slate-500 font-normal ml-1">
                ({totals.totalFull} Full, {totals.totalEmpty} Empties, {totals.totalDefect} Damaged)
              </span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-300">|</span>
            {totals.totalReturned === totals.totalLoaded ? (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300">
                <Check size={12} className="text-emerald-700 stroke-[3]" />
                <span>Balanced</span>
              </span>
            ) : totals.totalReturned > totals.totalLoaded ? (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-300">
                <span>+{totals.totalReturned - totals.totalLoaded} Extra</span>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300">
                <AlertTriangle size={12} className="text-amber-700" />
                <span>{totals.totalReturned - totals.totalLoaded} Short</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Primary Action Button */}
          {canManage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isSubmitting || isLoadingDetail || loadedProducts.length === 0}
              onClick={() => setShowConfirmModal(true)}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              title={loadedProducts.length === 0 ? "No dispatched products to reconcile" : "Confirm and complete stock reconciliation"}
            >
              <span>Confirm & Complete Reconciliation</span>
              <ArrowRight size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. STANDARDIZED CONFIRMATION MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={showConfirmModal}
        onClose={() => setShowConfirmModal(false)}
        title="Confirm Post-Trip Stock Reconciliation"
        subtitle={selectedTrip ? `${selectedTrip.truckPlate} · Trip #${selectedTrip.tripNumber}` : "Reconciliation"}
        icon={PackageCheck}
        maxWidth="max-w-md"
        footer={
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => setShowConfirmModal(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="primary"
              onClick={handleFinalSubmit}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>{isSubmitting ? "Settling..." : "Complete Reconciliation"}</span>
              <CheckCircle2 size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      >
        <div className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
          <p className="text-slate-600">
            Confirming this intake will immediately update the Bunawan yard inventory balances:
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-[#BCE1F1] rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase block">Sale-Ready</span>
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mt-0.5">{totals.totalFull}</p>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Unsold full units</span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 uppercase block">Refill Dock</span>
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-800 mt-0.5">{totals.totalEmpty}</p>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Good empty returns</span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-800 uppercase block">Quarantine</span>
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-rose-800 mt-0.5">{totals.totalDefect}</p>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Damaged / defects</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
              Supervisor Notes (Optional)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={supervisorNotes}
              onChange={(e) => setSupervisorNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Verified at Bunawan gate..."
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-[#F4F8FA] border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:bg-white"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* GATE RETURN / END TRIP MODAL */}
      <EndTripModal
        isOpen={showEndTripModal}
        trip={targetTrip}
        onClose={() => setShowEndTripModal(false)}
        onEndTrip={handleEndTripFromCheckIn}
      />

      {/* TOAST NOTIFICATION */}
      {toast && (
        <ToastNotification
          type={toast.type}
          message={toast.message}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
/**
 * MadayawGas Date & Time Utility
 * Enforces Philippine Standard Time (PHT / GMT +8, Asia/Manila) across all date/time parsing,
 * formatting, calendar inputs, and range filtering.
 */

export const PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE = "Asia/Manila";
export const PHILIPPINE_LOCALE = "en-US";

/**
 * Robust parser converting inputs (ISO UTC strings, Date objects, timestamps, date-only strings)
 * into a valid Date object.
 * Date-only strings ("YYYY-MM-DD") are safely pinned to Philippine midnight (00:00:00 PHT)
 * to avoid timezone boundary drift.
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date | null | undefined} input
 * @returns {Date | null}
 */
export function parsePhilippineDate(input) {
  if (input === null || input === undefined || input === "") return null;

  if (input instanceof Date) {
    return isNaN(input.getTime()) ? null : input;
  }

  if (typeof input === "string") {
    const trimmed = input.trim();
    // Safe check for pure YYYY-MM-DD calendar date strings
    const match = trimmed.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
    if (match) {
      const [, y, m, d] = match;
      // In Asia/Manila (UTC+8), 00:00:00 local is 16:00:00 UTC of previous day (i.e. -8h UTC)
      return new Date(Date.UTC(+y, +m - 1, +d, -8, 0, 0));
    }
  }

  const d = new Date(input);
  return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}

/**
 * Formats a date to Philippine medium date: "MMM DD, YYYY" (e.g. "Aug 24, 2026").
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {object} [options]
 * @param {string} [options.fallback="N/A"]
 * @param {string} [options.month="short"] - "short", "long", or "numeric"
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPhilippineDate(dateInput, options = {}) {
  const fallback = options.fallback !== undefined ? options.fallback : "N/A";
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return fallback;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(PHILIPPINE_LOCALE, {
      timeZone: PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE,
      year: "numeric",
      month: options.month || "short",
      day: "numeric",
      ...options,
    }).format(parsed);
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/**
 * Formats a date to Philippine short table date: "MM/DD/YY" (e.g. "08/24/26") or "MM/DD/YYYY".
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {object} [options]
 * @param {string} [options.fallback="-"]
 * @param {number} [options.yearDigits=2] - 2 for "YY", 4 for "YYYY"
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPhilippineDateShort(dateInput, options = {}) {
  const fallback = options.fallback !== undefined ? options.fallback : "-";
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return fallback;

  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(PHILIPPINE_LOCALE, {
      timeZone: PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
    });

    const parts = formatter.formatToParts(parsed).reduce((acc, part) => {
      acc[part.type] = part.value;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    const yearDigits = options.yearDigits || 2;
    const yearStr = yearDigits === 2 ? parts.year.slice(-2) : parts.year;
    return `${parts.month}/${parts.day}/${yearStr}`;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/**
 * Formats a timestamp into 12-hour Philippine time: "hh:mm A" (e.g. "08:30 AM").
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {object} [options]
 * @param {string} [options.fallback="-"]
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPhilippineTime(dateInput, options = {}) {
  const fallback = options.fallback !== undefined ? options.fallback : "-";
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return fallback;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(PHILIPPINE_LOCALE, {
      timeZone: PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE,
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hour12: true,
      ...options,
    }).format(parsed);
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/**
 * Formats a timestamp into full Philippine date and time: "MMM DD, YYYY, hh:mm A" (e.g. "Aug 24, 2026, 08:30 AM").
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {object} [options]
 * @param {string} [options.fallback="-"]
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPhilippineDateTime(dateInput, options = {}) {
  const fallback = options.fallback !== undefined ? options.fallback : "-";
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return fallback;

  try {
    const dStr = formatPhilippineDate(parsed, options);
    const tStr = formatPhilippineTime(parsed, options);
    return `${dStr}, ${tStr}`;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/**
 * Converts any date or timestamp to "YYYY-MM-DD" in Philippine Time.
 * Ideal for HTML `<input type="date">` values, min/max bounds, and date comparisons.
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toPhilippineDateInputString(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return "";

  if (typeof dateInput === "string") {
    const trimmed = dateInput.trim();
    const match = trimmed.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})$/);
    if (match) return match[1];
  }

  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return "";

  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(PHILIPPINE_LOCALE, {
      timeZone: PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
    });

    const parts = formatter.formatToParts(parsed).reduce((acc, part) => {
      acc[part.type] = part.value;
      return acc;
    }, {});

    return `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`;
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/**
 * Returns today's calendar date in Philippine Time in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
 *
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function getPhilippineTodayString() {
  return toPhilippineDateInputString(new Date());
}

/**
 * Checks whether a given timestamp or date falls within a Philippine calendar date range [dateFrom, dateTo].
 * Both dateFrom and dateTo are assumed "YYYY-MM-DD" strings.
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {string} [dateFrom] - "YYYY-MM-DD"
 * @param {string} [dateTo] - "YYYY-MM-DD"
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isPhilippineDateInRange(dateInput, dateFrom, dateTo) {
  if (!dateFrom && !dateTo) return true;
  if (!dateInput) return false;

  const phtDate = toPhilippineDateInputString(dateInput);
  if (!phtDate) return false;

  if (dateFrom && phtDate < dateFrom) return false;
  if (dateTo && phtDate > dateTo) return false;

  return true;
}

/**
 * Returns the ISO 8601 day of week (1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, ..., 7=Sunday) in Philippine Time.
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} [dateInput=new Date()]
 * @returns {number} 1 to 7
 */
export function getPhilippineDayOfWeek(dateInput = new Date()) {
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return 1;

  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(PHILIPPINE_LOCALE, {
      timeZone: PHILIPPINE_TIMEZONE,
      weekday: "short",
    });
    const weekday = formatter.format(parsed);
    const map = { Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6, Sun: 7 };
    return map[weekday] || 1;
  } catch {
    const jsDay = parsed.getDay();
    return jsDay === 0 ? 7 : jsDay;
  }
}

/**
 * Adds or subtracts days to/from a date in Philippine Time, returning "YYYY-MM-DD".
 *
 * @param {string | number | Date} dateInput
 * @param {number} days
 * @returns {string} "YYYY-MM-DD"
 */
export function addPhilippineDays(dateInput, days) {
  const parsed = parsePhilippineDate(dateInput);
  if (!parsed) return "";
  const next = new Date(parsed.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  return toPhilippineDateInputString(next);
}
````

## File: src/utils/phone.js

````javascript
/**
 * Utility for parsing, validating, and formatting Philippine phone numbers.
 * Supports:
 * - Mobile: +639xxxxxxxxx, 09xxxxxxxxx, (+63) 9xx xxx xxxx, 09xx-xxx-xxxx
 * - Landlines: +63(area)xxxxxxx, 0(area)xxxxxxx, e.g. +63822245678, (082) 224-5678, +63281234567
 */

/**
 * Validates whether a phone number matches standard Philippine phone conventions.
 * @param {string} phone
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function isValidPhilippinePhone(phone) {
  if (!phone || typeof phone !== "string") return false;
  const cleaned = phone.replace(/[\s\-().]/g, "");

  // Mobile: +639xxxxxxxxx (13 chars) or 09xxxxxxxxx (11 digits) or 9xxxxxxxxx (10 digits)
  const mobileRegex = /^(\+63|0)?9\d{9}$/;

  // Metro Manila Landline: +632 + 8 digits, 02 + 8 digits, 2 + 8 digits
  const manilaLandlineRegex = /^(\+63|0)?2\d{8}$/;

  // Provincial Landlines (2-digit area codes 3x-8x + 7 digits local):
  // e.g. +63822245678, 0822245678, 822245678
  const provincialLandlineRegex = /^(\+63|0)?[3-8]\d{8}$/;

  return (
    mobileRegex.test(cleaned) ||
    manilaLandlineRegex.test(cleaned) ||
    provincialLandlineRegex.test(cleaned)
  );
}

/**
 * Formats a phone string into clean display format e.g. (+63) 999 999 9999 or (+63) 82 224 5678.
 * @param {string} phone
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatPhilippinePhone(phone) {
  if (!phone || typeof phone !== "string") return phone || "";
  const cleaned = phone.replace(/[\s\-().]/g, "");

  // 1. Mobile (10-13 digits: 9xxxxxxxxx, 09xxxxxxxxx, +639xxxxxxxxx)
  if (/^\+639\d{9}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(3, 6)} ${cleaned.slice(6, 9)} ${cleaned.slice(9)}`;
  }
  if (/^09\d{9}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(1, 4)} ${cleaned.slice(4, 7)} ${cleaned.slice(7)}`;
  }
  if (/^9\d{9}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(0, 3)} ${cleaned.slice(3, 6)} ${cleaned.slice(6)}`;
  }

  // 2. Metro Manila Landline (Area code 2 + 8-digit subscriber number)
  // e.g. +63281234567, 0281234567, 281234567
  if (/^\+632\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) 2 ${cleaned.slice(3, 7)} ${cleaned.slice(7)}`;
  }
  if (/^02\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) 2 ${cleaned.slice(2, 6)} ${cleaned.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (/^2\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) 2 ${cleaned.slice(1, 5)} ${cleaned.slice(5)}`;
  }

  // 3. Provincial Landline (2-digit Area code e.g. 82 for Davao, 32 for Cebu + 7-digit subscriber number)
  // e.g. +63822245678, 0822245678, 822245678
  if (/^\+63[3-8]\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(3, 5)} ${cleaned.slice(5, 8)} ${cleaned.slice(8)}`;
  }
  if (/^0[3-8]\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(1, 3)} ${cleaned.slice(3, 6)} ${cleaned.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (/^[3-8]\d{8}$/.test(cleaned)) {
    return `(+63) ${cleaned.slice(0, 2)} ${cleaned.slice(2, 5)} ${cleaned.slice(5)}`;
  }

  return phone;
}
````

````javascript
/**
 * Storage Sanitizer Utility
 * Ensures stale legacy data or malformed UUID caches do not contaminate
 * live API environments.
 */
const SANITIZE_VERSION = "mg_storage_v3_pure_live";

const LIVE_CACHE_KEYS = [
  "app_users_cache",
  "app_templates_cache",
  "app_schedules_cache",
  "app_fleet_cache",
  "app_zones_cache",
  "app_trips_cache",
  "app_inspections_cache",
  "app_odometer_cache",
  "app_work_orders_cache",
  "app_maintenance_logs_cache",
  "app_items_cache",
  "app_plant_stock_cache",
  "app_customers_cache",
];

const MOCK_SIGNATURES = [
  "q1w2e3r4-t5y6-u7i8-o9p0-a1s2d3f4g5h6",
  "e9b21f37-142c-4f76-96f3-a3d8b02e7b91",
  "sch-11111111",
  "tpl-11111111",
  "trk-11111111",
  "log-1001-1",
  "insp-1001-1",
];

export function sanitizeAppCaches() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) return;

  const isAlreadySanitized = localStorage.getItem(SANITIZE_VERSION);

    LIVE_CACHE_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
      try {
        const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
        if (!item) return;

        // If the item contains any known mock signatures or if version changed
        const hasMockData = MOCK_SIGNATURES.some((sig) => item.includes(sig));
        if (hasMockData || !isAlreadySanitized) {
          localStorage.removeItem(key);
          console.info(`[Sanitizer] Cleared stale cache for key '${key}'`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[Sanitizer] Failed to inspect key '${key}':`, err);
      }
    });

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SANITIZE_VERSION, new Date().toISOString());
    } catch {
      // Ignore quota errors
    }
}
````

## File: src/utils/text.js

````javascript
/**
 * Utility functions for text processing, normalization, and casing.
 */

/**
 * Converts a string into proper Title Case (capitalizing the first letter of each word or segment).
 * Handles hyphenated names, multi-word names, and apostrophes.
 * Examples:
 *   "juan" -> "Juan"
 *   "dela cruz" -> "Dela Cruz"
 *   "mary-jane" -> "Mary-Jane"
 *   "o'connor" -> "O'Connor"
 *   "CARLOS" -> "Carlos"
 *
 * @param {string} str
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toProperCase(str) {
  if (!str || typeof str !== "string") return str || "";
  return str
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/(?:^|[\s\-'])\S/g, (match) => match.toUpperCase());
}
````

## File: src/api/media.js
````javascript
// src/api/media.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";
import { compressAndPrepareImage } from "../utils/imageCompressor.js";
import { isValidMediaDomain, ALLOWED_MEDIA_DOMAINS } from "../utils/media.js";

/**
 * Uploads a media file into the canonical MadayawGas media storage subsystem.
 * Applies client-side compression/HEIC transcoding before transmission.
 *
 * @param {File | Blob} file - The file binary to upload
 * @param {string} domain - Whitelisted domain (e.g. 'maintenance/receipts')
 * @returns {Promise<{ storageKey: string, url: string, mimeType: string, sizeBytes: number, originalName?: string }>}
 */
export async function uploadMediaFile(file, domain) {
  if (!file) {
    throw new Error("No file provided for upload.");
  }

  if (!isValidMediaDomain(domain)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid media domain '${domain}'. Allowed domains are: ${ALLOWED_MEDIA_DOMAINS.join(", ")}`
    );
  }

  // 1. Client-side compression & size verification (< 5 MB)
  const preparedFile = await compressAndPrepareImage(file);

  // 2. Live backend upload via multipart/form-data
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", preparedFile);
  formData.append("domain", domain);

  const response = await apiClient("/media/upload", {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  return response.data;
}

/**
 * Resolves a canonical relative storage key to a fully qualified URL via the backend.
 *
 * @param {string} storageKey
 * @returns {Promise<{ storageKey: string, url: string }>}
 */
export async function resolveMediaKey(storageKey) {
  if (!storageKey) {
    throw new Error("storageKey must be provided as a non-empty string");
  }

  const response = await apiClient("/media/resolve", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { storageKey },
  });

  return response.data;
}

/**
 * Deletes a media file asset directly from canonical storage.
 * Endpoint: DELETE /api/media
 *
 * @param {string} storageKey - Canonical relative key or full URL
 * @returns {Promise<{ status: string, message: string }>}
 */
export async function deleteMediaFile(storageKey) {
  if (!storageKey) return null;

  const response = await apiClient("/media", {
    method: "DELETE",
    body: { storageKey },
  });

  return response.data || response;
}

export const mediaApi = {
  upload: uploadMediaFile,
  resolve: resolveMediaKey,
  delete: deleteMediaFile,
};
````

## File: src/components/auth/ProtectedRoute.jsx
````javascript
import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { can, canAny, getDefaultRoute } from "../../utils/permissions.js";

/**
 * Route guard component enforcing authentication and granular permissions.
 */
export default function ProtectedRoute({ permission, children }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, currentUser, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-full items-center justify-center bg-white">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#0F7AB2]">
          Verifying access...
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  // If the user must change their password, block rendering child pages
  if (currentUser?.mustChangePassword) {
    return null;
  }

  if (permission) {
    const hasAccess = Array.isArray(permission)
      ? canAny(currentUser, permission)
      : can(currentUser, permission);

    if (!hasAccess) {
      const fallback = getDefaultRoute(currentUser);
      const target = fallback === location.pathname ? "/dashboard" : fallback;
      return <Navigate to={target} replace />;
    }
  }

  return children;
}
````
