````javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, X } from "lucide-react";

export default function Modal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  subtitle,
  icon: Icon,
  badge,
  onBack,
  children,
  footer,
  maxWidth = "max-w-md",
  closeOnBackdrop = true,
  showCloseButton = true,
}) {
  const [shouldRender, setShouldRender] = useState(isOpen);
  const [isAnimatingOut, setIsAnimatingOut] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timer;
    if (isOpen) {
      const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setShouldRender(true);
        setIsAnimatingOut(false);
      });
      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    } else {
      const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setIsAnimatingOut(true);
      });
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setShouldRender(false);
        setIsAnimatingOut(false);
      }, 150);
      return () => {
        cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
        clearTimeout(timer);
      };
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Escape key listener
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && onClose) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!shouldRender && !isOpen) return null;

  const modalNode = (
    <div
      onClick={() => {
        if (closeOnBackdrop && onClose) onClose();
      }}
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 ${
        isAnimatingOut ? "animate-fade-out" : "animate-fade-in"
      }`}
    >
      <div
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={`bg-white rounded-2xl w-full shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] sm:max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden ${maxWidth} ${
          isAnimatingOut ? "animate-scale-out" : "animate-scale-in"
        }`}
      >
        {/* Header - Fixed */}
        {title && (
          <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 pt-5 pb-4 shrink-0 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/70">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 pr-2">
              {Icon && (
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                  <Icon size={18} />
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <h2 className="text-[#0A4B6E] text-base sm:text-lg font-bold truncate">
                    {title}
                  </h2>
                  {badge}
                </div>
                {subtitle && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5 truncate font-medium">
                    {subtitle}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
              {onBack && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onBack}
                  className="text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] p-1.5 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer"
                  title="Go back"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft size={18} />
                </button>
              )}
              {showCloseButton && onClose && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 p-1.5 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer"
                  title="Close modal"
                >
                  <X size={18} />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Content - Scrollable */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 custom-scrollbar flex-1 min-h-0">
          {children}
        </div>

        {/* Footer - Fixed */}
        {footer && (
          <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 py-3.5 border-t border-slate-100 shrink-0 bg-white">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(modalNode, document.body)
    : modalNode;
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { Funnel } from "lucide-react";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import StatusFilterGroup from "./StatusFilterGroup";
import RolesFilterGroup from "./RolesFilterGroup";
import DateFilterGroup from "./DateFilterGroup";

export default function FilterRole({
  label = "Filter Roles",
  onApply,
  className = "",
  roles = [],
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState("ACTIVE");
  const [selectedRole, setSelectedRole] = useState("All Roles");
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState("");
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState("");

  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const rolesList = useMemo(() => {
    const defaultRoles = [
      "All Roles",
      "Super Admin",
      "Admin",
      "Fleet Manager",
      "Driver",
      "Sales Manager",
      "Sales Person",
      "Sales Supervisor",
      "Logistics Supervisor",
    ];
    const fromProps = (roles || [])
      .map((r) => (typeof r === "string" ? r : r?.name))
      .filter(Boolean);
    return Array.from(new Set([...defaultRoles, ...fromProps]));
  }, [roles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setSelectedStatus("");
    setSelectedRole("All Roles");
    setDateFrom("");
    setDateTo("");
  };

  const handleApply = () => {
    if (onApply) {
      onApply({ status: selectedStatus, role: selectedRole, dateFrom, dateTo });
    }
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative inline-block text-left">
      {/* Trigger Button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        className={`bg-[#FCFEFE] hover:bg-[#F3F8FB] text-[#0A4B6E] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 hover:border-[#0A4B6E]/60 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all duration-150 h-[30px] min-w-[110px] justify-between cursor-pointer shadow-2xs ${className}`}
      >
        <span>{label}</span>
        <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
      </button>

      {/* Filter Card Dropdown */}
      <div

      >
        {/* Header */}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs">
            <Funnel size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            <span>Filter Roles</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Section Components */}
        <StatusFilterGroup
          selectedStatus={selectedStatus}
          onChange={setSelectedStatus}
        />

        <RolesFilterGroup
          rolesList={rolesList}
          selectedRole={selectedRole}
          onChange={setSelectedRole}
        />

        <DateFilterGroup
          dateFrom={dateFrom}
          dateTo={dateTo}
          onFromChange={(e) => setDateFrom(e.target.value)}
          onToChange={(e) => setDateTo(e.target.value)}
        />

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-gray-100">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={handleClearAll}
            className="!px-2.5 !py-1 !text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 uppercase tracking-wider !rounded-full !h-[26px]"
          >
            CLEAR ALL
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleApply}
            className="!px-3 !py-1 !text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider !rounded-full !h-[26px]"
          >
            APPLY RESULT
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import { hasUserRole } from "../../utils/userRoles.js";

export default function ReactivateUserModal({ user, onClose, onConfirm }) {
  if (!user || hasUserRole(user, "Super Admin")) return null;

  const modalNode = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl animate-scale-in">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#0B4A6E] mb-4">
          Reactivate User?
        </h2>

        <p className="text-gray-800 mb-8 leading-relaxed text-[15px]">
          {user.firstName} {user.lastName}'s account will be reactivated and
          will regain access to the system.
        </p>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onConfirm(user)}
            className="w-full py-3 bg-[#CD3E3E] border-none !text-white rounded-full font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-[#b83737] transition-colors"
          >
            CONTINUE
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full py-3 bg-transparent border-none !text-[#0B4A6E] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-full transition-colors"
          >
            CANCEL
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(modalNode, document.body)
    : modalNode;
}
````

````javascript
// src/pages/Inventory/TransferRecords.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useId } from "react";
import {
  FileText,
  Search,
  Filter,
  RefreshCw,
  Eye,
  Truck,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  Package,
  Layers,
  Calendar,
  User,
  AlertOctagon,
  Download,
} from "lucide-react";
import { inventoryApi } from "../../api/inventory.js";
import { formatPhilippineDateTime } from "../../utils/date.js";
import Pagination from "../../components/ui/Pagination.jsx";
import SideDrawer from "../../components/ui/SideDrawer.jsx";

const TRANSFER_TYPES = [
  { value: "ALL", label: "All Movements" },
  { value: "DISPATCH_LOAD", label: "Dispatch Loads" },
  { value: "RETURN_UNLOAD", label: "Return Unloads" },
  { value: "SUPPLIER_PURCHASE", label: "Supplier Restocks" },
  { value: "DEFECT_ADJUSTMENT", label: "Defect Adjustments" },
];

function getTransferTypeMeta(type) {
  switch (type) {
    case "DISPATCH_LOAD":
      return {
        label: "Dispatch Load",
        icon: ArrowUpRight,
        color: "text-[#0A4B6E] bg-sky-50 border-sky-200",
      };
    case "RETURN_UNLOAD":
      return {
        label: "Return Unload",
        icon: ArrowDownLeft,
        color: "text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200",
      };
    case "SUPPLIER_PURCHASE":
      return {
        label: "Supplier Restock",
        icon: Download,
        color: "text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200",
      };
    case "DEFECT_ADJUSTMENT":
      return {
        label: "Defect Adjustment",
        icon: AlertOctagon,
        color: "text-[#C93B32] bg-rose-50 border-rose-200",
      };
    default:
      return {
        label: type || "Stock Transfer",
        icon: Package,
        color: "text-slate-700 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200",
      };
  }
}

export default function TransferRecords() {
  const searchInputId = useId();
  const [transfers, setTransfers] = useState([]);
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({
    page: 1,
    limit: 20,
    totalItems: 0,
    totalPages: 1,
  });
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Search & Filter State
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [activeSearch, setActiveSearch] = useState("");
  const [transferType, setTransferType] = useState("ALL");

  // Selected slip for SideDrawer
  const [selectedSlip, setSelectedSlip] = useState(null);

  const fetchTransfers = useCallback(
    async (pageToFetch = 1, limitToFetch = meta.limit) => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const params = {
          page: pageToFetch,
          limit: limitToFetch || 20,
          search: activeSearch || undefined,
          transferType: transferType !== "ALL" ? transferType : undefined,
        };
        const res = await inventoryApi.getTransfers(params);
        setTransfers(res?.transfers || []);
        if (res?.meta) {
          setMeta(res.meta);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch transfer records:", err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [activeSearch, transferType, meta.limit]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTransfers(meta.page);
  }, [fetchTransfers, meta.page]);

  // Submit search on Enter or search button click
  const handleSearchSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActiveSearch(searchInput.trim());
    setMeta((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
  };

  const handleTypeChange = (typeVal) => {
    setTransferType(typeVal);
    setMeta((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    setMeta((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: newPage }));
  };

  // Helper to calculate total items and crates on a transfer slip
  const getSlipTotals = (slip) => {
    const items = slip?.items || [];
    const totalUnits = items.reduce(
      (sum, it) => sum + (Number(it.quantityUnits) || 0),
      0
    );
    const totalCrates = items.reduce(
      (sum, it) => sum + (it.crates !== null && it.crates !== undefined ? Number(it.crates) : 0),
      0
    );
    return { totalUnits, totalCrates };
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#F8FAFC]">
      {/* Top Controls Header */}
      <header className="shrink-0 bg-white border-b border-[#E2E8F0] px-6 py-3.5">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Movement Type Filter Tabs */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {TRANSFER_TYPES.map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.value}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleTypeChange(t.value)}
                className={`text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  transferType === t.value
                    ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-[#0A4B6E] shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-white text-[#6D8AA2] border-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-slate-50"
                }`}
              >
                {t.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {/* Search on Enter */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="relative sm:w-72">
              <label htmlFor={searchInputId} className="sr-only">Search slips, trips, or vehicles</label>
              <input
                id={searchInputId}
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search slip, truck, or notes..."
                value={searchInput}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-full text-[#0A4B6E] placeholder-[#6D8AA2]/70 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:bg-white transition-all"
              />
              <Search
                size={14}
                className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#6D8AA2]"
              />
              {searchInput && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearchInput("");
                    setActiveSearch("");
                    setMeta((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 text-xs"
                >

            </form>

            <button

            >
              <RefreshCw size={15} className={isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Table Container */}
      <main className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden flex flex-col p-6">
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 bg-white border border-[#0A4B6E]/30 rounded-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse min-w-[850px]">
              <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-[#0D4B6E] text-white text-xs md:text-sm z-10 shadow-xs select-none">

                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 md:px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">Destination / Source</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 md:px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">Recorded By</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 md:px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">Date & Time</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 md:px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap text-right">Total Units</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 md:px-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap text-center">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-xs md:text-sm">
                {isLoading && transfers.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-16 text-center text-[#6D8AA2]">
                      <RefreshCw size={20} className="animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                      Loading transfer records...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : transfers.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-16 text-center text-[#6D8AA2]">
                      <FileText size={24} className="mx-auto mb-2 text-[#CBD5E1]" />

                        {activeSearch

                          : "No stock movements recorded yet."}

                        : slip.recordedBy?.username || "System";

                    const vehicleSource = slip.trip?.plateNumber
                      ? `${slip.trip.plateNumber} · ${slip.trip.tripNumber || "Trip"}`
                      : slip.supplierInvoiceNumber
                      ? `Invoice: ${slip.supplierInvoiceNumber}`
                      : "Bunawan Yard";

                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={slip.id}
                        className="hover:bg-[#F4F9FC] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedSlip(slip)}
                      >
                        {/* Slip Number */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">

                            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] block">
                              {totalCrates} crates

                        </td>

                        {/* Action */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>

                </div>
              )}

              {selectedSlip.remarks && (
                <div className="col-span-2 border-t border-[#E2E8F0] pt-2 mt-1">
                  <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] text-[11px] block">Remarks / Notes</span>

                <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wide">

                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                  {selectedSlip.items?.length || 0} product lines
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                  <thead className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border-b border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Product</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Condition</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Units</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Crates</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#F1F5F9] text-[#0A4B6E]">
                    {(selectedSlip.items || []).map((it, idx) => (
                      <tr key={it.id || idx}>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">
                          {it.productName || "Product Item"}
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-normal block">
                            {it.containerType} · {it.netWeightKg} kg
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700">
                            {it.condition === "FILLED"
                              ? "Filled Good"
                              : it.condition === "EMPTY_GOOD"
                              ? "Empty Good"
                              : it.condition === "DEFECTIVE"
                              ? "Defective"
                              : it.condition}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          {Number(it.quantityUnits || 0).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right text-[#6D8AA2]">
                          {it.crates !== null && it.crates !== undefined ? it.crates : "—"}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </SideDrawer>
    </div>
  );
````

````css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');
@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  /* MadayawGas Core Design System Tokens */
````

````javascript
// src/api/customers.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";
import { authApi } from "./auth.js";

/**
 * Customer Profile API Service
 * Interacts with /api/sales/customers endpoints based on docs/API Contract/sales-customer.api.md
 */
export const customersApi = {
  /**
   * Verify admin password before performing sensitive operations.
   * Delegates directly to authApi.
   * @param {string} password
   * @param {string} [username]
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  async verifyAdminPassword(password, username) {
    return authApi.verifyPassword(password, username);
  },

  /**
   * View customer overview (List & Search).
   * @param {object} [params] - Query parameters (search, customerType, status, isActive, sortBy, sortOrder, page, limit)
   * @returns {Promise<Array|object>} Array of customer objects or paginated envelope
   */
  async getCustomers(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);
    if (params.search) query.append("search", params.search);
    if (params.customerType && params.customerType !== "All Types") {
      query.append("customerType", params.customerType);
    }
    if (params.status) query.append("status", params.status);
    if (params.isActive !== undefined) query.append("isActive", params.isActive);
    if (params.sortBy) query.append("sortBy", params.sortBy);
    if (params.sortOrder) query.append("sortOrder", params.sortOrder);

    const queryString = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const result = await apiClient(`/sales/customers${queryString}`);
    if (Array.isArray(result?.data)) {
      return result.data;
    }
    return result?.data?.customers || result?.data || (Array.isArray(result) ? result : []);
  },

  /**
   * View Single Customer Profile.
   * @param {string} id - Customer UUID
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Customer object
   */
  async getCustomerById(id) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/sales/customers/${id}`);
    return result?.data?.customer || result?.data || result;
  },

  /**
   * Register Customer.
   * @param {{ name: string, address: string, contactNumber: string, customerType: string, isActive?: boolean }} customerData
   * @returns {Promise<{ customer: object }>} Created customer response
   */
  async createCustomer(customerData) {
    const result = await apiClient("/sales/customers", {
      method: "POST",
      body: customerData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Update Customer Profile.
   * @param {string} id - Customer UUID
   * @param {object} customerData - Fields to update
   * @returns {Promise<{ customer: object }>} Updated customer response
   */
  async updateCustomer(id, customerData) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/sales/customers/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: customerData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Deactivate Customer (Soft delete with password verification).
   * @param {string} id - Customer UUID
   * @param {{ confirmPassword?: string }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<{ customer: object, message: string }>} Updated deactivated customer
   */
  async deactivateCustomer(id, { confirmPassword }) {
    const password =
      typeof confirmPassword === "object"
        ? confirmPassword?.confirmPassword || confirmPassword?.adminPassword
        : confirmPassword;
    const result = await apiClient(`/sales/customers/${id}/deactivate`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: {
        confirmPassword: password,
        adminPassword: password,
        confirm_password: password,
        admin_password: password,
      },
    });
    return result.data;
  },
};
````

````javascript
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";
import { toPhilippineDateInputString } from "../utils/date.js";

export function normalizeZone(z) {
  if (!z) return null;
  return {
    ...z,
    id: z.id,
    code: (z.code || "").toUpperCase(),
    name: z.name || "",
    description: z.description || "",
    isActive: z.isActive !== false && z.is_active !== false,
    createdAt: z.createdAt || z.created_at,
    updatedAt: z.updatedAt || z.updated_at,
  };
}

export function normalizeTemplate(t) {
  if (!t) return null;
  const rawDay = t.dayOfWeek !== undefined ? t.dayOfWeek : t.day_of_week;
  const dayNum = Number(rawDay);
  const salesName =
    t.salesName ||
    (t.sales_first_name
      ? `${t.sales_first_name} ${t.sales_last_name}`.trim()
      : t.sales_username || "Unassigned");

  return {
    ...t,
    id: t.id,
    truckId: t.truckId || t.truck_id,
    truckPlate: t.truckPlate || t.truck_plate_number || t.plate_number || "No Plate",
    truckModel: t.truckModel || t.truck_model || "Delivery Vehicle",
    zoneId: t.zoneId || t.zone_id,
    zoneCode: t.zoneCode || t.zone_code || "",
    zoneName: t.zoneName || t.zone_name || "",
    dayOfWeek: isNaN(dayNum) ? 1 : dayNum,
    defaultSalesUserId: t.defaultSalesUserId || t.default_sales_user_id || null,
    salesName,
    isActive: t.isActive !== false && t.is_active !== false,
    createdAt: t.createdAt || t.created_at,
    updatedAt: t.updatedAt || t.updated_at,
  };
}

export function normalizeSchedule(s) {
  if (!s) return null;
  const rawDate = s.scheduledDate || s.scheduled_date;
  const normalizedDate = rawDate ? toPhilippineDateInputString(rawDate) : null;
  const salesName =
    s.salesName ||
    (s.sales_first_name
      ? `${s.sales_first_name} ${s.sales_last_name}`.trim()
      : s.sales_username || "Unassigned");
  const driverName =
    s.driverName ||
    (s.driver_first_name
      ? `${s.driver_first_name} ${s.driver_last_name}`.trim()
      : "Unassigned");

  return {
    ...s,
    id: s.id,
    scheduledDate: normalizedDate,
    truckId: s.truckId || s.truck_id,
    truckPlate: s.truckPlate || s.truck_plate_number || "No Plate",
    truckModel: s.truckModel || s.truck_model || "Delivery Vehicle",
    truckStatus: s.truckStatus || s.truck_status || "ACTIVE",
    truckDriverId: s.truckDriverId || s.truck_driver_id,
    driverName,
    salesUserId: s.salesUserId || s.sales_user_id,

    zoneCode: s.zoneCode || s.zone_code || "",
    zoneName: s.zoneName || s.zone_name || "",
    status: s.status,

    tripId: s.tripId || s.trip_id,

    tripStatus: s.tripStatus || s.trip_status,
  };
}

export const schedulesApi = {
  // ==========================================

  async getZones(params = {}) {

    if (params.isActive !== undefined) query.append("isActive", params.isActive);
    if (params.search) query.append("search", params.search);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules/zones${qs}`);
    const rawList = res?.data?.zones || res?.data || [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawList)) {

      body: payload,

    return res.data;
  },

  // ==========================================
  // 2. Weekly Master Route Templates
  // ==========================================

  async getTemplates(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.truckId) query.append("truckId", params.truckId);
    if (params.zoneId) query.append("zoneId", params.zoneId);
    if (params.dayOfWeek) query.append("dayOfWeek", params.dayOfWeek);
    if (params.isActive !== undefined) query.append("isActive", params.isActive);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules/templates${qs}`);
    const rawList = res?.data?.templates || res?.data || [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawList)) {
      return rawList.map(normalizeTemplate);
    }
    return [];
  },

  async createTemplate(payload) {
    const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    let salesUserId = payload.defaultSalesUserId;
    if (typeof salesUserId === "string") {
      salesUserId = salesUserId.trim();
      if (!uuidRegex.test(salesUserId)) {
        salesUserId = null;
      }
    } else {
      salesUserId = null;
    }

    const cleanPayload = {
      truckId: payload.truckId,
      zoneId: payload.zoneId,
      dayOfWeek: Number(payload.dayOfWeek),
      defaultSalesUserId: salesUserId,
      isActive: payload.isActive !== false,

    const cleanPayload = {};
    if (payload.truckId !== undefined) cleanPayload.truckId = payload.truckId;
    if (payload.zoneId !== undefined) cleanPayload.zoneId = payload.zoneId;
    if (payload.dayOfWeek !== undefined) cleanPayload.dayOfWeek = Number(payload.dayOfWeek);
    if (payload.isActive !== undefined) cleanPayload.isActive = Boolean(payload.isActive);
    if ("defaultSalesUserId" in payload) {
      let salesUserId = payload.defaultSalesUserId;
      if (typeof salesUserId === "string") {
        salesUserId = salesUserId.trim();
        cleanPayload.defaultSalesUserId = uuidRegex.test(salesUserId) ? salesUserId : null;
      } else {
        cleanPayload.defaultSalesUserId = null;
      }
    }

    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules/templates/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: cleanPayload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  async deleteTemplate(id) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules/templates/${id}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  // ==========================================
  // 3. Operational Daily Truck Schedules
  // ==========================================

  /**
   * Fetches active sales representatives eligible for route planning & scheduling.
   * @param {object} [params] - { search }

  async getSalesPersons(params = {}) {

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";

    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules/sales-persons${qs}`);
    const rawList = res?.data?.salesPersons || res?.data || [];
    return Array.isArray(rawList) ? rawList : [];
  },

  async getSchedules(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.date) query.append("date", params.date);
    if (params.truckId) query.append("truckId", params.truckId);
    if (params.zoneId) query.append("zoneId", params.zoneId);
    if (params.status) query.append("status", params.status);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/schedules${qs}`);
    const rawList =
      res?.data?.schedules ||
      res?.data?.items ||
      (Array.isArray(res?.data) ? res.data : []);
    if (Array.isArray(rawList)) {
      return rawList.map(normalizeSchedule);
````

````javascript
// src/api/trips.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

export function normalizeTrip(raw) {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const driverName =
    raw.driverName ||
    (raw.driver_first_name
      ? `${raw.driver_first_name} ${raw.driver_last_name}`.trim()
      : raw.driver_name || "Unassigned");
  const salesName =
    raw.salesName ||
    (raw.sales_first_name
      ? `${raw.sales_first_name} ${raw.sales_last_name}`.trim()
      : raw.sales_name || "Unassigned");

  const reconStatus =
    raw.reconciliationStatus ||
    raw.reconciliation_status ||
    raw.reconciliation?.status ||
    null;

  const rawStatus = (raw.status || "").toUpperCase();
  const effectiveStatus =
    rawStatus === "COMPLETED" && reconStatus
      ? reconStatus
      : rawStatus === "COMPLETED"
      ? "AWAITING_SYNC"
      : raw.status || "IN_PROGRESS";

  const departureOdo =
    Number(raw.departureOdometer ?? raw.truck_current_odometer ?? raw.odometer) || null;
  const returnOdo =
    Number(raw.returnOdometer ?? raw.return_odometer_reading) || null;
  const distanceKm =
    raw.distanceDrivenKm ??
    raw.distance_driven_km ??
    (returnOdo && departureOdo ? Math.max(0, returnOdo - departureOdo) : null);

  const normalizedLoads = Array.isArray(raw.loads)
    ? raw.loads.map(normalizeLoad)
    : [];

  const normalizedRecon = raw.reconciliation
    ? normalizeReconciliation(raw.reconciliation)
    : null;

  const allItems = normalizedLoads.flatMap((l) => l.items || []);
  const totalUnits = allItems.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (it.quantityUnits || 0), 0);
  const canisterUnits = allItems
    .filter((it) => (it.containerType || it.container_type) === "CANISTER")
    .reduce((acc, it) => acc + (it.quantityUnits || 0), 0);
  const cylinderUnits = allItems
    .filter((it) => (it.containerType || it.container_type) === "CYLINDER")
    .reduce((acc, it) => acc + (it.quantityUnits || 0), 0);

  return {
    ...raw,
    id: raw.id,
    tripNumber: raw.tripNumber || raw.trip_number || `TRIP-${raw.id?.slice(0, 8)}`,
    scheduleId: raw.scheduleId || raw.schedule_id || null,
    scheduledDate: raw.scheduledDate || raw.scheduled_date || null,
    truckId: raw.truckId || raw.truck_id,
    truckPlate: raw.truckPlate || raw.truck_plate_number || raw.plate_number || "No Plate",
    truckModel: raw.truckModel || raw.truck_model || "Delivery Vehicle",
    truckStatus: raw.truckStatus || raw.truck_status || "ACTIVE",
    driverId: raw.driverId || raw.driver_id,
    driverName,
    driverPhone: raw.driverPhone || raw.driver_phone,
    salesUserId: raw.salesUserId || raw.sales_user_id,
    salesName,
    salesPhone: raw.salesPhone || raw.sales_phone,
    zoneId: raw.zoneId || raw.zone_id,
    zoneCode: raw.zoneCode || raw.zone_code || "",
    zoneName: raw.zoneName || raw.zone_name || "",
    rawStatus: rawStatus || (raw.status || "").toUpperCase(),
    status: effectiveStatus,
    departureTime: raw.departureTime || raw.departure_time,
    returnTime: raw.returnTime || raw.return_time || null,
    departureOdometer: departureOdo,
    returnOdometer: returnOdo,
    distanceDrivenKm: distanceKm,
    loads: normalizedLoads,
    reconciliation: normalizedRecon,
    onBoardSummary: raw.onBoardSummary || {
      totalUnits,
      canisterCrates: Math.floor(canisterUnits / 24),
      cylinders: cylinderUnits,
    },
    notes: raw.notes || null,
    cancelReason: raw.cancelReason || raw.cancel_reason || null,
  };
}

export function normalizeLoad(load) {
  if (!load) return null;
  return {
    ...load,
    id: load.id,
    tripId: load.tripId || load.trip_id,
    transferType: load.transferType || load.transfer_type,
    slipNumber: load.slipNumber || load.slip_number,
    recordedBy: load.recordedBy || load.recorded_by,
    recordedAt: load.recordedAt || load.recorded_at,
    remarks: load.remarks || null,
    items: Array.isArray(load.items)
      ? load.items.map((it) => ({
          ...it,
          id: it.id,
          loadId: it.loadId || it.load_id,
          productId: it.productId || it.product_id,
          productName: it.productName || it.product_name || it.name || "LPG Product",
          condition: it.condition || "FILLED",
          quantityUnits: parseInt(it.quantityUnits ?? it.quantity_units, 10) || 0,
          containerType: it.containerType || it.container_type,
          netWeightKg: Number(it.netWeightKg || it.net_weight_kg) || 0,
        }))
      : [],
  };
}

export function normalizeReconciliation(recon) {
  if (!recon) return null;
  return {
    ...recon,
    id: recon.id,
    tripId: recon.tripId || recon.trip_id,
    status: recon.status,
    isSettled: recon.status === "SETTLED" || recon.isSettled || recon.is_settled,
    totalLoadedFull: parseInt(recon.totalLoadedFull ?? recon.total_loaded_full, 10) || 0,
    totalSoldFull: parseInt(recon.totalSoldFull ?? recon.total_sold_full, 10) || 0,
    totalReturnedFull: parseInt(recon.totalReturnedFull ?? recon.total_returned_full, 10) || 0,
    totalReturnedEmptyGood:
      parseInt(recon.totalReturnedEmptyGood ?? recon.total_returned_empty_good, 10) || 0,
    totalReturnedDefective:
      parseInt(recon.totalReturnedDefective ?? recon.total_returned_defective, 10) || 0,
    netCustomerDebtCreated:
      parseInt(recon.netCustomerDebtCreated ?? recon.net_customer_debt_created, 10) || 0,
    fullDiscrepancy: recon.fullDiscrepancy ?? recon.full_discrepancy ?? null,
    emptyDiscrepancy: recon.emptyDiscrepancy ?? recon.empty_discrepancy ?? null,
    supervisorNotes: recon.supervisorNotes || recon.supervisor_notes || null,
    reconciledAt: recon.reconciledAt || recon.reconciled_at || null,
  };
}

export const tripsApi = {
  /**
   * List delivery trips with optional filters.
   */
  async getTrips(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.status) query.append("status", params.status);
    if (params.truckId) query.append("truckId", params.truckId);
    if (params.zoneId) query.append("zoneId", params.zoneId);
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);

    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips${qs}`);
    const rawList = res?.data?.trips || res?.data || [];
    if (Array.isArray(rawList)) {
      return rawList.map(normalizeTrip);
    }
    return [];
  },

  /**
   * Get single trip detail by ID.
   */
  async getTripById(id) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${id}`);
    const trip = res?.data?.trip || res?.data;
    if (trip) return normalizeTrip(trip);
    return null;
  },

  /**
   * Dispatch a delivery truck for a scheduled or ad-hoc run.
   */
  async dispatchTrip(payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/dispatch`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Record a midday reload or transfer slip.
   */
  async addTripLoad(tripId, payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/loads`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Driver ends an active delivery trip and logs mandatory return odometer reading.
   */
  async endTrip(tripId, payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/end`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Post-trip physical count reconciliation and stock variance settlement.
   */
  async reconcileTrip(tripId, payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/reconcile`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Complete yard return check-in with return unloads and reconciliation.
   */
  async completeTripReturn(tripId, payload) {
    return this.reconcileTrip(tripId, payload);
  },

  /**
   * Retrieve post-trip reconciliation breakdown.
   */
  async getTripReconciliation(tripId) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/reconciliation`);
    const recon = res?.data?.reconciliation || res?.data;
    return recon ? normalizeReconciliation(recon) : { status: "AWAITING_SYNC" };
  },

  /**
   * Settle post-trip stock reconciliation.
   */
  async settleReconciliation(tripId, payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/reconcile`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Cancel an operational trip.
   */
  async cancelTrip(tripId, payload = {}) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/trips/${tripId}/cancel`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },
};
````

````javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { UserRoundPlus, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import { isValidPhilippinePhone, formatPhilippinePhone } from "../../utils/phone.js";
import CustomerFormStep from "./CustomerFormStep";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal";

export default function CustomerModal({ isOpen, onSave, onClose, customer }) {
  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    address: "",
    contactNumber: "",
    customerType: "COMMERCIAL",
    isActive: true,
  });

  const [prevIsOpen, setPrevIsOpen] = useState(isOpen);
  const [prevCustomer, setPrevCustomer] = useState(customer);

  if (isOpen !== prevIsOpen || customer !== prevCustomer) {
    setPrevIsOpen(isOpen);
    setPrevCustomer(customer);
    if (isOpen) {
      setPhoneError("");
      setSubmitError("");
      setIsSubmitting(false);

      if (customer) {
        setFormData({
          name: customer.name || "",
          address: customer.address || "",
          contactNumber: customer.contactNumber || "",
          customerType: customer.customerType || "COMMERCIAL",
          isActive: customer.isActive !== undefined ? customer.isActive : true,
        });
      } else {
        setFormData({
          name: "",
          address: "",
          contactNumber: "",
          customerType: "COMMERCIAL",
          isActive: true,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleFormSubmit = async (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();

    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setSubmitError("Customer name is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.contactNumber.trim()) {
      setPhoneError("Contact number is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!isValidPhilippinePhone(formData.contactNumber)) {
      setPhoneError(
        "Please enter a valid Philippine phone number (e.g. 09171234567, +639171234567, or landline)."
      );
      return;
    }

    setPhoneError("");
    setSubmitError("");
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const normalizedData = {
      ...formData,
      contactNumber: formatPhilippinePhone(formData.contactNumber),
    };

    try {
      await onSave(normalizedData, customer ? customer.id : null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      setSubmitError(err.message || "Failed to save customer. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  const modalTitle = customer ? "Edit Customer Profile" : "Add New Customer";
  const modalSubtitle = customer
    ? "Update client segment, delivery and contact details"
    : "Register client account, segment & delivery destination";
  const modalIcon = customer ? UserRound : UserRoundPlus;

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={isSubmitting ? undefined : onClose}
      title={modalTitle}
      subtitle={modalSubtitle}
      icon={modalIcon}
      maxWidth="max-w-xl"
      closeOnBackdrop={false}
    >
      <div className="py-1">
        <CustomerFormStep
          formData={formData}
          setFormData={setFormData}
          customer={customer}
          phoneError={phoneError}
          setPhoneError={setPhoneError}
          submitError={submitError}
          isSubmitting={isSubmitting}
          onSubmit={handleFormSubmit}
          onClose={onClose}
        />
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

````javascript
function formatCurrency(val) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return `₱${num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

export default function MaintenanceDashboardSection({

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

    setExpandedRowId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  };

  // 1. Calculate KPI Metrics from all completed logs
  const { totalLogged, totalExpenditure, totalDowntime, averageCost } =
    useMemo(() => {
      const count = logs.length;
      const expenditure = logs.reduce((sum, log) => {
        const parts = Number(log.partsCost) || 0;
        const labor = Number(log.laborCost) || 0;
        const total = Number(log.totalCost) || parts + labor;
        return sum + total;
      }, 0);
      const downtime = logs.reduce((sum, log) => {
        return sum + (Number(log.downtimeDays) || 1);
      }, 0);
      const avg = count > 0 ? expenditure / count : 0;

      return {
        totalLogged: count,
        totalExpenditure: expenditure,
        totalDowntime: downtime,
        averageCost: avg,
      };
    }, [logs]);

  // 2. Filter logs by type & search query

    return logs.filter((log) => {
      const type = (log.maintenanceTypeName || "").toUpperCase();

      if (searchQuery.trim()) {

        ).toLowerCase();

        return (
          woNum.includes(q) ||
          plate.includes(q) ||
          model.includes(q) ||
          shop.includes(q) ||
          desc.includes(q)
        );
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [logs, selectedType, searchQuery]);

                  const typeName =
                    log.maintenanceTypeName || "CORRECTIVE";
                  const shop =
                    log.workOrder?.shopName ||
                    log.shopName ||
                    "In-House Facility";
                  const parts = Number(log.partsCost) || 0;
                  const labor = Number(log.laborCost) || 0;
                  const total =
                    Number(log.totalCost) || parts + labor;
                  const downtime =
                    log.downtimeDays !== undefined
                      ? Number(log.downtimeDays)
                      : 1;
                  const severity = (
                    log.severity || "LOW"
                  ).toUpperCase();

                  const severityBadgeVariant =
                    severity === "CRITICAL"
                      ? "danger"
                      : severity === "HIGH"
                      ? "danger"
                      : severity === "MEDIUM"
                      ? "warning"
                      : "success";

                  return (
                    <Fragment key={logId}>
                      <tr
                        onClick={() => toggleRow(logId)}
                        className={`transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                          isExpanded
                            ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold"
                            : "bg-white hover:bg-[#F4F9FC]"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Work Order / Record */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#0B4A6E]">
                            {log.workOrder?.workOrderNumber
                              ? `WO #${log.workOrder.workOrderNumber}`
                              : log.workOrderId
                              ? `WO #${log.workOrderId.slice(0, 8)}`
                              : `REC #${log.id.slice(0, 8)}`}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Vehicle */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800">
                            {plate}
                          </div>
                          {model && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-normal">
                              {model}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Type */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <Badge
                            variant="roles"
                            className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-0.5"
                          >
                            {typeName}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>

                        {/* Facility */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                          <div className="max-w-[200px] truncate" title={shop}>
                            {shop}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Resolution & Downtime */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                            {formatDate(log.dateResolved || log.createdAt)}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-600">
                            {downtime} day(s) downtime
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Serviced ODO */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono text-slate-700 font-medium">
                          {log.odometerAtService
                            ? `${Number(
                                log.odometerAtService
                              ).toLocaleString()} km`
                            : "-"}
                        </td>

                        {/* Parts / Labor */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-xs text-slate-600">
                          <div>
                            P:{" "}
                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                              {formatCurrency(parts)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            L:{" "}
                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
                              {formatCurrency(labor)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Total Cost */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] whitespace-nowrap">
                          {formatCurrency(total)}
                        </td>

                        {/* Severity */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                          <Badge
                            variant={severityBadgeVariant}
                            className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-0.5"
                          >
                            {severity}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>

                        {/* Expand Chevron */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-right">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-[#0B4A6E] hover:bg-slate-200/50 transition cursor-pointer"
                            title={
                              isExpanded ? "Collapse Details" : "Expand Details"
                            }
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? (
                              <ChevronUp size={16} />
                            ) : (
                              <ChevronDown size={16} />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>

                      {/* Expanded Details Row */}
                      {isExpanded && (
                        <tr
                          key={`${logId}-expanded`}
                          className="bg-[#F8FBFC] border-b border-gray-100"
                        >
                          <td colSpan={10} className="py-4 px-5">
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#0A4B6E]/20 shadow-xs">
                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Scope of Work
                                </span>
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 font-medium">
                                  {log.workOrder?.description ||
                                    log.description ||
                                    "Maintenance inspection and service overhaul."}
                                </p>
                              </div>

                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Cost Breakdown
                                </span>
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
                                  Parts:{" "}
                                  <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">
                                    {formatCurrency(parts)}
                                  </strong>
                                  <br />
                                  Labor:{" "}
                                  <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E]">
                                    {formatCurrency(labor)}
                                  </strong>
                                </p>
                              </div>

                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Service Timeline
                                </span>
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-700">
                                  Started:{" "}
                                  <strong>
                                    {formatDate(log.dateStarted)}
                                  </strong>
                                  <br />
                                  Resolved:{" "}
                                  <strong>
                                    {formatDate(log.dateResolved)}
                                  </strong>
                                </p>
                              </div>

                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#6D8AA2] uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Official Documentation
                                </span>
                                <p className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#0B4A6E]">
                                  {log.workOrder?.workOrderNumber
                                    ? `WO #${log.workOrder.workOrderNumber}`
                                    : log.workOrderId
                                    ? `WO #${log.workOrderId.slice(0, 8)}`
                                    : `REC #${log.id.slice(0, 8)}`}
                                </p>
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                                  Recorded on {formatPhilippineDate(log.createdAt)}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                    </Fragment>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/dashboard/SalesGraph.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";
import Card from "../ui/Card";
export default function SalesGraph({ salesData }) {
  const [timeframe, setTimeframe] = useState("monthly");

  const weeklySales = salesData?.weekly || [];
  const monthlySales = salesData?.monthly || [];
  const annualSales = salesData?.annually || [];

  const activeData =
    timeframe === "weekly"
      ? weeklySales
      : timeframe === "monthly"
      ? monthlySales
      : annualSales;

  return (
    <Card className="flex-1 flex p-4 md:p-5 flex-col min-h-[280px]">
      {/* Header Info */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between mb-6 gap-4">
        <h3 className="text-[16px] md:text-[18px] font-semibold text-gray-800">
          Sales Overview
        </h3>

        {/* Toggle Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-0.5 text-xs font-semibold">
          {["weekly", "monthly", "annually"].map((tf) => (
            <button
              key={tf}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTimeframe(tf)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer capitalize ${
                timeframe === tf
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#6D8AA2] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
              }`}
            >
              {tf}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Custom HTML Legend */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 sm:gap-6 mb-6 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-3 h-3 bg-[#93B5D0] rounded-xs"></span>
          <span>Butane Canister</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-3 h-3 bg-[#0F7AB2] rounded-xs"></span>
          <span>11 kg LPG</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-3 h-3 bg-[#FFDF2C] rounded-xs"></span>
          <span>22 kg LPG</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chart Area */}
      <div className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl h-[190px] md:h-[190px] flex items-center justify-center">
        {activeData.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">No sales data available for this timeframe</p>
        ) : (
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart
              key={timeframe}
              data={activeData}
              margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, left: -40, bottom: 0 }}
            >
              <CartesianGrid
                strokeDasharray="3 3"
                vertical={false}
                stroke="#E5E7EB"
              />

              <XAxis
                dataKey="name"
                axisLine={false}
                tickLine={false}
                tick={{ fill: "#6B7280", fontSize: 12 }}
                dy={10}
              />

              <YAxis axisLine={false} tickLine={false} tick={false} />

              <Tooltip
                contentStyle={{
                  borderRadius: "8px",
                  border: "none",
                  boxShadow: "0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)",
                }}
              />

              <Bar
                dataKey="butane"
                name="Butane Canister"
                fill="#93B5D0"
                barSize={16}
                radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
              />
              <Bar
                dataKey="lpg11kg"
                name="11 kg LPG"
                fill="#0F7AB2"
                barSize={16}
                radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
              />
              <Bar
                dataKey="lpg50kg"
                name="50 kg LPG"
                fill="#FFDF2C"
                barSize={16}
                radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
              />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/analytics/RecurringIssuesAnalytics.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, Fragment } from "react";

  AlertOctagon,

} from "lucide-react";
import { fleetApi } from "../../../api/fleet.js";
import Badge from "../../ui/Badge";
import SearchBar from "../../ui/SearchBar";
import { formatPhilippineDateShort } from "../../../utils/date.js";

const LOOKBACK_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 30, label: "Last 30 Days" },
  { value: 60, label: "Last 60 Days" },
  { value: 90, label: "Last 90 Days" },
  { value: 180, label: "Last 180 Days" },
];

const formatDate = (dateStr) => formatPhilippineDateShort(dateStr, { fallback: "-", yearDigits: 4 });

const getSeverityBadgeVariant = (severity) => {
  const normalized = (severity || "").toUpperCase();
  switch (normalized) {
    case "CRITICAL":
      return "danger";
    case "HIGH":
      return "warning";
    case "MEDIUM":
      return "roles";
    case "LOW":
      return "success";
    default:
      return "neutral";
  }
};

/**
 * RecurringIssuesAnalytics
 * Fleet reliability and chronic defect intelligence adhering to Madayaw Gas UI standards.
 */
export default function RecurringIssuesAnalytics({
  trucks = [],
  onCreateWorkOrderForTruck,
}) {
  const [days, setDays] = useState(90);
  const [minOccurrences, setMinOccurrences] = useState(2);
  const [selectedTruckId, setSelectedTruckId] = useState("");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [analyticsData, setAnalyticsData] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [expandedRowId, setExpandedRowId] = useState(null);

  const toggleRow = (id) => {
    setExpandedRowId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  };

  const fetchAnalytics = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setError("");
      const params = {
        days,
        minOccurrences,
      };
      if (selectedTruckId) {
        params.truckId = selectedTruckId;
      }
      const res = await fleetApi.getRecurringIssuesAnalytics(params);
      setAnalyticsData(res?.data?.recurringIssues || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load recurring defect analytics:", err);
      setError("Unable to compute recurring defect analytics. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [days, minOccurrences, selectedTruckId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAnalytics();
  }, [fetchAnalytics]);

  // Aggregate insights
  const totalRecurrences = useMemo(() => {
    return analyticsData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.occurrenceCount || 0), 0);
  }, [analyticsData]);

  const topIssueType = useMemo(() => {
    if (analyticsData.length === 0) return "None";
    const freqMap = {};
    analyticsData.forEach((item) => {
      const type = (item.incidentTypeName || "Other").replace(/_/g, " ");
      freqMap[type] = (freqMap[type] || 0) + item.occurrenceCount;
    });
    let maxType = "None";
    let maxCount = 0;
    Object.entries(freqMap).forEach(([t, count]) => {
      if (count > maxCount) {
        maxCount = count;
        maxType = t;
      }
    });
    return maxType;
  }, [analyticsData]);

  // Filter analytics data by search query
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return analyticsData;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return analyticsData.filter((item) => {
      const plate = (item.plateNumber || "").toLowerCase();
      const model = (item.truckModel || "").toLowerCase();
      const type = (item.incidentTypeName || "").toLowerCase();
      const category = (item.defectCategory || "").toLowerCase();
      const descs = (item.descriptions || []).join(" ").toLowerCase();
      return (
        plate.includes(q) ||
        model.includes(q) ||
        type.includes(q) ||
        category.includes(q) ||
        descs.includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [analyticsData, searchQuery]);

  return (

          className="w-full max-w-md"
        />

        {/* Filter Controls & Lookback Horizon Pills */}

                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-[#0B4A6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-xs"
                      : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 bg-transparent"
                  }`}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}

          >

                    </div>

                  const rowKey = `${item.truckId}-${item.incidentTypeId}-${idx}`;
                  const isExpanded = expandedRowId === rowKey;
                  const targetTruck = trucks.find((t) => t.id === item.truckId) || {

                    plateNumber: item.plateNumber,
                    model: item.truckModel,
                  };

                  return (
                    <Fragment key={rowKey}>
                      <tr
                        onClick={() => toggleRow(rowKey)}
                        className={`transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer ${

                            : "bg-white hover:bg-[#F4F9FC]"
                        }`}
                      >

                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">

                                {item.plateNumber}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium block truncate">
                                {item.truckModel || "Fleet Vehicle"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Defect Classification */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate">
                            {(item.incidentTypeName || "MECHANICAL_DEFECT").replace(/_/g, " ")}
                          </div>
                          {item.defectCategory && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#6D8AA2] truncate">
                              {item.defectCategory.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Recurrence Count */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-rose-50 text-[#C93B32] border border-rose-200 shadow-2xs">
                            <AlertTriangle size={12} className="shrink-0 text-[#C93B32]" />
                            <span>{item.occurrenceCount} Occurrences</span>
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Latest Severity */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                          <Badge
                            variant={getSeverityBadgeVariant(item.latestSeverity)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase"
                          >
                            {item.latestSeverity || "MEDIUM"}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>

                        {/* Last Reported Date */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                            <Clock size={13} className="text-[#6D8AA2] shrink-0" />
                            <span>{formatDate(item.latestIncidentDate)}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 md:px-5 text-right">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                            {onCreateWorkOrderForTruck && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  onCreateWorkOrderForTruck(targetTruck);
                                }}
                                className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold rounded-full py-1.5 px-3 text-xs transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                                title="Create Work Order for this vehicle"
                              >
                                <Wrench size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                                <span>Work Order</span>
                              </button>
                            )}

                            <div className="w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center text-[#0A4B6E]">
                              {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp size={16} /> : <ChevronDown size={16} />}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>

                      {/* Expanded Incident Reports Drawer */}
                      {isExpanded && (
                        <tr className="bg-[#E8F3F8]/40">
                          <td colSpan={6} className="p-4 md:p-5 border-t border-[#BCE1F1]/60">
                            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 border border-[#BCE1F1]/70 shadow-2xs space-y-3">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-2">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  <FileText size={14} />
                                  <span>Logged Incident Observations & Roadside Reports</span>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold">
                                  {item.descriptions?.length || 0} Incident Reports Recorded
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              {item.descriptions && item.descriptions.length > 0 ? (
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
                                  {item.descriptions.map((desc, dIdx) => (
                                    <div
                                      key={dIdx}
                                      className="bg-[#F8FAFC] rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-200/80 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed"
                                    >
                                      <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 font-bold text-[10px] mt-0.5">
                                        {dIdx + 1}
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="space-y-1">
                                        <p className="font-medium">{desc}</p>
                                        <span className="text-[10.5px] text-[#6D8AA2] block">
                                          Logged during mid-route operation
                                        </span>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic">
                                  No additional observation notes recorded for this defect cluster.
                                </p>
                              )}

                              <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 text-xs">
                                <span className="text-slate-500">
                                  Target Asset: <strong>{item.plateNumber}</strong> ({item.truckModel || "Fleet Vehicle"})
                                </span>
                                {onCreateWorkOrderForTruck && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => onCreateWorkOrderForTruck(targetTruck)}
                                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold rounded-full py-1.5 px-4 text-xs transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                                  >
                                    <Wrench size={13} />
                                    <span>Create Corrective Work Order</span>
                                  </button>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                    </Fragment>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````
