````javascript
import { Funnel, X } from "lucide-react";

export default function ActiveFleetFilters({
  selectedDriver,
  selectedStatus,
  selectedVehicleType,
  selectedPmStatus,
  dateFrom,
  dateTo,
  onClearDriver,
  onClearStatus,
  onClearVehicleType,
  onClearPmStatus,
  onClearDates,
}) {
  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    const norm = (status || "").toUpperCase().replace("_", " ");
    switch (norm) {
      case "ACTIVE":
      case "IN USE":
      case "AVAILABLE":
        return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200";
      case "STANDBY":
      case "IN SHOP":
        return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200";
      case "UNDER REPAIR":
      case "UNDER MAINTENANCE":
        return "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200";
      default:
        return "bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 flex-nowrap">
      {/* Active Driver Filter Chip */}
      {selectedDriver && selectedDriver !== "All Drivers" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Driver: <strong className="font-semibold">{selectedDriver}</strong></span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearDriver}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active Status Filter Chip */}
      {selectedStatus && selectedStatus !== "All" && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Status:</span>
          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border ${getStatusBadgeClass(selectedStatus)}`}>
            {selectedStatus.replace("_", " ")}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearStatus}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active Vehicle Type Filter Chip */}
      {selectedVehicleType && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Type:</span>
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200">
            {selectedVehicleType.replace("_", " ")}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearVehicleType}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active PM Due Filter Chip */}
      {selectedPmStatus && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>PM:</span>
          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border ${
            selectedPmStatus === "PM_DUE"
              ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200"
              : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200"
          }`}>
            {selectedPmStatus === "PM_DUE" ? "PM Due (≥ 5k KM)" : "Normal"}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearPmStatus}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}

      {/* Active Date Filter Chip */}
      {(dateFrom || dateTo) && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-[26px] px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shadow-2xs shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
          <Funnel size={11} className="text-[#0A4B6E]/70 shrink-0" />
          <span>Date: <strong className="font-semibold">{dateFrom || "Start"}</strong> to <strong className="font-semibold">{dateTo || "Present"}</strong></span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClearDates}
            className="p-0.5 hover:bg-black/10 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[#0A4B6E]"
            title="Remove filter"
          >
            <X size={11} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/DeleteConfirmationModal.jsx
import ConfirmationModal from "../ui/ConfirmationModal.jsx";

export default function DeleteConfirmationModal({ truck, onConfirm, onClose }) {
  if (!truck) return null;

  return (
    <ConfirmationModal
      isOpen={Boolean(truck)}
      onClose={onClose}
      onConfirm={(password) => onConfirm(truck, password)}
      title="Deactivate Truck?"
      confirmText="Deactivate"
      cancelText="Cancel"
      variant="danger"
      requiresPassword={true}
      passwordLabel="Enter your password to authorize deactivation:"
      message={
        <p className="text-gray-800 leading-relaxed text-xs">
          This action will mark{" "}
          <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold">
            {truck.plateNumber || "this vehicle"}
          </strong>{" "}
          as inactive and release its assigned driver, while its historical records and mileage logs are retained.
        </p>
      }
    />
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { AlertOctagon, AlertTriangle, Plus, Clock, MapPin, User, Search, Filter, X } from "lucide-react";
import { fleetApi } from "../../api/fleet.js";
import SideDrawer from "../ui/SideDrawer";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import Pagination from "../ui/Pagination";
import { formatPhilippineDateTime } from "../../utils/date.js";

/**
 * IncidentHistoryModal
 * Displays chronological breakdown, failure, and incident logs in a right-sliding panel.
 */
export default function IncidentHistoryModal({
  isOpen,
  truck = null,
  onClose,
  onOpenReport,
}) {
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState([]);
  const [incidentTypes, setIncidentTypes] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedSeverity, setSelectedSeverity] = useState("All");
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState("All");
  const [searchDraft, setSearchDraft] = useState("");
  const [committedSearch, setCommittedSearch] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const limit = 10;
  const [meta, setMeta] = useState({ page: 1, limit: 10, totalPages: 1, totalItems: 0 });

  // React 19 render-time state reset when opening
  const [prevIsOpen, setPrevIsOpen] = useState(isOpen);
  if (isOpen !== prevIsOpen) {
    setPrevIsOpen(isOpen);
    if (isOpen) {
      setPage(1);
      setSearchDraft("");
      setCommittedSearch("");
      setSelectedSeverity("All");
      setSelectedType("All");
    }
  }

  const loadIncidents = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const [incRes, typesRes] = await Promise.all([
        fleetApi.getIncidents({
          truckId: truck?.id || undefined,
          severity: selectedSeverity === "All" ? undefined : selectedSeverity,
          incidentTypeId: selectedType === "All" ? undefined : selectedType,
          search: committedSearch || undefined,
          page,
          limit,
        }),
        fleetApi.getIncidentTypes(),
      ]);

      setIncidents(incRes?.data?.incidents || []);
      if (incRes?.meta) {
        setMeta(incRes.meta);
      } else {
        const total = incRes?.data?.total || (incRes?.data?.incidents || []).length;
        setMeta({
          page,
          limit,
          totalItems: total,
          totalPages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / limit)),
        });
      }
      setIncidentTypes(typesRes?.data?.types || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load incidents:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [truck?.id, selectedSeverity, selectedType, committedSearch, page, limit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadIncidents();
    }
  }, [isOpen, loadIncidents]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const getSeverityBadge = (severity) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return (
          <Badge variant="danger" className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold">
            CRITICAL
          </Badge>
        );
      case "HIGH":
        return (
          <Badge variant="warning" className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">
            HIGH
          </Badge>
        );
      case "MEDIUM":
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold">
            MEDIUM
          </span>
        );
      case "LOW":
        return (
          <Badge variant="success" className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px]">
            LOW
          </Badge>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <Badge variant="neutral" className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px]">
            {severity}
          </Badge>
        );
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (isoString) => formatPhilippineDateTime(isoString, { fallback: "Recent" });

  return (
    <SideDrawer
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={truck ? `Incident Logs — ${truck.plateNumber || "Truck"}` : "Fleet Incident & Breakdown Logs"}
      subtitle={truck ? `${truck.model || "Isuzu Elf"} • Roadside incidents & defects` : "Fleet-wide breakdown & incident records"}
      icon={AlertOctagon}
      badge={
        truck ? (
          <Badge variant="neutral" className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">
            {truck.plateNumber || "Truck"}
          </Badge>
        ) : null
      }
      width="max-w-xl lg:max-w-2xl"
      footer={({ onClose: closeDrawer }) => (
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
          {onOpenReport && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onOpenReport(truck);
              }}
              className="flex-1 py-3 px-5 rounded-full font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-2 border-[#F6C445] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <Plus size={15} />
              <span>Report Incident</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={closeDrawer}
            className={`py-3 px-5 rounded-full font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0B4A6E] transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95 text-center ${
              onOpenReport ? "flex-1" : "w-full"
            }`}
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* FILTER TOOLBAR */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
          {/* Search with Search-on-Enter (Strategy B) */}
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchDraft}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchDraft(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  setCommittedSearch(searchDraft.trim());
                  setPage(1);
                }
              }}
              placeholder="Search (Press Enter)..."
              className="w-full text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full py-2 pl-8 pr-7 text-gray-800 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 transition-all"
            />
            <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400" />
            {searchDraft && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchDraft("");
                  setCommittedSearch("");
                  setPage(1);
                }}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 cursor-pointer"
                title="Clear search"
              >
                <X size={13} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Severity Filter */}
          <select
            value={selectedSeverity}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedSeverity(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full py-2 px-3 text-gray-800 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="All">All Severities</option>
            <option value="CRITICAL">Critical</option>
            <option value="HIGH">High</option>
            <option value="MEDIUM">Medium</option>
            <option value="LOW">Low</option>
          </select>

          {/* Incident Type Filter */}
          <select
            value={selectedType}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedType(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full py-2 px-3 text-gray-800 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="All">All Types</option>
            {incidentTypes.map((t) => (
              <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                {t.typeName.replace(/_/g, " ")}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* INCIDENT CARDS LIST */}
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
            Loading incident records...
          </div>
        ) : incidents.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {incidents.map((inc) => (
              <div
                key={inc.id}
                className="bg-[#F8FBFC] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8]/70 border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl p-4 transition-colors duration-150 text-xs space-y-2.5 shadow-2xs"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">
                      {inc.plateNumber || "Truck"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-gray-300">•</span>
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-full font-semibold text-[10px]">
                      {inc.incidentTypeName?.replace(/_/g, " ") || "INCIDENT"}
                    </span>
                    {getSeverityBadge(inc.severity)}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-[#5B8399] flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                    <Clock size={13} />
                    <span>{formatDate(inc.reportDate)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-xl p-3 text-gray-800 leading-relaxed font-sans text-xs shadow-2xs">
                  {inc.description}
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-gray-500 pt-0.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <MapPin size={12} className="text-gray-400" />
                    <span>{inc.incidentLocation || "Roadside mid-route"}</span>
                  </span>

                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <User size={12} className="text-gray-400" />
                    <span>Reported by: <strong className="text-gray-700">{inc.reporterName || "Logistics Supervisor"}</strong></span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {/* Pagination Controls */}
            {meta.totalPages > 1 && (
              <div className="pt-2">
                <Pagination
                  currentPage={page}
                  totalPages={meta.totalPages}
                  totalItems={meta.totalItems}
                  limit={limit}
                  onPageChange={(p) => setPage(p)}
                  isLoading={isLoading}
                  itemLabel="incidents"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="py-16 text-center text-gray-400 space-y-2">
            <AlertOctagon size={42} className="mx-auto text-gray-300 stroke-[1.5]" />
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600">No incidents recorded</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {committedSearch || selectedSeverity !== "All" || selectedType !== "All"
                ? "No incident logs matched your filter criteria."
                : "No roadside breakdowns or mechanical incidents recorded."}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </SideDrawer>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Truck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Wrench,
  PowerOff,
  Info,
  AlertTriangle,
} from "lucide-react";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import {
  checkActiveWorkOrder,
  ACTIVE_RESTRICTED_TOOLTIP,
  ACTIVE_RESTRICTED_ERROR,
} from "../../utils/fleetGuards.js";

const getStatusVariant = (status) => {
  const normalized = (status || "").toUpperCase().replace("_", " ");
  switch (normalized) {
    case "ACTIVE":
      return "success";
    case "UNDER MAINTENANCE":
      return "danger";
    case "INACTIVE":
      return "neutral";
    case "RETIRED":
      return "deactivated";
    default:
      return "neutral";
  }
};

export default function SetAvailabilityModal({
  isOpen,
  truck,
  workOrders = [],
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}) {
  const { hasActiveWorkOrder, activeWorkOrder } = checkActiveWorkOrder(
    truck,
    workOrders
  );

  const [status, setStatus] = useState("UNDER_MAINTENANCE");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (truck) {
      if (truck.status === "ACTIVE") {
        setStatus("UNDER_MAINTENANCE");
      } else if (hasActiveWorkOrder) {
        setStatus("UNDER_MAINTENANCE");
      } else {
        setStatus("ACTIVE");
      }
      setReason("");
      setErrorMsg("");
    }
  }, [truck, hasActiveWorkOrder]);

  if (!isOpen || !truck) return null;

  const currentStatus = truck.status || "ACTIVE";
  const driverDisplay = truck.driver
    ? `${truck.driver.firstName || ""} ${truck.driver.lastName || ""}`.trim() ||
      truck.driver.username
    : truck.driverName && truck.driverName !== "Unassigned"
    ? truck.driverName
    : "No Assigned";

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (status === "ACTIVE" && hasActiveWorkOrder) {
      setErrorMsg("Cannot set to Active while an active work order exists.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setErrorMsg("");
      await onSubmit({
        status,
        reason: reason.trim(),
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to update availability status:", err);
      setErrorMsg(
        err.message || "Failed to update availability status."
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const footerContent = (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center">
      {errorMsg && (
        <div className="w-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border border-red-200 mb-3 text-left">
          {errorMsg}
        </div>
      )}
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="yellow"
        disabled={
          isSubmitting ||
          status === currentStatus ||
          (status === "ACTIVE" && hasActiveWorkOrder)
        }
        onClick={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider mb-2"
      >
        {isSubmitting ? "UPDATING..." : "UPDATE AVAILABILITY"}
      </Button>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="cancel"
        disabled={isSubmitting}
        onClick={onClose}
        className="text-xs"
      >
        CANCEL
      </Button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Set Vehicle Availability"
      icon={SlidersHorizontal}
      badge={
        <Badge
          variant={getStatusVariant(currentStatus)}
          className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs"
        >
          {currentStatus.replace("_", " ")}
        </Badge>
      }
      maxWidth="max-w-lg"
      footer={footerContent}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4 text-left py-1 text-xs">
        {/* VEHICLE CONTEXT BANNER */}
        <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border border-[#BCE1F1]/60">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs">
              <Truck size={20} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-base leading-tight">
                {truck.plateNumber || "Truck"}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#588094]">
                {truck.model || "Isuzu Elf"}{" "}
                {truck.yearModel ? `(${truck.yearModel})` : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#588094] block font-medium">
              Assigned Driver
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {driverDisplay}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CURRENT REGISTERED METRICS */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-[#BCE1F1]/60 rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-xs shadow-2xs">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] block text-[11px] font-semibold">Current Status</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {currentStatus.replace("_", " ")}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] block text-[11px] font-semibold">Current Odometer</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#0A4B6E] font-mono">
              {Number(truck.currentOdometer || 0).toLocaleString()} KM
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TARGET CONDITION SELECTOR (Pill Buttons matching InspectionModal) */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            Target Status <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
          </label>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            {/* ACTIVE */}
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={hasActiveWorkOrder}
              onClick={() => !hasActiveWorkOrder && setStatus("ACTIVE")}
              title={hasActiveWorkOrder ? ACTIVE_RESTRICTED_TOOLTIP : ""}
              className={`w-full h-9 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                hasActiveWorkOrder
                  ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 border-slate-200 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50"
                  : status === "ACTIVE"
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-600 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                  : "bg-white text-emerald-800 border-[#BCE1F1]/80 hover:bg-emerald-50 cursor-pointer"
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 size={15} className="shrink-0" />
              <span>ACTIVE</span>
            </button>

            {/* UNDER MAINTENANCE */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatus("UNDER_MAINTENANCE")}
              className={`w-full h-9 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                status === "UNDER_MAINTENANCE"
                  ? "bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600 shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-white text-amber-800 border-[#BCE1F1]/80 hover:bg-amber-50"
              }`}
            >
              <Wrench size={15} className="shrink-0" />
              <span>MAINTENANCE</span>
            </button>

            {/* INACTIVE */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatus("INACTIVE")}
              className={`w-full h-9 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                status === "INACTIVE"
                  ? "bg-slate-700 text-white border-slate-700 shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-white text-slate-700 border-[#BCE1F1]/80 hover:bg-slate-100"
              }`}
            >
              <PowerOff size={15} className="shrink-0" />
              <span>INACTIVE</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          {hasActiveWorkOrder && (
            <p className="text-[#CD3E3E] text-[11px] mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
              <AlertTriangle size={13} className="shrink-0 text-[#CD3E3E]" />
              <span>Active work order in progress ({activeWorkOrder?.orderNumber || "Work Order"}). Complete it before setting to Active.</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* CONDITION IMPACT & SOFT-BINDING HELPER CARD */}
        {hasActiveWorkOrder ? (
          <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-amber-900">
            <AlertTriangle size={16} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-amber-600" />
            <div className="leading-relaxed">
              <strong>Active Work Order:</strong> Vehicle is undergoing repairs ({activeWorkOrder?.orderNumber || "Work Order"}). Finalize the work order in the Maintenance tab to restore Active status.
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] border border-[#BCE1F1]/60 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">
            <Info size={16} className="shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-[#0F7AB2]" />
            <div className="leading-relaxed">
              {status === "ACTIVE" ? (
                <span>
                  <strong>Active:</strong> Cleared for route dispatch.

              ) : status === "UNDER_MAINTENANCE" ? (

        {/* REASON / REMARKS */}
        <div>

          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
````

````javascript
import ConfirmationModal from "../ui/ConfirmationModal.jsx";

export default function DeactivateItemModal({ item, onConfirm, onClose }) {
  if (!item) return null;

  return (
    <ConfirmationModal
      isOpen={Boolean(item)}
      onClose={onClose}
      onConfirm={(password) => onConfirm(item, password)}
      title="Deactivate Item?"
      confirmText="Deactivate"
      cancelText="Cancel"
      variant="danger"
      requiresPassword={true}
      passwordLabel="Enter your password to authorize deactivation:"
      message={
        <p className="text-gray-800 leading-relaxed text-xs">
          Are you sure you want to deactivate{" "}
          <strong className="text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold">
            {item.name || item.itemName || "this product"}
          </strong>
          ? This product item will be marked as inactive and will not be available for new sales or inventory movements, while historical records are retained.
        </p>
      }
    />
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/ItemCard.jsx
import { List, Package, Flame, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";

export default function ItemCard({ item, stock = null, isSelected = false, onClick }) {
  const isActive =
    item.isActive !== undefined
      ? Boolean(item.isActive)
      : (item.status || "").toUpperCase() === "ACTIVE";
  const statusLabel = isActive ? "ACTIVE" : "INACTIVE";

  const isCylinder =
    (item.containerType || item.category || "").toUpperCase().includes("CYLINDER") ||
    (item.category || "").toUpperCase().includes("TANK");

  const getItemIcon = () => {
    if (isCylinder) {
      return <Flame size={16} />;
    }
    return <Package size={16} />;
  };

  const formattedWeight = () => {
    if (item.netWeightKg === undefined || item.netWeightKg === null) return "0.250 kg";
    const val = Number(item.netWeightKg);
    return `${val % 1 === 0 ? val.toFixed(1) : val.toFixed(3)} kg`;
  };

  const filledUnits = stock?.quantityFilled ?? null;
  const cratesFilled = stock?.cratesFilled ?? null;
  const emptyUnits = stock?.quantityEmptyGood ?? 0;
  const defUnits = stock?.quantityDefective ?? 0;

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => onClick && onClick(item)}
      className={`relative transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 border text-left ${
        isSelected
          ? "bg-slate-100/90 border-slate-300 shadow-sm"
          : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 shadow-xs"
      }`}
    >
      <div>
        {/* CARD HEADER */}
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3.5 transition-all duration-200 border ${
            isSelected
              ? "bg-white text-[#0A4B6E] border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs"
              : "bg-[#F4F8FA] text-[#0A4B6E] border-slate-200/80"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 font-bold shadow-xs bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C]">
              {getItemIcon()}
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg tracking-wide truncate">
              {item.name || item.itemName || "Product Item"}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <Badge variant="roles" className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 shrink-0 font-semibold">
            {item.category || "LPG"}
          </Badge>
        </div>

        {/* CARD BODY */}
        <div className="space-y-2 text-xs md:text-[13px] leading-relaxed mb-3 px-0.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">Category:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] truncate max-w-[60%] text-right">
              {item.category || "LPG Cylinder"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">Container Type:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] truncate max-w-[60%] text-right uppercase">
              {item.containerType || (isCylinder ? "CYLINDER" : "CANISTER")}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">Net Weight:</span>
            <span className="font-bold font-mono text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {formattedWeight()}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* BULK YARD STOCK HIGHLIGHT */}
          <div className="pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                <Package size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <span>Bulk Yard Stock:</span>
              </span>
              <div className="text-right">
                {filledUnits !== null ? (
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>{filledUnits.toLocaleString()} units</span>
                    {cratesFilled !== null && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 font-semibold">
                        ({cratesFilled} cr)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs italic">No yard stock</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {stock && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 pt-0.5">
                <span className="text-[10.5px] text-[#6D8AA2]">Yard Conditions:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-[10.5px]">
                  <span className="text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold">{emptyUnits.toLocaleString()}</span> empty ·{" "}
                  <span className={defUnits > 0 ? "text-rose-600 font-bold" : "text-slate-500"}>
                    {defUnits.toLocaleString()} def
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CARD FOOTER */}
      <div
        className={`flex items-center justify-between mt-auto pt-2.5 border-t px-0.5 ${
          isSelected ? "border-slate-200/80" : "border-slate-100"
        }`}
      >
        <Badge
          variant={isActive ? "success" : "deactivated"}
          className="px-3 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold shrink-0"
        >
          {statusLabel}
        </Badge>

        <div
          className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 border shadow-2xs shrink-0 ml-2 ${
            isSelected
              ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] border-slate-300"
              : "bg-[#F4F8FA] text-[#0A4B6E] border-slate-200"
          }`}
          title="View Item Details"
        >
          <List size={14} className="stroke-[2.2]" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Calendar, X, Trash2, CheckCircle2, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

const DAYS_OF_WEEK = [
  { num: 1, label: "Mon", full: "Monday" },
  { num: 2, label: "Tue", full: "Tuesday" },
  { num: 3, label: "Wed", full: "Wednesday" },
  { num: 4, label: "Thu", full: "Thursday" },
  { num: 5, label: "Fri", full: "Friday" },
  { num: 6, label: "Sat", full: "Saturday" },
  { num: 7, label: "Sun", full: "Sunday" },
];

export default function TemplateModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  template = null,
  initialTruckId = "",
  initialDayOfWeek = 1,
  vehicles = [],
  zones = [],
  salesUsers = [],
  onSaveTemplate,
  onDeleteTemplate,
}) {
  const isEditing = Boolean(template?.id);

  const [truckId, setTruckId] = useState("");
  const [dayOfWeek, setDayOfWeek] = useState(1);
  const [zoneId, setZoneId] = useState("");
  const [defaultSalesUserId, setDefaultSalesUserId] = useState("");
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(true);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Initialize form state when opened or props change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (template) {
      setTruckId(template.truckId || "");
      setDayOfWeek(Number(template.dayOfWeek) || 1);
      setZoneId(template.zoneId || "");
      setDefaultSalesUserId(template.defaultSalesUserId || "");
      setIsActive(template.isActive !== false);
    } else {
      setTruckId(initialTruckId || vehicles[0]?.id || "");
      setDayOfWeek(Number(initialDayOfWeek) || 1);
      setZoneId(zones[0]?.id || "");
      setDefaultSalesUserId("");
      setIsActive(true);
    }
    setError(null);
  }, [template, initialTruckId, initialDayOfWeek, vehicles, zones, salesUsers, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!truckId) {
      setError("Please select a delivery vehicle");
      return;
    }
    if (!zoneId) {
      setError("Please select a target service zone");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const selTruck = vehicles.find((v) => v.id === truckId);
      const selZone = zones.find((z) => z.id === zoneId);
      const selSales = salesUsers.find((u) => u.id === defaultSalesUserId);

      await onSaveTemplate({
        id: template?.id,
        truckId,
        dayOfWeek: Number(dayOfWeek),
        zoneId,
        defaultSalesUserId: defaultSalesUserId || null,
        isActive,
        truckPlate: selTruck?.plateNumber,
        truckModel: selTruck?.model,
        zoneCode: selZone?.code,
        zoneName: selZone?.name,
        salesName: selSales ? (selSales.fullName || `${selSales.firstName || ""} ${selSales.lastName || ""}`.trim() || selSales.username) : null,
      });

      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save route schedule");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!template?.id || !onDeleteTemplate) return;
    if (window.confirm("Are you sure you want to remove this route schedule?")) {
      try {
        setIsSubmitting(true);
        await onDeleteTemplate(template.id);
        onClose();
      } catch (err) {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to delete route schedule");
      } finally {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const selectedVehicle = vehicles.find((v) => v.id === truckId);
  const selectedZone = zones.find((z) => z.id === zoneId);

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#D5E3EC] max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scale-in text-left font-sans">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Calendar size={18} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                {isEditing ? "Edit Route Schedule" : "Add Route Schedule"}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2]">
                Assign recurring weekly route and designated sales representative
              </p>

          <div>

            </label>

                return (
                  <button

                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDayOfWeek(d.num)}
                    className={`py-2 px-1 text-center rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${

                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>{d.label}</div>

                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Vehicle Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
              Delivery Vehicle *
            </label>

              value={truckId}

              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              required
            >
              <option value="">Select vehicle...</option>
              {vehicles.map((v) => (
                <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                  {v.plateNumber} — {v.model} ({v.vehicleType || "TRUCK"})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {selectedVehicle?.driver && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-1 pl-1">
                Soft-bound driver: <span className="font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">{selectedVehicle.driver.name}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 3. Service Zone Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
              Target Service Zone *
            </label>
            <select
              value={zoneId}
              onChange={(e) => setZoneId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
              required
            >
              <option value="">Select service zone...</option>
              {zones.map((z) => (
                <option key={z.id} value={z.id}>
                  {z.code} — {z.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {selectedZone?.description && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-1 pl-1">
                Coverage: {selectedZone.description}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 4. Default Assigned Sales Person */}
          <div>
            <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
              Default Assigned Sales Person (Optional)
            </label>
            <select
              value={defaultSalesUserId}
              onChange={(e) => setDefaultSalesUserId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            >
              <option value="">None (Can be assigned upon dispatch)</option>
              {salesUsers.map((u) => (
                <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>
                  {u.fullName || `${u.firstName || ""} ${u.lastName || ""}`.trim() || u.username} ({u.username})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-1 pl-1">
              Automatically pre-fills the sales representative when dispatching
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* 5. Active Status */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="templateIsActive"
              checked={isActive}
              onChange={(e) => setIsActive(e.target.checked)}
              className="w-4 h-4 text-[#0A4B6E] rounded focus:ring-0 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <label htmlFor="templateIsActive" className="text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold cursor-pointer">
              Active route schedule
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Constraint note */}
          <div className="p-2.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] border border-[#D5E3EC] rounded-xl text-[11px] text-[#486581] flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-[#0A4B6E] shrink-0" />
            <span>
              <strong>Rule:</strong> Exactly one route schedule is maintained per vehicle per day of week. Saving will update the assignment for this slot.
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Footer Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
            <div>
              {isEditing && onDeleteTemplate && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDelete}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} />
                  <span>Remove</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#0E384E] cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span>{isSubmitting ? "Saving..." : isEditing ? "Save Schedule" : "Add Schedule"}</span>
                {isEditing && <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/TripDetailPanel.jsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Truck,
  User,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  Layers,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  RotateCcw,
  Plus,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  CalendarX,
  AlertOctagon,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";
import { isCanisterProduct, getCanisterCrates } from "../../utils/product.js";
import { formatPhilippineTime, formatPhilippineDate } from "../../utils/date.js";

export default function TripDetailPanel({
  entry,
  trip,
  schedule,
  onClose,
  onDispatch,
  onMiddayReload,
  onEndTrip,
  onReturnCheckIn,
  onReconciliation,
  onCancelTrip,
  onCancelSchedule,
  canManage = true,
}) {
  const activeEntry = entry || trip || schedule;
  if (!activeEntry) return null;

  const isTrip = Boolean(
    activeEntry.isTrip ||
      activeEntry.operationalStatus === "OUT_ON_ROAD" ||
      activeEntry.operationalStatus === "RETURNED" ||
      activeEntry.departureTime ||
      activeEntry.tripId
  );
  const isReady = activeEntry.operationalStatus === "READY";
  const isUnavailable = activeEntry.operationalStatus === "UNAVAILABLE";

  // Trip-specific data
  const tripData = isTrip ? (trip || activeEntry) : null;
  const currentStatus = (tripData?.rawStatus || tripData?.status || activeEntry?.status || "").toUpperCase();
  const isReturned = currentStatus === "RETURNED" || activeEntry?.operationalStatus === "RETURNED";
  const isSettled = currentStatus === "SETTLED" || currentStatus === "COMPLETED";
  const isPendingRecon = isReturned || currentStatus === "AWAITING_SYNC" || currentStatus === "FLAGGED_VARIANCE";
  const isOnRoute = (currentStatus === "IN_PROGRESS" || activeEntry?.operationalStatus === "OUT_ON_ROAD") && !isReturned;

  const departureFormatted = tripData?.departureTime
    ? formatPhilippineTime(tripData.departureTime)
    : activeEntry.departureTime
    ? formatPhilippineTime(activeEntry.departureTime)
    : "—";

  const returnFormatted = tripData?.returnTime
    ? formatPhilippineTime(tripData.returnTime)
    : null;

  // Staging Loads analysis
  const loadsList = Array.isArray(tripData?.loads) ? tripData.loads : [];
  const dispatchLoads = loadsList.filter((l) => l.transferType === "DISPATCH_LOAD");
  const middayLoads = loadsList.filter((l) => l.transferType === "MIDDAY_RELOAD");
  const returnUnload = loadsList.find((l) => l.transferType === "RETURN_UNLOAD");
  const reconciliation = tripData?.reconciliation || null;

  // Cargo summary for scheduled or trip
  const cargo = activeEntry.cargo || {};
  const gating = activeEntry.gating || {};

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 text-left font-sans">
      {/* 1. OPERATIONAL LIFECYCLE / STATUS SECTION */}
      {isTrip ? (
        <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2.5 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Clock size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
              <span>Trip Lifecycle Progress</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#3E5C76] font-medium">
              {isOnRoute ? "Step 1 of 3: Active Route" : isReturned ? "Step 2 of 3: Yard Return · Stock Check-In Needed" : isPendingRecon ? "Step 2 of 3: Return Unload" : "Step 3 of 3: Settled"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
            {/* Step 1: Out on Route */}
            <div
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-center transition-all ${
                isOnRoute
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white shadow-2xs font-semibold"
                  : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center mb-1">
                {isOnRoute ? (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#FFDF2C]" />
                ) : (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-600" />
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold truncate">1. On Route</p>
              <p className={`text-[11px] truncate ${isOnRoute ? "text-[#FFDF2C]" : "text-emerald-700"}`}>
                {isOnRoute ? "Departed" : "Completed"}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Step 2: Return Check-In */}
            <div
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-center transition-all ${
                isPendingRecon
                  ? "bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-2xs font-semibold"
                  : isSettled
                  ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200"
                  : "bg-slate-100 text-[#3E5C76]"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center mb-1">
                {isPendingRecon ? (
                  <Clock size={12} className="text-white" />
                ) : isSettled ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-600" />
                ) : (
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-300" />
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold truncate">2. Return Check-In</p>
              <p className={`text-[11px] truncate ${isReturned ? "text-amber-100 font-bold" : isPendingRecon ? "text-amber-100" : isSettled ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-slate-500"}`}>
                {isReturned ? "Ready for Dock" : isPendingRecon ? "Needs Audit" : isSettled ? "Unloaded" : "Pending"}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Step 3: Reconcile & Settle */}
            <div
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-center transition-all ${
                isSettled
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-semibold"
                  : "bg-slate-100 text-[#3E5C76]"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center mb-1">
                {isSettled ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-[#FFDF2C]" />
                ) : (
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-300" />
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold truncate">3. Settle Trip</p>
              <p className={`text-[11px] truncate ${isSettled ? "text-[#FFDF2C]" : "text-slate-500"}`}>
                {isSettled ? "Closed" : "Pending"}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3.5 space-y-2 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-wider">
              {isReady ? (
                <>
                  <ShieldCheck size={14} className="text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>Staged Departure Status</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ShieldAlert size={14} className="text-amber-600" />
                  <span>Departure Gating Assessment</span>
                </>
              )}
            </span>
            <span
              className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${
                isReady
                  ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200"
                  : "bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-300"
              }`}
            >
              {isReady ? "CLEARED FOR DISPATCH" : gating.reasonTag || "DISPATCH BLOCKED"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#3E5C76] leading-relaxed">
            {isReady
              ? "Assigned driver has clocked in, safety inspections are verified, and vehicle PM odometer is within operational tolerance."
              : gating.reasonText || "This vehicle cannot depart until compliance conditions are satisfied."}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. VEHICLE SPECIFICATIONS & ROUTE ASSIGNMENT */}
      <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3 shadow-2xs">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5 pb-2 border-b border-slate-200">
          <Truck size={14} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
          <span>Vehicle & Route Assignment</span>
        </h3>

        <div className="space-y-2.5 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[#3E5C76] font-medium">Plate Number</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">{activeEntry.truckPlate}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[#3E5C76] font-medium">Model / Asset</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">
              {activeEntry.truckModel || activeEntry.model || "Delivery Truck"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[#3E5C76] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <MapPin size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
              <span>Service Zone</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
              {activeEntry.zoneCode ? `${activeEntry.zoneCode} — ` : ""}
              {activeEntry.zoneName || "District Route"}
            </span>
          </div>

          {departureFormatted && departureFormatted !== "—" && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <Clock size={12} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />

              </span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{departureFormatted}</span>

            <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
              <span className="text-[#3E5C76] block text-[11px]">Returned Empty Good</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{reconciliation.totalReturnedEmptyGood ?? "—"}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-1 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#3E5C76]">Full Discrepancy:</span>
              <span className={`font-bold ${Number(reconciliation.fullDiscrepancy) === 0 ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-rose-700"}`}>
                {reconciliation.fullDiscrepancy ?? 0}

            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

              <span className={`font-bold ${Number(reconciliation.emptyDiscrepancy) === 0 ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-rose-700"}`}>
                {reconciliation.emptyDiscrepancy ?? 0}

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 6. OPERATIONAL ACTIONS CONTAINER */}
      {canManage && (
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-2.5">
          {/* Scheduled Run Actions */}
          {!isTrip && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onDispatch && onDispatch(activeEntry)}
                disabled={isUnavailable}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              >
                <Plus size={14} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                <span>Dispatch Vehicle</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onCancelSchedule && onCancelSchedule(activeEntry)}
                className="w-full py-2 px-4 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-white hover:bg-rose-50 border border-slate-300 hover:border-rose-300 text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-700 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest"
              >
                <CalendarX size={13} />
                <span>Cancel Scheduled Run</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Active Trip Actions */}
          {isTrip && isOnRoute && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onMiddayReload && onMiddayReload(tripData || activeEntry)}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-[#CBD5E1] text-[#0A4B6E] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest"
                >
                  <Plus size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                  <span>+ Midday Reload</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onEndTrip && onEndTrip(tripData || activeEntry)}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#0E384E] text-[#FFDF2C] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest active:scale-95"
                >
                  <span>End Trip</span>
                  <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onCancelTrip && onCancelTrip(tripData || activeEntry)}
                className="w-full py-2 px-4 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-white hover:bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest"
              >
                <AlertOctagon size={13} />
                <span>Cancel Active Trip</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Returned Trip Awaiting Dock Check-In */}
          {isTrip && isReturned && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onReturnCheckIn && onReturnCheckIn(tripData || activeEntry)}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest active:scale-95"
              >
                <span>Check-In Stock & Reconcile</span>
                <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Settled / Variance Trip Actions */}
          {isTrip && isPendingRecon && !isReturned && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onReconciliation && onReconciliation(tripData || activeEntry)}
              className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 uppercase tracking-widest"
            >
              <span>Reconcile & Settle Trip</span>
              <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Info, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, X } from "lucide-react";

export default function ToastNotification({
  show = true,
  type = "info", // "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error"
  title,
  message,
  duration = 4000,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!show || !onClose || duration <= 0) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
    }, duration);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [show, onClose, duration]);

  if (show === false) return null;

  const configs = {
    info: {
      bg: "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white border-sky-700",
      icon: Info,
      iconColor: "text-sky-300",
      defaultTitle: "Information",
      defaultMessage: "Notification update",
    },
    success: {
      bg: "bg-[#1B4332] text-white border-emerald-700",
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      iconColor: "text-emerald-400",
      defaultTitle: "Success",
      defaultMessage: "Saved Changes",
    },
    warning: {
      bg: "bg-[#78350F] text-white border-amber-600",
      icon: AlertTriangle,
      iconColor: "text-amber-300",
      defaultTitle: "Warning",
      defaultMessage: "Please check your inputs",
    },
    error: {
      bg: "bg-[#7F1D1D] text-white border-rose-700",
      icon: XCircle,
      iconColor: "text-rose-300",
      defaultTitle: "Error",
      defaultMessage: "An error occurred",
    },
  };

  const currentConfig = configs[type] || configs.info;
  const Icon = currentConfig.icon;
  const displayTitle = title !== undefined ? title : null;
  const displayMessage = message || currentConfig.defaultMessage;

  const toastNode = (
    <div
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      className={`
        fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50
        flex items-start gap-3
        px-4 py-3
        rounded-xl
        border shadow-xl
        max-w-sm w-full
        animate-slide-fade-in
        ${currentConfig.bg}
        ${className}
      `}
    >
      <Icon size={20} className={`shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${currentConfig.iconColor}`} />
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        {displayTitle && (
          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight uppercase tracking-wider mb-0.5">
            {displayTitle}
          </h4>
        )}
        <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed font-medium">
          {displayMessage}
        </p>
      </div>
      {onClose && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="p-1 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 -mr-1 -mt-1 text-white/80 hover:text-white"
          aria-label="Close notification"
        >
          <X size={15} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(toastNode, document.body)
    : toastNode;
}
````

````javascript
  const [adjustmentInitialCondition, setAdjustmentInitialCondition] = useState("FILLED");

  // Toast notifications (null when not showing)
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null); // { message: string, type: string }

  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = "success") => {
    setToast({ message, type });
  }, []);

  // Fetch yard stock from API
  const fetchStock = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const res = await inventoryApi.getPlantInventory();
      const list = Array.isArray(res) ? res : res?.data?.inventory || [];
      if (Array.isArray(list)) {
        setPlantStock(list);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(PLANT_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch plant stock:", err);
      showToast("Unable to load plant stock from server", "error");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [showToast]);

  // Real-time WebSocket synchronization
  useRealtimeRefresh({
    events: ["PLANT_STOCK_UPDATED", "TRIP_RECONCILIATION_UPDATED"],
    cacheKeysToInvalidate: [PLANT_CACHE_KEY],
    onRefresh: fetchStock,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStock();
  }, [fetchStock]);

  // Keep selectedProduct synchronized with fresh data from plantStock
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedProduct) {
      const sId = selectedProduct.productId || selectedProduct.product_id || selectedProduct.id;
      const fresh = plantStock.find(
        (p) => (p.productId || p.product_id || p.id) === sId
      );
      if (fresh) {
        setSelectedProduct(fresh);
      }
    }
  }, [plantStock]);

  // Metric aggregates for top header
  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    let totalFilled = 0;
    let totalEmpty = 0;
    let totalDefective = 0;
    let cratesFilled = 0;
    let cratesEmpty = 0;

    plantStock.forEach((p) => {
      const qF = Number(p.quantityFilled ?? p.quantity_filled ?? 0);
      const qE = Number(p.quantityEmptyGood ?? p.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
      const qD = Number(p.quantityDefective ?? p.quantity_defective ?? 0);
      const isCanister = (p.containerType || p.container_type) === "CANISTER";

      totalFilled += qF;
      totalEmpty += qE;
      totalDefective += qD;

      if (isCanister) {
        cratesFilled += Math.floor(qF / 24);
        cratesEmpty += Math.floor(qE / 24);
      }
    });

    return {
      totalFilled,
      totalEmpty,
      totalDefective,
      totalUnits: totalFilled + totalEmpty + totalDefective,
      cratesFilled,
      cratesEmpty,
    };
  }, [plantStock]);

  // Filtered product stock based on search, container type, and stock level
  const filteredStock = useMemo(() => {
    let list = plantStock;

    // 1. Container Type filter
    if (filters.containerType && filters.containerType !== "ALL") {
      list = list.filter((p) => {
        const cType = (p.containerType || p.container_type || "CYLINDER").toUpperCase();
        return cType === filters.containerType;
      });
    }

    // 2. Stock Level filter
    if (filters.stockLevel && filters.stockLevel !== "ALL") {
      list = list.filter((p) => {
        const qF = Number(p.quantityFilled ?? p.quantity_filled ?? 0);
        const qE = Number(p.quantityEmptyGood ?? p.quantity_empty_good ?? 0);
        const qD = Number(p.quantityDefective ?? p.quantity_defective ?? 0);
        const total = qF + qE + qD;

        switch (filters.stockLevel) {
          case "IN_STOCK":
            return total > 0;
          case "LOW_STOCK":
            return qF < 100;
          case "HAS_DEFECTIVE":
            return qD > 0;
          case "HAS_EMPTY":
            return qE > 0;
          default:
            return true;
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. Search query
    if (searchTerm.trim()) {
      const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter((p) => {
        const name = (p.productName || p.product_name || "").toLowerCase();
        const cat = (p.category || "").toLowerCase();
        return name.includes(term) || cat.includes(term);
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [plantStock, filters, searchTerm]);

  // Selection toggle for SideDrawer
  const handleSelectProduct = useCallback((product) => {
    if (!product) {
      setSelectedProduct(null);
      return;
    }
    const currentId = selectedProduct
      ? selectedProduct.productId || selectedProduct.product_id || selectedProduct.id
      : null;
    const newId = product.productId || product.product_id || product.id;
    if (currentId === newId) {
      setSelectedProduct(null);
    } else {
      setSelectedProduct(product);
    }
  }, [selectedProduct]);

  // View mode switcher with persistence
  const handleViewModeChange = useCallback((mode) => {
    setViewMode(mode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(VIEW_MODE_CACHE_KEY, mode);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, []);

  // Filter setters
  const handleApplyFilters = useCallback((newFilters) => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...newFilters }));
  }, []);

  const handleClearContainerType = useCallback(() => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, containerType: "ALL" }));
  }, []);

  const handleClearStockLevel = useCallback(() => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, stockLevel: "ALL" }));
  }, []);

  // Modal opening helper
  const handleOpenAdjustment = useCallback((maybeItemOrCondition = null, maybeCondition = "FILLED") => {
    let targetId = null;
    let cond = "FILLED";

    if (maybeItemOrCondition && typeof maybeItemOrCondition === "object") {
      targetId = maybeItemOrCondition.productId || maybeItemOrCondition.product_id || maybeItemOrCondition.id;
      if (typeof maybeCondition === "string") cond = maybeCondition;
    } else if (typeof maybeItemOrCondition === "string") {
      cond = maybeItemOrCondition;
    }

    setAdjustmentTargetProduct(targetId);
    setAdjustmentInitialCondition(cond);
    setShowAdjustmentModal(true);
  }, []);

  // Success handler for stock adjustments
  const handleAdjustmentSuccess = useCallback((receipt) => {
    fetchStock();
    showToast(
      receipt?.message || "Plant stock adjustment processed successfully.",
      "success"
    );
  }, [fetchStock, showToast]);

  const selectedProductId = selectedProduct
    ? (selectedProduct.productId || selectedProduct.product_id || selectedProduct.id)
    : null;

  const isSelectedCanister = (selectedProduct?.containerType || selectedProduct?.container_type) === "CANISTER";
  const selectedWeight = selectedProduct?.netWeightKg !== undefined ? selectedProduct?.netWeightKg : selectedProduct?.net_weight_kg;

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden min-w-0">
      {/* 1. PINNED TOP HEADER */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <PlantWarehouseHeader
          metrics={metrics}
          onOpenAdjustmentModal={() => handleOpenAdjustment()}
          canManage={canManage}
          onRefresh={fetchStock}
          isLoading={isLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. PINNED CONTROLS BAR */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <PlantWarehouseControls
          searchTerm={searchTerm}
          onSearchChange={setSearchTerm}
          onClearSearch={() => setSearchTerm("")}
          filters={filters}
          onApplyFilters={handleApplyFilters}
          onClearContainerType={handleClearContainerType}
          onClearStockLevel={handleClearStockLevel}
          viewMode={viewMode}
          onViewModeChange={handleViewModeChange}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 3. MAIN CONTENT: FULL-WIDTH TABLE OR CARDS (NO TABLE SQUISHING) */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 w-full h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {viewMode === "table" ? (
          <PlantWarehouseTable
            items={filteredStock}
            selectedProductId={selectedProductId}
            onSelectProduct={handleSelectProduct}
            onAdjustProduct={(item) => handleOpenAdjustment(item)}
            canManage={canManage}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
            <PlantWarehouseCards
              items={filteredStock}
              selectedProductId={selectedProductId}
              onSelectProduct={handleSelectProduct}
              onAdjustProduct={(item) => handleOpenAdjustment(item)}
              canManage={canManage}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 4. UNIVERSAL SIDEDRAWER FOR PRODUCT INSPECTION */}
      <SideDrawer
        isOpen={Boolean(selectedProduct)}
        onClose={() => setSelectedProduct(null)}
        title={selectedProduct?.productName || selectedProduct?.product_name || "Product Stock Details"}
        subtitle={`${isSelectedCanister ? "Butane Canister" : "LPG Cylinder"} · ${selectedWeight ?? 0} kg · Bunawan Yard`}
        icon={isSelectedCanister ? Package : Flame}
        badge={
          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1]">
            YARD BULK
          </span>
        }
        width="max-w-md sm:max-w-lg"
        footer={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedProduct(null)}
            className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#FFDF2C] text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#ebd024] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs text-center uppercase tracking-wider active:scale-95"
          >
            CLOSE
          </button>
        }
      >
        {selectedProduct && (
          <PlantStockDetailPanel
            product={selectedProduct}
            onOpenAdjustment={(prod) => {
              setSelectedProduct(null);
              handleOpenAdjustment(prod);
            }}
            canManage={canManage}
          />
        )}
      </SideDrawer>

      {/* 5. MODALS & TOAST NOTIFICATIONS */}
      <PlantStockAdjustmentModal
        isOpen={showAdjustmentModal}
        onClose={() => setShowAdjustmentModal(false)}
        plantStock={plantStock}
        defaultProductId={adjustmentTargetProduct}
        initialCondition={adjustmentInitialCondition}
        onAdjustmentSuccess={handleAdjustmentSuccess}
      />

      {/* Conditionally mounted ToastNotification with reliable dismiss */}
      {toast && (
        <ToastNotification
          type={toast.type}
          message={toast.message}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
                      Loading products...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : paginatedProducts.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={6} className="py-16 text-center text-[#6D8AA2]">
                      <Package size={24} className="mx-auto mb-2 text-[#CBD5E1]" />
                      <p className="font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]">No Products Found</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] mt-0.5">
                        {searchTerm
                          ? "No items match your search filter."
                          : "No product catalog items registered."}
                      </p>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  paginatedProducts.map((p) => {
                    const isCylinder = p.containerType === "CYLINDER";
                    const isSelected = selectedProduct?.id === p.id;
                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={p.id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedProduct(p)}
                        className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-[#E2EDF3] hover:bg-[#E2EDF3]"
                            : "hover:bg-[#F4F9FC]"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Name */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                              {isCylinder ? <Flame size={14} /> : <Package size={14} />}
                            </div>
                            <span>{p.name}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Category */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#6D8AA2] font-medium">
                          {p.category || "Uncategorized"}
                        </td>

                        {/* Container Type */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#0A4B6E]">
                          <Badge variant="neutral">
                            {isCylinder ? "Cylinder" : "Canister"}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>

                        {/* Net Weight */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-medium">
                          {p.netWeightKg} kg
                        </td>

                        {/* Status */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                          <Badge variant={p.isActive ? "active" : "deactivated"}>
                            {p.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedProduct(p)}
                              title="Inspect product"
                              className="p-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Eye size={14} />
                            </button>

                            {canManage && (
                              <>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(p)}
                                  title="Edit product"
                                  className="p-1.5 text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <Edit2 size={13} />
                                </button>

                                {p.isActive ? (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleTriggerDeactivate(p)}
                                    title="Deactivate product"
                                    className="p-1.5 text-[#C93B32] hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    <Trash2 size={13} />
                                  </button>
                                ) : (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"

                                    title="Reactivate product"
````
