````javascript
// src/components/ui/SideDrawer.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Standardized SideDrawer Component for MadayawGas
 * Slides in from the right edge with backdrop blur, sticky header, scrollable body,
 * and pinned action footer. Used for non-destructive inspection across all data tables.
 */
export default function SideDrawer({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  subtitle,
  icon: Icon,
  badge,
  headerActions,
  children,
  footer,
  width = "max-w-md sm:max-w-lg",
  backdrop = "mobile-only", // "mobile-only" (default) | "always" | "none" | boolean
}) {
  const [isClosing, setIsClosing] = useState(false);

  // Handle ESC key press
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Handle closing animation delay
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isClosing) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsClosing(false);
      if (onClose) onClose();
    }, 220);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [isClosing, onClose]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    setIsClosing(true);
  };

  if (!isOpen && !isClosing) return null;

  const isAlwaysBackdrop = backdrop === "always" || backdrop === true;
  const isNoBackdrop = backdrop === "none" || backdrop === false;
  const isMobileOnly = !isAlwaysBackdrop && !isNoBackdrop;

  const drawerNode = (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden flex justify-end ${
        isAlwaysBackdrop ? "pointer-events-auto" : "pointer-events-none"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Backdrop: Visible on mobile, hidden on desktop unless backdrop="always" */}
      {!isNoBackdrop && (
        <div
          className={`fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity pointer-events-auto ${
            isMobileOnly ? "lg:hidden" : ""
          } ${isClosing ? "animate-fade-out" : "animate-fade-in"}`}
          onClick={handleClose}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      {/* Drawer Container */}
      <div
        className={`relative z-10 w-full ${width} bg-white shadow-2xl h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-left border-l border-slate-200 pointer-events-auto ${
          isClosing
            ? "animate-slide-fade-out pointer-events-none"
            : "animate-slide-fade-in"
        }`}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal={isAlwaysBackdrop ? "true" : "false"}
        aria-label={typeof title === "string" ? title : "Detail Panel"}
      >
        {/* Sticky Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-[#F8FAFC]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
            {Icon && (
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                <Icon size={18} />
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">{title}</h2>
                {badge}
              </div>
              {subtitle && (
                <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5 truncate font-medium">
                  {subtitle}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 ml-2">
            {headerActions}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              aria-label="Close drawer"
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-200 text-[#6D8AA2] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-5 custom-scrollbar space-y-4">
          {children}
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Sticky Footer */}
        {footer && (
          <div className="shrink-0 px-5 py-3.5 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white">
            {typeof footer === "function" ? footer({ onClose: handleClose }) : footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== "undefined"
    ? createPortal(drawerNode, document.body)
    : drawerNode;
}
````

````javascript
import ConfirmationModal from "../ui/ConfirmationModal.jsx";
import { hasUserRole } from "../../utils/userRoles.js";

export default function DeactivateUserModal({ user, onClose, onConfirm }) {
  if (!user || hasUserRole(user, "Super Admin")) return null;

  return (
    <ConfirmationModal
      isOpen={Boolean(user)}
      onClose={onClose}
      onConfirm={(password) => onConfirm(user, password)}
      title="Deactivate User?"
      confirmText="Deactivate"
      cancelText="Cancel"
      variant="danger"

      message={

          system, while its records and activity history are retained.
        </p>
      }
    />
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy, CheckCircle2, KeyRound, Shield, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

                </span>

                <button
                  type="button"

                >
                  {copied ? (

        <button
````

````javascript
// src/pages/Login/Login.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { getDefaultRoute } from "../../utils/permissions.js";
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Clock } from "lucide-react";

import logo from "../../assets/logov2.svg";
import bgLeftCard from "../../assets/BG-Madayaw8.png";
import bgScreen from "../../assets/BG-Madayaw8.png";

export default function Login() {
  const { login, isAuthenticated, currentUser } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState(
    location.state?.successMessage || ""
  );
  const [sessionExpiredMessage, setSessionExpiredMessage] = useState(
    location.state?.sessionExpired
      ? location.state?.message ||
          "Your session has expired. Please log in again to continue."
      : ""
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  // If already authenticated, redirect directly to user's landing page
  if (isAuthenticated && currentUser) {
    return <Navigate to={getDefaultRoute(currentUser)} replace />;
  }

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (loading) return;

    if (!username.trim()) {
      setError("Please enter your username.");
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setError("Please enter your password.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setSessionExpiredMessage("");

    try {
      const user = await login(username.trim(), password);
      const fromObj = location.state?.from;
      const destination =
        typeof fromObj === "string"
          ? fromObj
          : fromObj?.pathname
          ? `${fromObj.pathname}${fromObj.search || ""}`
          : getDefaultRoute(user);

      navigate(destination, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid username or password.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      handleLogin();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 relative font-sans overflow-hidden">
  <div
````

````javascript
// src/pages/RoutePlanner/RoutePlanner.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { Calendar, Plus, RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "../../utils/permissions.js";

import { schedulesApi } from "../../api/schedules.js";
import { fleetApi } from "../../api/fleet.js";

import MasterTemplateMatrix from "../../components/route-dispatch/MasterTemplateMatrix";
import TemplateModal from "../../components/route-dispatch/TemplateModal";
import ToastNotification from "../../components/ui/ToastNotifications";

export default function RoutePlanner() {
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const canManage = can ? can(PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_MANAGE || "route.manage") : false;

  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem("app_templates_cache");
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem("app_fleet_cache");
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [zones, setZones] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem("app_zones_cache");
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [salesUsers, setSalesUsers] = useState([]);
  const [vehicleSearch, setVehicleSearch] = useState("");

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  // Modals state
  const [showTemplateModal, setShowTemplateModal] = useState(false);
  const [templateToEdit, setTemplateToEdit] = useState(null);
  const [prefillTruckId, setPrefillTruckId] = useState("");
  const [prefillDayOfWeek, setPrefillDayOfWeek] = useState(1);

  const showToast = (type, message) => {
    setToast({ type, message });
  };

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const [tplData, vData, zData, salesData] = await Promise.all([
        schedulesApi.getTemplates().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Error fetching templates:", err);
          return [];
        }),
        fleetApi.getVehicles().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Error fetching fleet:", err);
          return [];
        }),
        schedulesApi.getZones().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Error fetching zones:", err);
          return [];
        }),
        schedulesApi.getSalesPersons().catch((err) => {
          console.warn("Error fetching sales persons:", err);
          return [];
        }),
      ]);

      if (Array.isArray(tplData)) setTemplates(tplData);
      if (Array.isArray(vData)) setVehicles(vData);
      if (Array.isArray(zData)) setZones(zData);
      if (Array.isArray(salesData)) setSalesUsers(salesData);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to load route planner data:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleOpenAddTemplate = (truckId = "", dayOfWeek = 1) => {
    setTemplateToEdit(null);
    setPrefillTruckId(truckId);
    setPrefillDayOfWeek(dayOfWeek);
    setShowTemplateModal(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditTemplate = (tpl) => {
    setTemplateToEdit(tpl);
    setPrefillTruckId(tpl.truckId);
    setPrefillDayOfWeek(tpl.dayOfWeek);
    setShowTemplateModal(true);
  };

  const handleSaveTemplate = async (payload) => {
    try {
      if (payload.id) {
        await schedulesApi.updateTemplate(payload.id, payload);
        showToast("success", "Weekly route schedule updated successfully");
      } else {
        await schedulesApi.createTemplate(payload);
        showToast("success", "Weekly route schedule created successfully");
      }
      loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("error", err.message || "Failed to save route schedule");
      throw err;
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTemplate = async (id) => {
    try {
      await schedulesApi.deleteTemplate(id);
      showToast("success", "Weekly route schedule deleted successfully");
      loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("error", err.message || "Failed to delete route schedule");
    }
  };

  const filteredVehicles = useMemo(() => {
    if (!vehicleSearch.trim()) return vehicles;
    const q = vehicleSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    return vehicles.filter(
      (v) =>
        (v.plateNumber || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (v.model || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (v.vehicleType || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [vehicles, vehicleSearch]);

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col space-y-4">
      {toast && (
        <ToastNotification
          type={toast.type}
          message={toast.message}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Top Controls Bar */}
      <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#D5E3EC]">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="relative w-56 sm:w-64 max-w-full">
            <Search
              size={14}
              className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#6D8AA2]"
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={vehicleSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setVehicleSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search vehicle or model..."
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] placeholder-[#6D8AA2] focus:outline-hidden focus:border-[#0A4B6E] shadow-2xs"
            />
          </div>

          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] font-bold text-xs shadow-2xs">
            <Calendar size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
            <span>{templates.length} Active Route Schedules</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
          {canManage && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenAddTemplate()}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs active:scale-95 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]"
            >
              <Plus size={14} />
              <span>Add Route Schedule</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadData}
            disabled={isLoading}
            title="Refresh weekly route schedules"
            className="p-2 text-[#6D8AA2] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={15} className={isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 7-Day Grid View */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
        <MasterTemplateMatrix
          templates={templates}
          vehicles={filteredVehicles}
          canManage={canManage}
          onAddTemplate={handleOpenAddTemplate}
          onEditTemplate={handleOpenEditTemplate}
          onDeleteTemplate={handleDeleteTemplate}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Modal */}
      <TemplateModal
        isOpen={showTemplateModal}
        onClose={() => {
          setShowTemplateModal(false);
          setTemplateToEdit(null);
        }}
        template={templateToEdit}
        initialTruckId={prefillTruckId}
        initialDayOfWeek={prefillDayOfWeek}
        vehicles={vehicles}
        zones={zones}
        salesUsers={salesUsers}
        onSaveTemplate={handleSaveTemplate}
        onDeleteTemplate={handleDeleteTemplate}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````markdown
# System Permissions & RBAC Matrix

## 1. Role Permissions Matrix

| Permission | Super Admin | Admin | Plant Supervisor | Logistics Supervisor | Sales Supervisor | Sales Person | Driver | Description |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **`dashboard.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | View the main operational dashboard |
| **`fleet.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | View fleet and maintenance overview & vehicle profiles |
| **`fleet.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | View details & maintenance for assigned truck only |
| **`fleet.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Register vehicles, update info, set condition, assign drivers, deactivate |
| **`route.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | View all route dispatch schedules and trip logs |
| **`route.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | View routes and trip schedules assigned to current user |
| **`route.end_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | End active delivery trip with mandatory odometer reading |
| **`route.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Create, update, assign, and dispatch delivery routes |
| **`inventory.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | View inventory product catalog and stock levels |
| **`inventory.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Register, update, and deactivate product catalog items |
| **`inventory.plant.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Master plant stock management, supplier restocks, and yard defect quarantines |
| **`inventory.vehicle.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | Manage vehicle fleet stock, transfers between plant and trucks, and route reconciliations |
| **`sales.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | View all sales and customer profiles across the organization |
| **`sales.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | View customer profiles and sales created by the current user |
| **`sales.create`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | Register new sales customers and create frontline sales orders |
| **`sales.update`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | Update sales customer profiles and sales orders |
| **`sales.delete`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | Delete, cancel, or void sales records |
| **`delivery.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | View all delivery fulfillment transactions |
| **`delivery.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | View delivery fulfillment assigned to the current user |
| **`delivery.update`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | Update delivery statuses and completion records |
| **`delivery.update_own`**| ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | Update delivery progress assigned to the current user |
| **`apprehensions.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | View all roadside traffic apprehension records |
| **`apprehensions.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | View roadside apprehensions involving own vehicle or trip |
| **`apprehensions.create`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | Record road traffic apprehension with mandatory ticket proof |
| **`apprehensions.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Update, settle, or dispute road apprehension tickets |
| **`fuel.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | View all vehicle fuel intake records and consumption summaries |
| **`fuel.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | View fuel intake logs for assigned vehicle only |
| **`fuel.create`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | Record vehicle fuel intake, cost, and odometer reading |
| **`fuel.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Edit or delete vehicle fuel log records |
| **`alerts.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | View organizational driver emergency alerts feed |
| **`alerts.view_own`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | View own submitted driver emergency alerts |
| **`alerts.trigger`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Single-action mobile emergency alert SOS dispatch |
| **`alerts.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Acknowledge and resolve driver emergency alerts |
| **`users.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | View employee profiles and user lists |
| **`users.manage`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Create accounts, reset credentials, deactivate, manage roles & permissions |
| **`history.view`** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | View system event historical audit logs |

> [!NOTE]
> * **Plant Supervisor**: Oversees Bunawan refilling yard bulk physical inventory, supplier purchases, defect quarantining, and yard return receiving. Has total control of master plant stock, but no direct control on vehicle fleet stock.
> * **Sales Supervisor**: Oversees frontline sales, customers, transactions, delivery fulfillment, vehicle stock, and post-trip reconciliation. Has full control of vehicle fleet stock, but limited control to plant stock (strictly moving between plant and vehicles via dispatch loads and return unloads).
> * **Driver Role**: Drivers possess authenticated login capabilities for the mobile application with frontline permissions (`apprehensions.create`, `apprehensions.view_own`, `fuel.create`, `fuel.view_own`, `alerts.trigger`, `alerts.view_own`, `route.view_own`, `route.end_own`, and `fleet.view_own`). Access to vehicle telemetry, maintenance, and trips is strictly scoped to the driver's assigned vehicle and trips.
> * **Product Catalog Visibility**: To empower mobile and in-field sales operations without exposing sensitive plant storage ledgers, `GET /api/inventory/products` and `GET /api/inventory/products/:id` permit users holding `inventory.view`, `sales.view`, `sales.view_own`, or `sales.create`. Frontline `Sales Person` accounts can freely read available products and specifications while plant physical stock (`/plant`) and cross-fleet transfers (`/transfers`) remain strictly guarded by `inventory.view`.
> * **Multi-Role Employees**: Users assigned multiple roles (such as an employee holding both `Sales Supervisor` and `Logistics Supervisor`) automatically receive the union of all permissions across their assigned roles.
> * **Legacy Role Aliases**: `Fleet Manager` maps to `Logistics Supervisor`; `Sales Manager` maps to `Sales Supervisor`.

---

## 2. Complete Permissions Reference

| Permission | Subsystem Domain | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `dashboard.view` | Dashboard | View operational dashboard metrics and summaries. |
| `fleet.view` | Fleet & Maintenance | View fleet inventory, condition metrics, and vehicle records. |
| `fleet.view_own` | Fleet & Maintenance | View details and maintenance records for own assigned vehicle. |
| `fleet.manage` | Fleet & Maintenance | Register vehicles, update odometer/details, set status, and assign drivers. |
| `route.view` | Schedule & Trip | View all organizational route dispatch schedules. |
| `route.view_own` | Schedule & Trip | View routes and trip schedules assigned to the current user. |
| `route.end_own` | Schedule & Trip | End active delivery trip with mandatory odometer reading for own assigned trip. |
| `route.manage` | Schedule & Trip | Create, update, assign, and manage route dispatches. |
| `inventory.view` | Inventory Management | View inventory products catalog and stock levels. |
| `inventory.manage` | Inventory Management | Register, modify, and deactivate inventory items. |
| `inventory.plant.manage` | Inventory Management | Manage master plant physical stock, supplier restocks, and yard defect quarantines. |
| `inventory.vehicle.manage` | Inventory Management | Manage vehicle fleet stock, transfers between plant and trucks, and route reconciliations. |
| `sales.view` | Sales & Delivery | View all customer accounts and sales records. |
| `sales.view_own` | Sales & Delivery | View sales and customers created by the current user. |
| `sales.create` | Sales & Delivery | Register new customer accounts and create sales orders. |
| `sales.update` | Sales & Delivery | Update customer account profiles and edit sales transactions. |
| `sales.delete` | Sales & Delivery | Void, delete, or cancel sales transactions. |
| `delivery.view` | Sales & Delivery | View all delivery transactions across the system. |
| `delivery.view_own` | Sales & Delivery | View deliveries assigned to the current user. |
| `delivery.update` | Sales & Delivery | Update delivery status and proof of delivery information. |
| `delivery.update_own` | Sales & Delivery | Update delivery status for own assigned deliveries. |
| `apprehensions.view` | Operations | View all roadside traffic apprehension records. |
| `apprehensions.view_own` | Operations | View roadside apprehensions involving own vehicle or trip. |
| `apprehensions.create` | Operations | Record road traffic apprehension with mandatory ticket proof. |
| `apprehensions.manage` | Operations | Update, settle, or dispute road apprehension tickets. |
| `fuel.view` | Operations | View all vehicle fuel intake records and consumption summaries. |
| `fuel.view_own` | Operations | View fuel intake logs for assigned vehicle only. |
| `fuel.create` | Operations | Record vehicle fuel intake, cost, and odometer reading. |
| `fuel.manage` | Operations | Edit or delete vehicle fuel log records. |
| `alerts.view` | Operations | View organizational driver emergency alerts feed. |
| `alerts.view_own` | Operations | View own submitted driver emergency alerts. |
| `alerts.trigger` | Operations | Single-action mobile emergency alert SOS dispatch. |
| `alerts.manage` | Operations | Acknowledge and resolve driver emergency alerts. |
| `users.view` | User Management | View user directory and employee profiles. |
| `users.manage` | User Management | Create users, manage credentials, deactivate accounts, and manage roles. |
| `history.view` | System Event Logs | View system event history and audit trails. |
````

````javascript
  onSelectCustomer,
  sortConfig = { key: "name", direction: "asc" },
  onSort,
  pagination,
}) {

          itemLabel="customers"
````

````javascript
function formatCurrency(val) {
  const num = Number(val) || 0;
  return `₱${num.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })}`;
}

function getServiceTypeBadgeVariant(typeName) {
  const lower = (typeName || "").toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes("preventive")) return "roles";
  if (lower.includes("corrective")) return "maintenance";
  if (lower.includes("emergency")) return "danger";
  if (lower.includes("accident")) return "neutral";
  return "roles";
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Truck, AlertTriangle, AlertOctagon, Calendar, MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import { fleetApi } from "../../../api/fleet.js";
import Modal from "../../ui/Modal";
import Button from "../../ui/Button";
import Badge from "../../ui/Badge";
import { getPhilippineTodayString } from "../../../utils/date.js";

const getDriverDisplay = (t) => {
  if (!t) return "No Assigned";
  if (t.driver) {
    const fullName = `${t.driver.firstName || ""} ${t.driver.lastName || ""}`.trim();
    if (fullName) return fullName;
    if (t.driver.name) return t.driver.name;
    if (t.driver.username) return t.driver.username;
  }
  if (
    t.driverName &&
    t.driverName !== "Unassigned" &&
    t.driverName !== "No Driver" &&
    t.driverName !== "No Assigned"
  ) {
    return t.driverName;
  }
  return "No Assigned";
};

export default function CreateWorkOrderModal({
  isOpen,
  truck = null,
  trucks = [],
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}) {
  const todayStr = getPhilippineTodayString();
  const [selectedTruckId, setSelectedTruckId] = useState(truck?.id || "");
  const [maintenanceTypes, setMaintenanceTypes] = useState([]);
  const [maintenanceTypeId, setMaintenanceTypeId] = useState("1");
  const [shopName, setShopName] = useState("Bunawan Heavy Repair Center");
  const [estimatedCost, setEstimatedCost] = useState("");
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState(() => getPhilippineTodayString());
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [isLoadingTypes, setIsLoadingTypes] = useState(true);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const isPastDate = Boolean(scheduledDate && scheduledDate < todayStr);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadTypes() {
      try {
        setIsLoadingTypes(true);
        const res = await fleetApi.getMaintenanceTypes();
        const types = res?.data?.types || [];
        setMaintenanceTypes(types);
        if (types.length > 0 && !maintenanceTypeId) {
          setMaintenanceTypeId(String(types[0].id));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load maintenance types:", err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoadingTypes(false);
      }
    }

    if (isOpen) {
      loadTypes();
      if (truck?.id) {
        setSelectedTruckId(truck.id);
      } else if (trucks.length > 0 && !selectedTruckId) {
        setSelectedTruckId(trucks[0].id);
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, truck, trucks, selectedTruckId, maintenanceTypeId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setScheduledDate(getPhilippineTodayString());
      setError("");
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentTruck = truck || trucks.find((t) => t.id === selectedTruckId) || null;
  const numCost = Number(estimatedCost) || 0;
  const requiresApproval = numCost >= 5000.0;

  const driverDisplay = getDriverDisplay(currentTruck);

  const handleDateChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setScheduledDate(val);
    if (val && val < todayStr) {
      setError("Scheduled date cannot be in the past.");
    } else if (error && error.includes("Scheduled date")) {
      setError("");
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedTruckId) {
      setError("Select a vehicle.");
      return;
    }
    if (!scheduledDate) {
      setError("Scheduled date is required.");
      return;
    }
    if (scheduledDate < todayStr) {
      setError("Scheduled date cannot be in the past.");
      return;
    }
    if (!description.trim()) {
      setError("Work scope is required.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      setError("");

      const payload = {
        truckId: selectedTruckId,
        vehicleId: selectedTruckId,
        maintenanceTypeId: Number(maintenanceTypeId),
        shopName: shopName.trim() || "Bunawan Heavy Repair Center",
        estimatedCost: numCost,
        scheduledDate: scheduledDate
          ? new Date(`${scheduledDate}T08:00:00`).toISOString()
          : new Date().toISOString(),
        description: description.trim(),
      };

      await onSubmit(payload);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to create work order:", err);
      setError(err?.message || "Failed to create work order.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const isSubmitDisabled =
    isSubmitting ||
    isLoadingTypes ||
    !description.trim() ||
    !scheduledDate ||
    isPastDate;

  const footerContent = (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center">
      {error && (
        <div className="w-full bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border border-red-200 mb-3 text-left">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="yellow"
        disabled={isSubmitDisabled}
        onClick={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider mb-2"
      >
        {isSubmitting ? "CREATING..." : "CONFIRM WORK ORDER"}
      </Button>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="cancel"
        disabled={isSubmitting}
        onClick={onClose}
        className="text-xs"
      >
        CANCEL
      </Button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Create Work Order"
      maxWidth="max-w-lg"
      footer={footerContent}
    >
      <div className="space-y-4 text-left py-2">
        {/* VEHICLE CONTEXT BANNER */}
        {truck ? (
          <div className="bg-[#E8F3F8] rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border border-[#BCE1F1]/60">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-[#0A4B6E] text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <Truck size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-base leading-tight">
                    {truck.plateNumber || "Truck"}
                  </h3>
                  {truck.vehicleType && (
                    <Badge variant="info" className="text-[9.5px] px-2 py-0">
                      {truck.vehicleType.replace("_", " ")}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#588094]">
                  {truck.model || "Isuzu Elf"} {truck.yearModel ? `(${truck.yearModel})` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-[#588094] block">Assigned Driver</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-[#0A4B6E]">{driverDisplay}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
              Target Vehicle <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <select
              value={selectedTruckId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedTruckId(e.target.value)}

            >
              {trucks.map((t) => {
                const driver = getDriverDisplay(t);
                const typeStr = t.vehicleType ? ` • ${t.vehicleType.replace("_", " ")}` : "";
                return (
                  <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                    {t.plateNumber || "Truck"} — {t.model || "Fleet Asset"}{typeStr} ({driver})
                  </option>
                );
              })}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* CURRENT REGISTERED METRICS */}
        {currentTruck && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-[#F3F5F5] rounded-xl p-3.5 text-xs">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[#588094] block text-[11px]">Status</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#0A4B6E]">
                {(currentTruck.status || currentTruck.operationalStatus || "ACTIVE").replace("_", " ")}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[#588094] block text-[11px]">Current Odometer</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#0A4B6E]">
                {Number(currentTruck.currentOdometer || 0).toLocaleString()} KM
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* MAINTENANCE CLASSIFICATION TYPE */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
            Maintenance Type <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <select
            value={maintenanceTypeId}
            onChange={(e) => setMaintenanceTypeId(e.target.value)}
            disabled={isLoadingTypes}
            className="w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
          >
            {maintenanceTypes.map((t) => (
              <option key={t.id} value={String(t.id)}>
                {t.typeName} — {t.description?.split("(")[0] || ""}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* SHOP / SERVICE CENTER NAME */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
            Repair Facility / Shop
          </label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={shopName}
              onChange={(e) => setShopName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g., Bunawan Heavy Repair Center"
              className="w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] border border-gray-200 rounded-xl py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
            />
            <MapPin size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-[#588094]" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ESTIMATED COST & SCHEDULED DATE ROW */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
              Estimated Cost (₱ PHP)
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <span className="absolute left-3 top-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500">₱</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="50"
                value={estimatedCost}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setEstimatedCost(e.target.value);
                  setError("");
                }}
                placeholder="0.00"
                className="w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] border border-gray-200 rounded-xl py-2 pl-7 pr-3 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
              Scheduled Date <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type="date"
                min={todayStr}
                value={scheduledDate}
                onChange={handleDateChange}
                className={`w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] border rounded-xl py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 ${
                  isPastDate
                    ? "border-red-400 focus:ring-red-400 bg-red-50/20"
                    : "border-gray-200 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]"
                }`}
              />
              <Calendar
                size={15}
                className={`absolute left-3 top-2.5 ${
                  isPastDate ? "text-red-500" : "text-[#588094]"
                }`}
              />
            </div>
            {isPastDate && (
              <span className="text-[11px] text-red-600 font-medium mt-1 block">
                Scheduled date cannot be in the past.
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* FINANCIAL APPROVAL GATE WARNING NOTICE */}
        {requiresApproval && (
          <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-amber-900 text-xs">
            <AlertTriangle size={17} className="text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <p className="font-bold">Approval Required</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 leading-relaxed">
                Estimated cost is ₱5,000.00 or higher. Requires admin approval before proceeding.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* VEHICLE GROUNDING NOTICE */}
        <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <AlertOctagon size={18} className="shrink-0 text-red-600 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <p className="font-bold">Grounding Notice</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed">
              Vehicle will be set to <strong>UNDER_MAINTENANCE</strong>. Driver ({driverDisplay}) remains assigned.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* DESCRIPTION / WORK SCOPE TEXTAREA */}
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1.5">
            Work Scope & Diagnosis <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <textarea
            rows={3}
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setDescription(e.target.value);
              if (error) setError("");
            }}
            placeholder="Describe repairs, parts, diagnosis, or shop instructions..."
            className="w-full bg-[#F3F5F5] border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E] resize-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/fleet/work-orders/ReceiptAttachmentManager.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { FileText, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import DocumentViewerModal from "../../ui/DocumentViewerModal.jsx";
import { getReceiptFileUrl, isImageFile, isPdfFile } from "../../../utils/media.js";

/**
 * ReceiptAttachmentManager
 * Streamlined read-only Receipt Documentation Gallery.
 * OR files serve strictly as audit documentation (no tags or cost inputs).
 * Uses global DocumentViewerModal for consistent, unified preview & fullscreen lightbox.
 */
export default function ReceiptAttachmentManager({
  receipts = [],
  className = "",
}) {
  const [previewItem, setPreviewItem] = useState(null);

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-3 ${className}`}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <FileText size={16} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#0A4B6E]">
            Receipt Documentation
          </h4>
        </div>
        {receipts.length > 0 && (
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E]">
            {receipts.length} {receipts.length === 1 ? "File" : "Files"}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Receipts List */}
      {receipts.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {receipts.map((rcpt, index) => {
            const hasFile = Boolean(rcpt.fileUrl || rcpt.previewUrl || rcpt.storageKey);
            const isImg = hasFile && isImageFile(rcpt);
            const isPdf = hasFile && isPdfFile(rcpt);
            const displayName =
              rcpt.fileName ||
              (rcpt.fileUrl ? rcpt.fileUrl.split("/").pop() : null) ||
              `Receipt Document ${index + 1}`;

            return (
              <div
                key={rcpt.id || `rcpt-${index}`}
                onClick={() => setPreviewItem(rcpt)}
                className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-[#F8FAFC] hover:bg-[#E8F3F8]/50 hover:border-[#BCE1F1] transition-all cursor-pointer group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                  {/* Thumbnail / File icon */}
                  {hasFile && isImg ? (
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 shrink-0 bg-white">
                      <img
                        src={getReceiptFileUrl(rcpt)}
                        alt={displayName}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                      />
                    </div>
                  ) : hasFile && isPdf ? (
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-xs font-bold">
                      PDF
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <FileText size={18} />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-mono font-medium text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] truncate">
                      {displayName}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10.5px] text-[#6D8AA2] mt-0.5">
                      Click to view document
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ml-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setPreviewItem(rcpt);
                    }}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-white text-slate-500 hover:text-[#0A4B6E] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Preview Receipt"
                  >
                    <Eye size={15} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-xs text-[#6D8AA2]">
            No receipts attached yet.
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            Receipt documentation is uploaded upon repair finalization.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* GLOBAL REUSABLE DOCUMENT & IMAGE VIEWER MODAL */}
      <DocumentViewerModal
        isOpen={Boolean(previewItem)}
        onClose={() => setPreviewItem(null)}
        item={previewItem}
        fallbackName="Receipt Documentation"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export default function FleetHeader({
  activeSubTab = "vehicles",
  onTabChange,
  trucksCount = 0,
  workOrdersCount = 0,
  logsCount = 0,
  fuelLogsCount = 0,

}) {
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef(null);

  // Close incident dropdown on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e) {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setIsMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const isMaintenanceHub =
    activeSubTab === "work-orders" ||
    activeSubTab === "logs" ||
    activeSubTab === "analytics";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col mb-4">
      {/* 1. SECONDARY SUBNAV FOR MAINTENANCE HUB ONLY */}
      {isMaintenanceHub && (
        <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-start mb-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center p-1 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#D5E3EC] shadow-2xs gap-1 max-w-full overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">

            >

              <span>Work Orders</span>

                  {pendingApprovalCount} pending
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold min-w-[20px] text-center ${
                    activeSubTab === "work-orders"

                >

                activeSubTab === "logs"
                  ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs font-bold"
                  : "text-[#486581] hover:text-[#0A4B6E] hover:bg-white/70 font-medium"
              }`}
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>Maintenance Logs</span>
              <span
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold min-w-[20px] text-center ${
                  activeSubTab === "logs"
                    ? "bg-white/20 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-200/90 text-slate-700"
                }`}
              >
                {logsCount}

            </button>

            {/* Defect Analytics */}
            <button

              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs transition-all duration-150 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${

              }`}
            >

                <Fuel size={14} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                <span>Fuel Monitoring & Consumption Telemetry</span>
              </span>
              {fuelLogsCount > 0 && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 font-bold text-xs h-[30px]">
                  {fuelLogsCount} Records
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 h-[30px]" />
          </>
        )}

        {/* VIEW 6: APPREHENSIONS */}
        {activeSubTab === "apprehensions" && (
          <>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#E8F3F8] text-[#0A4B6E] border border-[#BCE1F1] font-bold text-xs shadow-2xs h-[30px]">
                <FileWarning size={14} className="text-amber-600" />
                <span>Driver Roadside Apprehensions & Citations</span>
              </span>
              {apprehensionsCount > 0 && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300 font-bold text-xs h-[30px]">
                  {apprehensionsCount} Citations
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 h-[30px]" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/items/ItemModal.jsx
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Package,
  Flame,
  Pencil,
  PackagePlus,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Weight,
  Layers,
} from "lucide-react";
import Input from "../ui/Input";
import Select from "../ui/Select";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";

/**
 * Interactive Status Pills selector for Edit / Add forms
 */
const StatusPills = ({ isActive, onSelect }) => {
  const statuses = [
    { label: "ACTIVE", value: true, variant: "success" },
    { label: "INACTIVE", value: false, variant: "deactivated" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {statuses.map((s) => {
        const isSelected = isActive === s.value;
        return (
          <label key={s.label} className="cursor-pointer relative flex items-center">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="itemStatus"
              value={String(s.value)}
              checked={isSelected}
              onChange={() => onSelect(s.value)}
              className="sr-only"
            />
            <Badge
              variant={s.variant}
              className={`px-4 py-1.5 text-xs transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                isSelected
                  ? "ring-2 ring-offset-1 ring-[#0A4B6E] font-bold shadow-xs scale-102"
                  : "opacity-50 hover:opacity-80"
              }`}
            >
              {s.label}
            </Badge>
          </label>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default function ItemModal({
  item,
  isOpen = true,
  onClose,
  onUpdate,
  onAdd,
  isAdding = false,
  items = [],
}) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1); // 1: Form, 2: Confirm, 3: Success
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: item?.name || item?.itemName || "",
    category: item?.category || (item?.containerType === "CANISTER" ? "Canister" : "LPG Cylinder"),
    containerType: item?.containerType || "CYLINDER",
    netWeightKg: item?.netWeightKg !== undefined ? item.netWeightKg : 11.0,
    isActive: item?.isActive !== undefined ? Boolean(item.isActive) : true,
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    let parsedValue = value;

    if (name === "name") {
      // Disallow special characters
      parsedValue = value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s.-]/g, "");
    }

    if (name === "netWeightKg") {
      if (value !== "" && (Number(value) < 0 || Number(value) > 9999)) return;
      parsedValue = value === "" ? "" : value;
    }

    if (name === "containerType") {
      const suggestedCategory = value === "CANISTER" ? "Canister" : "LPG Cylinder";
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        containerType: value,
        category: prev.category === "Canister" || prev.category === "LPG Cylinder" ? suggestedCategory : prev.category,
      }));
      return;
    }

    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: parsedValue }));

    if (errors[name]) {
      setErrors((prev) => {
        const newErrors = { ...prev };
        delete newErrors[name];
        return newErrors;
      });
    }
  };

  const validate = () => {
    const newErrors = {};

    const trimmedName = formData.name?.toString().trim();
    if (!trimmedName) {
      newErrors.name = "Product name is required";
    } else if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9\s.-]+$/.test(trimmedName)) {
      newErrors.name = "Special characters are not allowed in product name";
    } else {
      const nameExists = items.find(
        (i) =>
          (i.name || i.itemName)?.toString().toLowerCase().trim() ===
            trimmedName.toLowerCase() &&
          (!item || i.id !== item.id)
      );
      if (nameExists) {
        newErrors.name = "A product with this name already exists";
      }
    }

    if (!formData.category?.toString().trim()) {
      newErrors.category = "Category is required";
    }

    if (!formData.containerType) {
      newErrors.containerType = "Container type is required";
    }

    if (
      formData.netWeightKg === "" ||
      formData.netWeightKg === null ||
      isNaN(Number(formData.netWeightKg)) ||
      Number(formData.netWeightKg) <= 0
    ) {
      newErrors.netWeightKg = "Net weight must be greater than 0 kg";
    }

    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleProceedToConfirm = (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;
    setSubmitError("");
    setStep(2);
  };

  const handleConfirmSave = async () => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitError("");

    try {
      const payload = {
        name: formData.name.trim(),
        category: formData.category.trim(),
        containerType: formData.containerType,
        netWeightKg: Number(formData.netWeightKg),
        isActive: formData.isActive,
      };

      if (isAdding) {

      } else {
        await onUpdate(item.id, payload);

    : step === 3

    : "Edit Product";

  const modalSubtitle = isAdding

      : step === 2

    : step === 3

    : step === 2

  const modalIcon = isAdding
    ? step === 3
      ? CheckCircle2
      : step === 2
      ? ShieldCheck
      : PackagePlus
    : step === 3
    ? CheckCircle2
    : step === 2
    ? ShieldCheck
    : Pencil;

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={modalTitle}
      subtitle={modalSubtitle}
      icon={modalIcon}
      maxWidth="max-w-md"
    >
      <div className="text-left font-sans">
        {/* ================= STEP 1: FORM ================= */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <form onSubmit={handleProceedToConfirm} className="space-y-4">
            {submitError && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium">
                {submitError}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Product Name */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                Product Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <Input
                name="name"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={handleInputChange}
                placeholder="e.g. 11kg Standard LPG Cylinder"
                error={errors.name}
                className="w-full text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Container Type & Net Weight */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">
````

````javascript
            </span>
            <p className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">
              {formData.birthday || "Not Specified"}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white/80 p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#BCE1F1]/40 space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[#6D8AA2] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Shield size={13} /> {userRoles.length > 1 ? "Role Privileges" : "Role Privilege"}

            <p className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-sm">
````

````javascript
// src/utils/fleetGuards.js
import { PERMISSIONS } from "./permissions.js";
import { getUserRoleNames } from "./userRoles.js";

export const ACTIVE_RESTRICTED_TOOLTIP =
  "Cannot set to Active while Work Order is in progress";

export const ACTIVE_RESTRICTED_ERROR =
  "Cannot activate vehicle: This truck is currently linked to an ongoing work order. Complete or cancel the work order first.";

/**
 * Checks whether a user has executive administrative authority to approve/reject
 * high-cost work orders (₱5,000 threshold).
 * Allowed roles: Super Admin, Admin, or any user possessing `users.manage` permission.
 *
 * @param {object|null} user - Current user object
 * @param {Function} [canFn] - `can` permission checker function from useAuth()
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
export function canApproveWorkOrderCost(user, canFn) {
  if (!user) return false;
  const userRoles = getUserRoleNames(user, "");
  const isAdminRole = userRoles.some((r) => r.toUpperCase().includes("ADMIN"));
  const hasManagePermission = Boolean(
    canFn
      ? canFn(PERMISSIONS?.USERS_MANAGE || "users.manage")
      : user.permissions?.includes("users.manage")
  );
  return isAdminRole || hasManagePermission;
}

/**
 * Checks whether a truck is currently undergoing an active / unresolved work order.
 * Active work order statuses: PENDING, APPROVED, SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS.
 *
 * @param {object} truck - Truck object to inspect
 * @param {Array} [workOrders] - Optional collection of work orders
 * @returns {{ hasActiveWorkOrder: boolean, activeWorkOrder: object|null }}
 */
export function checkActiveWorkOrder(truck, workOrders = []) {
  if (!truck) return { hasActiveWorkOrder: false, activeWorkOrder: null };

  const truckId = truck.id || truck.truckId;
  const plate = truck.plateNumber;

  // 1. Check live workOrders collection FIRST (authoritative reactive state)
  if (Array.isArray(workOrders) && workOrders.length > 0) {
    const matchingOrders = workOrders.filter((wo) => {
      const matchesId =
        truckId && (wo.truckId === truckId || wo.truck?.id === truckId);
      const matchesPlate =
        plate && (wo.plateNumber === plate || wo.truck?.plateNumber === plate);
      return Boolean(matchesId || matchesPlate);
    });

    if (matchingOrders.length > 0) {
      const activeOrder = matchingOrders.find(
        (wo) => !["COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(wo.status)
      );
      return {
        hasActiveWorkOrder: Boolean(activeOrder),
        activeWorkOrder: activeOrder || null,
      };
    }
  }

  // 2. Fallback: inspect direct explicit flags from backend / enriched truck object
  if (
    truck.activeWorkOrder &&
    !["COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(truck.activeWorkOrder.status)
  ) {
    return {
      hasActiveWorkOrder: true,
      activeWorkOrder: truck.activeWorkOrder,
    };
  }

  if (truck.hasActiveWorkOrder && truck.activeWorkOrder) {
    return {
      hasActiveWorkOrder: true,
      activeWorkOrder: truck.activeWorkOrder,
    };
  }

  // 3. Fallback: inspect activeRepair string if it references an ongoing work order
  if (
    typeof truck.activeRepair === "string" &&
    truck.activeRepair.toLowerCase().includes("work order")
  ) {
    return {
      hasActiveWorkOrder: true,
      activeWorkOrder: {
        description: truck.activeRepair,
        status: "IN_PROGRESS",
      },
    };
  }

  return { hasActiveWorkOrder: false, activeWorkOrder: null };
}

/**
 * Evaluates whether a scheduled truck run can be dispatched today.
 * Inspects vehicle operational status, grounding flags, safety inspection allowance,
 * and assigned driver account status.
 *
 * @param {object} sched - Schedule or template-derived run object
 * @param {Array} [vehicles] - Current vehicles collection from fleetApi
 * @param {Array} [drivers] - Current drivers / staff collection
 * @returns {{
 *   canDispatch: boolean,
 *   reasonTag: string,
 *   reasonText: string | null,
 *   variant: 'success' | 'maintenance' | 'inactive' | 'retired' | 'danger'
 * }}
 */
export function getScheduleDispatchGating(
  sched,
  vehicles = [],
  drivers = []
) {
  if (!sched) {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "UNKNOWN",
      reasonText: "No schedule record provided",
      variant: "inactive",
    };
  }

  const truckId = sched.truckId || sched.truck_id;
  const vehicle = Array.isArray(vehicles) ? vehicles.find((v) => v.id === truckId) : null;
  const vStatus = (vehicle?.status || vehicle?.operationalStatus || sched.truckStatus || "ACTIVE").toUpperCase();

  if (vStatus === "UNDER_MAINTENANCE") {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "UNDER MAINTENANCE",
      reasonText: "Vehicle is grounded for maintenance or repairs",
      variant: "maintenance",
    };
  }

  if (vStatus === "INACTIVE") {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "INACTIVE",
      reasonText: "Vehicle is temporarily disabled or off-duty",
      variant: "inactive",
    };
  }

  if (vStatus === "RETIRED") {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "RETIRED",
      reasonText: "Vehicle has been decommissioned from the fleet",
      variant: "retired",
    };
  }

  if (vehicle?.allowDispatch === false || vehicle?.isGrounded === true) {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "GROUNDED",
      reasonText: "Vehicle failed safety inspection gating",
      variant: "danger",
    };
  }

  // Driver account status
  const driverId = sched.truckDriverId || sched.driverId || vehicle?.driverId;
  if (!driverId) {
    return {
      canDispatch: false,
      reasonTag: "NO DRIVER",
      reasonText: "Vehicle has no assigned driver. A driver must be assigned to dispatch.",
      variant: "danger",
    };
  }

  if (driverId && Array.isArray(drivers) && drivers.length > 0) {
    const driverUser = drivers.find((d) => d.id === driverId || d.userId === driverId);
    if (driverUser) {
      if (driverUser.isBlocked) {
        return {
          canDispatch: false,
          reasonTag: "DRIVER SUSPENDED",
          reasonText: "Assigned driver account is suspended",
          variant: "danger",
        };
      }
      if (driverUser.isActive === false) {
        return {
          canDispatch: false,
          reasonTag: "DRIVER INACTIVE",
          reasonText: "Assigned driver account is deactivated",
          variant: "inactive",
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    canDispatch: true,
    reasonTag: "READY",
    reasonText: null,
    variant: "success",
  };
}
````

````javascript
// src/api/auth.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

export const authApi = {
  /**
   * Client-side placeholder. Server-side password verification is enforced
   * directly within sensitive operation endpoints (e.g., /deactivate, /status, /credentials).
   * @param {string} _password
   * @param {string} [_username]
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
  async verifyPassword(_password, _username) {
    return true;
  },

  /**
   * Log in user and establish session cookie (mg_sid).
   * Stores fallback Bearer token for mobile/iOS WebKit cross-origin compatibility.
   * @param {string} username - User's username
   * @param {string} password - User's password
   * @returns {Promise<object>} User object with role and permissions
   */
  async login(username, password) {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/login", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { username, password },
    });

    const token = result.data?.token || result.token;
    if (token && typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("mg_token", token);
    }

    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Get currently authenticated user profile and permissions.
   * Used on page refresh to verify active session cookie.
   * @returns {Promise<object|null>} Current user object
   */
  async getMe() {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/me");
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Log out user and destroy server-side session cookie.
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Logout success message
   */
  async logout() {
    try {
      return await apiClient("/users/logout", { method: "POST" });
    } finally {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        localStorage.removeItem("mg_token");
      }
    }
  },

  /**
   * Change authenticated user's password.
   * For first login / mustChangePassword: true, currentPassword is omitted.
   * @param {{ currentPassword?: string, newPassword: string }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Success message
   */
  async changePassword({ currentPassword, newPassword }) {
    const body = {
      ...(currentPassword && { currentPassword }),
      newPassword,
    };

    try {
      return await apiClient("/users/change-password", {
        method: "POST",
        body,
      });
    } finally {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        localStorage.removeItem("mg_token");
      }
    }
  },
};
````

````javascript
// src/utils/permissions.js

/**
 * System Permissions constant dictionary matching backend permissions.
 */
export const PERMISSIONS = {
  DASHBOARD_VIEW: "dashboard.view",
  FLEET_VIEW: "fleet.view",
  FLEET_MANAGE: "fleet.manage",
  ROUTE_VIEW: "route.view",
  ROUTE_VIEW_OWN: "route.view_own",
  ROUTE_MANAGE: "route.manage",
  INVENTORY_VIEW: "inventory.view",
  INVENTORY_MANAGE: "inventory.manage",
  SALES_VIEW: "sales.view",
  SALES_VIEW_OWN: "sales.view_own",
  SALES_CREATE: "sales.create",
  SALES_UPDATE: "sales.update",
  SALES_DELETE: "sales.delete",
  DELIVERY_VIEW: "delivery.view",
  DELIVERY_VIEW_OWN: "delivery.view_own",
  DELIVERY_UPDATE: "delivery.update",
  DELIVERY_UPDATE_OWN: "delivery.update_own",
  USERS_VIEW: "users.view",
  USERS_MANAGE: "users.manage",
  HISTORY_VIEW: "history.view",
  ALERTS_VIEW: "alerts.view",
  ALERTS_MANAGE: "alerts.manage",
  ALERTS_TRIGGER: "alerts.trigger",
  FUEL_VIEW: "fuel.view",
  FUEL_VIEW_OWN: "fuel.view_own",
  FUEL_CREATE: "fuel.create",
  FUEL_MANAGE: "fuel.manage",
  APPREHENSIONS_VIEW: "apprehensions.view",
  APPREHENSIONS_VIEW_OWN: "apprehensions.view_own",
  APPREHENSIONS_CREATE: "apprehensions.create",
  APPREHENSIONS_MANAGE: "apprehensions.manage",
};


/**
 * Check if a user has a specific permission.
 *
 * @param {object|null} user - The user object containing a `permissions` array
 * @param {string} permission - The permission string to check
 * @returns {boolean} True if the user has the specified permission
 */
export function can(user, permission) {
  if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.permissions)) return false;
  return user.permissions.includes(permission);
}

/**
 * Check if a user has ALL permissions in a list.
 *
 * @param {object|null} user - The user object containing a `permissions` array
 * @param {string[]} permissionsList - Array of required permission strings
 * @returns {boolean} True if the user has ALL of the specified permissions
 */
export function canAll(user, permissionsList = []) {
  if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.permissions)) return false;
  return permissionsList.every((p) => user.permissions.includes(p));
}

/**
 * Check if a user has AT LEAST ONE permission in a list.
 *
 * @param {object|null} user - The user object containing a `permissions` array
 * @param {string[]} permissionsList - Array of permission strings to test
 * @returns {boolean} True if the user has AT LEAST ONE of the specified permissions
 */
export function canAny(user, permissionsList = []) {
  if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.permissions)) return false;
  return permissionsList.some((p) => user.permissions.includes(p));
}

/**
 * Determine the optimal landing page for a user based on their granted permissions.
 *
 * @param {object|null} user
 * @returns {string} Target path (e.g. '/dashboard', '/sales-delivery', '/fleet')
 */
export function getDefaultRoute(user) {
  if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.permissions)) return "/login";

  // Dedicated workplace check for Plant Supervisor:
  const roleName = (user.role || (Array.isArray(user.roleNames) ? user.roleNames.join(" ") : "")).toLowerCase();
  if (
    roleName.includes("plant") ||
    (can(user, PERMISSIONS.INVENTORY_MANAGE) &&
      !can(user, PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_VIEW) &&
      !can(user, PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_MANAGE) &&
      !can(user, PERMISSIONS.FLEET_VIEW) &&
      !can(user, PERMISSIONS.SALES_VIEW))
  ) {
    return "/inventory/plant";
  }

  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.DASHBOARD_VIEW)) return "/dashboard";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.SALES_VIEW) || can(user, PERMISSIONS.SALES_VIEW_OWN)) return "/sales-delivery";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.FLEET_VIEW) || can(user, PERMISSIONS.FLEET_MANAGE)) return "/fleet";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_VIEW) || can(user, PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_MANAGE) || can(user, PERMISSIONS.ROUTE_VIEW_OWN)) return "/route-dispatch";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.INVENTORY_VIEW)) return "/inventory/plant";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.USERS_VIEW) || can(user, PERMISSIONS.USERS_MANAGE)) return "/users";
  if (can(user, PERMISSIONS.HISTORY_VIEW)) return "/history-log";
  return "/dashboard";
}
````

````javascript
// src/components/route-dispatch/DispatchModal.jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import {
  Truck,
  X,
  Plus,
  Trash2,

import { isCanisterProduct } from "../../utils/product.js";
import {
  getPhilippineTodayString,
  toPhilippineDateInputString,
  formatPhilippineDate,
} from "../../utils/date.js";

/**
 * Enterprise Truck Dispatch Modal for MadayawGas
 * Features:
 * - Real-time Bunawan warehouse stock availability validation
 * - Dynamic remaining stock countdown as dispatcher types
 * - 1-click quick-fill action chips (Max available, +1 Crate)
 * - Zero Unicode emojis (clean Lucide vector icons only)
 * - Standardized Accent Yellow (#FFDF2C) primary action button
 */
export default function DispatchModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onDispatch,
  schedules = [],
  allSchedules = [],
  trips = [],
  vehicles = [],
  drivers = [],
  zones = [],
  products = [],
  salesUsers = [],
  plantInventory = [],
  initialScheduleId = "",
}) {
  const [isAdHoc, setIsAdHoc] = useState(false);
  const [selectedScheduleId, setSelectedScheduleId] = useState(initialScheduleId || "");

  // Reset or synchronize initial schedule
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialScheduleId) {
      setSelectedScheduleId(initialScheduleId);
      setIsAdHoc(false);
    }
  }, [initialScheduleId, isOpen]);

  // Reset error whenever modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setError(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Ad-hoc run & personnel selection fields
  const [truckId, setTruckId] = useState("");
  const [driverId, setDriverId] = useState("");
  const [salesUserId, setSalesUserId] = useState("");
  const [isChangingSalesUser, setIsChangingSalesUser] = useState(false);
  const [zoneId, setZoneId] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  // Initial load items with canister vs cylinder awareness
  const [loadItems, setLoadItems] = useState(() => {
    const defaultProd = products[0];
    const isCan = isCanisterProduct(defaultProd);
    return [
      {
        productId: defaultProd?.id || "",
        condition: "FILLED",
        quantityUnits: isCan ? 120 : 25,
      },
    ];
  });

  // Ensure load items synchronize once products resolve
  useEffect(() => {
    if (products.length > 0) {
      setLoadItems((prev) => {
        const hasMissing = prev.some((it) => !it.productId);
        if (hasMissing) {
          const firstProd = products[0];
          const isCan = isCanisterProduct(firstProd);
          return [
            {
              productId: firstProd.id,
              condition: "FILLED",
              quantityUnits: isCan ? 120 : 25,
            },
          ];
        }
        return prev;
      });
    }
  }, [products, isOpen]);

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const todayPht = getPhilippineTodayString();

  // Scheduled routes ready to dispatch today
  const scheduledOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      const isScheduled = (s.status || "").toUpperCase() === "SCHEDULED";
      const schedDate = toPhilippineDateInputString(s.scheduledDate);
      const isToday = schedDate === todayPht;
      const isPreselected = initialScheduleId && s.id === initialScheduleId;
      const isAllowed = s.gating ? s.gating.canDispatch : true;
      return isScheduled && (isToday || isPreselected) && isAllowed;
    });
  }, [schedules, todayPht, initialScheduleId]);

  // Auto-select schedule if preselected or only one is available
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAdHoc && scheduledOptions.length > 0) {
      if (initialScheduleId && scheduledOptions.some((s) => s.id === initialScheduleId)) {
        setSelectedScheduleId(initialScheduleId);
      } else if (!selectedScheduleId && scheduledOptions.length === 1) {
        setSelectedScheduleId(scheduledOptions[0].id);
      }
    }
  }, [scheduledOptions, isAdHoc, initialScheduleId, selectedScheduleId]);

  const selectedSchedule = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAdHoc) return null;
    return scheduledOptions.find((s) => s.id === selectedScheduleId) || null;
  }, [isAdHoc, scheduledOptions, selectedScheduleId]);

  // Synchronize salesUserId whenever selected schedule changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAdHoc && selectedSchedule) {

  const currentTruck = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAdHoc) {

    if (selectedSchedule) {
      return vehicles.find((v) => v.id === selectedSchedule.truckId) || null;
    }
    return null;
  }, [isAdHoc, truckId, selectedSchedule, vehicles]);

  const resolvedDriverId = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAdHoc) {

    }
    return driverId || selectedSchedule?.driverId || selectedSchedule?.truckDriverId || currentTruck?.driverId || null;
  }, [isAdHoc, driverId, currentTruck, selectedSchedule]);

  const resolvedDriver = useMemo(() => {

    return drivers.find((d) => d.id === resolvedDriverId || d.userId === resolvedDriverId) || null;

  // Combined schedules pool for cross-referencing assignments today
  const totalSchedules = allSchedules.length > 0 ? allSchedules : schedules;

  // Map of active ongoing trips by sales user ID (status === IN_PROGRESS)
  const activeTripBySalesUserId = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    trips.forEach((t) => {

  // Map of other today's schedules by assigned sales user ID
  const assignedOtherScheduleMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    totalSchedules.forEach((s) => {
      const isSched = (s.status || "").toUpperCase() === "SCHEDULED";
      // Exclude current schedule when in scheduled mode so pre-assigned sales rep can remain selected
      const isOther = isAdHoc ? true : (!selectedScheduleId || s.id !== selectedScheduleId);
      if (isSched && isOther && s.salesUserId) {
        map.set(s.salesUserId, s);

    return map;

  const assignedOtherScheduleSalesUserIds = useMemo(() => {
    return new Set(assignedOtherScheduleMap.keys());
  }, [assignedOtherScheduleMap]);

  // Conflict detection for pre-assigned sales representative on the selected schedule
  const preassignedTripConflict = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAdHoc || !selectedSchedule?.salesUserId) return null;
    return activeTripBySalesUserId.get(selectedSchedule.salesUserId) || null;

  const preassignedScheduleConflict = useMemo(() => {
    if (isAdHoc || !selectedSchedule?.salesUserId) return null;
    return assignedOtherScheduleMap.get(selectedSchedule.salesUserId) || null;
  }, [isAdHoc, selectedSchedule, assignedOtherScheduleMap]);

  const isPreassignedSalesUnavailable = Boolean(
    preassignedTripConflict || preassignedScheduleConflict
  );

  // Filtered list of Sales Persons who are genuinely available for dispatch
  const availableSalesUsers = useMemo(() => {
    return salesUsers.filter((u) => {
      // 1. Must be active and not blocked
      if (u.isActive === false || u.isBlocked === true) return false;

      // 2. Must not be on an active trip in progress
      if (activeTripBySalesUserId.has(u.id)) return false;

  // Helper: Computes live stock availability and remaining count for a given item row
  const getProductStockInfo = (productId, currentQuantity = 0, currentIndex = -1) => {
    const stockItem = plantInventory.find(

    const totalInYard = stockItem

      : null;

    // Sum quantities of other rows with the same productId
    const otherAllocated = loadItems.reduce((acc, it, idx) => {
      if (idx !== currentIndex && it.productId === productId) {

      return acc;
    }, 0);

    const availableForThisRow = totalInYard !== null ? Math.max(0, totalInYard - otherAllocated) : null;
    const qty = Number(currentQuantity || 0);
    const remainingInYard = availableForThisRow !== null ? availableForThisRow - qty : null;
    const isExceeded = remainingInYard !== null && remainingInYard < 0;

    return {
      totalInYard,
      availableForThisRow,
      remainingInYard,
      isExceeded,

      cratesAvailable: availableForThisRow !== null ? Math.floor(availableForThisRow / 24) : 0,

      if (validLoads.length === 0) {
````
