          const oSched = assignedOtherScheduleMap.get(resolvedSalesUserId);
          throw new Error(
            `Sales representative '${resolvedSalesPersonName}' is already assigned to a scheduled vehicle (${oSched?.truckPlate || "today"}). Please select an available sales person.`
          );
        }
        if (!resolvedDriverId) throw new Error("Please select a driver");

        const selTruck = vehicles.find((v) => v.id === truckId);
        const selDriver = resolvedDriver;
        const selZone = zones.find((z) => z.id === zoneId);

        payload = {
          truckId,
          truckPlate: selTruck?.plateNumber,
          truckModel: selTruck?.model,
          driverId: resolvedDriverId,
          driverName: selDriver
            ? selDriver.fullName || `${selDriver.firstName || ""} ${selDriver.lastName || ""}`.trim() || selDriver.username
            : "Juan Driver",
          salesUserId: resolvedSalesUserId,
          salesName: resolvedSalesPersonName || "Sales Person",
          zoneId,
          zoneCode: selZone?.code,
          notes,
          initialLoads: validLoads.map((item) => ({
            productId: item.productId,
            condition: item.condition,
            quantityUnits: Number(item.quantityUnits),
          })),
        };
      }

      await onDispatch(payload);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to dispatch vehicle");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const isFormBlocked =
    isSubmitting ||
    hasOverAllocatedItems ||
    !resolvedSalesUserId ||
    isSalesUserBusy;

  const modalNode = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#0E384E]/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden animate-scale-in text-left">
        {/* Header: Clean & Pleasant with Truck Icon */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-[#F8FAFC]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* The nice Truck icon preserved */}
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
              <Truck size={17} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Dispatch Vehicle</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#3E5C76]">Assign cargo loads and confirm vehicle departure</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X size={17} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1 space-y-4 text-xs">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-[#D93025] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle size={14} className="shrink-0 text-rose-600" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Mode Switch (Only show if not preselected from a row) */}
          {!initialScheduleId && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">Dispatch Type:</span>
              <div className="inline-flex p-0.5 bg-[#EDF3F7] rounded-full border border-[#D5E3EC]">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdHoc(false)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    !isAdHoc ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs" : "text-[#3E5C76] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
                  }`}
                >
                  Scheduled Route
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAdHoc(true)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    isAdHoc ? "bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C] shadow-2xs" : "text-[#3E5C76] hover:text-[#0A4B6E]"
                  }`}
                >
                  Ad-Hoc Run
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Vehicle & Route Section */}
          {!isAdHoc ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {/* If no initialScheduleId, let user pick from schedule dropdown */}
              {!initialScheduleId && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                    Select Scheduled Route <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
                  </label>
                  {scheduledOptions.length > 0 ? (
                    <select
                      value={selectedScheduleId}
                      onChange={(e) => setSelectedScheduleId(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                    >
                      <option value="">Select a schedule...</option>
                      {scheduledOptions.map((s) => (
                        <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                          {s.truckPlate} ({s.truckModel}) — {s.zoneCode || "Zone"} · Driver: {s.driverName || "Driver"}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl text-amber-900 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertCircle size={14} className="text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                      <span>No scheduled routes awaiting dispatch today. Switch to Ad-Hoc Run.</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Vehicle & Crew Summary Card */}
              {selectedSchedule && (
                <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-3 space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Truck size={15} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                      <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-[#0A4B6E]">
                        {selectedSchedule.truckPlate}
                      </strong>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-[#3E5C76]">({selectedSchedule.truckModel})</span>
                    </div>

                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1">
                      <MapPin size={10} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                      <span>{selectedSchedule.zoneCode} — {selectedSchedule.zoneName || "Zone"}</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Driver Row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <User size={13} className="text-[#3E5C76]" />
                      <span className="text-[#3E5C76]">Driver:</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-800">
                        {resolvedDriver?.fullName || selectedSchedule.driverName || "Juan Driver"}
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Sales Person Row & Assignment */}
                  {!resolvedSalesUserId ? (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <UserCheck size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                          <span>Assign Sales Person <span className="text-rose-600">*</span></span>
                        </label>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                          Required for Cabin App
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <select
                        value={salesUserId}
                        onChange={(e) => setSalesUserId(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs text-slate-800 font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                        required
                      >
                        <option value="">
                          {availableSalesUsers.length > 0
                            ? "Select sales personnel..."
                            : "No available sales personnel"}
                        </option>
                        {availableSalesUsers.map((u) => (
                          <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>
                            {u.fullName || `${u.firstName || ""} ${u.lastName || ""}`.trim() || u.username}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      {availableSalesUsers.length === 0 && (
                        <div className="p-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-amber-900 text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                          <AlertCircle size={13} className="text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                          <span>All sales representatives are currently on active trips or assigned to other scheduled vehicles today.</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : !isChangingSalesUser && !isPreassignedSalesUnavailable ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 text-xs">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <UserCheck size={13} className="text-[#3E5C76]" />
                        <span className="text-[#3E5C76]">Sales Person:</span>
                        <strong className="text-slate-800">
                          {resolvedSalesPersonName}
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setIsChangingSalesUser(true)}
                        className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Change
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <label className={`text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${isPreassignedSalesUnavailable ? "text-amber-900" : "text-[#0A4B6E]"}`}>
                          {isPreassignedSalesUnavailable ? (
                            <AlertCircle size={13} className="text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                          ) : (
                            <UserCheck size={13} className="text-[#0A4B6E]" />
                          )}
                          <span>
                            {preassignedTripConflict
                              ? `Assigned Rep on Active Trip (${preassignedTripConflict.tripNumber || "ongoing"}). Reassign:`
                              : preassignedScheduleConflict
                              ? `Assigned Rep Scheduled on Another Vehicle. Reassign:`
                              : "Reassign Sales Person"}
                          </span>
                        </label>
                        {!isPreassignedSalesUnavailable && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setSalesUserId(selectedSchedule?.salesUserId || "");
                              setIsChangingSalesUser(false);
                            }}
                            className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Keep Original
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <select
                        value={salesUserId}
                        onChange={(e) => setSalesUserId(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs text-slate-800 font-medium focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                      >
                        <option value="">
                          {availableSalesUsers.length > 0
                            ? "Select replacement sales personnel..."
                            : "No replacement sales personnel available"}
                        </option>
                        {availableSalesUsers.map((u) => (
                          <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>
                            {u.fullName || `${u.firstName || ""} ${u.lastName || ""}`.trim() || u.username}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                      {availableSalesUsers.length === 0 && (
                        <div className="p-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-amber-900 text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                          <AlertCircle size={13} className="text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
                          <span>All other sales representatives are currently on active trips or assigned to other scheduled vehicles today.</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Ad-Hoc Run Form */
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                  Vehicle <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={truckId}
                  onChange={(e) => setTruckId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select vehicle...</option>
                  {vehicles
                    .filter((v) => {
                      const status = (v.status || v.operationalStatus || "ACTIVE").toUpperCase();
                      return status === "ACTIVE" && v.allowDispatch !== false && v.isGrounded !== true;
                    })
                    .map((v) => (
                      <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                        {v.plateNumber} ({v.model})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                  Zone <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={zoneId}
                  onChange={(e) => setZoneId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select zone...</option>
                  {zones.map((z) => (
                    <option key={z.id} value={z.id}>
                      {z.code} — {z.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                  Driver <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={driverId}
                  onChange={(e) => setDriverId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select driver...</option>
                  {drivers.map((d) => (
                    <option key={d.id} value={d.id}>
                      {d.fullName || d.username}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
                  Sales Person <span className="text-rose-600">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={salesUserId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSalesUserId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#CBD5E1] rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {availableSalesUsers.length > 0
                      ? "Select sales..."
                      : "No available sales personnel"}
                  </option>
                  {availableSalesUsers.map((u) => (
                    <option key={u.id} value={u.id}>
                      {u.fullName || `${u.firstName || ""} ${u.lastName || ""}`.trim() || u.username}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                {availableSalesUsers.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-700 font-medium mt-1">
                    No sales personnel available (all on active trips or scheduled today).
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Cargo Staging Section with Real-Time Stock Availability Counter */}
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <label className="font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs block">
                  Cargo to Load (Initial Departure)
                </label>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#3E5C76]">
                  Real-time warehouse verification prevents over-dispatching
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddItem}
                className="text-[#0A4B6E] hover:text-[#0E384E] font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full transition-colors"
              >
                <Plus size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} /> Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {loadItems.map((item, idx) => {
                const selectedProd = products.find((p) => p.id === item.productId) || products[0];
                const isCan = isCanisterProduct(selectedProd);
                const qty = Number(item.quantityUnits) || 0;
                const crates = Math.floor(qty / 24);

                const stockInfo = getProductStockInfo(item.productId, item.quantityUnits, idx);
                const { availableForThisRow, remainingInYard, isExceeded, cratesAvailable } = stockInfo;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border bg-[#F8FAFC] space-y-2 transition-colors ${
                      isExceeded
                        ? "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50/30 ring-1 ring-rose-200"
                        : "border-slate-200"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Primary Row Controls */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <select
                        value={item.productId}
                        onChange={(e) => handleItemChange(idx, "productId", e.target.value)}
                        aria-label={`Product item ${idx + 1}`}
                        className="flex-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs text-[#0A4B6E] font-semibold"
                      >
                        {products.map((p) => (
                          <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                            {p.name} ({p.containerType})
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>

                      <div className="w-24 shrink-0">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          min="1"
                          max={availableForThisRow !== null ? availableForThisRow : undefined}
                          value={item.quantityUnits}
                          onChange={(e) => handleItemChange(idx, "quantityUnits", e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Units"
                          aria-label={`Quantity units ${idx + 1}`}
                          className={`w-full bg-white rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-center text-[#0A4B6E] border outline-none transition-colors ${
                            isExceeded
                              ? "border-rose-400 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-200"
                              : "border-slate-300 focus:border-[#0A4B6E]"
                          }`}
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="w-18 text-right text-[11px] text-[#3E5C76] font-semibold shrink-0">
                        {isCan && crates > 0 ? `${crates} crates` : ""}
                      </div>

                      {loadItems.length > 1 && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveItem(idx)}
                          aria-label="Remove item"
                          className="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={15} />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Live Warehouse Availability & Quick Action Sub-Row */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/70">
                      {/* Left: Total in Yard & Quick Fill Chips */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-[#3E5C76]">
                          Warehouse:{" "}
                          <strong className="text-slate-800">
                            {availableForThisRow !== null ? `${availableForThisRow} available` : "Checking stock..."}
                          </strong>
                        </span>

                        {availableForThisRow !== null && availableForThisRow > 0 && (
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 ml-1">
                            {/* Max Available Chip */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleQuickSetQuantity(idx, availableForThisRow)}
                              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-[#0A4B6E] transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title={`Set quantity to max available warehouse stock (${availableForThisRow} units)`}
                            >
                              Max: {availableForThisRow}
                            </button>

                            {/* +1 Crate Chip (24 units for canisters) */}
                            {isCan && availableForThisRow >= 24 && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  const current = Number(item.quantityUnits) || 0;
                                  const nextCrateQty = Math.min(availableForThisRow, Math.floor(current / 24 + 1) * 24);
                                  handleQuickSetQuantity(idx, nextCrateQty);
                                }}
                                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-300 text-[#0A4B6E] transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                title="Add 1 full crate (24 units)"
                              >
                                +1 Crt (24)
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Right: Real-Time Dynamic Remaining Counter */}
                      <div>
                        {remainingInYard !== null && (
                          isExceeded ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-700">
                              <AlertCircle size={12} className="shrink-0 text-rose-600" />
                              <span>Exceeds stock by {Math.abs(remainingInYard)} (Max: {availableForThisRow})</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : remainingInYard === 0 ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-800">
                              <Check size={11} className="shrink-0 text-blue-600" />
                              <span>All stock allocated</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : remainingInYard < 24 ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-900">
                              <AlertTriangle size={11} className="shrink-0 text-amber-700" />
                              <span>Low stock: {remainingInYard} remaining</span>
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-800">
                              <Check size={11} className="shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                              <span>{remainingInYard} remaining in warehouse</span>
                            </span>
                          )
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Notes (Optional) */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] mb-1">
              Departure Notes (Optional)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Regular residential deliveries"
              className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-slate-800 focus:outline-[#0A4B6E]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Sticky Modal Footer */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isFormBlocked}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-[#FFDF2C] hover:bg-[#ebd024] text-[#0A4B6E] transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs uppercase tracking-wider disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>{isSubmitting ? "Dispatching..." : "Confirm Dispatch"}</span>
              <ArrowRight size={13} strokeWidth={2.5} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(modalNode, document.body);
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import CustomerHeader from "../../components/customers/CustomerHeader";
import CustomerControls from "../../components/customers/CustomerControls";
import CustomerTable from "../../components/customers/CustomerTable";
import CustomerDetailPanel from "../../components/customers/CustomerDetailPanel";
import CustomerModal from "../../components/customers/CustomerModal";

import SideDrawer from "../../components/ui/SideDrawer";
import Badge from "../../components/ui/Badge";

import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext.jsx";
import { customersApi } from "../../api/customers.js";
import { PERMISSIONS } from "../../utils/permissions.js";

const LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY = "app_customers_cache";

export default function Customers() {
  const { can } = useAuth();

  // Data State
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Error loading cached customers", e);
    }
    return [];
  });

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(customers.length === 0);
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [activeDetailCustomer, setActiveDetailCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [isClosingPanel, setIsClosingPanel] = useState(false);
  const closeTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // Modal and Action States
  const [isAddingCustomer, setIsAddingCustomer] = useState(false);
  const [editingCustomer, setEditingCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [customerToDeactivate, setCustomerToDeactivate] = useState(null);

  // Toast Notification State
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null); // { message: string, type: string }

  // Search, Filter, Sort and Server Pagination (Strategy B)
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(20);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [committedSearch, setCommittedSearch] = useState("");
  const [paginationMeta, setPaginationMeta] = useState({
    page: 1,
    limit: 20,
    totalItems: 0,
    totalPages: 1,
  });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    customerType: "All Types",
    status: "",
    dateFrom: "",
    dateTo: "",
  });
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({
    key: "name",
    direction: "asc",
  });

  // Permissions
  const canManage = can
    ? can(PERMISSIONS?.SALES_UPDATE || "sales.update") ||
      can(PERMISSIONS?.SALES_CREATE || "sales.create")
    : true;
  const canCreate = can
    ? can(PERMISSIONS?.SALES_CREATE || "sales.create")
    : true;

  // Load Customers (Server Pagination & Filters)
  const loadCustomers = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const res = await customersApi.getCustomers({
        page,
        limit,
        search: committedSearch.trim() || undefined,
        customerType: filters.customerType === "All Types" ? undefined : filters.customerType,
        status: filters.status || undefined,
        sortBy: sortConfig.key,
        sortOrder: sortConfig.direction,
      });

      if (res?.data && Array.isArray(res.data)) {
        setCustomers(res.data);
        if (res.meta) {
          setPaginationMeta(res.meta);
        } else {
          setPaginationMeta({
            page,
            limit,
            totalItems: res.data.length,
            totalPages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(res.data.length / limit)),
          });
        }
      } else if (Array.isArray(res)) {
        setCustomers(res);
        setPaginationMeta({
          page,
          limit,
          totalItems: res.length,
          totalPages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(res.length / limit)),
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load customer list", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [page, limit, committedSearch, filters, sortConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCustomers();
  }, [loadCustomers]);

  const handleSearchSubmit = (query) => {
    setCommittedSearch(query);
    setSearchTerm(query);
    setPage(1); // Auto reset page = 1
  };

  const handleSearchClear = () => {
    setCommittedSearch("");
    setSearchTerm("");
    setPage(1); // Auto reset page = 1
  };

  // Clean up timer on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (closeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(closeTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Helper to sync local state changes to localStorage
  const updateCustomersState = (updater) => {
    setCustomers((prev) => {
      const updated = typeof updater === "function" ? updater(prev) : updater;
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Close panel with smooth exit animation (left-to-right off screen)
  const handleCloseDetail = () => {
    if (closeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(closeTimerRef.current);
    setIsClosingPanel(true);
    setSelectedCustomer(null);
    closeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setActiveDetailCustomer(null);
      setIsClosingPanel(false);
    }, 250);
  };

  // Handlers for Selection, Sorting & Server Pagination
  const handleSelectCustomer = (customer) => {
    if (closeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(closeTimerRef.current);

    if (selectedCustomer?.id === customer.id) {
      handleCloseDetail();
    } else {
      setIsClosingPanel(false);
      setSelectedCustomer(customer);
      setActiveDetailCustomer(customer);
    }
  };

  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig((prev) => ({
      key,
      direction: prev.key === key && prev.direction === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc",
    }));
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    setPage(newPage);
  };

  const handleLimitChange = (newLimit) => {
    setLimit(newLimit);
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleApplyFilters = (newFilters) => {
    setFilters(newFilters);
    setPage(1); // Auto reset page = 1
  };

  const handleClearType = () => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, customerType: "All Types" }));
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleClearStatus = () => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, status: "" }));
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleClearDate = () => {
    setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, dateFrom: "", dateTo: "" }));
    setPage(1);
  };

  // Create / Update Customer Handler (POST /api/sales/customers or PATCH /api/sales/customers/:id)
  const handleSaveCustomer = async (formData, customerId) => {
    if (customerId) {
      const result = await customersApi.updateCustomer(customerId, formData);
      const updatedCustomer = result?.customer || {
        ...formData,
        id: customerId,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      updateCustomersState((prev) =>
        prev.map((c) => (c.id === customerId ? { ...c, ...updatedCustomer } : c))
      );

      if (activeDetailCustomer?.id === customerId) {
        setActiveDetailCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
        setSelectedCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
      }

      setToast({ type: "success", message: "Saved Changes" });
    } else {
      const result = await customersApi.createCustomer(formData);
      const newCustomer = result?.customer || {
        ...formData,
        id: `cust-${Date.now()}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      updateCustomersState((prev) => [newCustomer, ...prev]);
      setToast({ type: "success", message: "Customer Created Successfully" });
    }
    await loadCustomers();
  };

  // Reactivate Inactive Customer Handler (PATCH /api/sales/customers/:id with isActive: true)
  const handleReactivateCustomer = async (customer) => {
    try {
      const targetId = customer.id;
      const result = await customersApi.updateCustomer(targetId, {
        isActive: true,
      });

      const updatedCustomer = result?.customer || {
        ...customer,
        isActive: true,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      updateCustomersState((prev) =>
        prev.map((c) => (c.id === targetId ? { ...c, ...updatedCustomer } : c))
      );

      if (activeDetailCustomer?.id === targetId) {
        setActiveDetailCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
        setSelectedCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
      }

      setToast({
        type: "success",
        message: "Customer Successfully Reactivated",
      });
      await loadCustomers();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to reactivate customer:", err);
      setToast({
        type: "error",
        message: err.message || "Failed to reactivate customer.",
      });
    }
  };

  // Trigger deactivation flow (Dangerous Operation)
  const handleInitiateDeactivate = (targetCustomer) => {
    setCustomerToDeactivate(targetCustomer);
  };

  // Confirm Password and Deactivate Customer (PATCH /api/sales/customers/:id/deactivate)
  const handleConfirmDeactivate = async (targetCustomer, adminPassword) => {
    if (!targetCustomer) return;

    const targetId = targetCustomer.id;
    // Sends { confirmPassword } directly to PATCH /api/sales/customers/:id/deactivate
    const result = await customersApi.deactivateCustomer(targetId, {
      confirmPassword: adminPassword,
    });

    const updatedCustomer = result?.customer || {
      ...targetCustomer,
      isActive: false,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    updateCustomersState((prev) =>
      prev.map((c) => (c.id === targetId ? { ...c, ...updatedCustomer } : c))
    );

    if (activeDetailCustomer?.id === targetId) {
      setActiveDetailCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
      setSelectedCustomer((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updatedCustomer }));
    }

    setToast({
      type: "success",
      message: "Customer Successfully Deactivated",
    });

    setCustomerToDeactivate(null);
    await loadCustomers();
  };

  const customerSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const total = paginationMeta.totalItems || customers.length;
    const active = customers.filter((c) => c.isActive !== false).length;
    return { total, active };
  }, [customers, paginationMeta.totalItems]);

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden min-w-0">
      {/* Header (Pinned at Top) */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <CustomerHeader
          canCreate={canCreate}
          onAddCustomer={() => setIsAddingCustomer(true)}
          customerSummary={customerSummary}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Search and Filters Controls (Pinned at Top) */}
      <div className="shrink-0">
        <CustomerControls
          searchTerm={searchTerm}
          onSearchChange={setSearchTerm}
          onSearch={handleSearchSubmit}
          onClearSearch={handleSearchClear}
          activeFilters={filters}
          onApplyFilters={handleApplyFilters}
          onClearType={handleClearType}
          onClearStatus={handleClearStatus}
          onClearDate={handleClearDate}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area: Full-Width Table with Independent SlideDrawer Inspection */}
      {isLoading && customers.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-12 text-gray-500 font-medium">
          Loading customer records...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 w-full h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <CustomerTable
            customers={customers}
            selectedCustomer={selectedCustomer}
            onSelectCustomer={handleSelectCustomer}
            sortConfig={sortConfig}
            onSort={handleSort}
            pagination={{
              page,
              limit,
              totalItems: paginationMeta.totalItems,
              totalPages: paginationMeta.totalPages,
              onPageChange: handlePageChange,
              onLimitChange: handleLimitChange,
              isLoading,
            }}
          />

          {/* Slide-Over Customer Inspection Drawer */}
          <SideDrawer
            isOpen={Boolean(activeDetailCustomer)}
            onClose={handleCloseDetail}
            title={activeDetailCustomer?.name || "Customer Profile"}
            subtitle={activeDetailCustomer?.address || "Customer Account"}
            icon={UserRound}
            badge={
              activeDetailCustomer && (
                <Badge
                  variant={activeDetailCustomer.isActive !== false ? "success" : "deactivated"}
                  className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold"
                >
                  {activeDetailCustomer.isActive !== false ? "ACTIVE" : "INACTIVE"}
                </Badge>
              )
            }
            width="max-w-md sm:max-w-lg"
          >
            {activeDetailCustomer && (
              <CustomerDetailPanel
                customer={activeDetailCustomer}
                onClose={handleCloseDetail}
                onEdit={(c) => {
                  handleCloseDetail();
                  setEditingCustomer(c);
                }}
                onDelete={(c) => handleInitiateDeactivate(c)}
                onReactivate={(c) => handleReactivateCustomer(c)}
                canManage={canManage}
              />
            )}
          </SideDrawer>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Customer Create / Edit Wizard Modal */}
      <CustomerModal
        isOpen={isAddingCustomer || !!editingCustomer}
        customer={editingCustomer}
        onSave={handleSaveCustomer}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAddingCustomer(false);
          setEditingCustomer(null);
        }}
      />

      {/* Deactivate Customer Confirmation Modal with Inline Password Authorization */}
      {customerToDeactivate && (
        <DeactivateCustomerModal
          customer={customerToDeactivate}
          onClose={() => setCustomerToDeactivate(null)}
          onConfirm={handleConfirmDeactivate}
        />
      )}

      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <ToastNotification
          type={toast.type}
          message={toast.message}
          onClose={() => setToast(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// src/api/inventory.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";
import { authApi } from "./auth.js";

/**
 * Inventory / Product API Service
 * Interacts with /api/inventory/products and /api/inventory/plant endpoints
 * based on docs/api-contracts/inventory/
 */
export const inventoryApi = {
  /**
   * Verify admin password before performing sensitive operations.
   * Delegates directly to authApi.
   * @param {string} password
   * @param {string} [username]
   * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
   */
  async verifyAdminPassword(password, username) {
    return authApi.verifyPassword(password, username);
  },

  /**
   * View Item Profiles (List & Search).
   * @param {object} [params] - Query parameters (search, category, containerType, status, isActive, sortBy, sortOrder, page, limit)
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} Array of product items
   */
  async getInventoryItems(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.search) query.append("search", params.search);
    if (params.category && params.category !== "All Categories" && params.category !== "All") {
      query.append("category", params.category);
    }
    if (params.containerType && params.containerType !== "All") {
      query.append("containerType", params.containerType);
    }
    if (params.status && params.status !== "ALL") query.append("status", params.status);
    if (params.isActive !== undefined) query.append("isActive", params.isActive);
    if (params.sortBy) query.append("sortBy", params.sortBy);
    if (params.sortOrder) query.append("sortOrder", params.sortOrder);
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);

    const queryString = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const result = await apiClient(`/inventory/products${queryString}`);
    if (Array.isArray(result?.data)) {
      return result.data;
    }
    return result?.data?.products || (Array.isArray(result) ? result : []);
  },

  /**
   * View Single Item Profile.
   * @param {string} id - Product UUID
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Product item object
   */
  async getInventoryItemById(id) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/inventory/products/${id}`);
    return result?.data?.product || result?.data || result;
  },

  /**
   * Register Item / Product.
   * @param {{ name: string, category: string, containerType: string, netWeightKg: number, isActive?: boolean }} productData
   * @returns {Promise<{ product: object }>} Created product response
   */
  async createProduct(productData) {
    if (productData.name && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9\s.-]+$/.test(productData.name.trim())) {
      const err = new Error("Product name cannot contain special characters.");
      err.status = 400;
      throw err;
    }

    const result = await apiClient("/inventory/products", {
      method: "POST",
      body: productData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Update Item Profile.
   * @param {string} id - Product UUID
   * @param {object} productData - Fields to update
   * @returns {Promise<{ product: object }>} Updated product response
   */
  async updateProduct(id, productData) {
    if (productData.name && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9\s.-]+$/.test(productData.name.trim())) {
      const err = new Error("Product name cannot contain special characters.");
      err.status = 400;
      throw err;
    }

    const result = await apiClient(`/inventory/products/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: productData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Deactivate Item (Soft delete with password verification).
   * @param {string} id - Product UUID
   * @param {{ confirmPassword?: string }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<{ product: object, message: string }>} Updated deactivated product
   */
  async deactivateProduct(id, { confirmPassword }) {
    const password =
      typeof confirmPassword === "object"
        ? confirmPassword?.confirmPassword || confirmPassword?.adminPassword
        : confirmPassword;
    const result = await apiClient(`/inventory/products/${id}/deactivate`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: {
        confirmPassword: password,
        adminPassword: password,
        confirm_password: password,
        admin_password: password,
      },
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  // Backward compatibility alias for stock update
  async updateStock(id, stockData) {
    return this.updateProduct(id, stockData);
  },

  // ==========================================
  // Plant Yard Bulk Inventory & Reconciliation
  // ==========================================

  /**
   * Master Bunawan Yard bulk inventory overview across all active products.
   * Guarantees all active catalog products are represented in the list.
   */
  async getPlantInventory() {
    try {
      const [plantRes, productsRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient(`/inventory/plant`),
        apiClient(`/inventory/products?status=ACTIVE`),
      ]);

      const plantList =
        plantRes.status === "fulfilled"
          ? plantRes.value?.data?.inventory || plantRes.value?.data || []
          : [];
      const productList =
        productsRes.status === "fulfilled"
          ? productsRes.value?.data?.products || (Array.isArray(productsRes.value?.data) ? productsRes.value.data : [])
          : [];

      const normalizedPlantList = Array.isArray(plantList)
        ? plantList.map((item) => ({
            ...item,
            productId: item.productId || item.product_id,
            productName: item.productName || item.product_name,
            containerType: item.containerType || item.container_type,
            netWeightKg: item.netWeightKg !== undefined ? item.netWeightKg : Number(item.net_weight_kg) || 0,
            quantityFilled: item.quantityFilled !== undefined ? item.quantityFilled : Number(item.quantity_filled) || 0,
            quantityEmptyGood: item.quantityEmptyGood !== undefined ? item.quantityEmptyGood : Number(item.quantity_empty_good) || 0,
            quantityDefective: item.quantityDefective !== undefined ? item.quantityDefective : Number(item.quantity_defective) || 0,
            cratesFilled: item.cratesFilled !== undefined ? item.cratesFilled : (item.container_type === 'CANISTER' ? Math.floor(Number(item.quantity_filled) / 24) : null),
            cratesEmptyGood: item.cratesEmptyGood !== undefined ? item.cratesEmptyGood : (item.container_type === 'CANISTER' ? Math.floor(Number(item.quantity_empty_good) / 24) : null),
            cratesDefective: item.cratesDefective !== undefined ? item.cratesDefective : (item.container_type === 'CANISTER' ? Math.floor(Number(item.quantity_defective) / 24) : null),
          }))
        : [];

      // Defensively ensure that all active products are present in the returned plant list
      if (Array.isArray(productList) && productList.length > 0) {
        const existingProductIds = new Set(normalizedPlantList.map((p) => p.productId));
        productList.forEach((prod) => {
          if (prod.isActive !== false && !existingProductIds.has(prod.id)) {
            normalizedPlantList.push({
              id: `pln-${prod.id}`,
              productId: prod.id,
              productName: prod.name,
              category: prod.category,
              containerType: prod.containerType,
              netWeightKg: prod.netWeightKg,
              quantityFilled: 0,
              cratesFilled: prod.containerType === "CANISTER" ? 0 : null,
              quantityEmptyGood: 0,
              cratesEmptyGood: prod.containerType === "CANISTER" ? 0 : null,
              quantityDefective: 0,
              cratesDefective: prod.containerType === "CANISTER" ? 0 : null,
              lastCountedAt: prod.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
              updatedAt: prod.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
            });
            existingProductIds.add(prod.id);
          }
        });
      }

      return normalizedPlantList;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch plant inventory from API:", err);
      throw err;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Record supplier bulk shipment stock-in.
   */
  async restockPlant(payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/plant/restock`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Quarantines yard leakers or defective stock.
   */
  async quarantineDefects(payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/plant/quarantine-defects`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Adjust plant inventory discrete balances (Physical Count Audit, Stock Correction, Scrap Write-off).
   * Consumes POST /api/inventory/plant/adjust
   * @param {object} payload - { productId, adjustmentType, targetCondition, deltaQuantity, newQuantity, sourceCondition, supplierInvoiceNumber, reason }
   */
  async adjustPlantStock(payload) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/plant/adjust`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: payload,
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Retrieve plant stock adjustments audit log.
   * Consumes GET /api/inventory/plant/adjustments
   * @param {object} [params] - { productId, adjustmentType, targetCondition, page, limit }
   */
  async getPlantAdjustments(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params.productId) query.append("productId", params.productId);
    if (params.adjustmentType) query.append("adjustmentType", params.adjustmentType);
    if (params.targetCondition) query.append("targetCondition", params.targetCondition);
    if (params.limit) query.append("limit", params.limit);
    if (params.page) query.append("page", params.page);
    const qs = query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/plant/adjustments${qs}`);
    return res?.data?.adjustments || (Array.isArray(res?.data) ? res.data : []);
  },

  /**
   * Calculate suggested equal truck loading split.
   */
  async getSuggestedSplit(productId, activeTripCount = 3) {
    const res = await apiClient(
      `/inventory/plant/suggested-split?productId=${productId}&activeTripCount=${activeTripCount}`
    );
    return res?.data;
  },

  // ==========================================
  // Global Cross-Fleet Stock Movement Transfers
  // ==========================================

  /**
   * Global cross-fleet inventory transfers ledger.
   * Consumes GET /api/inventory/transfers
   * @param {object} params - { page, limit, search, transferType, startDate, endDate, productId, tripId, truckId }
   * @returns {Promise<{ transfers: Array, meta: object }>}
   */
  async getTransfers(params = {}) {
    const page = Number(params.page) || 1;
    const limit = Number(params.limit) || 20;

    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    query.append("page", page);
    query.append("limit", limit);
    if (params.transferType && params.transferType !== "ALL") query.append("transferType", params.transferType);
    if (params.search && params.search.trim()) query.append("search", params.search.trim());
    if (params.startDate) query.append("startDate", params.startDate);
    if (params.endDate) query.append("endDate", params.endDate);
    if (params.productId) query.append("productId", params.productId);
    if (params.tripId) query.append("tripId", params.tripId);
    if (params.truckId) query.append("truckId", params.truckId);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/transfers?${query.toString()}`);
      const rawList = res?.data || [];
      const meta = res?.meta || {
        page,
        limit,
        totalItems: rawList.length,
        totalPages: 1,
        hasNextPage: false,
        hasPrevPage: false,
      };
      return {
        transfers: Array.isArray(rawList) ? rawList : [],
        meta,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("apiClient /inventory/transfers failed, returning empty list:", err.message);
      return {
        transfers: [],
        meta: { page: 1, limit, totalItems: 0, totalPages: 1 },
      };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Historical plant stock adjustments audit log.
   */
  async getPlantAdjustments(params = {}) {
    const query = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
    const qs = query ? `?${query}` : "";
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/plant/adjustments${qs}`);
    return res?.data?.adjustments || res?.data || [];
  },

  /**
   * Retrieves all multi-load and return transfer slips for a trip.
   */
  async getTripTransfers(tripId) {
    const res = await apiClient(`/inventory/trips/${tripId}/transfers`);
    return res?.data?.transfers || res?.data || [];
  },
};

// src/api/users.js
import { apiClient } from "./client.js";

export const usersApi = {
  /**
   * Get all user accounts (Admin/Manager with users.view permission).
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} List of user objects
   */
  async getUsers() {
    return this.getAllUsers();
  },

  async getAllUsers() {
    const result = await apiClient("/users");
    return result.data.users;
  },

  /**
   * Get single user by ID.
   * @param {string} id - User ID
   * @returns {Promise<object>} User object
   */
  async getUserById(id) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${id}`);
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Get list of system roles.
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} List of roles
   */
  async getRoles() {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/roles");
    return result.data.roles;
  },

  /**
   * Get system permissions catalog.
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} List of available permissions
   */
  async getPermissions() {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/permissions");
    return result.data.permissions;
  },

  /**
   * Create / Register a new user.
   * Backend auto-generates username (e.g. jcruz) and temporary password.
   *
   * @param {{ firstName: string, lastName: string, phone?: string, birthdate?: string, roleId: string }} userData
   * @returns {Promise<{ user: object, temporaryPassword: string }>} Created user and one-time temporary password
   */
  async createUser(userData) {
    const result = await apiClient("/users", {
      method: "POST",
      body: userData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Update a user's profile details.
   * @param {string} id - Target user ID
   * @param {{ firstName?: string, lastName?: string, phone?: string, birthdate?: string, roleId?: string, isBlocked?: boolean, status?: string }} userData
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated user object
   */
  async updateUser(id, userData) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: userData,
    });
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Update a user's system role (Admin dangerous operation).
   * Supports single-role (roleId) or multi-role (roleIds + primaryRoleId).
   * @param {string} id - Target user ID
   * @param {{ roleId?: string, roleIds?: string[], primaryRoleId?: string, confirmPassword?: string, adminPassword?: string }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated user object
   */
  async updateUserRole(id, { roleId, roleIds, primaryRoleId, confirmPassword, adminPassword }) {
    const password = confirmPassword || adminPassword;
    const body = {
      confirmPassword: password,
      adminPassword: password,
      confirm_password: password,
      admin_password: password,
    };
    if (roleIds && Array.isArray(roleIds) && roleIds.length > 0) {
      body.roleIds = roleIds;
      if (primaryRoleId) body.primaryRoleId = primaryRoleId;
    } else if (roleId) {
      body.roleId = roleId;
    }
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${id}/role`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body,
    });
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Update personal profile information of currently logged-in user.
   * @param {{ firstName?: string, lastName?: string, phone?: string, birthdate?: string }} profileData
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated user object
   */
  async updateMe(profileData) {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/me", {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: profileData,
    });
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Admin Reset / Update User Credentials.
   * Requires admin password confirmation.
   *
   * @param {string} id - Target user ID
   * @param {{ confirmPassword?: string, adminPassword?: string, resetPassword?: boolean, username?: string }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Confirmation and new temporary password if reset
   */
  async resetUserCredentials(id, { confirmPassword, adminPassword, resetPassword, username }) {
    const password = confirmPassword || adminPassword;
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${id}/credentials`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: {
        confirmPassword: password,
        adminPassword: password,
        confirm_password: password,
        admin_password: password,
        resetPassword: resetPassword !== undefined ? resetPassword : true,
        ...(username && { username }),
      },
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Deactivate/Activate or Block/Unblock a user account.
   * Requires admin password confirmation.
   *
   * @param {string} id - Target user ID
   * @param {{ confirmPassword?: string, adminPassword?: string, isActive?: boolean, isBlocked?: boolean }} payload
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated user object
   */
  async updateUserStatus(id, { confirmPassword, adminPassword, isActive, isBlocked }) {
    const password = confirmPassword || adminPassword;
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${id}/status`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: {
        confirmPassword: password,
        adminPassword: password,
        confirm_password: password,
        admin_password: password,
        ...(isActive !== undefined && { isActive }),
        ...(isBlocked !== undefined && { isBlocked }),
      },
    });
    return result.data.user;
  },

  /**
   * Create a new role.
   * @param {{ name: string, description?: string, permissions?: string[] }} roleData
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Created role object
   */
  async createRole(roleData) {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/roles", {
      method: "POST",
      body: roleData,
    });
    return result.data.role;
  },

  /**
   * Update an existing role.
   * @param {string} id - Role ID
   * @param {{ name?: string, description?: string, permissions?: string[] }} roleData
   * @returns {Promise<object>} Updated role object
   */
  async updateRole(id, roleData) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/roles/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: roleData,
    });
    return result.data.role;
  },

  /**
   * Upload or replace currently authenticated user's profile avatar.
   * @param {File | Blob} file - Compressed image binary
   * @returns {Promise<{ user: object, avatarUrl: string, avatarMediaKey: string }>}
   */
  async uploadMyAvatar(file) {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("avatar", file);
    const result = await apiClient("/users/me/avatar", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Remove currently authenticated user's profile avatar.
   * @returns {Promise<{ user: object }>}
   */
  async deleteMyAvatar() {
    const result = await apiClient("/users/me/avatar", {
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Admin upload/replace avatar for target user.
   * @param {string} userId
   * @param {File | Blob} file
   * @returns {Promise<{ user: object, avatarUrl: string, avatarMediaKey: string }>}
   */
  async uploadUserAvatar(userId, file) {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("avatar", file);
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${userId}/avatar`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });
    return result.data;
  },

  /**
   * Admin remove avatar for target user.
   * @param {string} userId
   * @returns {Promise<{ user: object }>}
   */
  async deleteUserAvatar(userId) {
    const result = await apiClient(`/users/${userId}/avatar`, {
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    return result.data;
  },
};

// src/components/fleet/TruckCard.jsx
import { AlertTriangle, ChevronRight, Truck, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";

export default function TruckCard({
  truck,
  isSelected = false,
  onClick,
}) {
  const normalizedStatus = (truck.status || truck.operationalStatus || "").toUpperCase().replace("_", " ");

  const getStatusVariant = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "ACTIVE":
        return "success";
      case "UNDER MAINTENANCE":
        return "danger";
      case "INACTIVE":
        return "neutral";
      case "RETIRED":
        return "deactivated";
      default:
        return "neutral";
    }
  };

  const driverDisplay = truck.driver
    ? `${truck.driver.firstName || ""} ${truck.driver.lastName || ""}`.trim() || truck.driver.username
    : truck.driverName && truck.driverName !== "Unassigned" && truck.driverName !== "No Assigned"
    ? truck.driverName
    : "No Assigned";

  const currentOdo = Number(truck.currentOdometer) || 0;
  const lastPmOdo = Number(
    truck.lastPmOdometer !== undefined
      ? truck.lastPmOdometer
      : truck.lastPMOdometer || 0
  );
  const distanceSinceLastPm = Math.max(0, currentOdo - lastPmOdo);
  const isPmDue =
    truck.pmDueFlag !== undefined
      ? Boolean(truck.pmDueFlag)
      : truck.isPmDue !== undefined
      ? Boolean(truck.isPmDue)
      : distanceSinceLastPm >= 5000;
  const pmPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((distanceSinceLastPm / 5000) * 100));

  // Safety Inspection Advisory Derivation
  const latestInspection = truck.latestInspection || null;
  const inspectionResult = (
    truck.lastInspectionResult ||
    truck.latestInspectionResult ||
    latestInspection?.result ||
    (truck.hasPendingIssues ? "NEEDS_ATTENTION" : "") ||
    ""
  ).toUpperCase();

  const hasNeedsAttention = inspectionResult === "NEEDS_ATTENTION";
  const isDispatchRestricted =
    hasNeedsAttention &&
    (latestInspection?.allowDispatch === false || truck.allowDispatch === false);

  const advisoryTooltip = isDispatchRestricted
    ? `Safety inspection flagged items requiring attention — Dispatch restricted${
        latestInspection?.findings ? `: "${latestInspection.findings}"` : ""
      }`
    : `Safety inspection flagged items requiring attention${
        latestInspection?.findings ? `: "${latestInspection.findings}"` : ""
      }`;

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => onClick && onClick(truck)}
      className={`rounded-xl p-4 text-left transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between border shadow-2xs hover:shadow-xs ${
        isSelected
          ? "bg-[#F4F9FC] border-[#0A4B6E]/40 ring-1 ring-[#0A4B6E]/30"
          : "bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
      }`}
    >
      <div>
        {/* CARD TOP LINE: Plate & Operational Status */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 pb-2.5 border-b border-slate-100">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 font-bold shadow-2xs bg-[#0A4B6E] text-[#FFDF2C]">
              <Truck size={16} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-[#0A4B6E] tracking-wide truncate">
                {truck.plateNumber || `Truck #${truck.truckId || truck.id}`}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-normal truncate mt-0.5">
                {[
                  truck.model || "Isuzu Elf",
                  truck.yearModel ? `(${truck.yearModel})` : null,
                  truck.vehicleType ? truck.vehicleType.replace("_", " ") : null,
                ]
                  .filter(Boolean)
                  .join(" • ")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 flex-wrap justify-end">
            <Badge
              variant={getStatusVariant(normalizedStatus)}
              className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              {normalizedStatus || "ACTIVE"}
            </Badge>

            {isPmDue ? (
              <Badge variant="danger" className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold shrink-0">
                PM DUE
              </Badge>
            ) : distanceSinceLastPm >= 4000 ? (
              <Badge variant="warning" className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold shrink-0">
                NEAR
              </Badge>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CARD BODY METRICS */}
        <div className="space-y-2 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <UserRound size={13} className="text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>Assigned Driver:</span>
            </span>
            <span
              className={`truncate max-w-[65%] text-right ${
                driverDisplay !== "No Assigned" && driverDisplay !== "Unassigned"
                  ? "font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E]"
                  : "text-slate-400 italic"
              }`}
            >
              {driverDisplay}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Current Odometer:</span>
            <span className="font-bold font-mono text-[#0A4B6E] text-xs">
              {currentOdo.toLocaleString()} KM
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* PM Progress */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">PM Interval:</span>
              <span
                className={`font-semibold text-[11px] truncate text-right ${
                  isPmDue
                    ? "text-[#C93B32]"
                    : distanceSinceLastPm >= 4000
                    ? "text-amber-800"
                    : "text-[#0A4B6E]"
                }`}
              >
                {distanceSinceLastPm.toLocaleString()} / 5,000 KM ({pmPercent}%)
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200/50">
              <div
                className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                  isPmDue
                    ? "bg-[#CD3E3E]"
                    : distanceSinceLastPm >= 4000
                    ? "bg-[#F6C445]"
                    : "bg-[#0A4B6E]"
                }`}
                style={{ width: `${pmPercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CARD FOOTER */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 text-xs">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          {hasNeedsAttention ? (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-amber-200 truncate cursor-help"
              title={advisoryTooltip}
            >
              <AlertTriangle size={11} className="shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
              <span>{isDispatchRestricted ? "Needs Attention (Restricted)" : "Needs Attention"}</span>
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
              {truck.designatedRoute ? `Route: ${truck.designatedRoute}` : "Standard Route"}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#0A4B6E] flex items-center gap-0.5 hover:underline ml-2 shrink-0">
          <span>Details</span>
          <ChevronRight size={13} />
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// src/components/users/UserFormStep.jsx
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { User, KeyRound, AlertCircle, Phone, Calendar, Shield, Sparkles, Check } from "lucide-react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import { toProperCase } from "../../utils/text.js";

export default function UserFormStep({
  formData,
  setFormData,
  roles,
  user,
  statuses,
  errors = {},
  setErrors,
  submitError = "",
  setSubmitError,
  isSubmitting = false,
  onResetPassword,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}) {
  const clearFieldError = (field) => {
    if (errors && errors[field] && setErrors) {
      setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: "" }));
    }
    if (submitError && setSubmitError) {
      setSubmitError("");
    }
  };

  const handleNameChange = (field, value) => {
    const sanitized = value.replace(/[^\p{L}\s\-.']/gu, "");
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: sanitized }));
    clearFieldError(field);
  };

  // Normalize system roles list
  const normalizedRoles = useMemo(() => {
    if (roles && roles.length > 0) {
      return roles.map((r, idx) => ({
        id: typeof r === "object" && r.id ? String(r.id) : `role-${idx}`,
        name: typeof r === "object" && r.name ? r.name : String(r),
      }));
    }
    return [
      { id: "admin", name: "Admin" },
      { id: "driver", name: "Driver" },
      { id: "sales-person", name: "Sales Person" },
      { id: "sales-manager", name: "Sales Manager" },
      { id: "sales-supervisor", name: "Sales Supervisor" },
      { id: "logistics-supervisor", name: "Logistics Supervisor" },
      { id: "plant-supervisor", name: "Plant Supervisor" },
      { id: "fleet-manager", name: "Fleet Manager" },
    ];
  }, [roles]);

  // Resolve currently selected role IDs
  const selectedRoleIds = useMemo(() => {
    if (Array.isArray(formData.roleIds) && formData.roleIds.length > 0) {
      return formData.roleIds.map(String);
    }
    if (formData.roleId) {
      return [String(formData.roleId)];
    }
    if (formData.role) {
      const target = String(formData.role).toLowerCase();
      const match = normalizedRoles.find((r) => r.name.toLowerCase() === target);
      if (match) return [match.id];
    }
    return normalizedRoles[0] ? [normalizedRoles[0].id] : [];
  }, [formData.roleIds, formData.roleId, formData.role, normalizedRoles]);

  // Resolve effective primary role ID
  const effectivePrimaryId = useMemo(() => {
    if (formData.primaryRoleId && selectedRoleIds.includes(String(formData.primaryRoleId))) {
      return String(formData.primaryRoleId);
    }
    if (formData.roleId && selectedRoleIds.includes(String(formData.roleId))) {
      return String(formData.roleId);
    }
    return selectedRoleIds[0] || (normalizedRoles[0] ? normalizedRoles[0].id : "");
  }, [formData.primaryRoleId, formData.roleId, selectedRoleIds, normalizedRoles]);

  // Selected role objects
  const selectedRolesList = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedRoleIds.map((id) => {
      const match = normalizedRoles.find((r) => r.id === id);
      return {
        id,
        name: match ? match.name : id,
        isPrimary: id === effectivePrimaryId,
      };
    });
  }, [selectedRoleIds, effectivePrimaryId, normalizedRoles]);

  const handleToggleRole = (role) => {
    const isSelected = selectedRoleIds.includes(role.id);
    let nextRoleIds = [];
    let nextPrimaryId = effectivePrimaryId;

    if (isSelected) {
      if (selectedRoleIds.length === 1) {
        if (setErrors) {
          setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, role: "User must have at least one role assigned." }));
        }
        return;
      }
      nextRoleIds = selectedRoleIds.filter((id) => id !== role.id);
      if (nextPrimaryId === role.id) {
        nextPrimaryId = nextRoleIds[0];
      }
    } else {
      nextRoleIds = [...selectedRoleIds, role.id];
      if (!nextPrimaryId) {
        nextPrimaryId = role.id;
      }
    }

    const selectedObjs = nextRoleIds.map((id) => {
      const match = normalizedRoles.find((r) => r.id === id);
      return {
        id,
        name: match ? match.name : id,
        isPrimary: id === nextPrimaryId,
      };
    });
    const selectedNames = selectedObjs.map((r) => r.name);
    const primaryObj = selectedObjs.find((r) => r.id === nextPrimaryId) || selectedObjs[0];

    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      roleIds: nextRoleIds,
      primaryRoleId: nextPrimaryId,
      roleId: nextPrimaryId,
      role: primaryObj?.name || "Driver",
      roles: selectedObjs,
      roleNames: selectedNames,
    }));
    clearFieldError("role");
  };

  const handleSetPrimaryRole = (primaryId) => {
    const selectedObjs = selectedRoleIds.map((id) => {
      const match = normalizedRoles.find((r) => r.id === id);
      return {
        id,
        name: match ? match.name : id,
        isPrimary: id === primaryId,
      };
    });
    const selectedNames = selectedObjs.map((r) => r.name);
    const primaryObj = selectedObjs.find((r) => r.id === primaryId) || selectedObjs[0];

    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      primaryRoleId: primaryId,
      roleId: primaryId,
      role: primaryRoleObj?.name || prev.role,
      roles: selectedObjs,
      roleNames: selectedNames,
    }));
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      {submitError && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-medium p-3.5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fade-in">
          <AlertCircle size={16} className="shrink-0 text-red-600" />
          <span>{submitError}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CARD 1: Personal Information */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4.5 border border-slate-200/80 shadow-2xs space-y-3.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider">
          <User size={14} />
          <span>Personal Information</span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {/* First Name */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              First Name <span className="text-[#CD3E3E]">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              placeholder="e.g. Juan"
              value={formData.firstName}
              onChange={(e) => handleNameChange("firstName", e.target.value)}
              onBlur={(e) =>
                setFormData((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  firstName: toProperCase(e.target.value),
                }))
              }
              className={`w-full bg-white text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400 ${
                errors.firstName
                  ? "border-[#CD3E3E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-200"
                  : "border-slate-200 focus:border-[#0A4B6E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A4B6E]/10"
              }`}
            />
            {errors.firstName && (
              <p className="text-[#CD3E3E] text-[11px] mt-1 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertCircle size={12} className="shrink-0" />
                <span>{errors.firstName}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Last Name */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#0A4B6E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              Last Name <span className="text-[#CD3E3E]">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              placeholder="e.g. Dela Cruz"
